entities.description:
Ketrian Altronel was a Human female from the planet Hargeeva who joined the Alliance to Restore the Republic, convinced by her former fiancée Stevan Makintay to join, during the Galactic Civil War.

When the planet's rich mineral deposits, including coralline and ostrine, were discovered by the Galactic Empire, they subjugated the world, installing a garrison and advanced refineries. Ketrian Altronel discovered that crystalline manipulation and plas-bonding of certain trace elements of ostrine modified it, resulting in the mineral being able to instantly freeze objects that came in contact with it. She defected to the Rebel Alliance and added her ostrine-derived absorbent to the housings of X-wing cannons, improving their firepower.

entities.name: Serifa Altunen
entities.description:
Serifa Altunen was a female Arkanian Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order in the waning years of the Galactic Republic. When the Clone Wars broke out between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Altunen decided to leave the Order, believing that it should be serving the Force, not the Galactic Senate and its war.

Serifa Altunen was a Force-sensitive female Arkanian who trained in the ways of the Force under the Jedi Order. Ascending to the rank of Jedi Knight after completing her trials, Altunen went on to become well respected within the Order. When negotiations between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems broke down and the Clone Wars erupted across the galaxy.

As the war dragged on, Altunen became disenchanted with the Order's role in the war and the corruption in the Galactic Senate. Departing Coruscant, Altunen returned to her homeworld of Arkania where she began encouraging the Arkanian government to declare neutrality during the Clone Wars. When the Jedi High Council heard of this, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker were dispatched to persuade her to return to the Order and the war. Rendezvousing with Altunen on a watery tundra plain thirty months after the start of the war, Master Kenobi pleaded with the woman to return to the Jedi Temple. Taking off her Jedi robe and folding it, Altunen officially resigned from the Order, citing that she served the Force, and that she believed that the Jedi no longer did. With the conversation over, Altunen departed the company of her fellow Jedi and returned to her people.

Altunen received training from the Jedi Order and was able to pass the trials to become a Jedi Knight. Having earned a stature of respect, her opinion carried a strong weight towards the government of her homeworld.

entities.name: Alurali
entities.description:
Alurali was a female Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order in the years prior to the Clone Wars. Unlike most Jedi, Alurali was trained at the experimental Almas Academy in the Cularin system.

Born in the late waning years of the Galactic Republic, Alurali was discovered by the Jedi Order and entered into their experimental academy on the planet Almas as opposed to the main Temple on Coruscant. Passing through her early education, Alurali was selected by a Jedi Master to become a Padawan. Serving and learning from her master, Alurali became good friends with fellow Padawan Lora Nadad. Together, they set a philanthropic group of Jedi who worked to bring to light the harsh reality that plagued the Cularin system: some two thousand homeless orphans roamed the streets on several worlds. This group of children, collectively known as "the Lost," had been overlooked for many years but was given more attention through the Jedi's work. Alurali's master suggested that she take the Trials of Knighthood, which she passed; the Jedi High Council acknowledged her success and allowed the Almas Council to knight her.

entities.name: Naytha Alutana
entities.description:
Naytha Alutana was a female Twi'lek escort who lived during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. Alutana began life as a slave; she was eventually purchased from a slaving pen by Thurm Loogg, a senior Metatheran Cartel official, and she entered the service of the Cartel. In about 31 BBY, Loogg sent Alutana to act as an escort for Merik Darou, the assistant of Lavina Wren, the senator of the Cularin system, as part of a plan developed by Loogg to put the senator into his debt. Alutana spent some time with Darou on the planet Cularin, and she was with him when he entered a coma as a result of consuming some tainted ryll. The Twi'lek immediately called some private medical personnel and ensured that they took care of Darou, then traveled to a Cartel officer-cruiser to report to Loogg on Darou's condition.

Lavina Wren hired the Heroes of Cularin, a group of local freelance agents, to track down the drug dealer from which Darou had purchased the tainted ryll, and the agents flew to the officer-cruiser to meet with Alutana. Loogg and the Twi'lek met with the agents in Loogg's personal office, and Loogg agreed to allow Alutana to assist the agents with their investigation. She then provided them with the address of Kelkan D'vrosh, the dealer who had sold the ryll to Darou.

Despite being forced into slavery, Alutana was genuinely helpful and willing to serve others. However, she was fiercely loyal to Loogg due to the fact that he had rescued her from slavery, so she was only willing to help the freelance agents once Loogg had directed her to do so.

During the Galactic Civil War, Alva and her family were ambushed by Savrips on their journey to Fifth Wheel. Wearing survival gear and a homemade slugthrower rifle, Alva and Evun attempted to hold off the Savrips while Theel guarded the children.

entities.name: Alyson
entities.description:
Alyson was a female human. Around 4 BBY she, the Lasat Garazeb Orrelios, Lexim, Wad, and Greve were almost attacked by gundarks at Lexim's hunting ground.

Around 4 BBY, Greve brought his friends Alyson and Wad to Lexim's hunting ground on a forest planet in the Lothal sector to hunt gundarks. However, after arriving Lexim found he could not control the animals and soon the gundarks overran the facility. Lexim and the three patrons were forced into hiding within the facility while Lexim sent off a distress signal. Garazeb Orrelios, aboard the shuttle Phantom responded to the distress signal. However, he found the door locked and busted it down. Having unintentionally opened the door for the gundarks, the group soon came under attack by the creatures. Orrelios ordered the group deeper into the facility, finding shelter in the galley.

There Orrelios ordered the group to find weapons to arm themselves with, but instead they only found a broken rifle and a pair of spoons. Greve revealed that he had only brought Wad there to combat his fear of animals, which had not been helped by what they had been through. Orrelios confronted Lexim about not having prepared the facility for the gundark threat, but they were interrupted by the gundarks which broke through the floor. The group had to defend themselves again, with Alyson battling the gundarks with the broken rifle and was quickly overwhelmed. Lexim, the last one of them standing, took Orrelios' bo-rifle and took out the gundarks, freeing the group.

The group then decided to flee using the tunnel to the landing pad where Orrelios had left the Phantom. Greve, Alyson, and Wad all made it to the shuttle safely. They rendezvoused with the Ghost where Hera Syndulla suggested to Greve he take up other hobbies than hunting.

entities.name: Alyssia
entities.description:
Alyssia was a princess of the Hapan Royal House, a niece of Ta'a Chume, to whom she bore a close physical resemblance. She was also the younger sister of Chelik.

Regard as particularly cunning and ruthless even by the standards of the Hapan royal family, Alyssia had ambitions to become Queen Mother of Hapes, in pursuit of which she plotted against the families of both her aunt Ta'a Chume and her sister Chelik.

In 27 ABY, as the reigning Queen Mother Teneniel Djo was rapidly losing influence, Alyssia put her plans into action. She won the loyalty of Ta'a Chume's lover and advisor, the male courtesan Trisdin Gheer, which gave her insights into the plans of the ruling branch of the royal family, and to weaken the rival claim of her elder sister Chelik, she appears to have convinced Chelik's daughter to attempt the assassination of Prince Isolder.

In the end, her plotting was for naught, as her cousin Tenel Ka took the throne.

entities.name: Am
entities.description:
Am was a Force-sensitive human female clone who, like her twin brother Karre, was created through advanced cloning technology and the dark side of the Force. The two were raised from birth to become Dark Lords of a remnant of the Galactic Empire known as the T-Empire. At some point after the Battle of Exegol of 35 ABY, Am and Karre were on board a Gemini-class Star Destroyer as the final adjustments to its hyper cannon superweapon were being completed. When Am gave the order to fire the hyper cannon, she learned that its power core had been stolen, preventing it from charging. She quickly realized that Karre had stolen it and confronted him in a hangar as he tried to escape with it. With the help of his droid R-DUO, Karre stole a T-X-wing starfighter, which he piloted out of the Star Destroyer. Before he could escape, Am exited to the surface of the Star Destroyer and used the Force to pull Karre and the power core back to her. Both twins used the Force to fight for control of the core, which eventually shattered to reveal the kyber crystal within it, which soon also shattered and exploded.

In the aftermath of the explosion, Am and Karre both saw a vision of Am's death as a result of her using the crystal. Karre revealed that he had previously seen the vision and explained that he had stolen the kyber crystal to save Am. Karre warned her not to use the crystal's power, but she ignored him and placed it into her armor before attacking him with her lightwhips. Karre fought back, but Am knocked him off the Star Destroyer into space, where he was caught on his X-wing by R-DUO. As a result of her attacks, Am's armor overloaded and she lost control of it. To save her, Karre used the power of the X-wing's hyperdrive and destroyed the kyber crystal with his lightsaber. After he jumped to hyperspace, Am was left floating unconscious among debris from the Star Destroyer until she was rescued by her protocol droid, B-2ON.

entities.name: Amanoa
entities.description:
Amanoa was a Human female from the world of Onderon who was born in 4070 BBY. The daughter of a prominent nobleman, Amanoa enjoyed the wealth and privileges afforded to the Onderonian aristocracy, and eventually married into the planet's royal family as the wife of Onderon's King Ommin. The couple birthed a daughter named Galia, and together they lived in the royal palace of Onderon's capital city of Iziz. Amanoa's reign saw drastic changes in Onderon's role in the galaxy. Along with her husband, she was beguiled by the specter of the long-dead Dark Lord Freedon Nadd, to whom she became the Sith apprentice in her final years. As she and Ommin steeped themselves further in the dark side, both became masters of Sith sorcery, and used their magics to maintain rule over the Onderonian populace as dictated by four hundred years of tradition. When Ommin's health began to fail him as a result, Amanoa became the sovereign leader of Onderon, and imposed her will through the power of the dark side of the Force.

Amanoa's allegiance to the spirit of Freedon Nadd brought her into direct conflict with the Beast Riders of Onderon's wilderness, exiled citizens who refused to submit to the oppression of the Sith. Against the suggestions of Nadd, Amanoa entered into a protracted war with the Beast Riders, and was eventually forced to request help from the Jedi Order in hopes of bringing a peaceful resolution to conflict. However, it was through her petition that Amanoa's clandestine activities under Nadd's tutelage came to light. She was defeated by Jedi Master Arca Jeth and his apprentices, and died when they drove the Dark Lord's influence from Iziz. When Amanoa's husband was killed in battle with the same Jedi two years later, the once-proud queen of Onderon was interred alongside him and their Sith Master in a burial temple on Onderon's jungle moon, Dxun.

Amanoa was an Onderonian and the daughter of a wealthy noble; she was born in 4070 BBY. When Ommin's father became one with the Force, Ommin took his rightful place as the king of Onderon and ruler of Iziz. The new King married Lady Amanoa as his queen and together they had a daughter named Galia. As a direct descendant of Freedon Nadd, King Ommin rose to power like his ancestors by dominating the citizens of Onderon with the power of the dark side.

entities.name: Keturah Ambar
entities.description:
Keturah Ambar was born and raised on the moon Neftali, where she met and married her husband, Drexler Ambar. The couple had a family of seven sons and a daughter, and ran Ambar's Big Game, Tackle, and Gear Shop. On the evening of the Ambars' sixtieth wedding anniversary, Drexler went out to check the ice pools and traps and never returned. Searches for Ambar found nothing, but Keturah refused to give up on her husband. For ten years, Keturah hiked to the top of the Orane Mountain to watch for signs of Ambar. Because of her vigil, the top of the Orane Mountain became known as Keturah's Point. Keturah's routine left her nearly blind and disabled due to overexposure to Neftali's freezing temperatures. She spent her time in the back of the family-run shop, knitting and entertaining children with stories of her husband's hunting expeditions and how the animals got their names.

Ameé was a female individual who was born on the Mid Rim planet Naboo around 54 BBY. In 40 BBY, they began serving as the Queen of Naboo for the Royal House of Naboo after their predecessor, Queen Ekay, left the position. That year, Princess Fanry of the Inner Rim planet Pijal considered inviting Ameé and other young galactic leaders to her world for a summit. However, her lord regent Rael Averross rejected the idea. Days later, Fanry decried democracy after seizing absolute power at her coronation, insisting that she wished to become a warrior queen, similar to Ameé and other queens of Naboo, on behalf of her people. In 36 BBY, Ameé left their position as Naboo's monarch, and Queen Réillata took their place.

Ameé was first mentioned, albeit indirectly, in Master & Apprentice, a 2019 novel written by Claudia Gray.

entities.name: Xiaan Amersu
entities.description:
Xiaan Amersu was a female Rutian Twi'lek Jedi Knight who fought during the Clone Wars. She was the Padawan of J'Mikel, an Anx Jedi she saw killed by the bounty hunter Aurra Sing. Amersu was later put in care of Jedi physicians to free her mind of the horror she witnessed. Afterwards, she met with Quinlan Vos in the Mediation Garden within the Coruscant Jedi Temple and gifted Vos the Heart of Fire so that he could use his ability of psychometry to remember his Padawan, Aayla Secura.

By the time of the Clone Wars, Amersu had reached the rank of Jedi Knight. During the Siege of Saleucami, she flew as Blue Leader and sacrificed herself and her fighter to eliminate a Separatist planetary gun.

A member of the Jedi Order, Xiaan Amersu was a Twi'lek female from the planet Ryloth. Whilst in the Jedi Temple located on the planet Coruscant, Amersu was approached by Padawan Aayla Secura who presented her with a Heart of Fire, a stone that Secura's master had given her during her training.

In 30 BBY, the pair were exploring the Coruscant underworld in the Temple Precinct with Master Peerce searching for the bounty hunter Aurra Sing. They followed a trail of blood, coming across the corpses of four Republic Peace Officers killed by Sing. J'Mikel apologized to Amersu on the matters of seeing the tragic scene, with Amersu remarking that the officers were with the Force. The group split up, with Peerce finding the missing fifth Duros Republic Peace Officer tied up.

entities.name: Tawni Ames
entities.description:
Tawni Ames was a female human who served as the governor of Desix during the Imperial Era.

During the Clone Wars, Tawni Ames and her homeworld of Desix sided with the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Ames would work with the Separatist Senate, and when her colleague, Senator Mina Bonteri of Onderon put forth the Confederate–Republic peace initiative, a treaty suggesting the beginning of peace negotiations between the Galactic Republic and the Separatist movement, Ames supported her. The failure of this attempt for peace convinced Ames that the Republic never intended for the war to actually end and enforced her faith in the Separatist Count Dooku's movement.

Following the Proclamation of the New Order and the Republic's transformation into the Galactic Empire, Ames led her planet into independence, serving as the governor. In the months following the rise of the Empire sent the first Imperial governor, Grotton, to assume his position in Desix City. Ames refused to surrender her planet to the Empire, claiming that Desix had separated from the Empire's predecessor early in the war and that the Imperial government had therefore no claim to the planet. Ignoring Grotton's objections, she ordered a contingent of B1-series battle droids from the planet's army to take him and his TK stormtrooper escort into custody.

When news of the governor's kidnapping reached Coruscant, Vice Admiral Rampart tasked genetically defective clone CT-9904 "Crosshair" and clone stormtrooper commander CC-2224 "Cody" to extract him from his captivity in Desix City and restore Imperial order to the planet. Despite the mission being disguised as a diplomatic convoy, Ames correctly guessed its military nature and had her T-series droid commander order the shuttle carrying Cody's unit shot down. She then took Grotton with her to the city's Bell Tower as the surviving clones from the extraction team were ambushing her forces outside. Eventually, Crosshair, Cody, "Nova," and "Wyler" reached the Bell Tower's steps, at which point Tawni ordered her remaining BX-series droid commando droids and droidekas to attack them. Cody and Crosshair took down the droids and the T-series commander in one shot from Crosshair's sniper rifle with the help of Cody, throwing one of Crosshair's mirror discs.

Ayama was excited, and said she hoped to construct a saberstaff.

entities.name: Padmé Amidala Naberrie
entities.description:
Padmé Amidala Naberrie, also simply known as Padmé Amidala, was a human female politician who represented the people of Naboo during the final years of the Galactic Republic. Prior to her career as a senator in the Galactic Senate, Amidala was the elected ruler of the Royal House of Naboo. A political idealist, she advocated for the preservation of democracy as well as a peaceful resolution to the Clone Wars. However, her secret marriage to the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker would have a lasting effect on the future of the galaxy for decades to come.

Born in 46 BBY during the Age of the Republic, Padmé Naberrie was raised by her parents, Ruwee Naberrie and his wife Jobal, on the peaceful Mid Rim world of Naboo. Despite the humble background of the Naberrie family, Padmé was identified early for her potential in public service. Devoting her life to civic duty, she was elected queen and, therefore, adopted the regnal name "Amidala" in 32 BBY. Due to the machinations of her advisor, Senator Sheev Palpatine, Amidala's reign was put to the test by the Trade Federation's blockade and subsequent invasion of Naboo. Unable to fight the Federation's army of battle droids without assistance, the queen beseeched the Galactic Senate on Coruscant for help, only to see her efforts hampered by bureaucracy and procedure. Although she ultimately liberated her homeworld with the help of the Jedi Order and the Gungan Grand Army, her decision to cast a Vote of No Confidence against Finis Valorum enabled Palpatine to become the Supreme Chancellor.

Following her reign, Amidala joined the Senate and struggled to resolve the Separatist Crisis through diplomacy, becoming a leading voice in the Loyalist Committee by 22 BBY. After surviving an assassination attempt planned by the Trade Federation, she was removed from the capital and sent back to Naboo under the protection of Padawan Anakin Skywalker. Though the Jedi Code forbade personal relationships, deeming attachment, and possession unbecoming of a Jedi, the two gradually became closer as their feelings for each other grew. In the aftermath of the First Battle of Geonosis, Amidala secretly married her Jedi protector, despite her own reservations about their relationship and the consequences they would face if the truth ever came to light. Their subsequent interactions were limited throughout the Clone Wars, with Amidala continuing to advocate peaceful solutions in the Senate while Skywalker served on the front lines as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic.

The aim of the spacer was to retrieve a R2 unit motivator that was used in this podracer. Both Imperial Commander Barrezz and Rebel Captain Bastra dispatched agents to find the parts of that R2 unit.

An'Kwee appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, An'Kwee was added to the game as part of the "Legacy Quest" with the release of the "Publish 25," a.k.a. the "New Game Enhancements," on November 15, 2005.

entities.description:
Anachro the H'uun, or Anachro the Hutt, was a female H'uun (a low-caste Hutt) who lived on Tatooine during the time of the Galactic Civil War. She was the daughter of Orko and wife of Gorga, Orko's nemesis. To impress Orko and gain permission to marry Anachro, Gorga hired Boba Fett to capture Bar-Kooda. Fett succeeded, and Anachro married Gorga. Nevertheless, the animosity between Orko and Gorga remained, much to Anachro's frustration.

While honeymooning on Skeebo, Anachro was kidnapped by slavers for a million-credit ransom. Gorga once again hired Fett's services following his killing of the pirate Toxus Li. This time, Gorga paid Fett to rescue Anachro. Orko, meanwhile, suspected the entire affair to be Gorga's doing and went to Skeebo as well.

Unbeknownst to either Hutt was the imminent arrival Ry-Kooda, who was seeking revenge for the death of Bar-Kooda, his brother. Despite the conflagration of Hutts, Skavers, and Ry-Kooda, Boba Fett was successful—albeit in an unusual way. Fett attempted to lift Anachro from his swoop suspended from cables, but her weight proved to be too much—she nearly strangled on the cables as well. Fett dropped her into a mine car and she rolled all the way to the exit, where she was launched through the air to land upon a cluster of Skavers. Although flustered and terrified, she was all right.

Anachro later gave birth to Gorga's child.

Facet was Executive Personnel Officer at the Imperial Research Station on the planet Toprawa and an associate of Havet Storm. Storm used this relationship with Facet to gain access to the Death Star Superlaser schematics her father had been working on. Storm then passed these plans onto the Rebellion. For this betrayal, Facet sought revenge.

Disguised as an assassin named Diamond, Facet attacked Havet and some Rebel forces on Toprawa with a unit of Stormtroopers. She killed the Rebel leader Vermilion, but was wounded by Havet.

Despite her wounds, Facet managed to escape from the Imperial base before the Rebels demolished it to cover their tracks.

During the Life Day festivities of 1 ABY, Anarra resided on Endor and on Yavin 4 with her family. Her family included Oraalarri, Radrrl and Tebeurra.

Oraalarri would have spacers speak to Anarra and other members of her family to learn more about Life Day. Though naturally sympathetic to the Rebellion, due to the Empire's enslavement of her species, she, like the rest of her family, welcomed Imperials to their home. They told these Imperials that while they themselves may not be bad people, corruption and darkness would consume them as they grow more powerful within the Empire.

Anarra was a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the MMORPG Star Wars Galaxies. During the Life Day event of 2004, players could talk to Anarra on either Endor or Yavin 4 to learn about Life Day.

entities.name: Tal Anavere
entities.description:
Tal Anavere was a female Ho'Din with an abiding passion for art. Alive during the Galactic Civil War, Anavere witnessed the Galactic Empire's policies crushing free expression in numerous star systems, particularly among primitive cultures for whose art she bore a particular affinity. Those policies led Anavere to revile the Empire and drove her to support the Alliance to Restore the Republic. Anavere established herself as an art dealer who traded pieces created by important members of the Imperial bureaucracy. She used her influence with such clients to extract intelligence that she passed on to the Alliance. In the period between the battles of Yavin and Endor, Anavere had begun to use addictive Ho'Din herbal teas to exert greater influence over her marks. The technique raised some concerns for General Airen Cracken of Alliance Intelligence, but he allowed her to continue working for the Alliance due to her ongoing effectiveness.

Tal Anavere was a female Ho'Din, born around the year 70 BBY. She developed a passion for galactic art, with a particular affinity for artworks from pre-technological civilizations. Under the regime of the Galactic Empire, Anavere witnessed the artistic traditions of primitive cultures in many star systems curtailed or destroyed by Imperial slavery or domination. Believing the policies of the Empire crushed freedom of expression, Anavere became a con artist, gambler, and thief, eventually affiliating herself with the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

As a Rebel operative, Anavere operated as an art dealer and specialized in trading artworks created by important members of the Imperial bureaucracy—there being no market in the Empire for her preferred, pre-technological art forms. Many of those Imperials, jaded by the experience of individuals purchasing their art simply to curry favor, came to trust Anavere as she made them feel their works were being purchased by individuals with a genuine interest in the pieces. Anavere used her positions of trust to gather intelligence for the Rebel Alliance, but she also took more direct action to remove bounties placed on Rebel heads and arrange amnesties. Anavere avoided reprisals from the Empire by utilizing multiple aliases, erasing records of her previous activities and, on occasion, faking reports of her own death.

In the period between the Battle of Yavin in 0 ABY and the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY, Anavere established an art gallery, "Sophistication", on Obroa-skai, She also began using slightly addictive blends of Ho'Din herbal teas on her Imperial marks to increase her influence over them. That technique came to the attention of Airen Cracken, a general and member of Alliance Intelligence. Cracken was one of several high-ranking Alliance members who expressed reservations over Anavere's use of herbal teas; however, Cracken respected her abilities enough to include a file on the Ho'Din in his datafile on useful Alliance operatives.

entities.name: Talena Ancia
entities.description:
Talena Ancia was a female Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Galactic War with the reconstituted Sith Empire. Wielding two lightsabers in combat, she was one of the commanders of the Republic forces on the planet Voss.

Master Talena Ancia was first added to the video game Star Wars: The Old Republic as part of the Digital Expansion Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds, which added Conquest Commanders to most of the dual-faction worlds. Ancia is a rare NPC enemy, and her place at Kri-Ta Outpost on Voss is frequently occupied by a generic Veteran Jedi Battlemaster. However, her character model is glitched; she is incorrectly generated as wearing the male version of the outfit used by female Jedi Conquest Commanders. As a result, the outfit is far too large, and only the top of her head—for which hair is not generated, as the outfit is hooded—can be seen.

entities.name: Jioie Ancum
entities.description:
Jioie Ancum was a Human female who supported the Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Jioie was a native of Tuttin IV and she accompanied her husband, Tendis Ancum, who had taken a job as a foreman at a factory on Beltrix III when the Empire took over Tuttin IV, as his assistant. Their jobs were cover for their role in the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The two left their son, Ryley Ancum, in the care of Shran Etison. Unaware of his parents' role in the Rebellion, Ryley used his music to send codes to Keth Beamis on Beltrix III. Onjo Fegel, an Imperial spy from Tuttin IV, tried to infiltrate the Agency as a member of the Far Cry band, but Ryley Ancum managed to warn the Rebels ahead of time and foil Fegel's plans. Ryley was delighted and surprised at his audition to learn the cell leaders were his parents and Tet Tramys, his music teacher. He did nothing to show that he recognized them, preserving their cover.

entities.name: Anda
entities.description:
Anda was a female Human who was a supporter of General Vaklu and a political extremist during the lead-up to the Onderon Civil War.

In 3951 BBY, she offered Meetra Surik twenty-five hundred credits for each of three Royalist captains that could be convinced to leave their stations, allowing Vaklu's forces to attack the Iziz Royal Palace with less resistance when fighting broke out. The three captains were Gelesi, Riiken, and Bostuco.

It is possible that Anda only talks to Surik if the player decides to support Vaklu instead of Queen Talia. If so, Surik convinces Gelesi to step down by reminding him of possible harm to his wife and children, she slices a terminal near the Sky Ramp, causing a power surge that kills Bostuco, and arranges to have Riiken dishonorably discharged. Surik could also kill Riiken when he is patrolling near the cantina. However Surik must do this when she and Riiken are alone.

entities.name: Jalice Andit
entities.description:
Jalice Andit was a human female mercenary from the moon Jedha who lived in Jedha City with her husband, Joali Andit. The pair were loosely aligned with resistance fighter Saw Gerrera's partisans and aided them in their fight against the Galactic Empire, although the couple cared more about violence and getting paid than Gerrera's ideals.

After Jalice stole a crate of kyber crystals from a lost pilgrim, Gerrera's men took the crate from her. In exchange for several artifacts, Jalice then provided the location of the stronghold where the partisans had taken the crate to an Imperial spy who was searching for the crystals.

In 1 BBY, Jalice stood in the crowds in Tythoni Square in Jedha City shortly before the partisans ambushed a group of Imperials there. Jedha City was then destroyed by the Death Star superweapon shortly after the ambush.

Jalice Andit was a human female from the moon Jedha who married the human Joali Andit and worked with him as a two-person mercenary team. Jalice also worked as a merchant, selling scavenged goods and arms. The pair came to Jedha to fight alongside the partisans led by resistance fighter Saw Gerrera, aiding them in their fight against the Empire for the thrills and credits. The couple lived together in Jedha City on the moon during its occupation by the Galactic Empire and took full advantage of the permanent chaos that prevailed there. Only loosely aligned with the partisans, they aided them in the city so long as they were allowed to participate in any outbreaks of violence and kept getting paid.

entities.name: Maarva Carassi Andor
entities.description:
Maarva Carassi Andor was a human female who lived during the final decades of the Galactic Republic and into the era of the Galactic Empire. On her homeworld, Maarva was a member of the Daughters of Ferrix and was revered by the members of her community. Alongside her husband, Clem, Maarva became the adoptive mother of Cassian Andor, whom they rescued while scavenging on the planet Kenari. After Clem was hanged by the Empire, she became scared and disapproved of Cassian's rebellious streak despite her contempt for the Empire.

Unbeknownst to her, her son became involved with the Axis network and participated in the Aldhani heist. The event and the Imperial occupation of Ferrix rekindled her spirit. Refusing Cassian's invitation to start over somewhere else, Maarva remained in her home with her droid, B2EMO, and pledged the waning months of her life to fighting the fascist government. Before she died of an illness while her son was incarcerated on Narkina 5, she recorded a speech for her funeral that inspired her fellow residents of Ferrix to fight the Empire. Cassian Andor subsequently committed himself to the rebel cause and aided in the theft of the Death Star plans.

Maarva Carassi Andor was a human female who was born around 82 BBY and hailed from the planet Ferrix which was located in the Free Trade sector. Around 76 BBY, when Maarva was six according to her memories, she attended her first funeral alongside her sister, in which they held hands as they walked Fountain Square. During the service, she also felt the musical customs and history of Ferrix, as well as touching her first funerary stone. At some point, Maarva married Clem, and the two worked as scavengers, making salvage runs to scattered worlds and bring back unclaimed tech to their homeworld.

Prior to the Clone Wars, around the year 24 BBY, Maarva and Clem, alongside their droid, B2EMO, were salvaging around the Mid Rim planet Kenari when a starship crashed onto the planet's surface. Hoping to get their hands on a console unit, the three landed their ship on Kenari and entered the fallen starship with masks, as toxic air was fuming from outside, which had killed the officers onboard the ship, all of whom carried the emblem of the future Confederacy of Independent Systems.

She was the founder and sole member of the Preserve Our Wild Endangered Resources Party, and with the aide of the criminal Denetrus, she helped Qui-Gon Jinn and Obi-Wan Kenobi foil Xanatos' plot to bring Offworld Mining Corporation onto Telos. She later married Denetrus and, with the Chun family, helped develop the BioCruiser.

entities.name: Momi Andrell
entities.description:
Momi Andrell was a wealthy Human female who was the daughter of Senator Wain Andrell and part of a group of animal rights activists that served the Galactic Republic during the Cold War.

In 3643 BBY, she went on a mission to the planet Nar Shaddaa to save the Shanjaru, a race of non-sentient creatures that were driven to near extinction. Momi was upset to learn how Drooga the Hutt was planning on using the shanjaru as part of his feast. She violently opposed him and all those who abused the shanjaru. In order to save the last of these species, she began to spend her father's wealth by hiring mercenaries, including her friend Tyrka, to save the Shanjaru and repopulate them, leaving Drooga a three-hour long holorecording diatribe. She then went to meet with Doctor Lazhae, believing he would help her smuggle the shanjaru offworld, but the doctor betrayed her, desiring to experiment on the shanjaru, believing it be evidence of evolving sapience.

During her imprisonment by the mad doctor, Momi was used for horrifying experiments, so as to avoid experimenting on Lazhae's "smart" vrblthers. As a smuggler came to stop the doctor and find the male shanjaru to deliver to Drooga, Momi was injected by incurable diseases. The smuggler promised to save her and end the Doctor's experiments, but Momi didn't care about revenge since she wanted to die for everything that has happened to her. The Doctor was willing to pay the smuggler in order to keep the samples, but Momi begged the smuggler to recover them from the mad doctor. The smuggler ordered the doctor to hand the samples and asked him to run. After the doctor, Momi thanked the smuggler for everything and asked the spacer to deliver the samples to the Senate Tower on Coruscant where Daru'da can clone the shanjaru. She then begged the smuggler to end her life since she wanted to be put out from her misery. The smuggler told her not to lose hope since Momi's father could offer treatment to her. Momi accepted and would try to make it back.

Momi's father later sent a message to the smuggler that she is being treated by the best scientists in the galaxy in hopes of curing her, while simultaneously her extremist goals were put on hold.

entities.name: Lesle Andreya
entities.description:
Lesle Andreya was a female Human from the planet Neree. One of the Rebellion's top agents, she prevented several Imperial ambushes on her fellow Rebels. She continued to serve under General Airen Cracken's leadership when the Rebellion matured into the New Republic in 4 ABY before eventually turning traitor in 7 ABY.

At that time, she stole computer files and fled to the planet Nal Hutta. The New Republic believed she then traveled to a sector under Imperial control intending to sell the plans to the highest bidder. Cracken wrote about Andreya in his dossier, Wanted by Cracken, noting her great skill and cautioning agents to be careful and potentially start their search in the planet Tatooine's city of Mos Eisley.

Lesle Andreya, who hailed from the planet Neree, was a Human woman born Andreya continued to work for the fledgling government.

Around 7 ABY, The New Republic Intelligence Service believed that she obtained transport from there to an Imperial-controlled sector, where they believed she was planning to sell the information for as many credits as possible. As such, she was wanted by the New Republic for the charges of bribery, espionage, extortion, sabotage, theft, and treason, prompting the government to post a reward of fifteen thousand credits for her capture.

Jestra Andrim was a female individual who was a member of House Andrim, a Kuati noble house. At some point during the reign of the Galactic Empire, House Andrim sent an operative to the Belgaroth system, to spy on some weapons tests that were to be performed by the Star Destroyers Burning Vengeance and Legacy. To collect the data that their operative had recovered, Jestra approached a group of agents that were stopping over on Kuat and requested that they perform a courier mission for her. She then invited the agents to an evening party in House Andrim's manor on the surface of Kuat, where she discussed with them the details of the assignment, then dispatched them to the Belgaroth system.

entities.description:
Venra Andsof was a female Lorrdian diplomat who served as the assistant to the ambassador Milac Troper. At some point during galactic history, Andsof accompanied Troper to the herdship Galactic Horizon, to attend some peace talks. However, the former scout Dayla Kev hijacked the conference, seeking revenge against Troper for abandoning her to die on a jungle world many years earlier. Kev and her allies released various dangerous predators aboard the ship, driving Andsof, Troper and several of their security guards deep into the jungle biosphere of the ship, while falling under constant attack from the creatures.

entities.name: Anduvil
entities.description:
Anduvil was a female Ogemite who worked with the Rebel Alliance as an intelligence operative. While working for the Rebels, Anduvil stumbled upon a mysterious outbreak of Bledsoe's disease that appeared to be connected to the destruction of nearby Rebel outposts. Unable to surmise the connection between the devastating outbreaks and the Imperial attacks, she contacted Alliance Command, who sent the Rebel pilot Luke Skywalker to investigate. After following the trail to the Outer Rim world of Tatooine, Anduvil met Skywalker in Mos Eisley and relayed the information to him just as Bledsoe's disease began to infect the city.

The two Rebels evacuated the city, but Skywalker still ended up contracting the virus, and they were captured by Imperial stormtroopers, who brought them back to their base. After escaping their captors, Anduvil and Skywalker forced the Imperial Doctor Kaaldar to cure Skywalker and reveal that they were behind the Bledsoe's disease outbreaks, which they were using as a method to communicate the location of nearby Rebel bases. In Skywalker's starship, Anduvil and the Rebel pilot escaped Tatooine with an Imperial hostage, determined to make him reveal the Empire's role in the disease outbreak. Following the mission, Anduvil began a short-lived relationship with Skywalker, but eventually his devotion to the Alliance caused the relationship to end, and they parted ways.

Anduvil was an Ogemite Anduvil seemed destined for a life outside of the trading business until the timely death of her father. Anduvil's father contracted Bledsoe's disease, an extremely contagious and deadly disease, and eventually succumbed to the ailment. As her father's only child, Anduvil inherited his business and became one of the few female Ogemite traders.

Although Ogem was known to be concerned solely with profits, refusing to get involved in galactic politics, many Ogemites joined the Rebellion, claiming that the Empire had overextended its credit, and relying on the Rebels to pay in cash. Anduvil was among the number of Ogemites to ally with the Rebellion, and she went to work as an intelligence agent, bringing valuable information to Alliance Command. Although allied with the Rebels, she still maintained separation from the group, working as an independent smuggler.

entities.name: Orqiti Aneofo
entities.description:
Orqiti Aneofo was a merchant who resided in the city of Bestine on Tatooine during the Galactic Civil War.

Sometime after 0 BBY, Orqiti worked out of a merchant area in Bestine, alongside her Jawa associate. During the elections in Bestine between Sean Trenwell and Victor Visalis, Orqiti encountered a spacer who she mistook as an individual interested in collecting influx capacitors. After listening to the Jawa for clarification, she learned that the spacer was not the one she was waiting for. Nonetheless, she used the chance to encourage the spacer to vote for Sean Trenwell as Bestine's Director of Commerce so that the marketplace in the city could thrive.

Orqiti Aneofo was a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the MMORPG Star Wars Galaxies. She often appeared next to a Jawa in the Bestine marketplace, and would encourage players to vote for Sean Trenwell. Though her appearance and gender were consistent in the game, her name was actually randomly generated. However, the randomly generated name, Orqiti Aneofo, appeared in the Star Wars Galaxies Friday Feature named [https://web.archive.org/web/20040316050620/http://starwarsgalaxies.station.sony.com/content.jsp?page=Bestine%20Politics Bestine Politics]. Since the feature is an official source, this suggests that the name Orqiti Aneofo is the most canon version of her name.

entities.name: Aneth
entities.description:
Aneth was a human female who owned and operated the Mina-Rau General Store on the planet Mina-Rau with her spouse, Kellen. She disapproved of their daughter, Beela, seeing the undocumented toolie Wilmon Paak and unsuccessfully urged her to stay away from him. In 4 BBY, the Galactic Empire began an Imperial Supply Census of Mina-Rau and Imperials visited the store, making Aneth nervous.

The next day, they returned, and Aneth put on a false smile for Imperial Lieutenant Krole when she spoke with him, although she sharply sent Beela inside when her daughter caught the lieutenant's eye. The Imperials then captured Paak's fellow toolie Brasso in front of the store and killed him before being killed themselves by Paak and Brasso's ally Cassian Andor.

Aneth was a human and ran the Mina-Rau General Store with her The couple had a daughter, Beela, who aided them in the shop alongside a P1 adminmech droid Between 5 BBY and 4 BBY, a group of undocumented toolies without visas or shares on Mina-Rau illegally settled down nearby to carry out repairs and befriended Kellen.

Beela became infatuated with Wilmon Paak, a member of the group, but Aneth did not like him visiting her daughter at the store due to his illegal status and urged her to stay away from him. To get around this, Beela would often find excuses during the workday to bring water or supplies to Paak, who knew that Aneth disapproved of Beela seeing him. In 4 BBY, Beela brought water to Paak and his friend Bix Caleen while they were working in one of the fields, prompting Paak to explain to Caleen that Aneth disliked his and Beela's relationship.

entities.description:
Aneé-san was a Twi'lek Sith who worked as a bodyguard for Anzellan gangster Que-Dama, wielding a red-bladed lightsaber. known as the Ronin.

Aneé-san appeared in "The Duel: Payback", a non-canon short film directed by Takanobu Mizuno that released as part of the third volume of the Star Wars: Visions series. The animated short, produced by Kamikaze Douga and ANIMA, The character was first introduced at the Star Wars: Visions panel at Celebration Japan on April 19, 2025. The spelling of her name was confirmed in a StarWars.com article published on April 25 of that year. She is voiced by Takako Honda in the original Japanese version and by Suzy Nakamura in the English dub. Concept art of Aneé-san was created by Takashi Okazaki. However, other sources only describe her as a Sith.

entities.description:
Angela was a Human female who lived on the planet of Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

By the time of the Battle of Yavin, Angela lived in Coronet City with her husband Ilyamo.

In 1 ABY, Ilyamo and Angela went to Doaba Guerfel because Ilyamo wanted to go hiking. Ilyamo joined a group who went hiking in the Thaos Mountains with the ranger Myron Beech. However, the group suddenly disappeared. Desperate, she begged a spacer, sent by Commander Talte of the Corellian Security Force, to find him. an anti-government and criminal group. The CorSec eventually assaulted the cave where the hostages were kept and freed the hostages, including Ilyamo.

Some time later, Angela highly recommended the spacer who rescued her husband to her friend Madison Silene after her husband Kyran also disappeared.

Anger was one of five female Force Priestesses who had sustained their consciousness in the Force after death and dwelt on the Wellspring of Life. Anger expressed the emotion anger during his mystical exploration of The Force.

Like her four other forms, whom she referred to as cousins, Anger was Force-sensitive and possessed the ability to shape-shift. She had yellow eyes and gray skin, both of which were manifestations, and was 1.85 meters (6 feet, 1 inch) tall.

The Force Priestess was first introduced in "Destiny", the twelfth episode of the sixth season of the animated series Star Wars: The Clone Wars. Like the other four Force Priestesses, Anger's voice was provided by American actress Jaime King.

entities.name: Darial Anglethorn
entities.description:
Darial Anglethorn was a female Human moisture farmer and peacekeeper who later became her homeworld of Beheboth's first representative in the New Republic Senate. Anglethorn owned and operated the largest moisture farm on Beheboth, and when the arid world's farmers came under threat by brigand raids in 3 ABY, Anglethorn organized and led the defense efforts, and later joined with Rebel hero Luke Skywalker to play a key role in the brigands' defeat. Anglethorn later became elected peacekeeper of the town of Prosperity, while continuing to operate her farm and serve in the New Republic Senate. Mildly Force-sensitive, unbeknownst to her, she later called on Skywalker again in 8 ABY, to help investigate the mysterious death of a man found on her farm.

A Human female, Darial Anglethorn ran the biggest moisture farm on her homeworld, the arid planet Beheboth, during the Galactic Civil War. Around 3 ABY, many of the surrounding farms and homes started to be raided by mysterious brigands, who would arrive completely unseen and steal every drop of water they had. Anglethorn's farm was later to be targeted, during which time Anglethorn stepped into a leadership role in the nearby community of Garrotine, providing water to those left bereft by the brigands' attacks and coordinating their defense efforts. This came at considerable expense to Anglethorn—having already invested heavily in providing her farm with the best technology money could buy, she transformed her farm into something akin to a military fort, with high walls and multiple lines of defense. At the height of these raids, Anglethorn happened into a cantina where she broke up a brewing fight between a group of locals and an offworlder named Luke Skywalker, who had drawn their suspicion. Impressed with how Skywalker handled himself, Anglethorn offered the stranger a job guarding her farm, expecting a brigand attack to come.

Skywalker accepted, but the offworlder was only on-site for a few hours before the brigands finally struck Anglethorn's farm—up late sharing a mug of hot chav with Skywalker, Anglethorn was rendered unconscious by a mysterious force and carried off to the brigands' hideaway. There, she learned her enemy's true nature—led by a ruthless bandit named Gideon Longspar, the brigands struck using a unique creature called the Tirrith, an empathic gaseous culture of hive-minded sentient particles. Longspar compelled the Tirrith's obedience by imprisoning part of the creature and threatening it with harm, but the sympathetic Tirrith later helped free Anglethorn and Skywalker from their prison cell, and aided them in destroying Longspar's gang—Anglethorn reluctantly struck the killing blow, destroying a tank filled with all of the brigands' collected water to cause a flood that buried the raiders. Although Anglethorn feared for her planet's future after sacrificing so much precious moisture, the Tirrith paid off her faith by seeding Beheboth's clouds and causing heavy rain for the first time in generations.

entities.description:
Anglu was a Twi'lek who was a swoop pilot for the Hidden Beks. They attended the Tarisian Season Opener and talked to the former Sith Lord Revan there. They fled shortly thereafter when a fight broke out between Black Vulkar leader Brejik and Revan.

Anglu was a Twi'lek female who operated as a swoop pilot for the swoop gang Hidden Beks on the Outer Rim planet Taris during the Jedi Civil War During 3956 BBY, they attended the Tarisian Season Opener in which then amnesiac former Sith Lord Revan competed against the Black Vulkar swoop pilot Redros for Jedi Bastila Shan as a prize.

During the Season opener, Revan talked to Anglu, with them admitting to not understanding why new swoop riders make their starts in the biggest races of the year. Anglu then told Revan about his swoops chance to explode due to the prototype swoop accelerator installed on it.

After Revan won the swoop race, Black Vulkar leader Brejik accused Revan of cheating in the race. Cutting Brejik's boasting short, Shan was able to escape from the cage she was kept in and defeated the guard near her. Brejik called for Shan and Revan to killed and Anglu fled shortly thereafter.

entities.name: Aniseya
entities.description:
Mother Aniseya was a human female who lived during the High Republic Era. She led an exiled coven of witches and eventually settled the group on the planet Brendok after they had suffered persecution for some time. Around 156 BBY, Mother Aniseya created the twin children Mae-ho and Verosha Aniseya, who were then carried until their birth by Mother Koril. Mother Aniseya and Koril raised the sisters together as their mothers, though the pair often disagreed on how to raise the twins.

In 148 BBY, Aniseya hosted Rite of Ascension ceremony for her daughters to become witches. When several visiting Jedi interrupted, and Mother Aniseya agreed to let the pair be tested after Jedi Master Indara insisted. Not long after, Aniseya perished when she attempted to forestall further conflict during a confrontation with Master Sol and the Padawan Torbin where the Jedi questioned her about the nature behind her daughters' birth. Triggering the beginnings of a transformation within both herself and Mae-ho, Aniseya was killed by Sol, who mistook her efforts as an attack against him and struck out with his lightsaber, mortally wounding the witch, who explained with her dying breaths that she had been intending to allow Verosha to leave and join the Jedi Order.

Her death having spurred the following battle between the Brendok coven and the Jedi, which resulted in the deaths of most of the witches. Verosha and Mae-ho survived, with the former becoming Sol's Padawan and the latter becoming a Sith assassin under a Sith known as "the Stranger," with both grieving their mother's death for years afterward. Verosha's inability to let go of her feelings of loss for her mother eventually resulted in her agreeing to train under the Stranger following Mae-ho's departure from the Sith's tutelage.

Mother Aniseya was a female human who lived during the High Republic Era. around 156 BBY, Koril carried them in her womb. After their birth, the women both became the twins' mothers. Though Mother Aniseya often adopted a more relaxed parenting style, in contrast, Koril's fierce protectiveness of the twins

entities.name: Mae-ho Aniseya
entities.description:
Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya was a Force-sensitive human female former Sith acolyte and assassin who lived during the High Republic Era. Created with the Force by her mother with the aid of a vergence on Brendok, she was the identical twin sister of former Jedi Padawan Verosha Aniseya. She was presumed dead after starting a fire to prevent her sister from becoming a Jedi and falling into a mining shaft. However, she survived and eventually encountered a mysterious Sith known only as "the Master" and became a candidate to be his apprentice.

In 132 BBY, Mae reappeared on Ueda and murdered Jedi Master Indara, leading the Jedi Order to investigate. While the Jedi originally blamed Mae's twin Osha for the crime, the twins were reunited on Olega after Mae convinced Master Torbin, who had taken the Barash Vow, to commit suicide. Having learned of Osha's survival, Mae resolved to turn herself into the Jedi on Khofar, putting her in the crosshairs of her Sith Master, who promptly killed all of the Jedi save Master Sol, the man responsible for killing the twins' mother, and began to target Mae for betraying him.

To escape, Mae disguised herself as her twin and snuck aboard Sol's ship, where her deception was uncovered and she was captured by Sol. The Jedi brought her back home to Brendok, eager to prove to the rest of the Order that the twins were created by their coven using the vergence on the planet. After Sol's death at the hands of Osha, Mae's memory was voluntarily erased by her former master, allowing Osha to take her place as the Sith's acolyte. The amnesiac Mae was then brought into custody by a Jedi investigation party and recruited by Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh to hunt down her former Sith Master, who was also Rwoh's former student.

Mae-ho Aniseya was the "twin sister" to Verosha Aniseya and daughter to Mother Aniseya. She was created by Aniseya through the use of and carried by coven member Koril, who eventually gave birth to her and her sister around 156 BBY. In truth, however, Mae and Osha were not "sisters" nor "twins" but a singular consciousness that had been broken into two bodies.

entities.name: Verosha Aniseya
entities.description:
Verosha "Osha" Aniseya, nicknamed Oshie by her sister, was a Force-sensitive human female Sith acolyte during the High Republic Era. Created via the Force by her mother with the aid of a vergence on the planet Brendok, she was raised as part of a coven of witches alongside her twin sister, Mae-ho "Mae" Aniseya. After Mae started a fire in the coven's fortress in order to prevent Osha from going with four Jedi who had discovered their coven, most of the witches, including Osha's mother, were killed by the Jedi. Osha was rescued by Jedi Master Sol and brought to Coruscant where the Jedi Council reluctantly permitted her training despite her advanced age.

At the Jedi Temple, Osha was taken on as Sol's Padawan but failed to control her negative feelings towards her sister for the deaths of her family. For these reasons, and at the recommendation of the Council, as well as Master Indara who had been on the original mission to Brendok, Osha left the Order and, by 132 BBY, was a meknek for the Trade Federation. After Mae resurfaced and murdered Master Indara on Ueda, Osha was initially blamed and arrested by the Jedi for the crime.

However, Osha was quickly absolved of the crime on Olega after Mae killed Master Torbin, leading to the twins' reunion and Osha to team up with her former Jedi Master to bring her sister to justice. Over the course of the investigation, Sol's role in the murder of the twin's mother was gradually revealed, leading a betrayed Osha to fall to the dark side of the Force and kill her former master. She then accepted the invitation of a Sith known simply as "The Stranger" to become his Sith apprentice, parting ways with Mae after the latter had her mind voluntarily erased by the Sith.

Aniseya, the leader of a coven of witches, created Osha and Mae Koril carried and bore them; both women were considered to be the girls' mothers. They were brought up on the planet Brendok, where the coven lived in a secret fortified village that was in hiding from the Republic and the Jedi Order. They were the only two children in the village. Their mothers cared deeply for their daughters but argued over how to raise them: Aniseya's desire to show lenience clashed with Koril's more strict approach.

entities.name: Anj'a
entities.description:
Anj'a was a female Twi'Lek who worked as an entertainer during the Galactic Civil War, sometime after the Battle of Yavin. While she declared that she was neutral in the conflict, rumors persisted that she aided the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the war. She graced the covers of every fashion holo-mag and adorned the screens of every HoloNet user's computer in the galaxy. She was considered by both the Galactic Empire and the Rebellion to be the galaxy's most popular holo-pinup girl, much to the dismay of Imperial officers.

Anj'a found the Nightsisters of the planet of Dathomir fascinating, using one of their energy lances as a dancing prop during her performances. She also owned a suit of custom Rancor bone armor that she wore frequently. A painting was commissioned of Anj'a performing her number-one galactic hit "Booombaaa Boombaa Bombashella" at the outdoor theater at Vreni Island on the planet Corellia.

Anj'a appeared in a painting in the 2003 MMORPG Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided and on a card in the Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game set, Threat of the Conqueror. The painting and card were named Intense Performer and their artwork was created by the player Anj'a, who won a contest in 2010 to have their artwork added to the games. The artwork's appearance as a painting in Star Wars Galaxies includes a short biography of Anj'a the entertainer.

entities.name: Vora Anjek
entities.description:
Vora Anjek was a female Twi'lek Chirq Council adjutant who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

After the Battle of Yavin, Vora Anjek was one of the three individuals who ran the Kor Vella chapter of the Chirq Council, also known as the Red Circle Gang, along with Annor Fash and Vella Corse. She was based in the Red Circle Base, a bunker in the Vella plains.

In 1 ABY, After the assassination of the mayor of Kor Vella Deel Draav by the Red Circle Gang, the CorSec raided the Ryll Smuggler Base. The spacer eliminated the underboss Ubis Reendorr and retrieved his access code for the Red Circle Base. The CorSec later assaulted the Red Circle Base nearby and killed most of the guards. The spacer used Reendorr's access code to slice the mainframe in the courtyard of the base and learned the identity of the three local Chirq Council leaders: Vora Anjek, Annor Fash and Vella Corse. The CorSec therefore attacked the basement of the Red Circle Base and killed the three leaders. During the assault, the spacer also discovered that the leaders of the Chirq Council were based in the city Doaba Guerfel.

Vora Anjek was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Vora Anjek was added to the game with the update named "Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives," published on June 8, 2006.

entities.name: Padija Anjeri
entities.description:
Padija Anjeri was a anthropologist and operative for the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The daughter of Jedi Colonel Tyneir Renz, Anjeri studied at the University of Alderaan where she was recruited into the Alliance by Professor Oll Maccabe. Anjeri worked as a recovery agent, rescuing relics and artifacts from historical sites destroyed by the Galactic Empire. During a mission to Omman Minor, Anjeri hired the smuggler Drake Paulsen to transport her off-world after she recovered an idol important to the Twi'lek Nercathi clan.

entities.name: Prello Anjiliac
entities.description:
Prello Anjiliac was a Hutt crime lord and part of the Anjiliac clan.

When one of her employees, a Balosar named Barin Trevina, disappeared while attempting to acquire a Dark side object known as the Fell Star, Prello hired a group to find him. She agreed to pay 1,500 credits to each person in the group if Trevina were brought back alive and unharmed. She offered a further 1,500 each if they also brought back the object that Trevina had been searching for.

At under 200 years of age, Prello was relatively young for a Hutt during her time as a crime lord, and unlike others of her species, Prello seemed to genuinely care about the non-Hutt individuals that she employed. Though many of her clan resided on Point Nadir, she maintained a townhouse in the upscale part of Mos Eisley on the desert world of Tatooine.

entities.name: Zietta Anjiliac
entities.description:
Zietta Anjiliac, also known as Zietta the Hutt, was a Hutt of the Anjiliac kajidic who was in charge of its operation on the shadowport Point Nadir.

Born into a wealthy criminal family on Nal Hutta, Zietta was a disgrace of her kajidic. Though as ambitious as any other Hutt, she lacked the means to achieve her goals, which always made her the last among all competitors. She was unable to create a criminal empire of her own and thus the embarrassed clan sent her to Point Nadir to be the adjutant of her cousin, Tirello Anjiliac, who ran the Hutt's criminal operations of Point Nadir for almost a century by that time. Tirello greatly disliked Zietta, and did his best to demean her by assigning her to menial tasks. Zietta resented him, but lacked the means to arrange an assassination. Everything changed when Zietta met a Wroonian woman Tis Dolan. Dolan treated Zietta with respect and quickly became her right hand and close confidant. Eventually, Tirello was killed by Sable Dawn assassins, which came as a surprise to Zietta. With Dolan's help, Zietta stepped in her place and became the new boss of Point Nadir. Though she regained the respect of her clan, she was in truth but a puppet in hands of Tis Dolan, who made the majority of the decisions and manipulated the Hutt to her own ends.

entities.name: Tettsel Anker
entities.description:
Tettsel Anker was a female Zabrak Chirq Council sub-councilor who lived on Corellia during the time of the Galactic Civil War.

Tettsel Anker was a member of the criminal organization known as the Chirq Council. After the Battle of Yavin, sub-councilors Tettsel Anker and Dain Pax were trained in the Second Elite Council Bunker, near the city of Doaba Guerfel, in order to start new Chirq Council chapters in Bela Vistal and Vreni Island.

In 1 ABY, Captain Vitala Baize successfully infiltrated a CorSec agent within the organization. Assuming the identity of the Chirq Council member Trins Evnar, the CorSec agent managed to infiltrate Jzoro Quanera's Chirq Council chapter in Doaba Guerfel. From Jzoro Quanera's database, the CorSec obtained the identity of the nine elite councilors and the locations of their secret headquarters. The CorSec later assaulted the First and the Second Elite Council Bunkers. During the raid on the Second Elite Council Bunker, Agent Chun Solso was tasked to prevent Tettsel Anker and Dain Pax's attempt to extend the reach of the Chirq Council in Bela Vistal and Vreni Island. Agent Solso thus hired an independent spacer who previously worked for the CorSec to help him in his mission. The spacer fought and managed to kill the two sub-councilors. Eventually, the Chirq Council splintered after the Chirq Council elite councilors were killed by the CorSec in the Elite Council Bunkers.

Ann'ya was a female Twi'lek who worked as a dancer at Varath cantina on the planet Tatooine.

A female Twi'lek employed as a dancer, Ann'ya performed for the Great Hunt bounty hunter Veeboo Lunx at some point in 3643 BBY. While dancing for the Rodian, Lunx's rival arrived at the cantina. Events quickly escalated, and Veebo was killed. Ann'ya pleaded with the bounty hunter to let her live, and she managed to run off.

entities.name: Anna
entities.description:
Anna was a female Cathar miner. In 3631 BBY she was part of the mining group working on Ilum for the Minos-Mestra Corporation, who secured the minings rights from both Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire. After the miners accidentally desecrated a burial cite of Xivhkalrainik's father, his son, the Sith Lord Xalek began attacking their mining camps, slaughtering everyone and leaving no survivors. When Anna was at Shaft 12, Xalek attacked it and began killing everyone. Anna contacted Shaft 16 for help, but by the time it arrived, she was already dead.

Anna appears in Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire during Xalek Alliance alert mission.

entities.name: Tola Annax
entities.description:
Tola Annax was a female Keshiri Sith Saber in the Lost Tribe of Sith from the planet of Kesh. She served under Gavar Khai and led the Sith forces on the ground during the Battle on Nam Chorios. When she initially confronted their targets Luke, Ben Skywalker, and Vestara Khai, she had three Sith attack them, however all were killed and she escaped. Later, when Khai switched his allegiances from the Tribe to Abeloth, Annax went along. After Khai was slain by his daughter Vestara, Annax took his place as head of Abeloth's fleet. However, not long afterwards, Abeloth stripped Annax of her powers, and filled her with dark energy, leaving her on Upekzar as bait for a trap for the Jedi, where she died from the massive amount of energy.

entities.name: Annaz
entities.description:
Annaz was a female Falleen gangster who was part of the Malandro syndicate on the planet Tangenine. Her syndicate extorted places like the farm owned by Remba and Kelven. When their farm failed to pay up, Annaz killed them and left their children, Lauren Mel Coelho and Julien orphaned. Lauren took a job for the Malandro syndicate in order to pay for treatment for Julien but got caught and landed in jail leaving Julien to die of his illness. When the Galactic Empire came to Tangenine, they realized the Malandro syndicate was too embedded into the system and had bounty hunters clear the way for them. Lauren returned as a bounty hunter named Brand and attacked and tortured Annaz.

entities.name: Anniya
entities.description:
Anniya was a female Zabrak merchant who lived during the Galactic Civil War. After the Battle of Yavin, she resided aboard Tansarii Point Station, a space station located above the planet Ord Mantell, in the Bright Jewel system. There, she was working as a junk dealer, buying droid parts, old weapons and various other things from spacers that passed by. She was one of the two junk dealers working on Tansarii Point Station, along with Eocade, and she could frequently be found on the main level of the station.

Anniya appeared as a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, Anniya was added to the game as part of the "New Player Tutorial," In the game, he was a junk dealer that players could sell loot and other items they no longer needed to her.

When Tansarii Point Station and its inhabitants was first introduced into the game, Anniya was depicted under a generic spawn template that included at least one known Human female depiction. Her appearance was later permanently changed to that of a female Zabrak.

entities.name: Klossi Anno
entities.description:
Klossi Anno was a female Chalactan Padawan serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final years of the Republic. A commander within the Grand Army of the Republic, she survived the Clone Wars and the execution of Contingency Order 66, unlike her master, who died during the initial stages of the Great Jedi Purge.

Discovered to be Force-sensitive near birth on Chalacta, Klossi Anno was taken to the Coruscant Jedi Temple and inducted into the academy there. Studying the ways of the Force, Anno eventually graduated after years of study and was selected by a Jedi Master for one-on-one training. During her apprenticeship, the tensions between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems came to a breaking point resulting in the start of the Clone Wars. Reporting to the Jedi High Council, Anno was given the rank of Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic and leadership of clone troopers.

After years of fighting, the war ended abruptly when the Republic's Supreme Chancellor disbanded the Jedi Order with the issuance of Contingency Order 66. When her clone troopers turned their blasters on her, Anno's master sacrificed herself so that Anno could flee. Making her way to Dellalt, Anno joined with nine other fugitive Jedi in hijacking an SX troop shuttle from the newly formed Galactic Empire. While they were pursued by a group of ARC-170s and a light cruiser, losing two of their company, Anno and the others escaped pursuit and were given sanctuary by the crew of the Drunk Dancer. In the company of smuggler Jula Shryne, the group was eventually joined by Master Roan Shryne and Padawan Olee Starstone. Given new hope by Starstone's enthusiasm and determination, Anno and her companions agreed to search for Grand Master Yoda on Kashyyyk. Giving Master Shryne her fallen master's lightsaber, the group headed out to meet their fate on the Wookiee homeworld.

Once there, Kashyyyk came under invasion by the Empire for housing Jedi. Led by Darth Vader, the Empire searched for the Jedi fugitives, eventually confronting them. Padawan Anno attacked the Sith Lord after he injured Jedi Knights Siadem Forte and Iwo Kulka, but the powerful cyborg merely sidestepped her, slashing her across the back with his lightsaber. Dragged away from the battle and taken offworld by the other surviving Jedi, Anno was able to recover and decided to sabotage the Empire in a less direct way. With the suggestions of her comrades, Anno planned to work on construction sites, or in an agricultural project, and intended to undo the Sith in more subtle ways than with a lightsaber.

entities.name: Loo Re Anno
entities.description:
Loo Re Anno was a female Sibettan and a respected racer in the Dragon Void Run. Within the Dragon Void, she was acknowledged as both the greatest and eldest racer present.

Loo Re Anno was born into the Sibettan Among her people, a spacefarer's heart, and the loyalty of their crew, often proved enough.

Despite this, Loo Re chose to ignore her grandmother's lessons, and shunned both friendship and community in pursuit of self-discovery through solitude. Believing strength lay in isolation, Loo Re began flying alone, and her ship and the stars became her home. Ultimately, her entire race dwindled down with the help of outsiders, and embarked on an exodus to depart the galaxy for another realm. Building a Gate which lay at the end of the Dragon Void Run, they entered the seams between space and time, disappearing from the outside world. Not permitted to join the rest of her species beyond the Gate, Loo Re became the last of her kind in the galaxy.

Loo Re became known as the greatest racer in the galaxy, as well as the oldest and the last of her species, as of the Dragon Void Run attended by Han Solo during the Age of the Empire. Having grown tired of being alone, save for the company of her witnesses, she intended for the race to be her last, expecting to either win or die, and her fellow competitors all took bets on the the competition being her final Run. She intervened in an altercation between newcomer Han Solo and Delan Vook, daring the racers to question her skill, and mused that perhaps Solo had the heart to win the race. As the race began, the pilots found themselves under attack from explosive probes and mines, although Loo Re reassured her witnesses by remaining calm, choosing not to run her engines after realizing the mines were only targeting ships that were powered up. Solo followed her example, and Loo Re attached a line to the Corellian's Millennium Falcon, using his momentum to carry her vessel through the static barrier to safety. Uncoupling, Loo Re thanked Solo, and sped towards a brief respite on the next planet.

The grandmother of Loo Re Anno was a founding member of the Dragon Void Run. According to Loo Re Anno, her grandmother was a mapmaker first and foremost but also loved to fly fast. Unusually for her kind, Anno's grandmother did not want to fly alone. They also wanted to build a family that would come together to race another, to challenge each other and become something more together.

entities.description:
Anok was a female Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire during the Galactic War with the Galactic Republic. She sold gear to fellow Sith aboard Vaiken Spacedock. Anok wore red body armor.

Lord Anok appears in the video game Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel, as the Operations Gear vendor for the Sith Inquisitor class. Her gear has changed frequently throughout the game's history, reflecting the current tier of gear. She was removed in Game Update 5.0 on November 29, 2016, which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.

She was the girlfriend of Vector Hyllus until he became a Joiner on Alderaan. Anora sent Vector a holomessage, pleading him to return to her and undo the joining process, but after contemplation Vector decided that he enjoyed his current situation better.

entities.description:
Anoser was a Human female member of the Onderon Royal Family and, together with her brother Anosek, she was a cousin to King Regalun Petryph of Onderon during the renewed Galactic War, a galactic conflict between the Sith Empire and Galactic Republic.

During the Imperial storyline for Onslaught, the player character is tasked with eliminating Anoser and Anosek in an attempt to infuriate King Regalun Petryph into rallying his supporters against the Republic in an attack on the capital Iziz so he can reclaim his throne. The player character can either kill them both or take them as prisoners.

While the fates of the cousins are not detailed during the Republic storyline, Lana Beniko brings up the idea of the cousins being potential replacements for who becomes ruler when Petryph is deposed, but laments that they aren't proper material for such a role.

entities.name: Anoura
entities.description:
Anoura was a female Cerean information broker for the Bothan Businessman Elwis Bontraar. Her death caused her sister Zascha to enact revenge on Elwis and kidnap his daughter.

During the reign of the Galactic Republic, Anoura worked as an information broker for the Bothan Elwis Bontraar, a wealthy businessman who lived on the planet Coruscant and was best known for the annual Galactic Costume Extravaganza, a costume party where guests would swap information anonymously. Anoura was eventually killed on a routine mission for Elwis which brought much grief to her Force-sensitive sister, Zascha.

After Anoura's death Zascha blamed Elwis for the loss of her sister and a year later kidnapped Elwis's daughter Jennalyn Bontraar as revenge. She then anonymously contacted Elwis asking for a ransom of 1000 cred sticks to be exchanged for his daughter at the next Galactic Costume Extravaganza aboard his ship the Masquerade. However Elwis hired a number of spacers to find his daughter's kidnapper during the party as did the Hutts of Hutt Space who had been falsely accused of being the kidnappers and wanted to remove the individual who had caused the problem. Zascha attempted to trick and escape the two groups but was eventually found and forced to give up Jennalyn whilst she escaped.

entities.name: Anri
entities.description:
Anri was a female Twi'lek major of the Sith Empire who served during the Third Galactic War. She was in command of Raven Squad.

Anri viewed her advancement in the meritocratic terms of the Sith Empire at large; one's power and standing rises as they prove their superiority by overcoming the threats and impediments facing them. Her skillful leadership and gallows humor made her popular with her fellow troops, and while her outspokenness led some officers and Sith to question her dedication, her troops knew firsthand that her determination to see the Sith Empire triumph over all foes was absolute.

Major Anri was first introduced in Patch 5.10.0 of Star Wars: The Old Republic, dubbed Jedi Under Siege. She is available as a companion NPC to the main character. who previously worked on Star Wars: The Old Republic as Jedi Master Surro. According to Charles Boyd, the Creative Director for the game, Anri is an updated version of a character that he originally wrote years prior to the release of Jedi Under Siege; an antagonist in the Republic Trooper storyline who was cut from the final release of the game.

For Republic players during the Mek-Sha storyline, Anri is confronted by Vice-Admiral Dol Narlock attempting to activate the station's failsafe. If the player is a Loyalist, Anri immediately surrenders, not wanting to take her chances against the one who defeated the Sith Emperor. Alternatively, if the player is a Saboteur, they have the choice of either killing Narlock and allowing Anri to activate the failsafe, or assist Narlock.
