entities.name: Baritha
entities.description:
Baritha was a female Dathomirian who was one of the founding members of the Nightsisters of the planet Dathomir and served as leader Gethzerion's right hand until the Nightsisters were defeated by the Singing Mountain Clan.

Baritha was exiled from Dathomir's Singing Mountain Clan along with Gethzerion after the pair attempted to assassinate the Clan mother, Augwynne. While traveling Dathomir, the outcasts met a small group of former clan sisters who tried to kill them. The exiles defeated them, but spared one's life in return for a pledge of servitude. This was the beginning of the Nightsisters.

Baritha was in the Nightsister Stronghold on Dathomir during the Galactic Civil War, during which she recruited an explorer to help deliver two Imperial officers to her for her own amusement, and then capture a reformed Nightsister.

Four years after the Battle of Endor, Han Solo and Leia Organa arrived on Dathomir. Baritha used a mind trick on Solo, attempting to have him divulge the location of the Millennium Falcon. She said that he looked "tasty" from behind, and even tried to claim him as her slave. Soon after, Baritha was presumed killed during the Battle of Dathomir, though some members of New Republic Intelligence believe otherwise, since her body was never found.

entities.name: Camelle Barje
entities.description:
Camelle "Camella" Barje was a native of Corellia who moved with her husband Conil to Tatooine to begin a simple life as moisture farmers. The lives of her and her son were saved from Tusken warriors by their Jedi leader, Sharad Hett. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, Barje ran the motel in the town of Wayfar.

Camelle was born on the planet Corellia. She married Conil to raise their newborn son, Tekil.

Camelle and Conil sold everything to move to Tatooine, purchasing land from Zygian's Banking Concern. Arriving on Tatooine, Camelle and Conil established a moisture farm. Ever since arriving on the planet, Camelle and Conil heard rumors of Tusken Raider attacks, mainly from people at Tosche Station. Conil was determined to get some weapons to be on the safe side, so they traveled to the ancient trading site Mochot Steep. Conil told Camelle to stay with Tekil in the cart while he purchased some guns.

During the visit to Mochot Steep, a Tusken Raider war-band led by Sharad Hett attacked the settlement. During the attack, Conil told Camelle to ride away and save Tekil. While trying to help another moisture farmer, Conil was killed by one of the Tuskens. Camelle tried to escape, but a Tusken killed the dewback pulling her cart.

She tried to capture Leia Organa Solo in orbit of Corellia only to be killed by Han Solo along with one of her cohorts, Dex.

Although she kept them in her house for over four hours, she yielded them no useful information.

entities.name: Ara Barotta
entities.description:
Ara Barotta was a female Twi'lek Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the decade preceding the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive Twi'lek, Ara Barotta was trained in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order. Studying at the Coruscant Jedi Temple as an Initiate, Barotta ascended to the rank of Padawan after the Trade Federation's invasion of Naboo and the reemergence of the Sith. Assigned to a Jedi Master to continue training, Barotta constructed a blue-bladed lightsaber to wield throughout her career.

In response to the Sith's reappearance, the Jedi High Council opened several Jedi outposts across the galaxy for supplemental group training. Assigning Padawan Barotta to Kashyyyk, the High Council placed Jedi Master Mavra Zane in command of her and a number of other students to travel to the Wookiee homeworld aboard a Consular-class cruiser. Upon the group's arrival, the students were greeted by Grand Master Yoda the Watchman of Kashyyyk, along with Masters Mace Windu and Obi-Wan Kenobi. The Padawans settled in at the new outpost and quickly began classes, continuing on their path to knowledge.

During Barotta's time on the planet, the armies of the Commerce Guild, combined with Trandoshan slavers, attacked the planet and the Wookiee village near the outpost. Rallying behind Masters Yoda and Zane, the apprentices repelled the Trandoshans with few casualties. Following Master Yoda's departure, the students were attacked again. This time, Master Zane and several students were captured while the chapter house and most of the apprentices were killed. Barotta, among the survivors, eventually found herself above Felucia on a Commerce Guild Providence-class carrier/destroyer. After the Padawans and Zane were freed from captivity, the Jedi escaped aboard the Star Runner and made an emergency landing on the planet below. Joining Mak Pra and the Felucian resistance movement, Barotta and her companions attempted to capture Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai and prevent her from attacking Coruscant with trihexalon missiles. The Jedi rushed to Coruscant and smashed the Commerce Guild's fleet, ending the crisis and saving Coruscant.

entities.name: Barratk'l
entities.description:
Barratk'l was a female Yuzzem Jedi Master of the New Jedi Order and member of the Jedi High Council in 44 ABY.

At some point in her life, Barratk'l was badly wounded in her throat. While the damage was being repaired, she requested that her vocal cords be thinned, allowing her speech to be more understandable to other species. A line of white fur marked the scar on her throat.

Barratk'l was stationed on Nal Hutta when she was recalled to Coruscant and asked to join the Jedi High Council, after being nominated by acting Grand Master Kenth Hamner. She accepted, and attended a Council meeting after Galactic Alliance Chief of State Natasi Daala refused to release Jedi Knights Valin and Jysella Horn from carbonite even after the Force psychosis that had been affecting several Jedi in the order had been seemingly cured with the death of Abeloth at the hands of exiled Grand Master Luke Skywalker. When Hamner insisted that the Jedi do their best to avoid confrontation with the forces of the Galactic Alliance, Barratk'l supported him along with Cilghal and Kam and Tionne Solusar. The meeting was soon interrupted by Jedi Knight Leia Organa Solo and her husband Han Solo, who informed the Council about a force of Mandalorians sent to repress a slave protest on Blaudu Sextus.

After Master Saba Sebatyne explained the relationship between the Octusi and their masters, Barratk'l questioned Hamner after he wondered how the semi-sentient Octusi were able to understand the ways they were not free, asking him if he thought slavery was acceptable if the slaves were unable to realize they were enslaved. Hamner told her that she should know better than that, he pointed out a Octusi in a hologram of the protest holding a sign with chains on it, despite the fact the Octusi were never enslaved with chains. Barratk'l and the rest of the Council pondered what this meant, and Hamner suggested that the anti-slavery organization Freedom Flight might be behind it. Barratk'l defended the organization, and denied suspicion from the other Council members that she was assisting Freedom Flight. She was grateful to Hamner after he told the others that he doubted she was involved with them. Barratk'l and the rest of the Council decided to send Jedi Knights Sothais Saar and Avinoam Arelis to Blaudu Sextus in order to end the revolt and discover who had incited it before the Mandalorians put it down forcefully, in order to prevent a massacre and make sure the Octusi and their masters worked things out peacefully.

entities.name: Daakman Barrek's mother
entities.description:
A female individual residing on the planet Mrlsst was a famed geneticist and professor and was the mother of the Human Daakman Barrek. She discovered that Barrek was Force-sensitive through a blood screening and contacted the Jedi Council of the Jedi Order, hoping that her son would find importance serving the Galactic Republic. Barrek quickly rose through the ranks of the Jedi, eventually achieving the rank of Jedi Master after successfully training his first Padawan.

Daakman Barrek's mother was mentioned in the Databank entry for Daakman Barrek on StarWars.com, which was published by 2004.

entities.name: Chaney Barrow
entities.description:
Chaney Barrow was a female Human slicer and computer expert living during the Cold War. She was motivated by greed and known to hold grudges. Formerly a top saboteur of the Exchange crime syndicate, she was captured and imprisoned in the Belsavis prison by Galactic Republic. During the Invasion of Belsavis around 3641 BBY she was sprung out of her cell along with three other prisoners - Kanjon Slyke, Ohta and Paarkos. Their rescuer posed as a fellow inmate, but was in fact Imperial Intelligence operative Cipher Nine. The prisoners released were chosen for their skills and were asked to provide means to break into the Megasecurity Ward 23. To avoid the attention of SCORPIO's security system, they came up with a plan to reprogram security droids and order them to cause havoc, thus triggering multiple alarms at different locations at once, overloading SCORPIO's capabilities. The plan eventually worked, though SCORPIO managed to disconnect herself from the network and upload her consciousness back into the droid body. During the infiltration Barrow was betrayed and shot by Slyke.

Barrow is killed by Slyke in the Dark Side option if the player does not intervene. She survives in the Light Side option.

entities.name: Idryssa Barruck
entities.description:
Idryssa Barruck was a human female soldier who worked in the fight against the Galactic Empire. When Saw Gerrera took in the eight year-old girl Jyn Erso, Idryssa brought her suitable clothes and taught her about health and hygiene, including menstrual health. She first worked for Gerrera's Partisans, but over the next few years, Idryssa became distanced from Saw's group before leaving it entirely, breaking off and joining a more unified group. Later, fellow Partisan Xosad Hozem joined with Idryssa's new group.

Idryssa frequently disagreed with Saw's extremist tactics, insisting that they had to be better than the enemy and being unwilling to purposefully target civilians. She did, however, provide him with information and ideas for new missions.

Idryssa had very dark skin, and used colored makeup to give it a sparkling effect.

Idryssa was known to carry a pair of machetes strapped to her back.

entities.name: Barrut
entities.description:
Barrut was a human who served as a colonel in the First Order military during the war between the First Order and the Resistance. In 34 ABY, the colonel was in command of the Maxima-A-class heavy cruiser Fortitude, and attacked the planet Ikkrukk.

By 34 ABY, Colonel Barrut served the First Order. Sometime after the evacuation of D'Qar, Barrut was assigned the Maxima-A-class heavy cruiser Fortitude to go to Ikkrukk and take it over. However, the Ikkrukkians refused to leave their homeworld in their hands, so she ordered to attack Grail City, the capital. Although the Ikkrukkians under the command of Prime Minister Grist activated the deflector shields over the city in time, Barrut and her fellows had the help of a group of First Order sympathizers, who killed the engineers, deactivating them. As the Black Squadron, a starfighter squadron which served the Resistance and was send to Ikkrukk by General Leia Organa to search allies following the collapse of the New Republic, Barrut supervised the battle from the Fortitude, assuring her lieutenant that it was just a matter of time to win the battle. Upon realizing the presence of Black Squadron, she ordered them to be shot down, promising to put the pilots in commendations if they managed to destroy the X-wing starfighters before the shield could be reactivated.

Shortly afterwards, sometime after the Battle of Crait, Wing Commander Poe Dameron, Black Squadron's Black Leader, arrived to the scene aboard a starfighter and blew up one of the turrets of the Fortitude. Upon witnessing this, Barrut ordered her lieutenant to communicate her with Dameron, informing the pilot that if he wanted to negotiate it would have been before attacking them. The pilot responded that he didn't wanted to negotiate and revealed himself to Barrut, who dismissed his claims, assuring him that Poe Dameron was killed during the evacuation of D'Qar, but Dameron immediately told her that her people lied to her and that he wasn't dead and neither was the Resistance, taking the opportunity to reveal to her that Supreme Leader Snoke, his flagship the Supremacy, twenty other Star Destroyers and the Fulminatrix had all been obliterated, leading Barrut's crew to question if General Armitage Hux was leading the First Order. Furious, Barrut replied to her crew that Dameron must have lied about their losses, ordering them to shoot down Dameron. As such, Dameron performed an special maneuver with his teammates and got several TIEs destroyed, which in turn damaged the Fortitude, causing Barrut to order her lieutenant a damage report. However, the shield over Grail City was gone down, leading Barrut to order fire on the city given that their bombardment cannons were still online. But it was too late for that. With Black Squadron's help, Prime Minister Grist activated the city's defensive systems and fired on the Fortitude, destroying it and killing Barrut in the process.

A female human, Barrut served the First Order military, holding the rank of colonel and commanding the Fortitude. Barrut had no qualms on taking over Ikkrukk even if that meant killing thousands of innocents.

entities.name: Roisem Barsha
entities.description:
Roisem Barsha was a human female member of the Barsha family. She was married to Nnytyl Barsha and the mother of Jaylen and, together with her husband, the co-CEO of the Barsha Corporation from Corellia. She was also the unwilling stepmother to her husband's other son, Sliro Barsha, who she consistently treated as lesser than his half-brother. When Jaylen was eight years old, she gifted him two Fathier plushies, but purposefully didn't gift one to Sliro even though he would have liked them more than Jaylen. During the Clone Wars, the parents began to groom Jaylen Barsha to become the next CEO of the family company, while Sliro became a low ranking employee of Republic Intelligence.

During the official ceremony for the change of CEO in the early Imperial Era in 19 BBY, all of the members of the Barsha Corp's executive board were arrested by the Galactic Empire for conspiracy. They were tried and placed under house arrest at their compound on Corellia's moon Gus Treta. During their stay, the family were de facto on holiday. At some point into their stay, she gave the BX-series droid commando ND-5, who she believed to be one of the employed droids a green blazer to wear. Weeks after their trial, the executive board was pardoned and in celebration, Roisem Barsha held a party with family and friends at the compound. During the night, all of the Barsha family and their guests were assassinated by ND-5, who had actually been sent to kill everyone present. Roisem and Nnytyl were among the last killed and were witnessed by Jaylen who had tried to unsuccessfully save them. He was however able to survive by reprogramming ND-5 with the help of the compound's droid A1-A1 and thought dead.

Over the following nine years, their son, now known as Jaylen Vrax tried to find their murderer and ultimately learned that it was Sliro who had betrayed them to the Empire and after their pardon had sent ND-5 to kill them all instead. Throughout his adult years, Jaylen Vrax continued to remember his mother saying "you need to know when to say something or stay quiet" and often recited it to himself.

Roisem Barsha was a stern and goal-oriented mother to Jaylen. Because she didn't see him as a "full Barsha", Roisem mistreated Sliro as lesser to his half-brother and didn't treat him as her son, with him only calling her "Lady Barsha". Over the years her relationship with her husband, Nnytyl became distant and at their stay at the Barsha compound they almost never spoke with one another. Jaylen ultimately came to also become distant to his parents and had mixed feelings about them. Meanwhile, Sliro began to hate his father and Lady Barsha and see them as corrupt and as "architects of deception".

entities.name: Bartaph
entities.description:
Bartaph was a female Human who served as a colonel in the Republic Army during the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the resurgent Sith Empire. After Warden Graal disappeared during the riots that resulted from the Imperial attack on the prison planet Belsavis, Bartaph was sent to Belsavis in order to serve as the prison's new warden.

After the Hero of Tython had defeated Executor Krannus and foiled his plan to destroy Belsavis, Bartaph confronted the Jedi as they were preparing to leave the planet, having learned that they had worked alongside the convict Pak Taldine to defeat Krannus. Bartaph demanded to know why the Hero of Tython had worked with Taldine, revealing his past as a notorious criminal, but the Hero of Typhon defended Taldine, saying that the Zabrak's help was invaluable in their mission.

Although still skeptical, Bartaph ultimately agreed to take the Hero of Typhon's word and allowed Taldine to continue working with the Republic as he had been under former Warden Playt.

entities.name: Elsen Barthis
entities.description:
Elsen Barthis was a member of Galactic Alliance Intelligence who, along with Lieutenant Titch, tried to convince Wedge Antilles to give information to the Galactic Alliance on Rogue Squadron just prior to the start of the Second Galactic Civil War.

Barthis was a Human woman from a Corellian family in her mid twenties. Iella Wessiri worked with her father for a year, presumably in CorSec. She was blonde, well-muscled, as tall as Wedge Antilles, and in her mid-twenties as of 40 ABY.

It turns out that it was a trap, and Barthis was simply trying to get Wedge away from Corellia during the GA's attack on the planet. Wedge managed to escape, and shot her with Titch's blaster. Due to the failure of the mission to keep Wedge in custody, she was demoted from her previous rank of Captain to Lieutenant.

Later, Barthis was present at Toryaz Station during the meeting between Corellian and GA delegates. She danced with Han Solo.

The Bartokk Queen was killed on Corulag by the Jedi Grand Master Yoda while she was trying to escape the planet aboard her stolen Sullustan space yacht.

entities.name: Tria Bartyn
entities.description:
Tria Bartyn, known as Benevolent Tria was the Administrator of Lamaredd, working for the Outer Rim Oreworks as the successor of her parent, Hugo Bartyn. She was well-liked among her subjects.

Tria Bartyn was the oldest daughter to Hugo Bartyn. Hugo had been the founder of the fishing town Bartyn's Landing in Lamaredd, the Administrator to the local mines for Outer Rim Oreworks, and a tyrant to the inhabitants of his personal fief, aquatic aliens who were almost slaves at least until the founding of the Sailor's Union. Hugo also had an oldest son, Traggat.

C. 499 BBY, both Hugo, Traggat and several others were killed in mysterious circumstances. Tria inherited the Administratorship and the power.

Tria decided to not continue her father's policies. She arranged for the working aliens to be free of what Hugo had called "indentured servitude", and she prompted the Sailor's Union to expand and to open at least one hall in each of the towns of Lamaredd. She became very popular for these measures, and earned the nickname of "Benevolent Tria".

entities.name: Barukka
entities.description:
Barukka was a female Dathomiri, a former Nightsister, and the sister of the Nightsister leader Gethzerion. The daughter of the Singing Mountain Clan's leader, Augwynne Djo, she turned to the dark side of the Force but was able to break away from its influence and exiled herself. She petitioned unsuccessfully to rejoin her original clan, and was subsequently tormented mentally by Gethzerion, slowly being driven insane.

After being approached by Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker to find parts for the Millennium Falcon, Barukka was able to start redeeming herself. Skywalker helped her overcome her guilt, and she was able to return to the light side after Gethzerion was killed by the Imperial warlord, Zsinj. After Barukka completed the redemption process, she was able to return to her clan.

The daughter of Augwynne Djo, Barukka was raised in the Singing Mountain Clan by her mother alongside her sisters, Gethzerion, Kara'Teel, and Allaya Djo. However, Gethzerion betrayed her mother and attempted to assassinate her, killing Kara'Teel in the process, though Augwynne survived the attempt on her life. After these events, Gethzerion was exiled and chose to become a Nightsister, starting a clan of darksiders who imposed terror on the other clans, as well as the people that were imprisoned on Dathomir by the Galactic Empire. Barukka would later fall to the dark side and joined her sister's clan as a Nightsister. She learned the Nightsisters' spells and became powerful in the process, possessing an aura of dark power surrounding her body in the Force.

During her life as a Nightsister, Barukka committed atrocities that were unspoken of in her old clan. She gained valuable knowledge around the Imperial prison on Dathomir, which served as their base, but she eventually started to regret her actions. She left the Nightsisters, then exiled herself to a cavern known as the Rivers of Stone. During this time, she petitioned to rejoin the Singing Mountain Clan, though her mother seemed hesitant to allow her return, fearing that Barukka was emotionally unstable and untrustworthy due to her former actions as a Nightsister.

entities.name: Carh'la Bastra
entities.description:
Carh'la Bastra was a female Twi'lek who served as a Captain in Rebel Alliance Intelligence during the Galactic Civil War.

After the Battle of Yavin, Captain Carh'la Bastra was stationed in Anchorhead, on the planet Tatooine, where she recruited new members to join the Rebellion's cause. During that time, she worked closely with Droma Ordo, another Rebel Alliance member in Anchorhead. The company smuggled most of its goods to the Rebellion.

In 1 ABY, Bastra was tasked with finding a cargo arrived recently from Tansarii Point Station. The cargo was now lost among the various denizens on Tatooine and both Rebel and Imperial Intelligence were very interested in finding it. Fortunately, a spacer agreed to help Bastra, instead of Imperial Commander Barrezz.

Captain Bastra first tasked the spacer with finding the inventory of the cargo content that was acquired by a group of Jawa traders. The Jawas had recently been spotted at Tosche Station, near Anchorhead. There, the spacer learned from the manager Cuan Talon that he should ask his warehouse manager Janus but the latter had already been killed by Desert Demons. From Janus' datapad, the spacer recovered the first part of the cargo data and discovered that the Jawa had also visited the Lars homestead. At the homestead, Zef Ando agreed to give the inventory of what he bought from the Jawas. The spacer finally reached the Jawa sandcrawler in the Western Dune Sea but it was under attack from Tusken Raiders. The spacer attacked the Tusken Raiders and rescued the Jawas and the droid FA-2PO. The spacer later recovered Jawa encryption keys from the Tusken Raiders and finally accessed to the sandcrawler database.

Bat'theria first appeared in Star Wars: The Old Republic, a video game released by BioWare in 2011, as a junk dealer selling medical equipment on Taris. She also sold a import code, which could be used to open a import crate from Tatooine.

entities.name: Batcher
entities.description:
Batcher was a lurca hound from the planet Wayland. Initially aggressive under the captivity of the Galactic Empire, which designated the hound LH-201, Batcher was given her name by the imprisoned clone Omega, who was responsible for feeding the lurca hounds in Wayland's Mount Tantiss facility and formed a bond with Batcher. Omega then helped Batcher escape her captivity in the base after Omega learned she was going to be killed due to being domesticated. Once freed, Batcher later helped Omega and Crosshair in their escape from Wayland together, joining her namesake the "Bad Batch," Clone Force 99.

Batcher was the smallest among the lurca hounds that the Galactic Empire kept in captivity in the Lurca kennels at Mount Tantiss, a facility hidden in the forests of the planet Wayland. She was designated LH-201 and, as with the other hounds, were forced to wear collar devices and periodically released via a small tunnel into the facility's vicinity to patrol the grounds. They were forcibly summoned by their collars back into their cages in Mount Tantiss, where they were managed by the droid K-9X1.

The imprisoned human clone Omega, a member of the rogue Clone Force 99 "Bad Batch" that defied the Empire, was responsible for feeding the lurca hounds, among other duties in the facility. Omega found one hound to be aggressive and unwilling to eat the supplied food, but she secretly provided extra food from her own rations and named the hound "Batcher."

After Batcher was injured on one of her patrols in Mount Tantiss' vicinity, she was scheduled to be killed by her Imperial captors. Omega wished to save Batcher's life and treated her wound, gradually forming a bond with the hound. Nonetheless, her domestication and growing attachment to Omega was viewed as a detriment by the Empire and the termination order was maintained. Upon realizing Batcher's predicament, Omega overpowered the lurca hounds' handler, K-9X1, and freed Batcher from captivity, urging her to stay away from Mount Tantiss.

entities.description:
Kaasha Bateen was a Rutian Twi'lek female master strategist in the Free Ryloth Movement who was good with a blaster. While serving with the Free Ryloth Movement, she participated in the Pasa Novo campaign, where she met the smuggler Lando Calrissian, as well as during the Battle on Baltro. Bateen and Calrissian developed a romantic relationship. At some point, she was in a crew with Han Solo and Calrissian. They went on a mission to stop Fyzen Gor from activating the Phylanx Redux Transmitter, which succeeded when Gor died at Solo's hands. Bateen was known to be good at the game saigok, which she described as "badass dejarik," playing the game with Calrissian and Chewbacca onboard the ZV-9 freighter Vermillion. Bateen traveled with Lando and Kadara to the planet Adelphi where they spent a few days in the town of Cirimalk.

entities.name: Bathos
entities.description:
Bathos was the High Lady of Tapani House Cadriaan around during the Galactic Civil War. She was born into one of the lesser noble families of House Cadriaan, but rose in society through a series of shrewd marriages. Bathos' last husband was the former High Lord who lived long enough to allow her to build her own powerbase and successfully claim the leadership after his death.

Lady Bathos maintained her position through her talent for building strong alliances with a selection of different organizations and individuals. She fostered friendships with prominent titled commoners who were impressed by her good business sense. The High Lady also had a personality cult with the house military. However, she was not universally liked and there were several Cadriaan lords and ladies who considered their claim to the house leadership more legitimate. Bathos was aware of these threats from within and was careful to protect her flanks.

The High Lady maintained a sprawling garden paradise on Procopia called the Alaphoe Gardens located on Lalos Island. She entertained lavishing at the gardens and during Capital Season everybody who was or intended to be somebody tried to be seen at her parties.

entities.description:
Ress Batten was a female human from the planet Alderaan who served as a lieutenant aboard the Tantive IV. She accompanied Princess Leia Organa to Crait where they unknowingly came across a base being operated by Organa's father, Bail Organa. She was later brought into the rebellion by Captain Raymus Antilles shortly before the fleet was evacuated from Paucris Major.

Batten also attended the ceremony where Organa was officially invested as crown princess of Alderaan. When Organa walked past Batten in the palace Throne room Organa noted that she looked too bowled over to react.

Ress Batten first appeared in Leia, Princess of Alderaan, a 2017 young-adult novel written by Claudia Gray.

entities.name: Maxine Baytor
entities.description:
Maxine Baytor was once a general in the Galactic Republic, during which time she participated in the Battle of Denubba. Shortly after Palpatine's declaration of a New Order, she led a group of retired troops, known collectively as the Renegade Legionnaires, against the Galactic Empire. Baytor managed to escape to Tatooine, where she spent her time collecting rumors about the former members of her company. This led her to find other tidbits of information on the Imperials, which she sold to the local syndicate. Although she was not proud of doing this, she would rather sell the information than starve on the streets. Baytor was only one of many informants working for the syndicate. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, she had become a weathered woman with gentle creases in her face, and her once brown hair had started to gain gray shots.

Sometime during the war, however, the Empire believed that some of her former soldiers were in fact moles working for the Rebellion. Because of this, they tasked the local police forces of Tatooine to imprison Maxine. A group of Rebels discovered that she had been captured and were asked by a local to rescue her. To accomplish this, they met in a cantina with Verral Kayrell, a mechanic at the police station. They made a deal with him where they would acquire a Natrilux conductor relay in exchange for him leaving the garage door to the station unlocked. Soon after this the group was approached by a Wookiee working for the local syndicate named Nilwoon who offered them 15,000 credits if they gave Maxine to him, although the group turned him down. Though stormtroopers were assigned to the police station, the group managed to free Maxine. After this they had a fight on their hands to get off planet but eventually managed to escape and delivered Maxine to a Rebel Alliance base. Maxine then decided to reform the Renegade Legionnaires to work for the Rebel Alliance, and invited the group who had rescued her to meet with them. Though they were not as young as they had once been, they still had much to contribute to the Alliance.

entities.name: Bea
entities.description:
Bea was a female Human who lived on Cloud City during the Galactic Civil War between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire. There she worked as a receptionist in Figg Hall, a public space in the city's Tourist District for residents or visitors to speak to representatives of the city. As such, she could arrange meetings with Lando Calrissian, the Baron Administrator of the city, or Lobot, Calrissian's chief administrative aid. Bea worked alongside the protocol droid B-7G, and was polite and efficient while at work. A pretty woman, she could be charmed into showing the city's official records, but would alert Lobot to individuals of interest viewing such material.

Bea first appeared in The Jewel of Yavin, an adventure module released in 2014 by Fantasy Flight Games for Star Wars: Edge of the Empire. Bea is listed as a character that players might interact with to look up official files on other characters in the adventure, but as her involvement is completely optional this article does not assume such a meeting took place.

entities.name: Beam Beam
entities.description:
Beam Beam was a female fathier who was born around 1 BBY. In 3 ABY, they were ridden by Vinis Karyvin and competed in a fixed fathier race for the Galactic Empire.

Beam Beam was born around 1 BBY and by 3 ABY they competed in fathier races held in the city of Canto Bight on the Outer Rim planet Cantonica. That year, the fathier was purchased by the Galactic Empire. An Imperial officer personally inspected Beam Beam and determined them to be a fine specimen. Beam Beam was then set up by the Imperial Security Bureau to win a fixed race that was sponsored by the Galactic Empire and held during the Canto Cup racing tournament on Cantonica. For the race, Beam Beam was ridden by Imperial officer and jockey Vinis Karyvin. The race was promoted on posters placed around the city Myrra on Karyvin's homeworld of Akiva prior to its start.

Kay Vess, a scoundrel and cantonica native, noticed the promotional posters while in Myrra and immediately assumed the race was going to be fixed so the Imperial jockey would win. She had her suspicion confirmed when she overheard two Imperial stormtroopers talking about the race near The Alcazar cantina in Myrra. She eventually stole a datacard from an Imperial officer in the cantina and was able to determine that Karyvin was an Imperial Lieutenant. Vess then bet on the outcome of the race at a holographic fathier-betting module located in The Alcazar and watched Beam Beam with through the betting console's hologram.

Beam Beam was a female fathier who had brown fur and black eyes. During the sponsored race, the fathier was 299 centimeters tall and weighed 915 kilograms. An Imperial officer who inspected Beam Beam considered the fathier to be a fine specimen.

entities.name: Alecia Beck
entities.description:
Alecia Beck was a female human who served as a senior commander in the Imperial Security Bureau. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, she was tasked with hunting down Lieutenant Caluan Ematt, a member of the enemy Alliance to Restore the Republic.

Alecia Beck was a female human who came to serve in the Imperial Security Bureau, the largest of the two intelligence agencies of the Galactic Empire. During her first tour with the ISB, Beck, then a mere lieutenant, caught her training officer selling secrets for credits. Although he was a full captain, Beck confronted him in the maintenance bay aboard the Star Destroyer Vehement. The captain attempted to kill her, using a laser cutter he had found on a nearby workbench. The two then engaged in a fight. Beck managed to get the upper hand, although she lost her left eye in the confrontation. Consequently, Beck received a promotion and a commendation.

At some point, Beck attempted to request a meeting with Senator Mon Mothma. Hendri Underholt, Mon Mothma's aide, lied and claimed to Beck that the senator had already left on a fact-finding mission to Goroth. Underholt earned praise from Mon Mothma for her reply.

Around the time of the Battle of Yavin, Beck had been made a Senior Commander in the ISB, making her one of the few women holding high ranks in the Empire. She was tasked with hunting down the Shrikes, a special recon unit of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. When word came out that the Empire's Death Star battle station had been destroyed by the Alliance in the Yavin system, all senior commanders of the ISB were ordered to move on their current targets immediately.

entities.name: Reefa Been
entities.description:
Reefa Been was a Human female individual who lived during the time of the Galactic Civil War. Sometime following the Battle of Yavin in 0 BBY, the male Gungan known as Rep Been tasked a spacer with locating Reefa Been in the Naboo countryside, and escorting her back to Rep Been in the Gungan Sacred Place.

Reefa Been was a non-player character in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided, a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on December 15, 2011.

Reefa Been spawned under the generic "mission_plainsfolk" template, resulting in her consistently appearing as a Human female. Given Reefa Been's inclusion in Rep Been's questline, it is unclear if she was originally intended to be a Gungan relative of his. However, as Rep Been's quest dialogue was bugged, no mention was made of Reefa's physical characteristics. Therefore, this article assumes that the Human female depiction of Reefa is canon in the Star Wars Legends continuity, and that the surname of "Been" is merely coincidental. The questline that involved Reefa was removed from the game sometime after launch

entities.name: Beezer
entities.description:
Corporal Beezer both Beezer and Carlson were selected as members of a commando strike team that was sent to the moon of Endor by the Alliance with the objective of disabling an Imperial shield generator built there to protect the Death Star II superweapon.

Using the stolen Imperial shuttle Tydirium, the team landed on the moon and proceeded to the rear of the generator, where a security bunker acted as a backdoor. Expecting the Alliance attack, the Imperials ambushed the rebels at the bunker, but they were defeated when the local Ewok population came to the aid of the strike team. The rebels then destroyed the generator, allowing the Alliance Fleet to destroy the Death Star. Beezer had light skin, brown eyes, and brown hair. She wore a green helmet, and a brown jerkin with a white shirt.

In the current Star Wars canon, Beezer was pictured in an entry for Rebel troopers on the StarWars.com Encyclopedia.

The image used in the Encyclopedia entry was a promotional photo taken for the 1983 original trilogy film, Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi, although Beezer does not appear in the film itself. The photo depicts Beezer, and other commandos stood with protagonist Luke Skywalker as their prisoner in one of the Death Star II's corridors. A card in the 1999 Endor Limited expansion set of the Decipher Star Wars Customizable Card Game then linked the name to Eddon's character. The 2008 StarWars.com Hyperspace-exclusive short story Fists of Ion provided the character's first name as Dansra. The story's author Edward M. Erdelac, stated that the name was a tuckerization of his wife's first name.

entities.name: Dansra Beezer
entities.description:
Dansra Beezer was a Human female native of the planet Alderaan who held the rank of corporal in the Alliance to Restore the Republic by 4 ABY. She was a slicer, technician, and communications specialist who trained under Sergeant Brooks Carlson to serve as a scout for the Alliance commandos. In 4 ABY, Beezer was part of a strike team sent to the Forest Moon of Endor to deactivate the planetary shield generator protecting the Galactic Empire's second Death Star battle station in orbit around the moon.

A part of the strike team's Renegade Squadron detachment, Beezer was responsible for communications. After arriving on Endor, Beezer and the strike team were separated from the command crew following encounters with Imperial scout trooper patrols. Eventually, they encountered an All Terrain Scout Transport while making camp for the night. Beezer, whose role included jamming Imperial transmissions in case of emergencies, did so with the walker's transmissions. She later fought in the Battle of Endor, which ended with the destruction of the shield generator, allowing Alliance starfighters to destroy the Death Star.

At some point by 6 ABY, Beezer served as a sergeant in the New Republic's Intelligence Service. She worked alongside her commanding officer, Major Bren Derlin, in a mission to suspend the Reuss Corporation's rule over the planet Reuss VIII by aiding Calian shockboxer Lobar Aybock in a match that the corporation had set him up to lose with the intent of subsequently selling his organs. Beezer worked as a slicer to protect Aybock from a hostile rival employed by Reussi Torel Vorne of the Reuss Corporation, whose intent was to ensure Aybock's death. Ultimately, the New Republic succeeded in the mission, Aybock won his match, and the Reuss Corporation lost control of Reuss VIII, with the New Republic taking over the planet's government.

The Human female Dansra Beezer hailed from the planet Alderaan. She was a member of the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War against the Galactic Empire. in 0 BBY. By the year 4 ABY, Beezer attained the rank of corporal, and she served as a slicer, technician, and communications specialist. Sergeant Brooks Carlson trained her to serve as a scout for Alliance commandos.

entities.name: Deena Behar
entities.description:
Deena Behar was a Human female Corellian who worked as an assistant to Councilor Belos during the Galactic War.

During the Battle of Corellia in 3640 BBY Belos, who invited the Sith Empire to the world in the first place, had realized his mistake and began working with the Galactic Republic to undo his actions. He informed General Aves and Cole Cantarus that the Republic troops in the Labor Valley of Coronet City were being taken out by advanced droids developed by Danison Varik. Belos arranged for Deena Behar to meet with a Republic citizen and provide her with all information necessary to stop the droid production. Deena's lengthy plan involved activating the Beharen Droid Factory by activating the power generators located in the Hellfire to produce disaster relief droids able to break through the durasteel doors protecting Varik's laboratory. After giving all instructions, Deena departed, leaving the Republic citizen to do the work.

entities.name: Beilert Valance's mother
entities.description:
A human female was the mother of Beilert Valance. They lived with Valance and his father on Chorin where Valance's parents worked as miners. At one point, Valance's mother fixed his toy Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter after it broke, though Valance's father told them not to as it would only fill his head with dreams when he was destined to work as a miner. Valance's mother then told the boy's father to stop being a blurrg in the mud and that their son would have a childhood.

Beilert Valance's mother first appeared, in flashbacks, in the thirty-fourth issue of the 2020 comic series Star Wars: Bounty Hunters. The issue was written by Ethan Sacks, illustrated by Paolo Villanelli, and published by Marvel Comics

entities.description:
Janna bel Arde was a female Imperial Inquisitor who lived during the Galactic Civil War. Sometime after the Battle of Yavin, Janna bel Arde was dispatched by Grand Moff Ardus Kaine to inspect the Warren, a secret Imperial research facility located on Dantooine, because its commanding officer, Bors Teraud, was suspected of treachery. Teraud was indeed a traitor and his loyalists ambushed the Inquisitor and her stormtrooper escort during the inspection. Janna bel Arde was badly wounded, captured and imprisoned, eventually dying of her injuries in her cell.

entities.name: Arrianya Bel Iblis
entities.description:
Arrianya Bel Iblis was a Human female who served the Galactic Empire and was the wife of the powerful Corellian Senator Garm Bel Iblis.

The daughter of a well-off Core family, Bel Iblis supported Emperor Palpatine for the stabilization he brought to the Core Worlds. This drove a wedge between the married couple, who often argued over Palpatine's use of power. She, along with the Bel Iblis children, perished on Anchoron when a bomb meant for her husband detonated at the Treitamma Political Center.

It was this deliberate act of assassination that drove Garm Bel Iblis into fully backing the Alliance to Restore the Republic and even becoming one of the Rebellion's more prominent leaders.

entities.name: Reginna Bel Typolla
entities.description:
Reginna Bel Typolla or Gina was a Human female from the planet Malthor. After a period off-world in which she became involved in weapons smuggling, she returned to her home planet and became an administrative worker in the spaceport in the city of Fabrillan, where she was recruited by the Rebel Alliance as a member of a sleeper cell designated V-16.

Gina was born on the planet Malthor around 26 BBY. Sometime before 1 BBY she was active as a gunrunner in the Medepiest Uprising, but after surviving that campaign, she returned to Malthor, where she became a uniformed employee of the Fabrillan City Spaceport—specifically, she was the official charged with reviewing the documentation of all vessels docked at the facility, and making administrative copies of their cargo and passenger inventories.

Around 1 BBY, she was recruited by the Alliance to Restore the Republic as a member of Sleeper Cell V-16, tasked with simply sharing the information she had access to. Occasionally, she furnished specific details on Imperial movements through Fabrillan, or on smugglers and cargo pilots who might be useful to the Alliance, but her primary role involved making additional copies of the extensive information she obtained on shipping arriving at the port, which she would dead-drop every few days by discarding an apparently damaged computer memory device.

The clandestine methods Gina used to pass on information meant that she had no direct knowledge of other Alliance agents except her original recruiter, and she was unaware that the material she supplied found its way to Berren Sid Té, who she knew only as the head of a network of street vendors and perhaps a local information broker; she also believed that the Alliance was unware of her past activities as a gunrunner. However, although Sid was not formally told of her identity either, he had been able to work it out relatively easily due to the quantity of information he had access to, and senior Alliance personnel like General Airen Cracken were fully aware of her past—leading to a slight concern that the Empire might have also found out.

Sinissima Bel was a female smuggler active in the Post-Imperial Period. One planet she was known to visit was Gamorr where she would smuggle in illegal goods including poison and dangerous creatures to those who hired her to. In 13 ABY when the Jedi Callista Ming was investigating the murder of the Gamorrean Vrokk, and searching for the source of the poison used to kill him, she was told by the poet Sebastin Onyx that Sinissima hadn't been seen on Gamorr since the previous summer.

entities.name: Shrona Bel-Il
entities.description:
Shrona Bel-Il was a Selonian female warrior living on Corellia during the Cold War and the Galactic War.

When the reconstituted Sith Empire conquered Corellia she decided to oppose the Sith, becoming a leader. Her skills proved very useful for the fight. Darth Tormen sent his hunter to capture her and quickly the Hunter confronted to Tormen Shrona Bel-Il. The Hunter was able to gain the Selonian's attention by capturing three of their females. An outraged Shrona demanded that the Hunter release the females and lay down and die. The Hunter refused and engaged Shrona in battle, ultimately defeating the Selonian. Wounded, Shrona vowed that the Selonians will not bow before the Empire. The Hunter then froze her in carbonite to be delivered to Darth Tormen, who then, after unfreezing her, forced her to sign a treaty signifying Corellia's secession from the Republic.

Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide

However, the rebel cell led by Kanan Jarrus managed to rescue Belab, and gave her refuge in the Haven, a secret rebel hideout created to house defenseless citizens of Lothal.

Before being granted renewed hope by the Spectres, Belab lamented the vicious cycle of economic despair faced by Lothal's working populace, in the wake of the Empire's arrival.

entities.name: Belaya
entities.description:
Belaya was a Human female Jedi Guardian who resided in the Jedi Enclave on the planet Dantooine during the Jedi Civil War. A student of the renowned Jedi Master Zhar Lestin, Belaya was devoted to the Jedi traditions but struggled with controlling her emotions. She became very close to Juhani, a Cathar Padawan whose emotions were similarly volatile.

A test of humility devised by Juhani's Master, Quatra, resulted in Juhani lashing out in anger and falling to the dark side when she mistakenly believed she had killed her Master. After the fallen Padawan fled to the nearby Ancient Grove, her dark emotions turned the surrounding kath hounds aggressive, but the Jedi Council would not permit Belaya to attempt to redeem her dear companion.

When Revan, a former Jedi Knight who had lost his memories, arrived at the Jedi Enclave, Belaya confronted him about not being dressed in Jedi apparel, then apologized for her behavior. In Revan's final trial to become a Jedi once again, Master Lestin instructed him to confront and cleanse the darkness in the Ancient Grove. Revan spared Juhani and convinced her to return to the light. Afterward, Belaya expressed her gratitude to Revan for his actions, and she was reunited with Juhani until the redeemed Jedi joined Revan's quest to find the Star Forge and defeat Darth Malak and his Sith Empire.

Belaya was a young, Force-sensitive female citizen of the Galactic Republic. Belaya sought a deeper knowledge of the Force and traveled to the Jedi Enclave on the Outer Rim planet Dantooine. Jedi Master Zhar Lestin, a Twi'lek male member of the Jedi Council there, trained her as a Jedi.

Belaya Rist was first mentioned in the 2016 sourcebook Forged in Battle, a supplement to Fantasy Flight Games' Star Wars: Age of Rebellion game.

entities.name: Eppie Belden
entities.description:
Eppie Belden, maiden name Eppie Antruse, was a Bakuran female member of the Antruse family of Bakura. She joined the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. With her husband, Orn Belden, she had a son named Roviden Belden. After Roviden and Eppie both aided the Rebellion, Imperial Governor Wilek Nereus ordered her son's execution and her mind destroyed using a parasitic insect from the Jospro sector, causing her to live in a state resembling advanced senility; Orn was also eventually killed.

Belden was 132 years old by the time of the Bakura Incident, during which the Jedi Knight Luke Skywalker used the Force to reverse her condition. Using her Bakuran underground contacts and her skills as a slicer, she initiated the Bakuran Revolution and personally captured Nereus.

Eppie Antruse was a Bakuran female who was born in 128 BBY as a member of the Antruse family of Bakura. In 97 BBY, the same year as a droid uprising on Bakura, she married Senator Orn Belden and changed her name to Eppie Belden. Sometime afterward, they had their only child, Roviden.

Along with her husband and son, Eppie sympathized with the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War. Bakura was independent and neutral during the conflict until the Galactic Empire annexed Bakura in 1 ABY. Roviden, who had become an agent of the Rebellion, was executed on order of Imperial Governor Wilek Nereus; Eppie, who had also aided the Rebellion, was also ordered to be executed. Orn pleaded for her life, and Nereus agreed to grant it—but instead of killing her, Nereus destroyed her mind using a parasitic insect from the Jospro sector. The price for Orn was the loss of his voice.

entities.description:
Liiria Beldonna was the female Human leader of an organization of mercenaries also referred to as "Beldonna's Legion."

Liiria Beldonna was a Corellian woman born sometime around 25 BBY.

By roughly 1 ABY, she had built up an organization of hired mercenaries referred to as "Beldonna's League" or "Beldonna's Legion." Elements of the group were stationed on Corellia and Talus. Beldonna led the Legion under a strict set of rules and did not tolerate misconduct; her men were fiercely loyal to her.

Around 3 ABY, the group was hired by Imperial Consul-General Gilad Halsek of Kothlis, who was infatuated with Beldonna, to help bolster the planet's security. Beldonna enjoyed her position on Kothlis and frequently took her team hunting in the forest or the planet's ice caps.

A statue of Scotia Belford-Tapalo first appeared in the 1999 prequel trilogy film, Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace. The character was first identified in the 2025 reference book Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition.

entities.name: Belina
entities.description:
Belina was a girlfriend of Wedge Antilles when he was growing up. She had spent several nights with Wedge during their days on Tatooine. When Wedge and Wes Janson were stranded on Hoth, Wedge would reminisce about Belina and the great times he had had with her, hoping to keep his mind off the isolation. However, thinking about Belina only made Wedge more depressed.

Due to the dubious nature of this story and the contradictory backstory given to Wedge in Star Wars (1977) 78, it's unknown if Belina actually existed or was simply a fabrication of Wedge's story. The assertion that Wedge apparently met Belina when he was growing up on Tatooine, when he was actually from Corellia, may point more heavily towards the latter.

entities.name: Areta Bell
entities.description:
Areta Bell was a red-haired Human female native from the planet Corellia, who served in both the Alliance Fleet and the New Republic Defense Fleet during the Galactic Civil War.

Captain Areta Bell was the navigator of the GR-75 medium transport Dutyfree, and participated in the evacuation of Hoth. Escorted by Luke Skywalker and Wedge Antilles, Bell's transport ran the Imperial blockade and made it to the rendezvous point.

Following the Battle of Hoth, Areta Bell rose through the ranks of the Rebel Alliance and its successor, the New Republic. Under the new galactic government, Areta was promoted to the rank of Admiral, and commanded the Victory II-class Star Destroyer Swift Liberty. She and her ship participated in the campaign against Prince-Admiral Delak Krennel, notably in the Battle of Liinade III, where, under her command, the Swift Liberty helped the Moonshadow to disable the Ciutric Hegemony's Direption. During the battle, the Swift Liberty was the home to Rogue Squadron.

By 12 ABY, Areta Bell was assigned command of the Endurance-class fleet carrier Endurance, assisting General Wedge Antilles in the Battle of Orinda. Despite Antilles' orders to launch her squadrons of E-wing starfighters against the Executor-class Star Dreadnought Reaper, Bell hesitated, knowing that they were no match for the larger ship. Soon afterward, the Star Dreadnought Dominion arrived in system and joined in the attack on both Endurance and Antilles' command ship, Lusankya. Lusankya was able to retreat, but Endurance was destroyed, killing all onboard, including Bell.

entities.name: Bella
entities.description:
Bella was a female Twi'lek who served as a lieutenant to Captain Cavik Toth during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, she flew a personal assault transport and commanded the destroyer Reaver.

Bella was Cavik Toth's most trusted lieutenant. She oversaw the test of Toth's new weapon Trihexalon on Point Modie on the planet Maramere. Jedi Master Adi Gallia and Reti intervened to protect the innocents. Despite the results showing that the test was successful, Bella wanted to finish off the city. However, Adi Gallia managed to stop any more severe damage to the city.

Bella was then on the Sabaoth Destroyer Reaver commencing a salvage run on the Orbital Defense Cannon. However the Lok Revenants had the same idea which resulted in her forces on a Tug of War for the parts, Bella lost all of the parts but she did have a back-up plan in case of this. She sent a couple of Sabaoth Frigates to try to stop the Tritus from heading to Lok but even that had failed. She then went to Lok with Toth make a stand against the Lok Revenants but the pirates placed the Orbital Defense Cannon on one of Lok's moons known as Khons which started the Second Battle of Lok.

After the defenses failed and Nym destroyed the foundry. Lieutenant Bella decided to take the fight with Nym in her personal assault transport. Despite overwhelming firepower she was killed in a dogfight with Nym.

entities.name: Bene
entities.description:
Bene was a Force-sensitive human female Padawan of the Jedi Order who lived during the final years of the Galactic Republic. In the waning days of the Clone Wars, Bene was killed by the Sith Lord Darth Vader during the execution of Order 66 and the siege of the Jedi Temple.

Bene was a Jedi Padawan during the final days of the Clone Wars, when Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine, who was secretly the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, declared the Jedi Order traitors to the Galactic Republic. Executing Order 66 on Coruscant, the Sith Lord Darth Vader and the 501st Legion marched on the Jedi Temple to purge its occupants, including Bene. As the clone troopers stormed the Temple, Bene fought alongside Padawan Whie Malreaux and Battlemaster Cin Drallig against Vader. Despite their combined efforts, Bene, Malreaux and Drallig were killed by the new Lord of the Sith with Malreaux being the first to fall. Bene then attacked Vader in concert with Drallig, but Vader batted Bene's blade aside before grabbing her by the throat and strangling her whilst he dueled Drallig one-handed, killing the trainee Jedi before finishing off Drallig.

The duel between Bene and Vader was recorded by the Temple's surveillance system, allowing Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi to discover her fate while reviewing the security logs. Recognizing the Sith who led the attack as his one-time apprentice, Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, Kenobi deactivated the holographic recording as he was unable to watch it through to its completion. Bene's death along with the other Jedi in the Temple led Kenobi to confront Vader on Mustafar, where the former friends fought until Kenobi emerged as the victor.

Bene was a young human female who, at the time of the Clone Wars, possessed brown hair, brown eyes, and fair skin. She rallied to the Temple's defense, opposing a former Jedi-turned-Sith and his legion of clones. She was among the Jedi who tried to defeat Vader, but ultimately died defending the Temple.

At some point after the events of the Battle of Hoth, the bounty hunter Dengar kidnapped Benex and held her for ransom, demanding ten thousand credits.

entities.name: Lana Beniko
entities.description:
Lana Beniko was a Human female Sith Lord of the reconstituted Sith Empire. During the Galactic War against the Galactic Republic she served as an advisor to Dark Council member Darth Arkous. Investigating Arkous' unusual activities in the wake of the Korriban Incursion, Beniko discovered that Arkous was a traitor secretly working for the Order of Revan. To expose Arkous, Beniko teamed up with unusual allies, including Republic SIS agent Theron Shan, a Wookiee smuggler named Jakarro, and other figures of importance on galactic scale. The group tracked Arkous and his Revanite ally Rian Darok to Rakata Prime, where both were killed, only for Revan himself to enter the scene and attempt to kill Beniko and her allies. Proclaimed a traitor to the Empire, Beniko was forced into hiding along with Theron Shan and Jakarro. The three eventually tracked the Revanites to Rishi and were able to expose the conspiracy to Darth Marr. To stop Revan from resurrecting Sith Emperor Vitiate, Beniko and Marr joined forces with Jedi Grand Master Satele Shan and traveled to Yavin 4, forming a temporary coalition between the Republic and the Empire. Beniko stood against Revan himself alongside Darth Marr, Satele, Theron Shan, Jakarro, and Shae Vizla. Though Revan was defeated, the Emperor nevertheless returned to life. Darth Marr appointed Beniko as the new head of the reformed Sith Intelligence. As the new Sith Intelligence Minister, Lana opposed Vitiate's resurgence on Ziost, working with her assistant Rane Kovach and her partners from the Yavin Coalition to stop the rampage caused by the former Emperor. Though Shan and Beniko were able to shock a large number of Vitiate's victims unconscious and remove Sixth Line Jedi Master Surro from the planet's surface, Vitiate still performed the ritual that wiped out all life on the planet.

Later that year, the galaxy was invaded by the Eternal Empire of Zakuul, which overwhelmed both the Republic and the Sith Empire within a single year. Sith Intelligence effectively ceased to exist, and Beniko ventured into Eternal Empire space, looking for her partner from the Revanite crisis, believing them to be the galaxy's last hope of defeating the Eternal Empire. Over five years, Beniko made multiple contacts, such as former Knight of Zakuul Senya Tirall and exiled Zakuulan naval officer Koth Vortena, with whom she eventually managed to find and free the one Zakuulans had taken to calling the Outlander from being frozen in carbonite. While escaping pursuit, Beniko's group located and repaired the Gravestone - a legendary vessel capable of opposing the might of the Eternal Fleet. Beniko called her multiple contacts from the Sith Empire, the Republic, and the criminal underworld to converge on the remote planet Odessen, where she laid the foundations of an Alliance dedicated to defeating Eternal Emperor Arcann, becoming the right hand to her old associate, who became the Alliance Commander. In a bid to remove the advantage of Arcann's Eternal Fleet, the Alliance agreed to SCORPIO's plan to remotely take control of the GEMINI captains, but SCORPIO followed her own agenda and used that opportunity to claim the Eternal Throne for herself. In the resulting battle of Odessen, Beniko accompanied the Commander to their duel with Arcann, which ended with the Emperor defeated and taken away by his mother Senya Tirall. Arcann's sister Vaylin allied herself with SCORPIO and became the new Eternal Empress, and Beniko stood by the Commander's side as they battled her forces on Voss. An attempt by Vaylin to take control of the Gravestone led to the discovery of the hidden artificial world Iokath, which Alliance forces had to temporarily abandon when it was covered in deadly radiation. Beniko assisted in the mission to sabotage the Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin and accompanied the Commander on a mission to Nathema. Vaylin soon launched an assault on Odessen, in which Beniko fought on the front lines and which led to Vaylin's death at the Commander's hand. Alliance forces then traveled to Zakuul, where the Commander claimed the Eternal Throne and took control over the Eternal Fleet, transforming the Alliance from an anti-Zakuul insurgency into the Eternal Alliance.

entities.name: Tirgee Benyalle
entities.description:
Tirgee Benyalle was a Human female who worked as a crime boss on Kaal and used her control of the illegal gambling operations on the planet to take control of Kaal in the wake of the Galactic Empire's withdrawal.

Tirgee Benyalle was a crime boss on Kaal who exercised control of the planet's illegal gambling and entertainment industry. After the Galactic Empire's defeat in the Battle of Endor, Imperial forces withdrew from Kaal. Benyalle used her wealth and influence to move into the power vacuum, becoming Kaal's ruler and keeping the planet independent.

She used her funds to build Kaal's aquaculture industry until, in 6 ABY, she realized that she needed outside investment to expand it any further. She solicited outside powers to come to Kaal and negotiate for Kaal's aquacultural exports, and received Admiral Kermen, representing the Empire; Utoxx Prentioch, a nearby warlord; Talon Karrde, posing as Syndic Pandis Hart of the Sif-Uwana Council; and a New Republic delegation.

Benyalle received the group at her Grand Imperial hotel and casino, hosting a high-stakes sabacc game for the negotiators the night before the talks began. The next morning, she took the parties on a tour of a harvester factory and then began accepting bids aboard her luxury sail barge. Kermen, however, revealed a plan to retake Kaal by force, and he, his stormtrooper bodyguards, and the agents with which he had surreptitiously replaced most of the barge's crew attacked Benyalle. She was defended by Karrde, the New Republic delegation, and loyal crew members, but Kermen had bribed her bodyguard Sendir to betray her. The New Republic agents saved her from Sendir's attack, and escaped with her onto a submersible summoned by Karrde.

entities.name: Drusil Bephorin
entities.description:
Drusil Bephorin was a brilliant Givin female cryptologist.

For a time, Bephorin worked for the Galactic Empire, which had captured her family, against her will. She was later rescued by Luke Skywalker and Nakari Kelen in a mission spearheaded by the Rebel Alliance and agreed to work for them.

Like other members of her race, she enjoyed solving complex mathematical problems, but she was particularly skilled in areas of probability analysis and cryptography. Skywalker, in his discussions with her, often found that her keen insights gave him a new perspective on matters. She displayed a great affection for her family and frequently during her time with Skywalker and Kelen urged that every effort be made to verify that the mission to rescue her family had succeeded.

She was not identified in the film, but received a name in Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary, a reference book written by Pablo Hidalgo and released the same day as the film.

entities.description:
Bergola was the name given to one of the exoboars kept in the pens of the Palace of the Eternal Dragon on Zakuul during the Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin in 3630 BBY. Shortly before the Festival Bergola got sick and beast worker Bev tried to give her medicine, but she would not eat it. After the Eternal Empress Vaylin's speech was interrupted by the arrival of the Alliance Commander and the former Emperor Arcann, Beast master Oleg sent Bergola as well as her pack of Exoboars including Brick, Lil' Jwizzix and Rompy to deal with the captured Zakuulan rebels. After escaping a confrontation with Arcann, Vaylin ordered the Eternal Fleet to bomb the Palace into rubble.

Bergola appears in Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne during "Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw". If the player completes an optional side quest of adding glazed kell from the kitchen to her medicine, Bergola would eat it and show gratitude later, with her entire pack assisting the player throughout the rest of the chapter. Otherwise, Bergola and her pack would be hostile, requiring the player to kill them to progress.

entities.description:
Valk Beroya was a Human female Mandalorian warrior and the wife of Jos Beroya. Valk and her husband were members of Clan Vizla, and she wore white Mandalorian armor with blue and black markings. Shortly before the Battle of Rishi in the Galactic War, a group of independent operatives came to the clan's enclave on Tracyn Island to speak with Vizla, and Jos and Valk fought the group as part of Vizla's "challenges." The pair were defeated, though not killed.

Later, Valk Beroya joined Shae Vizla in her siege of the Eternal Empire's droid factory on Darvannis, leading her team inside the factory.

Jos and Valk Beroya appear as the second-to-last boss in "Blood Hunt," a Flashpoint added to the video game Star Wars: The Old Republic in the 2014 Digital Expansion Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan.

"Beroya" is the Mandalorian word for "Bounty Hunter" in Mando'a.

entities.name: Vera Beroya
entities.description:
Vera Beroya was a human female Mandalorian foundling who later served as the chieftain of Clan Awaud after the supposed death of her adoptive father, Nam Beroya during the Imperial Era. By the time she became a chieftain, Vera was considered young and battle-hardened.

Beroya, a human woman, was tall and muscular, a powerful build. Decisive and confident in combat, Beroya relished every chance to go into battle. Leading Clan Awaud from the front, she screamed in battle and, when her ammunition was depleted, charged to the front lines. However, Beroya was unsure of herself as a civic leader and agonized over decisions that affected her entire clan.

Beroya had a tactical mind and combat prowess, earning the respect of the Mandalorian clan she led for those attributes. In melee combat, she fought comparably to a legendary Mandalorian berserker, destroying everything in her path.

Beroya wielded a SHUKUR-05 light repeater and a massive mythosaur axe. She wore heavy Beskar'gam armor.

entities.name: Berri
entities.description:
Berri was a female Twi'lek child from Tatooine who worked in the kitchens at Krayn's palace.

She and her mother Mazie were slaves in the spice-processing facilities on Nar Shaddaa. They helped Anakin Skywalker to provoke Krayn's slaves into revolting, resulting in their freedom.

Berri herself, in her kitchen role, was able to retrieve Siri Tachi and Anakin Skywalker's lightsabers from Tachi's quarters (where the Jedi had hidden them beneath her sleep-couch), slipping the weapons through a food-delivery panel in the door of the high-security cell in which Berri's master had incarcerated the Jedi. Her courageous action allowed Tachi and Skywalker to escape their imprisonment by Krayn, but also to then initiate the slave revolt, which ultimately secured freedom for the slaves of Nar Shaddaa and ended with Skywalker's killing of the infamous pirate and crime-lord.

entities.name: Doman Beruss
entities.description:
Doman Beruss was a human female Corellian politician and a signator of the New Republic.

Doman Beruss was a member of the Corellian branch of the well-known Beruss family of Illodia As a representative of Corellia, Beruss became one of the nine signatories of the Declaration of the Alliance of Free Planets. Four weeks later, She subsequently served as a representative of the Corellian exiles on the New Republic Provisional Council.

Approximately one year after the Battle of Endor, General Airen Cracken informed Beruss and the rest of the Council of reports that Emperor Sate Pestage had been charged with treason and fled Coruscant. Beruss advocated for a New Republic mission to rescue Pestage, arguing that successfully doing so would render other Imperials more willing to defect from the declining Galactic Empire. A New Republic team secured Pestage on Ciutric, only to be trapped there by Imperial forces. Although her great-nephew Avan was a participant in the endangered mission, Beruss recommended not sending reinforcements, believing any escalation of the situation would be detrimental to the Republic. At the same time, Avan worried that his great-aunt was holding back reinforcements to avoid the appearance of favoritism toward him. Despite the lack of support, Avan survived the mission, which ultimately failed to keep Pestage in Republic custody.

In 6 ABY, as the New Republic was preparing for an attempt to seize Coruscant, Doman Beruss attended a meeting of the Provisional Council. There, she pointed out to the other councilors that whoever was able to claim Coruscant would be seen as the legitimate government of the galaxy, and that the warlord Zsinj had likely taken notice of the Republic's recent push toward the capital. Beruss was present at another meeting the following day, in which the debate over how to approach Coruscant continued. In response to Admiral Gial Ackbar's proposal to send a team of military specialists to Coruscant prior to the main attack, Beruss asked Airen Cracken, who specialized in such matters, if he felt prepared to handle the operation. She also expressed approval of Councilor Borsk Fey'lya's plan to distract Imperial forces by freeing Black Sun operatives from Kessel and releasing them on Coruscant.

entities.description:
Eryl Besa was a female Human Jedi who, in 27 ABY, participated in the Mission to Myrkr.

Eryl's father had been a space racer, and she had been born in the middle of one of his races, in 7 ABY. She later participated in many of his races, learning to use the Force to discover where in the galaxy she was at any given moment. She later joined the New Jedi Order.

During the Yuuzhan Vong War, Eryl joined the Myrkr strike team. Due to her ability to know exactly what part of space she was in at any given time, her role in the mission was to let the team know when they were at Myrkr. During the mission, she and Raynar Thul became close, until Eryl died when she was hit in the face with razor bugs on Myrkr.

She entered the tree and two days later, she re-emerged as a member of the Wyrd, having given in the dark side of the Force. Besaama was later redeemed and she abandoned the dark side.

entities.name: Borga Besadii Diori
entities.description:
Borga Besadii Diori was a Hutt from the Besadii clan.

Borga was the parent of Randa Besadii Diori and led the clan after the demise of Durga Besadii Tai, responsible for the failed Darksaber Project. She frequently alternated between female and male. During the Yuuzhan Vong War in 26 ABY, the Hutt in her female form negotiated a truce between the Yuuzhan Vong and the Hutts, to let them occupy some of its space. However, the Yuuzhan Vong had other plans and planned to betray the Hutts. To complicate the matter, the Hutts were negotiating with the New Republic to sell the information on the invaders' next attack. When the Yuuzhan Vong found out, they immediately attacked Hutt space. Borga led the Hutt defenses of Nal Hutta, however, his attempt was futile and the sector was conquered, forcing the Hutts to move to planets like Tatooine and other Hutt establishments. Borga and many other Hutts, however, remained on Nal Hutta as prisoners. The Hutt tried to persuade the Yuuzhan Vong into releasing them.

Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook

entities.name: Decca Besadii Diori
entities.description:
Decca Besadii Diori, also known as Decca the Hutt, was daughter of Gardulla Besadii the Elder and the sister of Gardulla Besadii the Younger.

After her mother's supposed death in 32 BBY, Decca inherited Gardulla's fortune. Decca started a fleet made up of pirates, mercenaries, bounty hunters and thugs. For a time, Decca's center of operations was on C-Foroon, near Tatooine, until she was chased offworld. She then relocated her thugs, goons, and cronies, together with her operations, principally in the spice trade, to the planet Mawan.

Shortly before 25 BBY, a civil war erupted on Mawan. Decca took advantage of the chance to take Mawan for the Hutts, but two rival gangs, one led by Feeana Tala and the other by Striker, were already fighting for the food and water supply on the planet. Decca held a personal grudge against Striker, who hit her operation when she first arrived on the planet, managing to seize the capital city's power grid and a large cache of weapons, while Decca was able to hold on to Naatan's main tunnels and transports. Striker, however, continued to strike, to keep all the fuel away from Decca, making her even more angry. The Jedi led by Master Yaddle, Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his Padawan Anakin Skywalker disrupted the civil war.

But things went from bad to worse when the Jedi arrived. Decca was celebrating a victory against Striker's gang at one of her "revels" when Obi-Wan, Anakin, and two of Tala's associates, Swanny Mull and Rorq, infiltrated the Hutt's stronghold. In the thick of the party, after Swanny and the Rooters had played their music and Decca had given a speech, Striker's force ambushed the Hutt compound and attacked her gang.

entities.name: Gardulla Besadii the Elder
entities.description:
Gardulla Besadii the Elder was a female Besadii Hutt of the Hutt Clan prior to and during the Clone Wars. Prior to the Clone Wars, Gardulla was the owner of Shmi and Anakin Skywalker, but lost them to Watto in a bet. She was eventually killed by Kylo Ren within her own fortress on Tatooine.

A female Hutt born on Nal Hutta, Gardulla Besadii the Elder became a prominent member of the Besadii division of the Hutt Clan and was one of the most powerful Hutt crime lords on Tatooine. alongside Jabba, she watched as her former slave, Anakin Skywalker won the Boonta Eve Classic podrace from Jabba's box seats.

In 21 BBY, following Ziro the Hutt's breakout during the Clone Wars, Gardulla and the Hutt Council met at her palace on Nal Hutta and demanded that Ziro give up the Council's records. When Jedi Masters Obi-Wan Kenobi and Quinlan Vos arrived, Gardulla asked them how the war was going and denied that the Hutts had anything to do with Ziro's escape or Cad Bane. When Vos accused her and the council of freeing Ziro, Gardulla said that he was lucky that the reasonable Kenobi was with him, or he would not be allowed to leave alive. Following that encounter, Gardulla and the Council discovered that Ziro had escaped. They then hired Bane to track Ziro down.

Gardulla would live well past the other members of the Hutt Council, surviving in 3 ABY the following year. she lived in a fortress on Tatooine and plotted to reclaim her former glory. She acquired three rancors alongside some Weequay guards to defend her fortress alongside a force-sensitive creature who could stop a potential force user that may try to challenge her. Following Kylo Ren's ascension to Supreme Leader of the First Order, the grandson of Vader was on a mission to learn more about Vader's legacy. With help from Vaneé, Ren learned of his grandfather's enslavement by Gardulla and forcibly entered her fortress by killing her guards and rancors. When he requested an audience with the Hutt, she asked him why he had come to see her, flattered that she was of enough importance to be so violently approached. Ren stated that he was there for something she had done in the past, to which she responded asking to hear it, as revenge stories were something she enjoyed hearing. Ren said that she owned his grandfather when he was young, and she defended her actions by stating that slavery was not illegal in Hutt Space, then or now. She then asked for her name, to which he threatened her and lit his lightsaber. She ordered her guards to fire on him, but Ren was able to take down all of them. That was when the force-sensitive creature in her court used telekinesis to take Ren's lightsaber. She told him that Skywalker's story was now his, and knocked him out and chained him in her prison.

Elta Besk was the head of Dynamic Automata, a droid design and manufacturing corporation. She inherited the role from her father, Metron Besk, who founded the company.

Shortly after the Battle of Endor, Besk was invited to the Pentastar Talks aboard the Reaper. Imperial warlord Grand Moff Ardus Kaine, the convenor of the talks, was proposing the formation of the Pentastar Alignment. Besk agreed with his proposals out of concern that the New Republic's focus on freedom could lead to a revolt among the largely Entymal slave labor used by her corporation.
