entities.name: T'Seely
entities.description:
T'Seely was a male Hasikian Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order during the last decades of the Galactic Republic.

As a Force-sensitive, T'Seely joined the Jedi Temple's academy, where he began training in the ways of the Force. Stationed at the Temple at the start of the Clone Wars, a conflict which erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY, T'Seely was assigned to pilot a shuttle to carry Grand Master Yoda to the Republic Executive Building to conduct a meeting with Supreme Chancellor Palpatine and Senator Bail Organa of Alderaan concerning the state of affairs in the war-torn Republic. T'Seely was concerned for the safety of Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Knight Anakin Skywalker, as he had heard many rumors floating around the Temple as to who survived the costly battle on Geonosis.

Sometime later, around the time of the Fall of Falleen, T'Seely was knighted in an attempt to bring more Knights into the war effort. Ascending to the rank of General within the Grand Army of the Republic, T'Seely was stationed at the Temple and assigned as an aide to Communications Chief Ban-yaro in the Temple's comm center. While there, the Hasikian received an urgent message sent by Senator Organa for Master Kenobi, and relayed it to the Jedi Master in the Situation Room.

entities.name: T'Teknulp
entities.description:
T'Teknulp was a Chadra-Fan Jedi General during the Clone Wars who fought in many perilous battles. When the planet Farquar III aligned with the Separatists, the Republic sent its forces to destroy a droid factory on the world, giving T'Teknulp command of a division of clone troopers. During the battle of Farquar III, T'Teknulp and his division were en route to reinforce General Obi-Wan Kenobi and his 7th Sky Corps when they encountered enemy forces in planetary orbit. T'Teknulp did not survive the engagement, and Kenobi was forced to continue the battle unaided.

A Chadra-Fan, T'Teknulp was one of the many Jedi called to lead the Republic forces against the Separatists when the Clone Wars broke out T'Teknulp developed a reputation as a skilled general while serving in the Clone Wars, with General Obi-Wan Kenobi having complete confidence in his abilities. By the weeks leading up to the battle of Farquar III, he had been involved in many dangerous battles but had not once been injured.

When the planet Farquar III aligned with the Separatists, the Republic sent its forces to destroy a droid factory on the world, giving T'Teknulp command of a clone trooper division. During the battle, T'Teknulp's division was en route to reinforce Kenobi's 7th Sky Corps when they encountered enemy forces in planetary orbit. T'Teknulp assured Kenobi that he would be at his position within five minutes; however, T'Teknulp and his division were killed. After Kenobi's Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, arrived and destroyed a number of enemy droidekas that were harassing his Master, the clone commander of the 7th Sky Corps, Cody, gave them the news of T'Teknulp's fate. Both Kenobi and Skywalker were stunned by the news, with Skywalker reacting with disbelief, stating that T'Teknulp had been just behind him. The two mourned the loss of yet another Jedi in the Clone Wars before they proceeded to attack the droid factory.

T'Teknulp was well respected during the Clone Wars, having been involved in many dangerous battles, but had not once been injured. Obi-Wan Kenobi regarded T'Teknulp as a skilled general, holding complete faith in the Chadra-Fan's ability to reinforce him during the battle of Farquar III despite having encountered enemy forces in planetary orbit. T'Teknulp was unsuccessful, however, as he was killed before reaching Kenobi. T'Teknulp was known by others to have a strangely jovial and high squeaky voice; Kenobi noted that he always sounded happy no matter the circumstances.

entities.name: Tanis
entities.description:
Tanis was a Jedi Master who served the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Tanis fought against the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet of Ryloth alongside Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker. While Skywalker was making a holorecord in which he requested aid from the Republic, he was spotted by a Confederate battle droid. Skywalker attacked the droid, advising Tanis and Commander Flybane to stay close.

Master Tanis was mentioned on the official LucasArts website, in a [http://www.lucasarts.com/games/jointheclonewars/holocomm.html?message_id=2&cam_requested=false holorecord made by Anakin Skywalker] on September 14, 2009. Although the record served as promotional material for the video game Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes, Tanis did not appear in the finished product.

entities.name: Jaro Tapal
entities.description:
Jaro Tapal, a Force-sensitive Lasat male, was a Jedi Master who served the Galactic Republic with distinction as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Adhering to a firm and disciplined doctrine, Tapal mentored his Padawan, Cal Kestis, in the ways of the Force. In the aftermath of the Bracca Invasion, Tapal and his apprentice were betrayed by their clone troopers of the 13th Battalion during Order 66. Although he was mortally wounded while attempting to escape to Bracca, Tapal managed to get Kestis to safety. Before dying, he urged Kestis to hold the line, await the Jedi High Council's signal, and to trust only in the Force.

Tapal's death haunted his former Padawan for years. Kestis, who kept Jaro Tapal's lightsaber, vowed to honor his Master's teaching and sacrifice as he set out to restore the Jedi Order during the reign of the Galactic Empire.

Jaro Tapal joined the Jedi Order prior to the onset of the Clone Wars and was assigned to Jedi Master Yaddle as her Padawan. Tapal would keep a copy of the theses written by Yaddle, which were about little-known Jedi arts. He eventually rose through the ranks and became a Jedi Master himself.

During the final years of the Galactic Republic, Jedi Master Jaro Tapal served in the Grand Army of the Republic—holding the military rank of Jedi General—as commanding officer of the 13th Battalion. In addition to his military responsibilities, Tapal found time to continue the training of Kestis, who had by that point become his Padawan, while away from the Jedi Temple on Coruscant. At some point in his life, Tapal befriended Jedi Knight Cere Junda, who regarded him as a true guardian of the Republic. At one point in the war, Tapal and Kestis encountered droidekas, one of the deadliest droid models used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. As the strong deflector shields that these droids possessed made them a great challenge even for the Jedi, Kestis was left without action due to this being his first encounter with these droids, which led Tapal to destroy them alone.

entities.name: Xaset Terep
entities.description:
Xaset Terep was a male Human Jedi who lived in the time of the Mandalorian Wars and the Jedi Civil War.

During a gathering called by Malak, circa 3963 BBY (around the time Revan decided to involve the Order in the Mandalorian Wars), Malak made a great plea to his fellow Jedi to follow Revan and himself into war against the Mandalorian threat.

Terep ended up casting his lot in with the rogue Knights (among them Meetra Surik, Cariaga Sin, Talvon Esan, and Nisotsa) going against the Jedi High Council's wishes, and by doing so, helped to split the Jedi Order in two.

In Meetra's vision, he wielded a violet lightsaber.

entities.name: Three Jedi Masters
entities.description:
In 19 BBY, towards the end of Operation: Knightfall, the Sith Lord Darth Vader's march upon the planet of Coruscant's Jedi Temple, the Jedi within the Temple had been nearly exterminated. At this point, three Jedi Masters took command of the remaining Jedi and Temple Security Force personnel. The trio of Jedi lead them through one last rally against the Galactic Republic's army, but it proved unsuccessful and all three were then killed by Vader's force.

The three Jedi Masters are killed by the player in Star Wars: Battlefront II, but the means of their execution is not standardized. They can be killed either as Vader or a clone trooper at the whim of the player.

entities.name: Laan Tik
entities.description:
Laan Tik was a Kajain'sa'Nikto member of the Jedi Order who served as a Jedi General of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Tik participated in the Battle of Mimban in 22 BBY, along with Clone Captain Rex, the 501st Legion, and the Mud Jumpers of the 224th Division. The Jedi was killed during the battle, and Tik's lightsaber was later used by Junior Representative Jar Jar Binks to save Rex's life.

Laan Tik was a member of the Kajain'sa'Nikto and a part of the Jedi Order, holding the rank of Jedi General of the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

During the intense battle against the forces of the Separatist Droid Army, Rex ordered the 501st Legion to advance and the Mud Jumpers to reinforce Tik. The general, however, replied that help was not needed and Force pushed a number of B1-series battle droids. While the Clone Captain and fellow 501st Legion clone trooper Hardcase spoke on evacuating Junior Representative Jar Jar Binks out of the area, Tik was killed by a shot to the chest. Following the death of the general, Binks paid respects to Tik's body and took Tik's lightsaber so that it would not fall into enemy hands. Since Galactic Republic forces were being defeated, Rex ordered a retreat.

Following Tik's death, Binks was the highest-ranking member of the Republic forces on Mimban, and thus the chain of command fell to him. Not wanting to lose more lives while destroying the Separatist shield generator, the Republic's target of the mission, Rex ordered that Republic High Command be contacted for extraction. However, he also planned to proceed to the shield generator alone and destroy it.

entities.name: Tiplar
entities.description:
Tiplar was a yellow-skinned Mikkian female Jedi Master who served as a Jedi General within the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. As part of her military service, Tiplar and her twin sister Tiplee led a unit of clone troopers along with Clone Commander Doom. Such was the case during the Battle of Ringo Vinda, in which the three of them collaborated with Jedi General Anakin Skywalker's 501st Legion to oust the Confederacy of Independent Systems from a space station orbiting Ringo Vinda. At the height of the campaign, 501st clone trooper Tup executed Tiplar by shooting her in the head due to a malfunction in his inhibitor chip, which triggered a premature activation of Clone Protocol 66, a Sith-implanted directive that branded all Jedi as traitors. Tiplar's death cost the Republic forces a potential victory and instead forced them to retreat, while Tup's apparent act of treason sparked a high-profile investigation that led ARC trooper Fives to uncover the existence and function of the clones' inhibitor chips.

Tiplar, a Mikkian female, lived during the final decades of the Galactic Republic. She and her twin sister, Tiplee, were both Force-sensitive and were inducted into the Jedi Order Both of them eventually attained the rank of Jedi Master. Following the outbreak of the Clone Wars, Tiplar and her sister accepted commissions as Jedi Generals in the Grand Army of the Republic,

In 19 BBY, Upon encountering a squad of BX-series droid commandos, Tiplar ordered Doom and his clone soldiers to shore up their left flank against the incoming droids. The appearance of a trio of droidekas led Tiplar to have her men prop up their energy shields, which they used to repel the droideka's heavy barrages of blasterfire. Reaching out with the Force, Tiplar telekinetically pushed the droidekas off their footing long enough for Doom and his soldiers to roll Electro Magnetic Pulse grenades underneath the droids' shields, thus disabling their adversaries. They proceeded to the communications center, where they eliminated the droids manning the station.

Once they had secured their position, Tiplar and Tiplee met with Skywalker and his troops from the 501st Legion to coordinate their assault on Trench's command center. Trench had requested reinforcements, so it was imperative that they capture the enemy facility as soon as possible. Since there were three hallways that led to the command center, Skywalker suggested that each Jedi General take one of the corridors; their teams would converge on Trench's position at the same time, thereby overwhelming his defenses. Skywalker had ARC trooper Fives and 501st trooper Tup bring along ten of their best soldiers to supplement Tiplar and Doom's men, who had been severely depleted in the earlier assault.

entities.name: Tiplee
entities.description:
Tiplee was a red-skinned Mikkian female Jedi Master who, along with her twin sister, Tiplar, served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars against the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Tiplee and her sister were commissioned as Jedi Generals in the Grand Army of the Republic, and the two fought in the Battle of Ringo Vinda in 19 BBY. During the campaign, Tiplar was murdered by clone trooper Tup after a malfunction in the clone's behavioral modification biochip that triggered a premature activation of Clone Protocol 66, a Sith-implanted command that forced clones to kill Jedi as traitors. Tiplee was present at the time and watched her sister die.

The death of Tiplar pushed Tiplee to increase the power of her aggressive tactics. Later in the war, Tiplee was part of the Jedi team investigating the aftermath of a battle between the forces of Maul, leader of the criminal army known as the Shadow Collective, and the Confederacy of Independent Systems on the planet Ord Mantell. Along with Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, Tiplee led an assault on Vizsla Keep 09, a Mandalorian supply outpost, where Maul was hiding. During the fight, Tiplee was killed by Count Dooku, leader of the Separatists, who had formed an alliance with Maul.

A Force-sensitive Mikkian Mikkia, Both sisters eventually achieved the rank of Jedi Master. serving as Jedi Generals within the Republic's Grand Army.

Tiplee and Tiplar occasionally served alongside each other, where they fought alongside the unit of clone troopers led by Clone Commander Doom as part of the force directed to take an orbital space station from the Confederacy. Along with Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, the two Jedi sisters led the clone troopers under their command against the battle droid forces of Admiral Trench.

entities.name: B'dard Tone
entities.description:
B'dard Tone was a male Coway Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Master Tone violated the direct order of the Jedi High Council and attempted to assassinate Supreme Commander Grievous of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

A Force-sensitive Coway, B'dard Tone was a member of the Jedi Order, learning the ways of the Force and attaining the rank of Jedi Master. By the time of the Separatist Crisis which plagued the Galactic Senate following the historically pivotal Invasion of Naboo, Tone had selected the rare Duinuogwuin Initiate Zephata'ru'tor as his Padawan.

In 22 BBY, when the conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems came to a head, Tone joined Master of the Order Mace Windu's strike team assembled to rescue Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker and Senator Padmé Amidala from execution on the planet of Geonosis. Participating in the storming of the Petranaki arena, Tone was one of a few dozen Jedi to survive the opening battle of the Clone Wars.

Taking up the rank of General in the Grand Army of the Republic, Tone joined the war effort. During the first year of the war, Tone was a part of a mission to retake Nadiem from Confederate control. During the mission, Tone had his first encounter with Supreme Commander of the Separatist Droid Army, General Grievous, engaging the Kaleesh cyborg in a lightsaber duel. Though Tone survived the encounter, Grievous severed Tone's right arm and badly disfigured the left side of his face. When the Separatist general fled the planet at the conclusion of the Battle of Nadiem, Zephata'ru'tor gave chase, attempting to stop Grievous using his species' natural ability to fly. Once he reached the general, however, Grievous activated his starfighter's hyperdrive in Zephata'ru'tor's path, disintegrating him into nothing.

entities.name: Flint Torul
entities.description:
Flint Torul was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars; a conflict in which Torul gave his life. Unbeknownst to the Order, Torul had sired a child who survived him by several decades.

A Force-sensitive, Flint Torul was discovered by the Jedi Order and inducted into their academy on Coruscant to study the Force. Living in the Jedi Temple for much of his life, Torul went on to pass his Trials of Knighthood and ascended to the rank of Jedi Knight. When the Clone Wars erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Jedi Torul dutifully answered the Jedi High Council's call to arms and took up the rank of General within the newly formed Grand Army of the Republic.

In the final year of the war, Torul was stationed on Belderone when the planet faced an attack from the Confederacy. While aiding in the hasty evacuation, Torul had a secret affair with a local woman named Zana; fathering a child. Not long after their meeting, Torul was flying with 27 other Jedi when General Grievous attacked the evacuation convoy. Unleashing the firepower of his fully armed, modified Providence-class carrier/destroyer named Invisible Hand, Grievous vaporized all of the Jedi and many refugee ships.

Survived by his lover and his son Flint, Torul's memory would give his namesake an idol in an increasingly darkening time as the Galactic Empire wiped out all vestiges of the Republic and the Jedi Order. Despite the good influence that his role as a Jedi would play on young Flint, the young man fell to the dark side of the Force when his mother was killed Eventually, however, Flint returned to the light and became a benevolent ambassador to the Firrerreo.

entities.name: Traavis
entities.description:
Traavis was a Human male Jedi Knight who served as a general during the Clone Wars. In 19 BBY, during the Galactic Republic's sieges in the Outer Rim, Traavis led a campaign for five months against the Cassandran Worlds of Monhudle, New Bakstre, and Biitu.

Later in the year, he moved his troops to the Separatist world of Garqi. After securing the planet, Traavis ordered the clone commandos of Aiwha Squad to search for civilians and to take them to refugee camps. As he was inspecting the camps, the squad returned with an orphan named Evan, whose parents were killed during a skirmish between the Grand Army of the Republic's clones and the Confederacy's battle droids. Traavis met with the boy and congratulated the squad for completing their mission. As the Jedi was speaking to the other commandos, Aiwha Squad's leader, Sarge, received Order 66 from Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, commanding all clone troopers to eliminate the Jedi. The clones immediately turned against Traavis and executed him.

Traavis, a Human male, was born during the final decades of the Galactic Republic on the asteroid Skip 5, located in the Smuggler's Run. During the Clone Wars—the conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems—Traavis served both the Jedi Order and the Republic as a Jedi Knight and general in the Grand Army of the Republic. In 19 BBY, during the Republic's Outer Rim Sieges, Traavis led a five-month campaign against the Cassandran Worlds of Monhudle, New Bakstre, and Biitu. Later in the year, Traavis' forces captured the planet Garqi, and the Jedi Knight began to inspect the planet's overcrowded refugee camps. He ordered the clone commandos of Aiwha Squad to search for civilians and to take them to the camps for protection. Traavis eventually received news that General Grievous, the Supreme Commander of the Separatist Droid Army, had been killed.

While Traavis was inspecting a refugee camp, Aiwha Squad's leader, Sarge, reported on the mission's success. The commando also introduced the Jedi to a boy named Evan, whose parents were killed during a skirmish between the Republic's clones and the Separatist's battle droids. Traavis told Evan that they would get the orphan a bed in the refugee camp and some food. He commended the squad on their successful mission and informed them that Grievous was dead, stating that the war was likely nearing completion. However, as Traavis conferred with the other clones, RC-1013 received Order 66 from Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, which commanded them to eliminate the Jedi Knights as enemies of the Republic. Sarge immediately ordered Aiwha Squad to execute Traavis. The Jedi attempted to reach for his lightsaber to defend himself, but he was killed by the squad's blaster fire.

entities.name: Axton Tredway
entities.description:
Axton Tredway was a male Human Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the final years of both institutions. A survivor of the rise of the Galactic Empire and the beginning of the Great Jedi Purge, Tredway was eventually killed by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader.

A Force-sensitive male Human, Axton Tredway was born into the wealthy Tredway family. As a youngling, Tredway was given to the Jedi Order for training in the ways of the Force. Tredway married a woman, and fathered two children, Dena and Erling, and kept them with their mother at his family's estate on the asteroid 24 Tredway in the Sil'Lume asteroid belt. While not on assignment for the High Council, Tredway returned to his home and aided in the family's mining business. Tredway became well acquainted with fellow Knight Anakin Skywalker, and introduced Skywalker to his family.

In 19 BBY, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine revealed himself to the Jedi Order as the mysterious Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious, defeating the Jedi's leaders and issuing Order 66, which caused the clone troopers of the Grand Army to turn on their Jedi commanders, executing thousands across the galaxy. Hidden within his estate, Tredway avoided the beginning of the Great Jedi Purge.

Tredway did not stay hidden for long, as he had made a costly error in showing Skywalker the location of his secret abode. Skywalker had fallen to the dark side of the Force and became known as Darth Vader, Sidious's most powerful Jedi hunter. Not long after the rise of the Galactic Empire, Imperial forces arrived in the asteroid field, seeking Tredway. The Jedi fled his home, hoping to draw attention away from his family and their business, but the Empire continued their harassment. Though they did not harm the Tredway family, Tredway's son Erling grew resentful of his father for leaving them with such a burden, too young to understand what was going on. At one point, Tredway returned, and Erling confronted him, furious over his absence.

entities.name: Etain Tur-Mukan
entities.description:
Etain Tur-Mukan was a female Human Jedi Knight and General who lived during the Clone Wars. She was the Padawan of Jedi Master Kast Fulier. They both were assigned to Qiilura some time after the First Battle of Geonosis to collect vital information about the Trade Federation and Separatist infrastructure on the planet. It was during this assignment that she would first encounter the clone commandos of Omega Squad, with whom she would later become increasingly involved.

After finishing her mission on Qiilura, Etain completed her Jedi Trials under Arligan Zey and became a full Jedi Knight. She served in multiple command positions throughout the Clone Wars, and completed assignments with both Omega Squad, Delta Squad and other clone units on Coruscant, Kashyyyk and elsewhere. During one of these missions she would break the Jedi Code's rule of attachment by falling in love with Darman, RC-1136, a clone commando in Omega Squad, and becoming pregnant with his child, Venku Skirata. The two would later marry in the traditional Mandalorian way shortly before her death in 19 BBY.

Etain was killed shortly after the issue of Order 66 in the aftermath of Operation: Knightfall at a security checkpoint at Shinarcan Bridge, Coruscant near the Jedi Temple. Etain had recently returned from Kashyyyk and was attempting to rejoin the rest of Clan Skirata and escape off-planet. On the way to the rendezvous, Etain had to pass through a security checkpoint on Shinarcan Bridge when several Padawans were discovered in the crowd. A melee ensued as the Padawans tried to escape, and Etain instinctively jumped between a clone trooper and a panicking Jedi Padawan, receiving the downward arc of the blow meant for the clone, severing her spine and killing her nearly instantaneously, only meters from her loved ones.

Taken from her parents at a young age after being discovered to be Force-sensitive, Etain Tur-Mukan was trained in the ways of the Force at the Coruscant Jedi Temple. After completing her education at the Temple's academy, Tur-Mukan was selected as Padawan by the Jedi Master Kast Fulier. Together, the Master-Padawan pair accepted missions from the Jedi High Council and traveled the galaxy together.

entities.name: Tyffix
entities.description:
Tyffix was a Gand Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars. In 21 BBY, Tyffix and their Padawan, Cal, were dispatched to lead a Republic clone trooper force on the planet Thustra when the world's populace attempted to secede from the Republic. Shortly after arriving on the planet, the Republic forces were attacked by the native Sephi, and Tyffix was killed when a suicide bomber destroyed the Republic command center.

A Force-sensitive Gand, Tyffix was a member of the Jedi Order who held the rank of Jedi Master during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Tyffix selected the young Human Cal as their Padawan, training the youth to think like a warrior.

In 21 BBY, Tyffix and Cal were part of a Republic task force sent to the planet Thustra when the native Sephi population wanted to secede from the Republic. What was originally planned to be a show of force soon turned into a bloody battle, in which Sephi suicide bombers inflicted heavy casualties on the Republic troops. While discussing strategy with fellow Jedi Master Tyr and a clone officer inside the Republic command center, Tyffix was victim to the Sephi tactics when a suicide bomber destroyed the command tent, killing all present except Tyr's Padawan, Pix, whom her Master had Force-pushed out of the tent before the explosion. Cal saw the explosion from afar and called out for his master. Cal and Pix then sent a message to the Jedi and Republic on the planet Coruscant informing them of Tyffix and Tyr's deaths and calling for help.

Tyffix taught Cal that thinking like a warrior and a conqueror would be the only way to survive the Clone Wars, a lesson the Padawan took to heart but one that ultimately led to the Padawan's death later during the battle.

entities.name: Tyr
entities.description:
Tyr was a male Weequay Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive Weequay, Tyr was educated by the Jedi Order in the ways of the Force, attaining the rank of Jedi Master. Because he was raised at the Coruscant Jedi Temple, Master Tyr did not worship the Quay totem that his people who grew up on Sriluur dedicated their lives to following fanatically. Wearing his long black hair in a tight braid, Master Tyr selected the young Human Initiate Pix as his Padawan.

When the Clone Wars erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems in 22 BBY, Master Tyr took up the rank of Senior Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic and contributed his lightsaber to the war effort. Assigned to the campaign on Thustra, Master Tyr and Padawan Pix joined Master Tyffix and his Padawan, Cal, in attempting to prevent the Sephi from joining the Confederacy. While Masters Tyr and Tyffix were going over strategy with their clone troopers in a battlefield command center, a suicide bomber attacked their tent. While the two Masters were killed, Master Tyr had successfully evacuated both Padawans from the tent using the Force.

As a Jedi Master, Tyr was proficient in the use of Force powers, demonstrating his skill at the Battle of Thustra when he pushed his Padawan, Pix, out of the command tent before it was engulfed by a suicide bombing. His ability to sense the imminent danger, as well as act accordingly in time to it, is testament to an aptitude for precognition.

entities.name: Ulseh
entities.description:
Ulseh was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive male educated in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, Ulseh was made a Jedi Master and selected the Jedi Initiate Ren Auglu as his Padawan. While he was training Auglu, the Clone Wars erupted between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, and Master Ulseh took up the rank of General in the Grand Army of the Republic.

Dispatched to the planet of Argul, the Master-Padawan pair participated in the campaign there, overseeing the evacuation of the injured Argullians while Master Nemen Ull held back the Separatist Droid Army. When one of the Republic's Acclamator-class assault ships was shot down by the Confederacy's artillery, Ulseh went to help the crash survivors escape the wreckage. However, the droid artillery began firing upon the ship again, and Ulseh was killed.

entities.name: Bre'ano Umakk
entities.description:
Bre'ano Umakk was a male Mon Calamari Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order before the rise of the Galactic Empire.

A Force-sensitive Mon Calamari, Bre'ano Umakk was discovered by the Jedi at a very young age and was taken to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant where he was to learn the ways of the Force. Later, the Clone Wars broke out after the First Battle of Geonosis happened in 22 BBY after Obi-Wan Kenobi had overheard a secret meeting of various heads of major corporations, some of which represented their worlds in the Galactic Senate of the Republic, and formed the Confederacy of Independent Systems. Umakk fought side by side with clones of the Grand Army of the Republic.

In 19 BBY, the last year of the war, it became clear that the Supreme Chancellor and leader of the Republic, Palpatine, was known to be the Sith Lord Darth Sidious and had influenced the war in his favor in recent years to annihilate the Jedi. Even during the fierce battles that took hold in the Outer Rim, Palpatine and Anakin Skywalker, who had fallen to the dark side and become Darth Vader, managed to turn against the Jedi by issuing Order 66 and pull the Galactic Senate to his side in forming the Galactic Empire. Umakk survived the purge and settled on Dantooine where he trained other Jedi, who had survived the purge, in defensive combat throughout the years. He taught others the ways of the Jedi in hopes of destroying those who followed the ways of the dark side.

entities.name: Luminara Unduli
entities.description:
Luminara Unduli was a Force-sensitive Mirialan female Jedi Master during the final days of the Jedi Order. She commanded the 41st Elite Corps of the Grand Army of the Republic, and was the master of Padawan Barriss Offee. Together, they fought in numerous battlefields of the Clone Wars, before Offee turned against the Jedi Order and bombed the Jedi Temple, much to the horror of Unduli.

At the end of the war, Unduli fought in the Battle of Kashyyyk. She was arrested and executed after the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Sidious issued Order 66 and destroyed the Jedi Order. The Galactic Empire would later use her remains to attract and kill any Jedi that survived Order 66. One such trap was laid for Kanan Jarrus and the crew of the Ghost, who believed Unduli was alive and being imprisoned on Stygeon Prime. They mounted a rescue mission, only to discover that it was a trap by the Grand Inquisitor. The rebels escaped with the knowledge that Unduli was dead and spread the word to dispel the ruse, preventing any more deaths in her name.

Many years after her demise, Unduli's voice was among many heard by the Jedi aspirant Rey as she faced down her grandfather, Darth Sidious, on Exegol, telling her to find the light.

Luminara Unduli was born on Mirial and was taken to become a Jedi. Luminara Unduli fought the Daa Security Forces on Ontotho along with five other Jedi. During her time as a Jedi, Unduli took on at least two Padawans, one being fellow Mirialan Barriss Offee; which was in keeping with the traditions of her people as only Mirialan Jedi were able to train Mirialan Padawans due to a special agreement with the Jedi Order, Both Unduli and Offee were also considered to be Jedi Vanguards.

entities.name: Unidentified Balosar Jedi General
entities.description:
A young Balosar Jedi Knight served as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. She had fought alongside the Navy Commander and Republic Intelligence officer Armen Sim multiple times during the war. After the war, Sim kept a hologram of her as his only memorabilia inside his apartment in the Imperial Elderblock 26-0640. During her investigation of the murder of her former neighbor Sim, the former Jedi Knight, Urbra Procura, who had also served alongside him during the war, found his holorecording of the Balosar and recognized her. Procura remembered her as wonderful and suspected that Sim had been in love with her even though he had must known that romantic relationships were against the Jedi Code.

entities.name: Unidentified Ho'Din Jedi
entities.description:
A Ho'Din Jedi Master served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a Jedi General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive Ho'Din was educated in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, ascending to the rank of Jedi Master. Having constructed his own green-bladed lightsaber, he studied as a Consular, specializing in the art of healing and becoming one of the Order's healers. The Ho'Din selected a young Human Initiate as his Padawan.

When the Clone Wars erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Master took up the mantle of General within the ranks of the Grand Army of the Republic. Along with his Padawan, the Master was assigned to assist in the evacuation of the planet Nadiem following an invasion by the Confederacy. While ushering citizens to the rescue shuttles, he came a cross a young mother and her wounded child. Taking a moment to heal the boy's wounds, the Ho'Din Master marveled at the boy's sense of calm amidst all the turmoil. Suspicious of the boy's Force-sensitivity, the Ho'Din summoned his Padawan to take a blood sample of the boy, which came up positive for sensitivity.

Because there were limited shuttles off the planet, and the Order was in desperate need of new recruits, the Master offered to designate the boy for priority evacuation, if his mother agreed to give him over to the Order for training. Assuring the young woman that her son would reach safety at the Coruscant Jedi Temple within two days, she agreed, and her son was taken off world. Not long afterwards, the Ho'Din was forced into battle with the Separatist Droid Army to defend the refugees. Surrounded by battle droids, the Jedi was quickly overwhelmed by the superior number of droids.

entities.name: Unidentified Humanoid Jedi
entities.description:
This Humanoid male was a Jedi Guardian during the events surround the Great Hyperspace War, when the Sith Empire made their thrust for domination of the Galactic Republic.

A member of a Humanoid species, this Jedi served as a commander of the Coruscant defense force when the Sith fleet arrived prepared for war. He served alongside Jedi Knights such as Memit Nadill, Tuknatan, and Sonam-Ha'ar, and the Coruscant soldiers in pushing back the Sith threat. Once Coruscant was protected, this Jedi was part of the fleet the followed the Sith back to their region of space to ensure their forces were decimated, so that the threat they posed was unquestionably defeated.

As a Jedi Guardian, this Jedi was an expert on tactics, weapons, armor, and vehicles used in combat during his time. His weapon of choice was not a lightsaber, but rather a lightstaff imbued with the Force, whose ends both glowed with a resonant blue energy signature.

entities.name: Unidentified Jedi
entities.description:
A green-skinned individual was a male Jedi who served the Galactic Republic and the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive, this individual received instruction in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, eventually attaining the rank of Jedi Knight. Reporting to Coruscant at the start of the Clone Wars, this Jedi took up the rank of General within the Grand Army of the Republic and accepted missions from the Jedi High Council.

The Jedi was placed in command of a Jedi-clone trooper task force created to investigate the mysteriously abandoned space station known as the Brink of the Celestial Wake. Boarding the station, the Jedi and clones were quickly attacked by mass amounts of pink blobs and all perished excluding Jedi Serra Keto. When Jedi Anakin Skywalker received Keto's distress code, he boarded the ship and found the body of the unfortunate Jedi task force leader. His body would be destroyed when the space station was destroyed by the combined efforts of the two surviving Jedi.

A green-skinned humanoid, this deceased Jedi belonged to a species which had three-fingers on each hand, and two curving cranial horns which sprouted from the back of his head.

entities.name: Unidentified Jedi
entities.description:
A member of the Jedi Order, this Jedi served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive Human trained in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, he constructed a green-bladed lightsaber by the time the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems declared war. Taking up the rank of General in the Grand Army of the Republic, he led clone troopers in at least one battle; he assisted clone trooper Denal during the battle of Orto Plutonia. Together, the Jedi and clone rescued Padawan Ahsoka Tano from a Confederate prison established on the world.

This Jedi's only appearance was in Star Wars: The Clone Wars mobile game. During the events shown in the wireless game, the main character, Denal sometimes encounters a Jedi. At one point during the game, this Jedi appears right after the player receives a message from Obi-Wan Kenobi. Also, he knows both Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, and he is important enough for Skywalker to risk and send his Padawan alone to assist him. However, this character is called just "Jedi" in the dialogue windows and wears a hood, making it impossible to identify him with Kenobi.

This unidentified individual was a Jedi serving the Jedi Order during the waning years of the Galactic Republic. A General within the Grand Army of the Republic, this individual was serving alongside clone troopers when Contingency Order 66 was initiated. Evading the initial onslaught, they traveled to Dellalt to meet with other survivors. While fleeing the planet aboard an SX troop shuttle, this Jedi was mortally wounded an died on board.

Serving the Order when tensions between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems came to a breaking point, this Jedi reported to Coruscant at the onset of the Clone Wars and received the rank of General within the Grand Army of the Republic. When the Republic's Supreme Chancellor disbanded the Jedi Order with the issuance of Contingency Order 66, this Jedi was surrounded by clone troopers who opened fire without apparent cause. Managing to escape, this Jedi responded to Iwo Kulka's distress call on Dellalt where they met with eight other Jedi survivors. Hijacking an SX troop shuttle in order to escape the world, the Jedi were attacked by agents of the Galactic Empire. The resulting firefight took the life of this Jedi and three others. Their body was taken on board the smuggler ship, the Drunk Dancer after having died in hyperspace.

entities.name: Unidentified Jedi Knight
entities.description:
A Jedi Knight served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, serving as a General within the Grand Army of the Republic.

A Force-sensitive, this individual was discovered by the Jedi Order sometime prior to 22 BBY and was trained in the ways of the Force. The Initiate, who had earned distinction as a promising student, proved their comprehension of the Jedi Code, self-discipline via meditation and lightsaber combat, and their strong attunement to the flow of the Force, passing the Initiate Trials. The apprentice gained the attention of a Master and was selected as a Padawan student.

At about this time, the Confederacy of Independent Systems (CIS) had united against the Republic, and the Jedi had no choice but to fight in the conflict, and like all apprentices the Padawan was given the rank of Jedi Commander. In the war room of the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, the Padawan convened with famed Jedi Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Mace Windu, Plo Koon and Ahsoka Tano, along with clone marshal commander CC-2224 and astromech droid R2-D2. They welcomed the Padawan formally into the Jedi Order, and Windu presented them their first lightsaber.

Fighting in many early battles such as the campaign on Iceberg Three, the conflict on Umbara, the battle for Ryloth, the skirmish on Carlac and the second battle of Geonosis, the Padawan was made a Jedi Knight by the Jedi High Council and given the rank of General.

entities.name: Unidentified Jedi Knight
entities.description:
This male individual served the Jedi Order as a Jedi Knight during the final decades of the Galactic Republic.

This Force-sensitive individual was inducted into the Jedi Order at an early age and instructed in the ways of the Force at one of the Order's academies before passing his Trials of Knighthood and ascending to the rank of Jedi Knight. When the Clone Wars erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, this Jedi took up the rank of General within the Grand Army of the Republic and fought throughout the war. During this time, this Jedi was in the process of assembling a documentary on the species represented within the Order. It is unknown how much of the documentary he accomplished by the time of the end of the war, but it is known that death prevented him from completing his work. During the fighting, the Republic's Supreme Chancellor betrayed the Order by issuing Contingency Order 66 to the clone troopers being led by the Jedi Generals in battle. This particular Jedi was one of many to die during the fall of the Order and the Republic.

While his work was incomplete, it survived the fighting and the fires that destroyed much of the Jedi Temple during the rise of the Galactic Empire. Sequestered away in the Temple Archives, the document survived the Galactic Civil War and the destruction of the Temple during the Yuuzhan Vong War. By 43 ABY, the Temple had been rebuilt and the Archives restored under the guardianship of the reformed Jedi Order, with this Jedi's work still preserved amongst the Stacks. While not listed among searchable records, High Council member and Chief Healer Cilghal discovered the record during a scan of audio files that included the term electroencephaloscan. Investigating, she came across the audio of an interview with long-dead Master Plo Koon. In the interview he discussed a Baran Do technique in which they could distort the scan's readings, making them appear brain-dead. This was a vital clue that first sparked the unraveling of the mystery of the bizarre Force Psychosis seen in several Jedi Knights.

A Force-sensitive, this individual received training in the ways of the Force at an academy and eventually attained the rank of Knight. Accepting the role of General at the beginning of the Clone Wars, this individual was stationed on Murkhana during the last part of the war. Participating in the battle there under the leadership of Jedi Master Saras Loorne, this Jedi was aboard a Republic gunship with Loorne and another Knight when the Republic's Supreme Chancellor betrayed the Order with the issuance of Contingency Order 66. The clone troopers under this Jedi's command obeyed the executive order and shot down the Jedi's gunship, killing all three.

entities.name: Unidentified Jedi Master
entities.description:
A male Human Jedi Master served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive male Human was trained in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, eventually attaining the rank of Jedi Master. Constructing a double-bladed lightsaber imbued with green crystals at its core, this Master was proficient in it use during lightsaber combat. During his years of service to the Order, the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems went to war, drawing the Jedi Order into the conflict known as the Clone Wars. The Master was stationed at the Coruscant Jedi Temple in 19 BBY when Supreme Chancellor Palpatine of the Republic betrayed the Order by issuing Contingency Order 66 to the Grand Army of the Republic. Led by Sith Lord Darth Vader, the 501st Legion marched on the Jedi Temple and began to slaughter all of its occupants, Masters, Knights, and Initiates alike.

As the forces of the 501st Legion stormed the Temple as part of Operation: Knightfall, this man came to possess a valuable holocron and attempted to escape the Temple with the artifact. While putting up a fight, this Master was slain by Darth Vader during the fighting and the holocron fell into the hands of the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Sidious.

This Jedi Master is killed by the player in Star Wars: Battlefront II, but the means of his execution is not standardized. He can be killed either as Vader or a clone trooper at the whim of the player.

entities.name: Unidentified Jedi Master
entities.description:
A male Jedi Master served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, becoming a key member of the Vaklin insurgency at the start of the Great Jedi Purge.

A Force-sensitive male was trained in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, eventually attaining the rank of Jedi Master by the time of the Clone Wars. Taking on a Padawan, they served together in the Grand Army of the Republic and both avoided execution during the initial stages of the Galactic Empire's ascent to power. Together with his former student and Jedi Cho'na Bene they went into hiding on Vaklin, a very pro-Jedi world.

A key member of the Vaklin insurgency, he was the first to be captured by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader. Surrendering and taken prisoner by the Sith, Vader believed that the man was far too good of a swordsman to be taken alive and dumped him out an airlock as a form of execution.

entities.description:
This individual was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive, this Human received training in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, ascending to the rank of Jedi Master. Constructing a double-bladed lightsaber imbued with blue crystals at its core, this Master was proficient in it use during lightsaber combat.

When the Clone Wars erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, this man took up the rank of General in the Grand Army of the Republic. Surviving three years of war, he was stationed at the Coruscant Jedi Temple when the Republic's Supreme Chancellor Palpatine betrayed the Order and issued Contingency Order 66 to the Grand Army, ordering them to kill their Jedi leaders. As the forces of the 501st Legion stormed the Temple as part of Operation: Knightfall, this man joined other masters and led a final charge against clone troopers on the Temple Veranda. While fighting valiantly against the clones under the command of Darth Vader, this Master and his companions were slain during the fighting and the Temple fell into the hands of the Dark Lord of the Sith, Darth Sidious.

This Jedi Master used a blue double-bladed lightsaber in combat. He was a talented swordsman as he was one of the last Jedi standing during the attack on the Temple.

entities.name: Unidentified reptilian Jedi Knight
entities.description:
A male Jedi Knight served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars, becoming a key member of the Vaklin insurgency at the start of the Great Jedi Purge.

A Force-sensitive male, this being was trained in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, studying under the tutelage of a Jedi Master during the Clone Wars. Serving the Order during the war as a Jedi Commander in the Grand Army of the Republic and later achieving the rank of Jedi Knight, he avoided execution during the initial stages of the Galactic Empire's ascent to power and went into hiding with his former master on Vaklin alongside Jedi Master Cho'na Bene.

A key member of the Vaklin insurgency, he watched in horror as his former master was dumped out an airlock over Shrokaan by Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader after the Master had surrendered and been taken prisoner. The Knight was taken prisoner as well and repeatedly interrogated by Vader, who claimed that he should never have been made a Knight. During an interrogation session, Vader used the Force to constrict the Jedi's heart, forcing him to reveal that Bene had holed up in the Temple of Imperfect Repose. Moments later, a band of insurgents bent on freeing the Jedi broke into the detention facility, only to be struck down by Vader and a group of stormtroopers. The Jedi managed to free himself from his restraints, but without his lightsaber he was easily killed by the Sith Lord.

entities.description:
This individual was a Rutian Twi'lek Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

This female Twi'lek Jedi fought alongside the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. During battle on an unknown planet between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, she was assigned to a battlefront under the leadership of Councilor Ki-Adi-Mundi. Joined by recently knighted Rivi-Anu and Eon, the group fought valiantly to repel the Separatist Droid Army. When a Victory-class Star Destroyer plummeted toward the battlefield, they all believed they would die, until Rivi-Anu held back the warship with an astounding display of the Force. Rivi-Anu waited until all Jedi and clones had fled the field, including this Twi'lek Jedi, and then allowed the ship to crash down upon herself.

entities.name: Unidentified Zabrak Jedi General
entities.description:
A Zabrak Jedi General was a member of the Jedi Order who lived during the last years of the era known as the Great Peace of the Republic. When the Clone Wars broke out, the Zabrak Jedi took up a role as a Jedi General in command of the clone soldiers that made up the Grand Army of the Republic. While leading clone troops in battle on a desert world, the Jedi General's LAAT/i gunship came under enemy fire. During the attack, a clone trooper was struck and fell from the gunship's open crew bay; the Zabrak General made no move to rescue the wounded trooper, who was abandoned for dead after the battle and left to fend for himself in the desert expanse. Because of the General's inaction, the clone soldier developed a hatred for the Jedi he had once served which remained for years after.

The unnamed Zabrak Jedi General first appeared in Star Wars in the first issue of the comic book series Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows, authored by Tim Siedell and published December 18, 2012.

entities.name: Upulu
entities.description:
Upulu was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive, Upulu was educated in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order. Attaining the rank of Jedi Master, Master Upulu selected the young Mon Calamari Initiate Shalimin as his Padawan during the Separatist Crisis.

When the Clone Wars erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Master Upulu took up the rank of General in the Grand Army of the Republic. While Master Upulu was away fighting, Padawan Shalimin was selected to serve beside Jedi High Council member Kit Fisto during the Battle of Dac where the two led the Republic to victory over the Confederacy. As the report came to the Coruscant Jedi Temple, Fisto detailed how Shalimin had reveled in the victory in a way unbecoming of a Jedi. Shamed by his Padawan's actions Upulu sent Shalimin to the planet Argul to assist in the defensive there. While an initial failure, Grand Master Yoda arrived with reinforcements which ensured a Republic victory.

entities.name: B'ink Utrila
entities.description:
B'ink Utrila was a female lethan Twi'lek who served as an instructor and Master in the Jedi Order. During the Clone Wars, she was the master of the Human Padawan Rennax Omani, who accompanied her and a squad of clone troopers to the moon Draay 2. There, Utrila and her force were to retrieve the ancient Sith artifact the Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger, lest it fall into the hands of Confederacy of Independent Systems leader Count Dooku. Although the Jedi and clones were able to locate the Gauntlet, Utrila was beset by the dark side of the Force upon touching it, and elected to try and leave it on the moon protected. The Republic force was later set upon by the Mandalorian Death Watch led by Pre Vizsla—in the ensuing engagement, the Jedi Temple that stored the Gauntlet was destroyed, which left Utrila satisfied that the device could not be retrieved. As a result of the mission however, Omani elected to leave the Jedi Order.

In 19 BBY, the Galactic Republic's capital, Coruscant, was attacked by the forces of General Grievous, who attempted to abduct Supreme Chancellor Palpatine. Appointed by Master Yoda to assist, Utrila joined Roth-Del Masona, Roron Corobb, Stass Allie, Shaak Ti and Foul Moudama in ferrying Palpatine to a secure bunker, which was nonetheless breached by Grievous and his forces. Although Utrila and her fellow Jedi endeavored to stop Grievous in his tracks, the droid general proved too formidable, and managed to defeat and kill Masona, Corobb, and Moudama in short order. Although Utrila was able to inflict superficial damage on her opponent, Grievous, wielding four lightsabers at once, proved too formidable, and ended Utrila's life by striking her through the heart.

B'ink Utrila was a female Twi'lek who served as a Jedi instructor in the Jedi Order. By the time of the Clone Wars, she had attained the rank of Jedi Master. She elected to wield twin lightsabers in combat, and supervised the tutelage of a Human female Padawan learner, Rennax Omani. As a Jedi Master, she held the rank of Jedi General within the Grand Army of the Republic, and commanded a squad of clone troopers. In 20 BBY, Utrila and Omani, along with their troops were dispatched to the Outer Rim Territories moon of Draay 2. According to a holocron, it was said that the Jedi Temple on the moon stored a dangerous Sith artifact, the Gauntlet of Kressh the Younger—a device that, according to legend, could render its user impervious to all physical harm. The Jedi High Council hoped to prevent the artifact falling into the hands of Confederacy of Independent Systems leader Count Dooku, and so it was Utrila's task to either bring the Gauntlet back to Coruscant or secure it permanently.

entities.name: Sarn Vals
entities.description:
Sarn Vals was a Quarren Jedi Knight serving the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive, Sarn Vals was discovered by the Jedi Order as an infant and instructed in the ways of the Force at the Coruscant Jedi Temple. Eventually completing training and passing the Trials of Knighthood, Vals was elevated to the rank of Jedi Knight by the Jedi High Council. Serving the Order throughout the Clone Wars, a violent and costly conflict between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Vals was able to survive an attack by the Grand Army of the Republic in 19 BBY. The Grand Army, which the Order had fought alongside and commanded during the entire conflict, turned on their Jedi leaders when Supreme Chancellor Palpatine betrayed the Jedi and initiated Contingency Order 66 in a secret scheme to destroy the Order.

Fleeing into exile, Vals escaped to the Corporate Sector and went to ground. However, when a disturbance was reported in the sector, the Inquisitorius of the newly formed Galactic Empire traced it back to the fugitive Vals and sent agents to locate and destroy the Quarren Jedi outlaw.

entities.name: Halagad Ventor
entities.description:
Halagad Ventor was a male Human Jedi Knight who was trained at an unusually late age, due to the fact that he was passed over for training initially during his childhood on Alderaan. Jedi Master Everen Ettene eventually agreed to take him as a Padawan at the Almas Academy. Since the nature of his training was unnatural, Ventor's actions as a Jedi were considered unorthodox, and he neglected the more subtle aspects of the Force. These shortcomings may have contributed to his botched peace talks in the Virgillian Civil War, where he and his team were erroneously reported dead during the Separatist Crisis.

Ventor served as a Jedi General during the Clone Wars, and was a recipient of the Medallion of Honor. While Obi-Wan Kenobi's second apprentice, he helped liberate the planet Skye from Zeta Magnus, a genetic terrorist, during which time he engaged in a Concordance of Fealty with Anakin Skywalker. Later in the Outer Rim Sieges, Ventor commanded a team which included Sha Koon assisting to purge the Confederacy of Independent Systems from the planet Bal'demnic. Surviving Order 66, Ventor teamed up with Jedi Master Ashka Boda to establish a network of fellow surviving Jedi. He was soon captured by the new Galactic Empire and interrogated by former protege, Darth Vader. Ventor was forced to reveal the secret location of his hidden Jedi network. He eventually escaped Vader and fled to Trinta, where madness and the dark side of the Force consumed him.

After many years during the Galactic Civil War, a band of Rebel Alliance scouts crash landed on Trinta and were terrorized by Ventor. After enduring several Force attacks, the rebels confronted Ventor and drew him out of the dark side. Deceased yet redeemed, Ventor would persist in the Force as a Force ghost, and would guide survivors of his betrayal years after his death.

Born to archivists of the Royal Library of Alderaan Ean and Zollet Ventor in 47 BBY, Halagad Ventor lived on Alderaan as a child. Despite being strong in the Force, Ventor was passed over for Jedi training by the Acquisition Division at an early age due to some oversight by Jedi Watchman Jorus C'baoth. Nevertheless, he aspired to be a scholar, and studied ancient tomes within the Royal Library where he learned the history of the Jedi Knights, and aspired to be one. Inspired by C'baoth's handling of the dispute between House Organa and House Antilles, Ventor began pursuing mastery of a wide range of scholarly and martial skills. Taken under the wing of a young Bail Organa, who would go onto become Senator and Viceroy of Alderaan, Ventor was introduced to a wide range of intellectual stimulation as he passed through adolescence.

entities.name: Silmis Vey
entities.description:
Silmis Vey was a male Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive male, Silmis Vey received training in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, achieving the rank of Jedi Master before the time of the Separatist Crisis. During this time, Vey selected the young Twi'lek Initiate, Mariineh, as his Padawan.

When the Clone Wars erupted between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Vey took up the rank of General in the Grand Army of the Republic. While Mariineh had nearly completed her training and was ready to take her Trials of Knighthood, the girl volunteered to accompany her master to the planet Argul to participate in the Republic offensive there. Proud of her choice and the responsibility it demonstrated, Vey and his student participated from orbit, overseeing the evacuation of transports from Argul to a rendezvous point near Belsavis.

entities.name: Volryder
entities.description:
Volryder was a male Human Jedi Master of the Jedi Order and served as general during the Cold War.

In 3643 BBY, he was stationed on Alderaan where he was ordered by Jedi Master Nomen Karr to protect Jaesa Willsaam's mother and father from the Sith. When Darth Baras' Sith apprentice entered to meet with Jaesa's parents, Volryder stood in front to protect them and ordered his men to rally around him. However, Gregor wanted to know why he and his wife were targets and would ask the apprentice about Jaesa. When the apprentice only wanted them to give Jaesa a message, the parents were Force choked to death in front of Volryder's eyes. Volryder engaged the Sith Warrior in a lightsaber duel, but he was killed.

The Sith Warrior has three options: he/she would convince the parents to join the Empire and spare them, and letting Volryder leave. If the Sith Warrior faces Volryder, he/she would force him to give into his anger or instead just face him in the duel both ways.

entities.name: Quinlan Vos
entities.description:
Quinlan Vos was a Kiffar male Jedi Master who lived during the final days of the Galactic Republic. Hailing from the planet Kiffu, he was a maverick within the Jedi Order and garnered a reputation for bending the rules. He was renowned for his retrocognition—perceiving others' memories when touching objects they had contacted. Due to this ability, Vos was an expert tracker. Many of his missions took him into the criminal underworld. On one such mission he met Aayla Secura and thereafter accepted her as his Padawan.

During the Clone Wars, a Hutt crime lord named Ziro escaped imprisonment in the Galactic Republic capital, Coruscant. Vos teamed with Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi to track and recapture him. Finding that Ziro had been freed by bounty hunter Cad Bane, Vos and Kenobi followed their trail to Nal Hutta, the Hutt homeworld, and then eventually to Teth. Here they discovered Ziro had been murdered and subsequently failed their attempt at arresting Bane.

Later in the war, Vos partnered and fell in love with Asajj Ventress, a former dark side assassin. The duo was unsuccessful in their attempt to assassinate Sith Lord Count Dooku, brutal leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems. In an attempt to uncover the identity of Dooku's master, Darth Sidious, Vos succumbed to the dark side and became Dooku's apprentice, serving the Confederacy as Admiral Enigma. However, he was brought back to the light side of the Force by his love for Ventress, who sacrificed her life for his. He buried her on her homeworld of Dathomir alongside Kenobi, professed his eternal love for her, and was accepted back into the Jedi Order.

During the final days of the war, the Jedi General participated in the Outer Rim Sieges, in which he took part in the fall of Saleucami, and subsequently moved his Republic troops to Boz Pity. After the fall of the Jedi Order, Vos survived the Great Jedi Purge along with his new lover, Khaleen Hentz, and was amongst those the Galactic Empire presumed to have survived and thus targeted to hunt down. Shortly after the fall of the Republic, Vos founded the Hidden Path, an underground network that resisted the Empire by helping fugitive Jedi and Force-sensitives escape persecution via Jabiim and forge new identities.

entities.name: Suljo Warde
entities.description:
Suljo Warde was a Human male Chandrilan Jedi Knight who served the Jedi Order during the Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems. During his time with the Order, Warde created a holocron in which he stored information on his unusual form of foresight.

Warde was rescued from assassins on the planet Eriadu by the Mirialan Gel Marcolf, leading Warde to bring Marcolf along with him in the hopes of training him as a Jedi. Warde traveled to the planet Arbooine, but not before stopping on the way to hide his holocron on a craggy planet. There, Warde removed the three information-storing kyber crystals from the holocron. He gave one to Marcolf, whom he appointed the temporary head of one of Arbooine's cities, and subsequently traveled to Cato Neimoidia for his new assignment.

After defeating Separatist forces in the planet's city of Jorra, Warde was tasked with maintaining Republic control of the city. As he did so, Warde became harsher and more irrational, falling closer to the dark side of the Force. Eventually, Warde met with a group of Separatist delegates, fell to the dark side, and slaughtered them, forcing his two fellow Jedi to try to kill him, but Warde killed them instead in a duel. He then fled in his starfighter to the Sith world of Moraband, where he remained for years until the arrival of a group of Force-sensitives who had discovered Warde's holocron and gathered two of its crystals. Warde met the group on Moraband, at first hiding his identity before revealing himself and challenging the discoverers to a duel.

Suljo Warde was a male Human born on of Chandrila. Warde joined the Jedi Order in his youth and was eventually apprenticed to a female Jedi Master who would regularly invent heavy-handed wisdom. At some point during the apprenticeship, Warde's master made him run laps around the Jedi Temple after he joked that she was not very wise.

entities.name: Ana Zett
entities.description:
Ana Zett was a female Human Jedi Knight, serving the Jedi Order during the last years of the Galactic Republic. During the Clone Wars, Zett served as a General within the Grand Army of the Republic, and was sent to the planet of Felucia, where she required the help of a young Jedi Knight.

A female Human, Ana Zett was inducted in the Jedi Order, where she was trained in the ways of the Force. During the Clone Wars, a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Zett served as a General within the Grand Army of the Republic.

Some time later, Zett was sent to the planet of Felucia, assigned to oversee the operations of a task force sent to hold back Separatist troops. While on the planet, Zett's lightsaber was damaged, and took refuge on a hill overlooking a nysillin farm where she sent out a distress call. Her lightsaber was repaired when a fellow Jedi brought a replacement piece.

entities.name: Arligan Zey
entities.description:
Arligan Zey was a male Human Jedi Master who served the Jedi Order and the Galactic Republic as a General in the Grand Army of the Republic and the Director of Special Forces during the Clone Wars.

A Force-sensitive Human, Arligan Zey was educated in the ways of the Force by the Jedi Order, attaining the rank of Jedi Master. Before the start of the Separatist Crisis in 28 BBY, Master Zey selected the young Initiate Bardan Jusik as his Padawan and traveled the galaxy on missions for the Jedi High Council.

When the Clone Wars erupted between the Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, Master Zey took up the rank of General in the newly founded Grand Army of the Republic. Serving as an intelligence officer, Master Zey was given oversight of several groups of the Republic's clone commandos; specialized units that performed insertion missions to wipe out specified targets without needing a General to lead them. A strong proponent of the clone trooper development program, he backed the creation of the Grand Army and espoused its superiority over the Separatist Droid Army. In addition to the commandos, Master Zey was privy to the top secret group of Null-class ARC Troopers and preferred to use them during data-gathering missions.

Early in the war, Master Zey oversaw the operations on Qiilura where Master Kast Fulier and Padawan Etain Tur-Mukan had gone missing in the confusion surrounding the start of the war. When the commandos of Omega Squad recovered Padawan Tur-Mukan, they assumed the mission of capturing the scientist Ovolot Qail Uthan, who planned to develop a nanovirus which would target the clone troopers. When the commandos were successful in capturing Uthan, Master Zey and Padawan Jusik flew to Qiilura to oversee clean-up operations on the world and arm the colonists on the planet to oppose Confederate occupation. Working closely with Jusik and Tur-Mukan, both were raised to the rank of Jedi Knight, and Master Zey strived to reestablish a Gurlanin colony on the world.

entities.name: Andeddu
entities.description:
Andeddu was an ancient Sith Lord who was the subject of the phrase "Andeddu's flames." During the reign of the Galactic Empire, the Sith Lord Darth Vader's servant, Vaneé, used the expression when he swore to capture the Rebel Alliance Lieutenant Thom Hudd after the latter escaped captivity in Vader's castle on the planet Mustafar.

Years later, the Sith Eternal, a cult of Sith loyalists drew their Sith trooper unit names after ancient Sith Lords. The Andeddu Legion was consequently named after them, whose name and history were hidden from the rest of the galaxy.

Andeddu was first mentioned in the current Star Wars canon in the comic book Star Wars Adventures: Return to Vader's Castle 2, which was written by Cavan Scott and released by IDW Publishing The character of Darth Andeddu was originally introduced in the Star Wars Legends continuity via Republic 63, a comic book that was written by John Ostrander, penciled by Jan Duursema, and released by Dark Horse Comics on April 7, 2004.

entities.name: Bichan
entities.description:
A human Sith Lord active during a war between the Jedi Order and the Sith, Bichan wore a red face-concealing mask and wielded a lightsaber with an attached whip. At one point, he fought and killed a group of eight Jedi, including the teacher of the Padawan Toul. The Sith Lord became interested by the anger displayed by the Jedi apprentice and spared his life, with Toul being left with a lingering sense of fear by the confrontation. Later, Bichan was noticed at a city on a marketplace asteroid by Toul, who was acquiring supplies there for a mission to the planet Dolgarak.

The Sith followed Toul and the mechanic Ara there, shooting down their starship with his own craft. Subsequently, Bichan engaged Toul in a lightsaber duel atop a speeder that Ara drove up one of the two statues of prophecy located on Dolgarak. Their confrontation continued atop a stone ring connecting the heads of the two statues, where Bichan eventually disarmed Toul and demanded that he either surrender to the dark side of the Force and join him or die. At that point, however, Ara, who realized that she played a part in a prophecy that had foretold the duel, distracted Bichan through the use of explosives, allowing Toul to summon his own lightsaber and decapitate the Sith Lord.

Bichan was a Sith Lord who was active during a war waged between the Sith tradition of Force-users and the Jedi Order, their ideological antithesis, at some point by 1032 BBY. During that conflict, Bichan fought a group of at least nine Jedi on a platform enveloped in a red-colored mist. The Sith Lord killed seven of his opponents before his attention was drawn to Toul, a Jedi Padawan facing him with his lightsaber drawn. Bichan rushed to strike the young Jedi down, but his attack was blocked by Toul's Jedi teacher, who used the Force to repulse their enemy. The Jedi proclaimed the Sith—whom they knew by name—to be "nothing but a disgrace" and launched a fierce attack on him, with the latter also leaping to engage in combat. Bichan, however, then used the whip attached to his lightsaber to fatally impale Toul's teacher.

In response, the enraged young Jedi apprentice himself attempted to attack the Sith, only for Bichan's whip to wrap around Toul's wrists and pin him to the ground. In response to the Padawan swearing he would kill him, Bichan goaded Toul to embrace his anger and the dark side of the Force, lifting the Jedi into the air and inviting him to find him later. Proclaiming his belief in the inevitable triumph of the Sith over the Jedi, Bichan then used his lightsaber to create a scar on Toul's face before dropping the Padawan to the ground and walking away from the site of the carnage.

entities.name: Crassus
entities.description:
Crassus was a Sith Lord who was known for his avarice. He created the piece of Force-imbued armor known as the Gauntlet of Crassus, which rendered its wearer's grip unbreakable and allegedly increased the strength of the individual's telekinetic abilities.

After his death, Crassus was buried in a tomb in the Valley of the Dark Lords on the planet Korriban, the homeworld of the Sith tradition of Force-users. Knowledge of the tomb's location was eventually lost to history, and by the time of the Galactic Civil War, long after Crassus's death, it was believed that the Gauntlet of Crassus had also been interred in its creator's final resting place.

Crassus was introduced in the 2015 core rulebook for Fantasy Flight Games' Star Wars: Force and Destiny roleplaying game system.

entities.description:
Desolous was a Sith Lord who was active in the galaxy long before The Sith Eternal cult, which was active during that time, had a custom of naming their Sith trooper detachments after ancient Sith. The Desolous Legion was thus named after them—a name whose true significance remained a mystery to those outside of the cult.

Desolous was first mentioned in the current Star Wars canon in Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary,

The character originated in the Star Wars Legends continuity, where he was depicted as a Pau'an Sith Lord named Darth Desolous, and was created as an exclusive character for the PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable and Wii versions of the 2008 video game Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, developed by Krome Studios and published by LucasArts.

entities.name: Felkor
entities.description:
Felkor was a Sith Lord who was depicted in a statue chiseled into one of the interior rock walls of the Sith Citadel on Exegol, a Sith planet in the Unknown Regions. Kylo Ren—former Jedi trainee, and the Supreme Leader of the First Order—had become familiar with Felkor as part of his studies. That year, when Ren arrived at the Sith Citadel in order to investigate a mysterious transmission from the supposedly-deceased Galactic Emperor Palpatine, he recognized Felkor and other Sith Lords in the statues of the edifice. As he advanced into the interior of the citadel, Ren heard unintelligible whispers from Felkor's effigy and the others despite their mouths not moving.

entities.name: Quorlac Fornayh
entities.description:
Quorlac Fornayh was a male Near-Human Sith Lord who lived over a thousand years before the Galactic Civil War. After the course of a war with the Galactic Republic turned against the Sith, Fornayh took shelter at his hidden fortress on the planet Yorgraxx. Over the next century, he channelled his efforts into the development of the coloi, a deadly, winged mutant rancor. By the time his creation was finalized, Fornayh was close to death and he stowed his single coloi specimen in stasis before passing away.

The Sith Lord endured afer death in the Force as a dark side spirit and he was awakened when an Imperial freighter and Rebel Alliance vessel were wrecked on Yorgraxx during the Galactic Civil War. Fornayh and his coloi subsequently attacked the crash survivors after they ventured into his fortress and were defeated by the group.

Quorlac Fornayh was a Force-sensitive Near-Human male Sith Lord, who served one of the Sith Empires over a 1000 years before the Galactic Civil War, amid a time of war between the Sith and the rival Galactic Republic. Fornayh established a base of operations on the planet Yorgraxx, of the Outer Rim Territories and enslaved the world's native native population. He employed his workforce to build a concealed underground fortress for his personal use, sited far beneath a high mountain range and exterminated the natives once construction of the base was completed. The Sith Lord programmed two sentry droids to protect the entrance to his facility on the planetary surface and also kept two lightsaber weapons with the base, one in his personal quarters and one within the installation's central control room.

After the tide of the war with the Republic turned against the Sith, Fornayh and many other Sith Lords were forced into hiding. The Near-Human retreated to his stronghold on Yorgraxx to strengthen his forces and began work on the development of the coloi mutant rancor that Fornayh schemed to use to seize the throne of the Sith Empire.

entities.name: Gol
entities.description:
Gol, known as the "Wither King," was a male Force-sensitive individual who became a Sith. only the hands of the Sith displayed his true condition.

As an infant, Gol was orphaned when his guardian was gunned down. He grew up alone and was shunned and bullied throughout his childhood. Eventually, he turned to the dark side of the Force, bleeding a kyber crystal and using it to fashion his Sith lightsaber.

As a Sith Lord, Gol was able to amass a court of lesser Sith. He ruled from a castle on an unknown world.

Gol was known to take prisoners, and his castle contained a vast dungeon where his prisoners were imprisoned and tortured. One such prisoner, a Jedi, was forced to wear jester clothing and serve as his "Jester Jedi." Eventually, the Jester Jedi could no longer bear his treatment and threw himself off the castle roof to his death, which Gol considered "the only funny thing he ever did."
