entities.name: Blessings
entities.description:
Blessings was the name of a Dreadnaught of Imperial design employed by the Yevetha during the Black Fleet Crisis.

It is unclear whether the Blessings was a warship assigned by the Yevetha to the Black Eleven Fleet. In 16 ABY, the Blessings failed to perform adequately in training exercises, and thus was excluded from participation in the Yevethan Purge. Dar Bille executed both the ship's commanding primate and his second. A new primate was appointed, and instructed to prepare for another training exercise after the return of the rest of the fleet.

In 17 ABY, the Blessings, like all other Imperial-type vessels under Yevethan control, was taken over by surviving Black Sword personnel and withdrawn from Koornacht to the Deep Core

The Blessings is only briefly mentioned in dialogue in the novel Before the Storm. The ship's full name is presumably Blessings of Yevetha, following their usual pattern for captured Imperial vessels.

entities.name: Blockade Bandit
entities.description:
The Bright Blast was a CR90 corvette of the Corellian Security Force. It was later captured by pirates and renamed Blockade Bandit. The ship was eventually shot down above Raxus Prime by Republic cruisers prior to the Clone Wars. Its wreck was abandoned in Scrapheap Point, a ship junkyard located on Raxus Prime.

entities.name: Blood Brother
entities.description:
The Blood Brother, formerly known as the Dura-Khan III, was a heavily modified Consular III-class cruiser used by Reddjak, and the main command vessel for the Red Fury Brotherhood.

Originally known as the Dura-Khan III, the Blood Brother was a Galactic Republic diplomatic vessel that was commandeered by Reddjak the pirate. Like other diplomatic vessels, the ship was painted red to denote its status of neutrality. After Reddjak claimed the ship, he kept the color scheme.

entities.name: Blue
entities.description:
Blue was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport used by the Rebel Alliance.

Blue was present at RS-32, an XQ4 Platform which was housing Mag Pulse technology used by the Rebels. After an unsuccessful raid on ZA-13, Imperial High Command, tracked down the raid to the station and attacked the station. When the station's shields were down, RS-32 called for reinforcements and launched T-wings and the transport Blue carrying Officers. However, before the transport could escape into Hyperspace, Maarek Stele intercepted and disabled the transport allowing it to be boarded and sent to Victory-class Star Destroyer Sceltor

entities.name: Boarding craft 356
entities.description:
Boarding craft 356 was a TIE/br boarding shuttle utilized by the Galactic Empire during their subjugation of Constancia.

After the life boat for Luke Skywalker and Gamine was launched with Han Solo and Sharlee onboard with an S.O.S. signal indicating that the former two were onboard and injured from an earlier ambush by the Imperials, boarding craft 356 as well as two TIE Advanced x1s and three TIE/LN starfighters were dispatched to retrieve the lifeboat. Boarding craft 356 managed to retrieve the lifeboat, although shortly thereafter, Solo and Sharlee proceeded to put their plan into effect and managed to attack the crew, either killing them or causing them to surrender via their Constancian battle armor, with their armor's speed-setting being augmented to nine times the average speed of a human being also ensuring that they defeated the crew before they could get a chance to send a S.O.S. signal alerting the Imperials to their presence. Upon taking control of the ship, the Imperial Naval Command later relayed to the group that the Millennium Falcon had been spotted heading towards the planet via its ice rings, and gave orders for them to intercept immediately. Solo then bluffed his "wingmates" and claimed he'll take them on, although he also attempted to avoid doing critical damage to the Millennium Falcon and ended up causing the other TIEs to pursue the Millennium Falcon anyways due to his "wingmates" thinking he was inept, forcing Solo and Sharee to look on as there wasn't anything more they can do without risking giving themselves away to the Imperials.

entities.name: Booty Full
entities.description:
The Booty Full was a pirate ship under the command of Phan Riizolo, who worked with the Invids. The Invids were a pirate organization led by Leonia Tavira and in opposition to the New Republic. The Booty Full was a modified bulk cruiser which carried a complement of eighteen Clutches attached to its outer hull. During the Battle of Alakatha in 11 ABY, it was captured by Rogue Squadron above the planet of Alakatha as it was attempting to raid the Glitterstar, a luxury liner. While all of its fighters were destroyed in the battle, the ship itself was captured intact. After its capture, the Booty Full captain provided the New Republic Intelligence Service with intelligence on Leonia Tavira.

The Booty Full was created for I, Jedi, which was written by Michael A. Stackpole and was published on May 4, 1998.

Botani was the name given to three Muurian transports used by the Bothans. These ships were attacked by Imperial forces lead by Darth Vader who were capturing Bothans to find more information regarding an incident with the Suprosa, a freighter which was carrying a supercomputer carrying data regarding the Second Death Star. Despite assistance from X-wings from Junker Squadron and Logan Squadron, and A-wings from Yme Squadron, all three transports were disabled and captured, along with Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle Com 1.

entities.name: Braxant Bonecrusher
entities.description:
The Braxant Bonecrusher—originally the Braxant Brave—was an Old Republic-era Dreadnaught-class cruiser.

Captured by Grand Admiral Thrawn during his raid on the Katana fleet, the aging ship was refitted by the Imperial Remnant during the Yuuzhan Vong War for use in a suicide mission.

Already outfitted with slave circuits to reduce its required crew complement, old combat droid brains recovered from the SD project were hardwired into the ship to control the remaining un-automated systems. Although perhaps overly pragmatic, the droid brains were capable of flying the Dreadnaught to its target and protecting its passengers until selective shield failures and specially placed charges created the illusion of the ship's destruction.

During the Battle of Borosk, the ship was hastily reconfigured for use in a mission to rescue prisoners from a Yuuzhan Vong Slaveship and renamed for Saba Sebatyne's Barabel hunting analogy. The ship carried the Jade Shadow and a small group of TIE Fighters, as well a squadron of older TIEs controlled by lesser droid brains to the rear of the Yuuzhan vong fleet, where Saba and Danni Quee boarded the ship and liberated the slaves.

The ship was captured by the Anakin Solo after Uran sold out her fellow smugglers to the Galactic Alliance. She intended to leave with her ship, but Jacen Solo stuck her with another.

entities.name: Carrion Spike
entities.description:
The Carrion Spike was a corvette and the personal starship of Moff Wilhuff Tarkin while he was stationed at Sentinel Base in the Outer Rim Territories. It was later captured in 14 BBY by the disaffected former Republic Intelligence agent Berch Teller and his rebel cell. Berch used the Carrion Spike in a campaign against Imperial space stations, in which its abilities were unparalleled. Later the ship was abandoned by the rebels at Carida after they discovered their inside source within the Empire, Vice Admiral Dodd Rancit, was planning a betrayal.

After Darth Vader exposed Rancit's treason, the Carrion Spike was recovered. By 3 BBY, the ship had been restored and was back in Tarkin's possession. At some point after the Battle of Jakku, the Carrion Spike was discovered in the abandoned Rothana Imperial Shipyards by Terex, who became the leader of the Ranc Gang and later an agent of the First Order's Security Bureau. The starship served as Terex's personal transport during his campaign against the Resistance starfighter pilot Poe Dameron and his Black Squadron. The Carrion Spike was destroyed by the First Order after Terex embarked on an unsanctioned campaign to destroy the Resistance.

An IPV-2C Stealth Corvette, the Carrion Spike was originally designed by Sienar Design Systems,

The Carrion Spike was normally crewed by eighteen crew members, but could also be crewed by a captain and communications officer. If the need arose, six people were enough to crew the ship.

entities.name: Choora
entities.description:
The Choora was a YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by the Nami during the Galactic Civil War.

After learning of a ransom attempt of the chief scientist of the TIE Defender project by the Rneekii Pirates, Nami Crime Lord Ali Tarrak sought to capture the scientist as she had one of the Defender prototypes to accelerate her plans to construct her own. She sent a strike force consisting of the Choora some Y-wings and T-wings which came by the time the Empire had defeated the Rneekii pirates and recovered both the scientist and the ransom. Although the strike team managed to disable the Interdictor Red Claw, they were thwarted by Tan Maarek Stele and the Choora was disabled and captured. Although Tarrak was not on board the crew did provide some information about her.

TIE Fighter: Defender of the Empire: Official Secrets & Solutions

entities.name: Cobra
entities.description:
The Cobra was a ship that belonged to Lando Calrissian. Calrissian had many stories of how he acquired the ship and wasn't sure which one he liked the best.

The vessel was a modified Mu-2 long range shuttle originally manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems.

In 1 ABY, Calrissian used it as part of his wager to Baron Administrator Dominic Raynor in a sabacc game, losing the Cobra in a game rigged by Barpotomous Drebble, but then later winning it back. At this time, the Cobra was notable enough for Raynor to request it by name when Lando proposed to wager a ship in their game.

Calrissian later flew the ship off of Bespin while faking his own death in order to uncover a plot to assassinate him. He then traveled to the Yucrales sector and the planet Quilken with it while being chased by the bounty hunter Thune.

entities.name: Compellor
entities.description:
The Compellor was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in the Imperial Navy under the command of Captain Rigell. It was stolen by members of the Alliance to Restore the Republic, who removed its gravity well projectors and then scuttled the ship.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Compellor was assigned to Admiral Senn's Task Force Vengeance, as a key tactical vessel in the mission to assimilate the Airam Sector into the Galactic Empire. Paired in a small battle group with the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Rage, Compellor acted as a powerful tool in hunting down hiding Rebels and Airam pirates. When the fleet encountered an enemy staging area, the Compellor prevented the enemy from escaping into hyperspace.

The Rebels were quick to understand the tactical importance of the Compellor and repeatedly tried to destroy it without success. It survived an assault by pilots of Viper and Phoenix Squadrons, and was ordered to Repair Yard KDY-77 in the Swellen system to have an anti-warhead missile defense system installed. En route, it was diverted to join Battlegroup Orion in the ambush in the Goff system, where Compellor was the only ship to escape the Rebel trap.

Subsequently, the Rebels tracked it to the repair facility, captured the interdictor during the Battle of Swellen, and took it to an Airam X7 Factory facility in the Mobetta system. There, the Rebels removed the gravity well projectors from the damaged vessel and incorporated them into the modified Strike-class cruiser Peregrine.

This converted drone barge was Admiral Mordur's base of operations following the Battle of Endor.

Command codes had been installed to enable an entire convoy of automated drone barges to follow this vessel, carrying massive amounts of valuable ores from Vandelhelm. The Admiral planned to leave the system once the last of Vandelhelm's royal family had been killed.

The plot failed, with all the conspirators killed, and the convoy came into the hands of the Alliance of Free Planets.

entities.name: Corellia Star
entities.description:
Corellia Star was a YT-1300 light freighter.

His pilot was aware of the Empire's secret weapons project, the TIE Phantom. Being sympathetic to the Rebels, he decided to offer his inside information. When he approached Dreighton, he tried to warn two Rebel B-wings that flew in that system, while Imperial troops boarded the Corellia, which was then captured and held in the Imperial base on the planet. The pilot was seen getting shot during his distress call, and it is presumed that both he and his crew perished.

The distress call was not clearly received, so the two Rebel ships approached the planet to find out what happened. The leader, Kirby, was blown out of the air, but the other, Rookie One, managed to eject. Having no other means to escape the planet, Rookie entered the base and fighting his way through, reached the Corellia Star. He escaped the base by flying through mining tunnels and delivered it to the Alliance fleet.

The pilot's message was then played by Admiral Ackbar and it was discovered that it spoke about the secret Imperial activity in the Belt of Arah as well as Darth Vader's new weapon.

entities.name: Corusca Rainbow
entities.description:
The Corusca Rainbow was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser under the command of Captain Uwlla Iillor. The ship was originally called the Black Asp and served in the Imperial Navy.

In 6.5 ABY it was part of the force assigned to Rachuk sector under Admiral Devlia. She participated in a skirmish with Rogue Squadron in the Chorax system while attempting to capture the Pulsar Skate. Lieutenant Potin was an officer at this time.

The Black Asp gravity well projectors dragged the squadron out of hyperspace en route to Talasea. Unfortunately for the Asp, the Rogues were able to force her retreat.

Following the loss of Borleias, Captain Iillor led the Black Asp in a defection to the New Republic. Renamed Corusca Rainbow, the ship and its crew were given a vital role in the siege of Coruscant. The Corusca Rainbow was to exit at the edge of the Coruscant system before the main fleet to determine if Rogue Squadron had successfully downed Coruscant's planetary shields. If it detected no shields, it would allow the fleet to exit directly above Coruscant; if the shields were intact, it would activate its gravity well generators to pull the fleet from hyperspace and avoid its defenses. Rogue Squadron brought the shields down at the last minute, allowing the Rainbow just enough time to power down the generators and join the fight.

entities.name: Crimson Jack's battlecruiser
entities.description:
This former Imperial battlecruiser was in operation as a pirate vessel during the early years of the Galactic Civil War.

The ship was driven by four main engines and a possible fifth, though this center engine appeared to be covered by armor at times, and might have functioned only as an auxiliary engine for emergencies. The hull was sleeker and more rounded than the Imperial-class Star Destroyers, and the main body was much more flat, with a protruding bulb towards the dorsal front of the ship.

The ship was damaged during a battle with the Rebel Alliance, and left adrift. After the battle, it was discovered by the space pirate Crimson Jack and his gang, who proceeded to kill the remaining crew members and use the vessel as their own base of operations. They repaired and modified the ship with backing from Jabba the Hutt.

They captured the Millennium Falcon with a tractor beam, and were lured to the planet Drexel where Han Solo claimed a secret Rebel treasury would be found. This venture turned out to be a trap and a failure for Crimson Jack, as his ship was permanently damaged when his second-in-command, Jolli, betrayed him and rammed the ship's command tower with her Y-wing starfighter.

entities.name: Crynyd
entities.description:
The Crynyd was the name given to an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer after its capture by the New Republic at a battle in the Milagro system.

In 5 ABY the Star Destroyer was commanded by the sadistic Captain Purdy M. Trico and was found amidst a battle in a star system when a New Republic gunboat seriously damaged its bow. With its task force consisting of about thirty support craft and transports, she hyperspaced to Milagro system for repairs.

She arrived shortly after the main Imperial forces withdrew from the devastated world of Milagro. The dreadnaught New Hope, remained on-station as the New Republic's command ship in the area. As his ship was damaged, and the Dreadnaught had a strong hull, Trico ordered an attack with fighters, avoiding to reveal her location.

However she was intercepted by Luke Skywalker's X-wing and the Moldy Crow piloted by Jan Ors. The two ships happened to exit hyperspace near her location, revealing it to Captain Tola, who commanded the battle from the New Hope; and Han Solo who led a group of squadron. The Destroyer's escorts had formed a protective screen around her, and its computer commanded the fire-control center of each one, maximizing their efficiency, but Skywalker, guided by Force, managed to lead their ships inside.

entities.name: Cryptic Warning
entities.description:
The Cryptic Warning was one of the two EE-104 Fisheyes that were stolen by the Lost Tribe of Sith for use for their armada. It was commanded by Sith Saber Querdan Dei and was used during the Jedi Queen project.

It, like most of the Fisheyes made in the Corporate Sector had no windows. This was to stop light from being picked up by enemy sensors. It also had a hull that was designed to mimic the environment around it. Another way that it was designed for stealth was its general oval shape, so it could keep a low profile. It also had a special stealth coating that would cause scans to bounce back to the ship sending them.

entities.description:
Cularin 1 was a capital ship that was used during the Clone Wars. It was originally called the Nimbus and used by the Thaereian military, but it was captured by the Cularin Militia and they renamed it and put it into service with their fleet. Major Xirossk planned the Militia's attack on the Thaereian military's base on Dorumaa while aboard it. The Cularin 1 later served as the Militia's flagship during the Battle of Cularin.

In Storm's Depths, the Nimbus is referred to as being a Corellian gunship, whereas Decision: Cularin identifies the Cularin 1 as a Corellian corvette.

entities.name: Dargon
entities.description:
The Dargon was an Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served the Empire as a prison ship.

Its escort typically included TIE Avengers and Assault Gunboats.

Carrying Bothan and Rebel prisoners, it came under attack from Rebel forces bent on rescuing prisoners, at least twice.

In Star Wars: TIE Fighter, the player (acting as Maarek Stele) prevents the Dargon from being disabled, ensuring that the prisoners can be brought to Lord Vader and interrogated by him. The Rebels sent three waves of starfighters then two CR90 corvettes called Keeper and an Assassin-class corvette called Hut'to. In another mission involving the Dargon, its engines shut down, possibly through sabotage. The Rebels then attack again with a Nebulon-B2 frigate called Bay Point with Y-wings and A-wings.
entities.short_description: The Dargon was an Imperial Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser that served the Empire as a prison ship.

entities.name: Darksing D-45
entities.description:
The Darksing D-45 was a heavy freighter owned by the Nallera's mining crew in the Tatoo system during the Galactic Civil War. the ship was captured by the Zynt'aia pirates but it was eventually recaptured by the starfighter forces dispatched by Mining Chief Operator A'Lerris Verata.

The Darksing D-45 appeared in the 2003 video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by Sony Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, The Darksing D-45 was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack Jump to Lightspeed on October 27, 2004.

entities.name: Decisive
entities.description:
Decisive was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer which served in the fleet of the Ciutric Hegemony, when the self-proclaimed "Prince-Admiral" Delak Krennel took control of the region. In the Battle of Ciutric, the Decisive surrendered to the New Republic after Krennel was killed and his flagship Reckoning was destroyed. When the Hegemony entered the New Republic, the ship and its crew were integrated into its defense force and remained at Ciutric IV.

entities.name: Deliverance
entities.description:
The Deliverance was a Star Destroyer utilized by the New Republic under Twi'lek General Hera Syndulla, and served as the flagship of the Republic navy's Barma Battle Group commanded by Syndulla. The Deliverance was present during the hunt for the Galactic Empire's 204th Imperial Fighter Wing in 5 ABY, alongside Flare, Hail, and Wild Squadrons. Despite the Deliverance and New Republic squadrons pursuing the Imperial forces, the 204th's bulk freighter Yadeez and its escorts managed to escape into hyperspace multiple times. The Deliverance was also present at the Attack on Chadawa.

Later in that same year, However, the Star Destroyer was destroyed amid the fighting, but not before its crew managed to escape the vessel aboard escape pods.

The Deliverance appeared in the 2021 novel Victory's Price: An Alphabet Squadron Novel, written by Alexander Freed.

entities.name: Demolisher
entities.description:
The Demolisher was a Gladiator-class Star Destroyer used by the Galactic Empire around 15 BBY.

The Demolisher was Admiral Screed's flagship during the early years of the Galactic Empire. He used the vessel while on campaigns in the Outer Rim Territories. At some point, the Demolisher was stolen from an Imperial repair dock by the space pirate Gir Kybo Ren-Cha and his crew. They intended to use it against the Tammuz-an space navy in an attempt to plunder their world.

During the battle, R2-D2 (who had been captured alongside C-3PO) reversed a proton torpedo he was ordered to load into one of Demolisher launch tubes, causing it to explode and cripple the Star Destroyer.

An interesting feature of this ship was that turbolaser shots fired always seemed to emit from the ring around the reactor dome on the bottom of the ship, or from the reactor itself. This is similar to ships in Star Trek, which possess phaser banks on rings on the top or bottom of the ships. Due to the amount of projectile ordnance the Demolisher possessed, the ship's design seemed to have been focused on missile delivery, suggesting that Gladiators were used as artillery support ships, and not actually used for capital-ship combat. The small number of traditional capital-ship weapon emplacements would only be a threat to small ships, such as blockade runners, and the missile launchers would have to be used as the primary weapons.

entities.name: Dhoora
entities.description:
The Dhoora was a YT-1300 light freighter owned and operated by the Nami during the Galactic Civil War.

In the year 3 ABY, the resurgent Nami of the Outer Rim Territories sought to wage war against the Galactic Empire under the leadership of their charismatic leader, Ali Tarrak. In this pursuit, the Nami aligned themselves with the Alliance to Restore the Republic, and sought to assist their Rebel allies in their cause through the theft and procurement of sensitive technologies belonging to the Empire. Their first major operation was a raid on a convoy of Imperial Assassin-class corvettes from Hashim group, who were transferring TIE/D Defender prototypes from an Imperial research facility located in the Parmel system formerly operated by treacherous Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin. With the facility's destruction at Zaarin's hands and the security of the TIE Defender technology threatened, the Nami moved in to take advantage of the Empire's weakness.

In this raid, the Nami sent a strike force led by the Dhoora to capture at least one of the corvettes carrying the TIE Defender prototypes. While the Rebels distracted the Imperial pilots guarding the convoy, among them Tan Maarek Stele the Dhoora raced into the region to capture Hashim 1 while its escort of T-wing interceptors further wrangled with the Imperials. Taking advantage of the chaotic situation, the Dhoora deployed its strike team who quickly overpowered the crew of the disabled corvette and secured the ship. The Dhoora and its surviving escorts then fled the area with their prize, with the intent of replicating and producing the TIE Defender for eventual sale to the Rebels and ultimately for use against the Empire.

Eventually, an Imperial task force led by Grand Admiral Thrawn discovered the manufacturing facility where Tarrak was mass-producing the TIE Defender, and deployed Maarek Stele to annihilate the facility and all Nami forces present in the area. In the battle that ensued, the Imperials destroyed the majority of Tarrak's forces, forcing Tarrak herself to flee the facility on the Dhoora in a desperate bid to evade capture.

entities.name: Direption
entities.description:
Direption was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served under the Warlord Admiral Krennel's fleet in 9 ABY. It was later surrendered to the New Republic.

It was originally commanded by a certain Captain Rensen, but when Rensen refused to raze a village which was home to a person who had attempted to assassinate Krennel, he was executed and command was turned over to Commander Vict Darron. Lieutenant Harsis was the sensor officer.

During the Battle of Liinade III, Direption was outnumbered and attacked by three New Republic warships: Freedom and Moonshadow, both Imperial II-class Star Destroyers, and Swift Liberty, a Victory II-class Star Destroyer. In the course of the battle, following the loss of his TIE/LN starfighters and his other support, Darron surrendered Direption in order to save the ship. The New Republic took possession of the severely damaged Star Destroyer.

entities.name: Distant Wind
entities.description:
Distant Wind was a modified XS-800 light freighter from Corellian Engineering Corporation. It was owned by Sullustan gamester Cunbus Locb.

The Distant Wind was a property of Cunbus Locb, a Sullustan gambler who traveled through several planetary systems in the Parmel, Portmoak and Quence sectors during the Galactic Civil War, making a good deal of money, but also some enemies.

During this time, Locb invested part of his earnings in customized improvements for his ship, including better shields, weapons (such as an additional laser cannon), and engines (increasing its atmospheric speed in 50 km/h). Locb also added four hidden smuggling compartments in the ship's common room.

Lastly, he augmented the Wind's sensor array to detect several credit-sized scanners Locb carried with him. The Sullustan strategically placed the scanners in any room he was to play cards at, and then the ship's array could report him the cards other players were holding.

entities.name: Dominant
entities.description:
The Dominant was a Carrack-class light cruiser of the Imperial Navy.

Built around 6 BBY, the Dominant shared a connection with the military career of Pter Thanas. Under Thanas's command, Dominant fought the Crimson Nova pirates at F'Dann IX, and presumably served in a defensive capacity while Thanas was stationed at Alzoc III. When Thanas was transferred to Bakura in 1 ABY, Dominant became the system force flagship under the command of Captain Dren Jamer, where its primary task consisted of a detailed mapping of the Bakura system.

By 4 ABY, Dominant was showing its age with a set of failing lateral thrusters. Despite its age, Dominant played a critical role in the Invasion of Bakura as the most powerful warship of the Imperial-Rebel alliance at Bakura. After successfully driving back the invasion force, Dominant turned its guns against the Alliance cruiser-carrier Flurry, and on Governor Nereus's orders, destroyed it.

In the subsequent Bakuran revolution, Thanas surrendered Dominant to the Alliance and defected. As Captain Jamer departed with the remaining Imperial garrison forces, Thanas was placed in command of Dominant as flagship of the newly created Bakuran Alliance system defense force.

entities.description:

entities.name: Dorin's Sky
entities.description:
The Dorin's Sky was a Thranta-class corvette that was in the service of the Republic Navy during the Cold War.

The Dorin's Sky was a standard Thranta-class corvette used by the Galactic Republic during the Cold War with the Sith Empire.

During the Cold War, the Dorin's Sky was carrying supplies to the ancient space station the Foundry that had been taken over by the Republic after the release of the Jedi Master Revan as part of the Republic fleet sent to guard it against Imperial attack. During this time it was carrying a battalion of Republic troopers and as well as a team of Jedi Knights to reinforce the station when the warship was intercepted by the Harrower-class dreadnought White Nova, the command ship of an Imperial task force. Once captured by the White Nova tractor beam, an Imperial strike team entered the warship and took the ship after eliminating the Republic forces in command of it. The ship would be later used to bypass the Republic blockade and board the Foundry prior to the arrival of the White Nova and the rest of the Imperial Task Force.

entities.name: Drone vessel 171
entities.description:
Drone vessel 171 was a drone freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

In 3 ABY, drone vessel 171 was part of a convoy of Imperial drone freighters en route to the Kuat Drive Yards with a cargo of hyperdrive components. When Rebel spies learned of this convoy, the Alliance mounted a daring mission to steal the hyperdrive components and captured the vessel.

entities.name: Duracrud
entities.description:
The Duracrud was a YV-666 given to Uran Lavint after her capture by Jacen Solo, in recompense for the appropriation of her usual ship, Breathe My Jets. When she insulted him, Jacen ordered that the hyperdrive should be sabotaged to fail upon a second jump, knowing that smugglers usually jumped to a remote location before continuing onto their destination. However, the Dark Jedi Alema Rar had stowed away in the hold, trusting that Lavint would be able to help her track down Han and Leia Solo. Alema helped her repair the hyperdrive in exchange for her help.

The two took the Duracrud to the Errant Venture in order to hunt for the Solos. However Booster Terrik and a team including the Solos, Wedge and Iella Antilles, Corran Horn, Jagged Fel and Jaina Solo all sprung an ambush, forcing Alema to steal the Duracrud to make her escape.

The freighter was then piloted by Alema to Gilatter VIII, where she knew that the Confederation summit was being held. Lavint had informed her that the Solos would be present, and then informed the Solos that Alema would be present as heads-up to the family. When Jacen Solo was trapped aboard a satellite resort by the Confederation, the Solos flew to the dome to rescue him with Luke and Mara Skywalker. Alema set the Duracrud up among the other parked ships several kilometers away and set waypoints in the nav computer. As Alema and Lumiya joined forces to attack the Solos and the Skywalkers, the Duracrud began to accelerate towards the dome, smashing through it and the floor beneath it, punching through the station's axis.

entities.name: Ebon Hawk
entities.description:
The Ebon Hawk was a Dynamic-class freighter and a smuggler ship that rose to fame due to its use around the time of the Jedi Civil War. It was well-known throughout the galaxy as a ship associated with the Exchange, and it passed through many hands before it was commandeered by amnesiac Dark Lord of the Sith, Revan, who was escaping the Destruction of Taris. After Revan joined the Jedi Order, the ship was instrumental in his search for the Star Forge.

After Revan traveled to the Unknown Regions to destroy the remains of a Sith Empire that had lain dormant there, the Hawk eventually fell into the hands of the Jedi Exile Meetra Surik, who used it on her quest to stop the Sith Triumvirate. The ship was heavily modified over the course of its life, to the point that it was difficult to determine its origins. With its extremely powerful hyperdrive, the ship was believed to be in the top ten of the fastest ships in the galaxy during its time, as it was the fastest ship in the Outer Rim Territories.

The Ebon Hawk was a Dynamic-class freighter, roughly resembled Aurebesh sigil minus the inward curves at the ends of the outer prongs, with the center prong flush with them, and with a concave curve to the vertical line. Visualizing the open side as the bow, the Hawk mass filled out the stern to the shape's midpoint and left only a small prong on the starboard side. The starboard mass contained a deployable turret that would extend from the ship's ventral side, and on the port and starboard sides were two more turret emplacements.

The ship was painted primarily white with the three prongs accented in red on the bow, as well as the dorsal and ventral sides. Towards the stern, on both the latter two sides, there were concave red stripes that curved parallel to the ship's stern from the center prong to the outer two, originating from the outward sides of two cylindrical engines, which met the center prong at its base and extended outward to port and starboard. This formed a symmetrical acute angle across the dorsal side on the longitudinal axis, with legs that met the rear curve. All along the outward-facing sides of these engines was another red stripe.

entities.name: Eclipse
entities.description:
The Eclipse was the first Eclipse-class dreadnought ever constructed and the lead ship and prototype of its class. It was built as a flagship for Emperor Palpatine, who used it after being reborn into one of his clone bodies. Both a powerful technological tool and a potent psychological weapon, the Eclipse boasted a planet's worth of weaponry and was almost unstoppable.

The Eclipse was equipped with a bevy of weapons and other technologies, including gravity well projectors, but chief among its weapons was an axial superlaser, capable of cracking a planet's crust or destroying a capital ship in a single shot.

For much of its existence, the Eclipse was under construction around the planet Kuat. Crime lord Tyber Zann raided the vessel from Galactic Empire forces in 4 ABY to retrieve data from its memory banks, and left it shortly thereafter, realizing that it would present far too big of a target to both the Empire and Rebel Alliance forces. The ship was later moved to Byss, where the reborn Emperor Palpatine took control of it as his personal battle station and flagship. The Eclipse led his new Dark Empire in an assault on the New Republic stronghold of Da Soocha V in 10 ABY, and in the battle was destroyed by one of Palpatine's Force storms.

The Eclipse was the lead ship of the 17.5 kilometer Eclipse-class dreadnought, the prototype of that class, Encased in a jet-black durasteel and quadranium By volume, the Eclipse was one of the largest warships ever built though in length it was somewhat shorter than the 19 kilometer Executor-class Star Dreadnoughts and Vengeance-class dreadnoughts.

entities.name: Eighth Brother's TIE fighter
entities.description:
The Eighth Brother's TIE fighter was a TIE/ad v1 starfighter used by the Eighth Brother, a Jedi hunter of the Galactic Empire's Inquisitorius. It was manufactured by Sienar Fleet Systems sometime between 4 BBY and 3 BBY. The TIE was equipped with shield generators and an armament of two L-s9.1 laser cannons and a projectile launcher. With a P-s5.2 twin ion engine, the TIE fighter could reach speeds up to 1,600 kilometers per hour, or 994 miles per hour, in atmosphere with a maximum acceleration of 4,150 G.

In 3 BBY, the Eighth Brother piloted the starfighter to the planet Malachor in his search for the former Sith Maul, a task assigned to him by the Inquisitorius leader, Darth Vader. There, his TIE/ad v1 was tracked by the rebels Ezra Bridger, C1-10P, Kanan Jarrus, and Ahsoka Tano during their search for knowledge to defeat the Inquisitors. The Eighth Brother confronted the rebels but attempted to flee to his starfighter, arriving too late as the astromech droid C1-10P found his starship and turned it against him. The Inquisitor later perished on Malachor, leaving his starfighter to be claimed by Maul.

The Eighth Brother's TIE fighter was a TIE/ad v1 initially owned by the Eighth Brother, a Terrelian Jango Jumper that was an Inquisitor of the Inquisitorius—an organization of the Galactic Empire However, after the Eighth Brother's death on the planet Malachor, the former Sith Maul took the TIE fighter and left the planet.

The starfighter measured 3.6 meters long, 6.6 meters wide, and 5.7 meters tall, or 11 feet and 7 inches long, 21 feet and 9 inches wide, and 18 feet and 8 inches tall. Equipped with a P-s5.2 twin ion engine, the starship was able to achieve a maximum acceleration of 4,150 G, 105 megalight per hour, and a maximum speed in atmosphere of 1,600 kilometers per hour or 994 miles per hour. The ship was outfitted with a Class 4.5 hyperdrive and an N-s6.a Navcon navigation system.

entities.name: Eleemosynary
entities.description:
The Eleemosynary was an Imperial Star Destroyer that served as the personal command ship of the cyborg Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik. The warship was one of many destroyers that comprised the Imperial Fleet during the Battle of Endor, while Teshik was aboard the second Death Star battle station. The Grand Admiral narrowly escaped the Death Star's destruction and retreated to the Eleemosynary, from where he continued to combat the Rebel Alliance for three hours after the Imperial withdrawal was initiated. However, the Alliance eventually disabled the Eleemosynary with concentrated ion cannon fire and captured Teshik.

The Eleemosynary was a Star Destroyer in the Galactic Empire's navy. Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik used the warship as his personal command ship.

By 4 ABY, the Eleemosynary was in use as the command ship of the cyborg Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik. The Star Destroyer was present in the Endor system while Teshik was aboard the second Death Star, the Eleemosynary participated in the Battle of Endor against the Rebel Alliance Navy.

As the battle raged on, the Alliance succeeded in destroying the Death Star's reactor core. Teshik was later executed.

entities.name: Emancipator
entities.description:
The Emancipator was a CR90 corvette used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the early months of the Galactic Civil War.

Originally, it was called Helot's Shackle and was a slave ship that had operated out of Ylesia. When Han Solo escaped from the planet along with Bria Tharen, they narrowly avoided being captured and boarded by the orbiting ship.

Nine years later, Tharen had founded Red Hand Squadron as part of the Rebel Alliance to free slaves around the galaxy. She masterminded an elaborate plan to hijack Helot's Shackle and free the Exultation-addicted slaves who were bound for either Kessel or various Imperial pleasure houses. Despite heavy losses and intense fighting, Red Hand Squadron prevailed and captured the ship. She renamed the ship Emancipator in homage to freeing the slaves.

The newly commissioned Rebel vessel participated in the Battle of Ylesia, where Bria Tharen freed all the pilgrims from the spice factories and the t'landa Til Exultation.

entities.name: Endeavor
entities.description:
The Endeavor was a colony vessel operated by the Arkanians. In 1 ABY, it was carrying 100 individuals to a new world. It was waylaid and captured by the Imperial Commander Rezi Soresh, who had fled the Empire and established an outpost in the Outer Rim of the galaxy. Soresh took the hostages to his outpost on a barren moon to use as bait in a trap for the Rebel Alliance pilot Luke Skywalker by threatening the hostages' lives.

When Skywalker arrived, Soresh used an impostor to greet him. The impostor was blasted by Han Solo, Skywalker's ally. Skywalker and his compatriots moved to the compound to free the hostages, but a series of mines went off, causing chaos. A colonist who appeared wounded grabbed Skywalker and used a Force pike to subdue Skywalker and revealed himself as Soresh. Soresh captured the other Rebels and held them in his outpost as he attempted to brainwash Skywalker. Soresh was also planning on luring the Rebel Fleet to his moon, along with Imperial leader Darth Vader, and destroying those obstacles to his power. Using his resources, Soresh acquired resonance torpedoes to destroy the system's star.

As the fleets arrived, Skywalker betrayed Soresh and his drugged bodyguards. Soresh escaped, but not before launching the resonance torpedoes. As the star began its death throes, the fleets withdrew, allowing Skywalker and his companions to rescue the surviving hostages. The hostages escaped on their ship before the supernova struck.

The vessel's name and origin were established in its appearance in Alex Wheeler's 2010 book Rebel Force: Uprising. During the narrative, the colonists were not specifically identified as Arkanian, but were instead referred to simply as "men" and "women." The ship was also mentioned in the 2012 reference book The Essential Reader's Companion.

entities.name: Ession Strike
entities.description:
The Ession Strike, originally named the Night Caller, was a modified CR90 corvette.

The Night Caller carried four TIE/LN starfighters in its forward cargo hold and mounted a heavy tractor beam projector in the place of one of its turbolaser turrets. Also, the normal deck between the hangar and bridge, usually used for luxury quarters, was removed.

These modifications were made during construction rather than as a refit, meaning that the Night Caller and the similarly modified Constrictor could be considered a sub-class of the CR90 corvette.

The Night Caller was captained by Zurel Darillian serving Warlord Zsinj before being captured by Wraith Squadron at Xobome in 7 ABY. Wraith Squadron impersonated the ship's crew and carried out its itinerary, which included the placement of empion mines along Hyperlanes.
entities.short_description: The Ession Strike, originally named the Night Caller, was a modified CR90 corvette.

entities.name: Ethar
entities.description:
Ethar was the designation given to a group of two CR90 corvettes used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

Shortly after the capture of the Imperial Nebulon-B frigate Priam, the Alliance learned the location of the Death Star I and Ethar 1 and 2 were sent there to investigate. They arrived to find that the Death Star had already left, having destroyed the planet first. Furthermore, Imperial forces had anticipated the Rebel's arrival and lingered there to set a trap. The corvettes were disabled and the Imperials dispatched repair crews aboard the Lambda-class shuttles, Ceptor 1 and 2 to board and capture the corvettes under the protection of Assault Gunboats.

Sometime later, the Alliance mounted a rescue attempt. The operation comprised three waves. First, three X-wings from Red Squadron, flown by Keyan Farlander, Casal Marskan and Horodi, arrived to engage the Gunboats. Three minutes later, two groups of three Y-wings from Blue and Gold squadrons arrived and attempted to disable the corvettes. Six minutes after the arrival of the Y-wings, two Lambda-class shuttles from Rogue group arrived to recapture the corvettes.

The Rebels succeeded in recapturing the corvettes, but resistance was greater than anticipated and the cost was high. Marskan and Horodi were both killed before the Y-wings arrived. After the rest of the Rebels fled to hyperspace, a communications problem resulted in Farlander receiving a late mission complete message and his X-wing was destroyed as he continued to battle the Gunboats alone. Farlander was able to eject and was later recovered by the Rebels.
entities.short_description: Ethar was the designation given to a group of two CR90 corvettes used by the Alliance to Restore the Republic during the Galactic Civil War.

entities.name: Evac One
entities.description:
Evac One was an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser originally known as Transport Ship 63378 which was stolen from the Galactic Empire and later used as an evac ship by the Spectres.

Evac One was an Imperial Gozanti-class cruiser on underside-mounted docking clamps. Its hull was painted a light gray, After it became a rebel ship under the name of Evac One, its appearance remained mostly unchanged save for an orange starbird painted at the starboard side.

The ship was known to the Empire as Transport Ship 63378. it was stolen by the Spectres to rescue their leader, Kanan Jarrus, from the Mustafar system. Sabine Wren made a distraction at a Lothal hangar while her fellow rebels absconded with the cruiser. They then added their previously stolen TIE fighter in order to enter the system. They rendezvoused with the Star Destroyer Sovereign for the rescue, leaving their droid C1-10P to pilot it. After rescuing Jarrus, they fled the Star Destroyer, but C1-10P had left with the transport. He then returned leading a rebel fleet, and together they escaped the system.

It was later used by the larger rebellion, seeing action as an evacuation ship under the callsign Evac One, such as the skirmish on Imvur.

entities.name: Eye of Shiblizar
entities.description:
The Eye of Shiblizar was an old Ulig Abaha Ltd. Dimel-class assault ship that was modified by the slavers Zlarb and Magg. Magg used his position as a Detached Duty agent in the Corporate Sector Authority to enable the theft of the Eye of Shiblizar before it could be destroyed in a Picket Fleet target practice session. Although Magg and Zlarb used the Eye of Shiblizar to carry slaves, they did not use it to make any direct deliveries, fearing that if the Authority identified it, their slaving operation would be severely compromised. They instead used the Eye of Shiblizar to hijack a vessel, transfer the slaves to it, and then use the hijacked vessel to deliver the slaves.

Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook

Around 3668 BBY, when the Dread Masters were captured and imprisoned in Section X on Belsavis, one of their apprentices stole the Fatality and tried to rescue them, only to be shot down.

entities.name: Forbidden
entities.description:
The Forbidden was a modified Lambda-class T-4a shuttle, which was assigned to Rogue Squadron in 6 ABY. It had been modified by the New Republic for training purposes. It was intended to simulate an Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing assault gunboat, and was equipped with a targeting system for concussion missiles. However, it did not have any launch tubes for such missiles, and was also stripped of its laser cannons. The process of restoring the lasers would have taken at least an hour. The Forbidden was kept unarmed because it was piloted by Captain Tycho Celchu, who was suspected by New Republic Intelligence of being an Imperial sleeper agent. Though the lack of weapons limited Celchu's ability to contribute in battle, he used the Forbidden to provide targeting data to other Rogue pilots, and to rescue downed pilots in battle. When piloting the Forbidden, Celchu's callsign was Rogue Null.

entities.name: Fowler
entities.description:
The Fowler was a Lancer-class frigate that was used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. At some point, the Lancer was captured by the Rebel Alliance near to the planet Malastare, and it was subsequently refitted by the Alliance for use as an anti-TIE Fighter attack platform. The Fowler performed an anti-starfighter role on a number of strike missions, in support of Alliance Y-wings, and it achieved a large number of combat kills. The Fowler later saw service with the New Republic, the Alliance's successor government, and it was eventually decommissioned.

entities.name: Fraunesaa
entities.description:
The Fraunesaa was a hauler starship belonging to the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. The ship had been seized from a Hutt after he had been forced to stop at the Starlight Beacon space station, and added to the fleet of ships overseen by Jedi Master Nubarron. An old, cube-shaped vessel, Nubarron issued the ship to Master Cohmac Vitus when he and his Padawan were summoned to Coruscant to make a report to the Jedi High Council and Galactic Senate. They were accompanied by Jedi Knight Vernestra Rwoh and her apprentice Imri Cantaros, who had also been called back to Coruscant, as Rwoh's history of crashing ships had led Nubarron to bar her from being issued any more at Starlight. The Fraunesaa was involved when the group responded to a Nihil attack on the planet Tiikae while en route to Coruscant.

entities.name: Freedom
entities.description:
Freedom was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer that served in the New Republic's starfleet. Prior to its New Republic service, the ship served in the Imperial Navy under the name Avarice.

Little is known of the early history of the Avarice. The ship came to be commanded by Sair Yonka. After the Battle of Endor, Warlord Zsinj attempted to recruit Yonka and the Avarice into his fleet, but Yonka refused to take any orders other than those coming from Coruscant. Yonka sided with Ysanne Isard, feeling that she represented the best chance to reestablish the Empire.

After Coruscant was captured by the New Republic, Yonka traveled to Thyferra. During this time he became increasingly disillusioned by Isard, and was disturbed over the use of biological weapons such the Krytos virus by Isard and the destruction of the Halanit colony.

Yonka was successfully bribed by Wedge Antilles to leave Imperial service. He and the crew of the Avarice, which was renamed the Freedom, confronted Isard's agents in the crew. These agents hijacked a shuttle and forced the Freedom crew to destroy the shuttle.

entities.description:
The Freejack was a modified IPV-1 patrol craft that was captured from a planetary defense network by Frei Aycen, during the time leading up to the Clone Wars. Refitting the ship to have additional cargo space, and removing several shield generators in order to make room and power available for a hyperdrive, Aycen made sure the ship had room for 400 metric tons of cargo, and was armed with four light turbolasers and a tractor beam projector.

They were under escort from T-wings an the Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser Rahmat. The Dreadnaught and the T-wings were all destroyed and the freighters were disabled and captured, despite interference from Zaarin's forces ranging in a Nebulon-B2 frigate Strident, which was destroyed.

entities.name: Gafra
entities.description:
Gafra was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. During Operation Strike Fear the Gafra collected a new experimental warhead from Celanon and transported it to a deep space transfer zone.

According to the plan by Crix Madine and the Sullustan technicians who had just joined the Alliance, they needed the warhead in order to destroy the Invincible and end Operation Strike Fear. Due to Celanon being too well defended, the Rebels decided to attack the Gafra at the deep space transfer zone.

An initial Rebel attack left the Gafra damaged and stranded before withdrawing. However, the freighter was still protected by a field of mines around it. Keyan Farlander in a Y-wing cleared them out and disabled the freighter. When that was done, the Lambda-class T-4a shuttle Herald came and boarded the freighter in order to lead it to the Alliance headquarters.

However, when the shuttle was done and the freighter was ready to enter hyperspace, Imperial stormtrooper transports came and attempted to destroy the freighter, but Farlander was able to drive them off.

entities.name: Gavi's shuttle
entities.description:
Gavi's shuttle was a Nihil escape shuttle that had crashed within the Lonisa City Zoo on the planet Valo The crashed shuttle was later discovered by the Jedi youngling Gavi, who suspected based on the damage it had sustained that it had been shot down during the Nihil marauders' attack on the Republic Fair two and a half years prior. Gavi, who had been hiding on Valo with fellow younglings Kildo and Tep Tep, wanted to use the shuttle to escape, but realized that it was not large enough to carry all of them. Unable to choose who should be saved, Gavi instead kept the shuttle a secret, discreetly repairing the vessel whenever he had the opportunity.

A month after Gavi had found the shuttle, the three younglings met the Jedi Padawan Ram Jomaram, who had been fighting back against the Nihil's occupation of the planet, as well as discovered that their old friend Driggit Parse had joined the marauders. Although he had managed to restore much of the shuttle's functionality, Gavi was further conflicted on who to give the vessel to. The young pirate Zyle Keem, who had come to Valo in the hope of stealing bacta from the sunken vessel Innovator and had joined their group, the Scarlet Skulls, discovered Gavi was keeping the shuttle a secret, but eventually promised not to tell the others.

However, Gavi was forced to reveal the shuttle's existence when the Nihil discovered their location and sent a force to confront them, including the scientist Niv Drendow Apruk and his Nameless, Grendrek. As his fellow Jedi were weakened by the Nameless' presence, Gavi fled and retrieved his shuttle. Gavi returned to rescue the others at the same time as Jomaram's droid, V-18, arrived to assist them. With Kildo and Keem boarding the shuttle as the others climbed onto V-18, the group was able to escape the Nihil. The reveal of the secret hurt Kildo and led to Gavi confessing his feelings for him.

The Scarlet Skulls later utilized Gavi's shuttle, alongside Jomaram's Eviscerator, to raid the Innovator at the bottom of Lake Lonisa. After a skirmish with the Nihil aboard the Innovator that resulted in the vessel beginning to flood, the group intended to depart aboard their two vessels. However, Parse and Apruk stole Gavi's shuttle and escaped, forcing the Scarlet Skulls to instead fly the entire Innovator out from the lake. Parse piloted the shuttle away from Valo and out of the Rseik sector, after which Apruk decided to head to the Korvix Vorn penal ship. Hoping to wait for an opportune moment to strike against the Nihil, Parse declared that she would accompany him and engaged the shuttle's hyperdrive.

entities.name: Geddawai
entities.description:
The Geddawai was a YT-1300 light freighter owned by the Rebel Alliance. Stationed on Rebel outpost DS 5 in 3 ABY, the Geddawai was used as an escape vehicle by the rogue Imperial Admiral Harkov when Imperial authorities caught up with him. Despite the deployment of a decoy and the confusion of the surrounding scene as the Imperials closed in, the ship was disabled by an Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing piloted by Maarek Stele, and was captured by stormtroopers. The vessel was then flown into the hangar of Imperial-class Star Destroyer Garrett, and its occupants, Harkov among them removed for interrogation. It is unknown what the Imperials did with the ship after its capture.

Since many ships of the X-wing series of games are anagrams and puns of names and phrases, Geddawai could probably stand for get away. This makes sense as Harkov had intended to escape the Imperials on this vessel.

TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide

entities.name: Genue
entities.description:
Genue was a BFF-1 bulk freighter used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. Genue was due to travel from the prison planet Mytus VII, aka Stars' End, to Kashyyyk when it was boarded by some escaped Rebel pilots, including Sam Raider and Toalagar.

The prisoners' escape was quickly discovered and a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport sent to board and search ships near Kashyyyk in an effort to recapture the prisoners.

The Rebel Alliance also learned of the escape and dispatched Captain Keyan Farlander with Lieutenant Cardacs, a friend of Raider, in R-22 Spearheads to lead a rescue mission. Farlander destroyed the Imperial transport just before it boarded the Genue and the Rebel Lambda-class shuttle Drago soon came and boarded the freighter in order to lead it to hyperspace, while the two R-22s repelled TIE fighter assaults from the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Intrepid. Cardacs was killed while protecting the boarding operation.

The escapees then informed the Alliance about Wookiee slaves gathered by the Empire to work for a secret project.

entities.name: Glas
entities.description:
The Glas was an IPV-1 System Patrol Craft that was used by the Ripoblus government during the Imperial era. In 3 ABY, it was hijacked by a group of Ripoblus scientists who were growing disenchanted with the Sepan Civil War, and wished to seek asylum with the Galactic Empire. Since the Glas had no hyperdrive, the Victory I-class Star Destroyer Protector arrived in the Sepan system to dock with the craft. Though the Ripoblus sent their own fighters to stop the scientists from escaping, the Glas docked successfully with the Imperial warship, and was abandoned.

As a Sienar Fleet Systems IPV-1 System Patrol Craft, the Glas was 150 meters in length, and could reach speeds of up to eighty megalights per hour. In terms of defense, its deflector shield strength was at 150 SBDs, with hull integrity at fifty RU. The Glas was also armed with three laser cannon turrets, and one rear-mounted turbolaser. To the disadvantage of the Ripoblus scientists who hijacked it during the Sepan Civil War, it was not equipped with a hyperdrive.

The system patrol craft Glas was owned by the Ripoblus government, and was in their service during the Imperial era. during Admiral Harkov's attempts to defuse the Sepan Civil War, a select group of scientists from Ripoblus grew weary of the conflict and wished to distance themselves from it as much as possible. They were mainly dissatisfied with the manner in which their research was being used by their government, and no longer wished to contribute to the war. Hijacking the Glas and the shuttles Nazaar 1 and Nazaar 2, the scientists sought refuge with the Imperial forces in the sector. As the Glas had no hyperdrive system, Harkov's flagship, the Victory I-class Star Destroyer Protector, journeyed to its location. The scientists arranged to have the Glas dock with the Protector to allow a transfer of personnel, but before the stolen patrol craft could reach the Star Destroyer, fighters sent by the Ripoblus government entered the system.

As Ripoblus BTL Y-wing starfighters from Able Squadron, as well as the Lambda-class T-4a shuttles of Lambda Group bore down on the Glas, the Protector launched TIE/IN interceptors to fend them off. Eventually, the Dimoks, enemies of the Ripoblus, sent their own fighters to attack the Glas. Their attack force mirrored that of the Ripoblus, as they dispatched Y-wings from Baker Squadron and shuttles from Sigma group. The Dimoks were also intercepted by the Imperial fighters, one of which was piloted by ace Maarek Stele. The Glas successfully docked with the Protector, transferring the scientists, while placing a set of decoys aboard the starship. Abandoned, the patrol craft was set on autopilot and sent out into space, though it was still considered a potential target by the enemy. Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttles from the Ripoblus arrived, but they were far too late to capture the scientists. Meanwhile, Nazaar 1 and Nazaar 2 successfully entered the hangar of the Imperial warship. Due to his role in protecting the Glas, Stele was given a promotion to lieutenant.

entities.name: Guardian
entities.description:
Note: Both hyperdrives inoperative from 4 ABY

The Guardian was an Executor-class Star Dreadnought. Originally under the command of Admiral Gaen Drommel of the Galactic Empire, it was stationed near Coruscant when news of the Battle of Endor arrived. Drommel took the Guardian to the region of space surrounding his homeworld of Oplovis, where he became a warlord. After a series of attacks on New Republic worlds and bases, the tide turned for Drommel, and the Guardian was badly damaged at the Battle of Tantive V in 4 ABY. Drommel fled into hyperspace, but due to the damage sustained on the vessel's hyperdrive, the Guardian emerged in the Fardon system rather than its intended destination. Its hyperdrive inoperable, it went into orbit around the planet Soullex, where it would stay for over a decade as Drommel conducted repairs.

Around 16 ABY, the New Republic learned that the Guardian was receiving parts through its Lambda-class shuttles. Two ship thieves, Cryle Cavv and Sienn Sconn, were sent to track the shuttles back to their origin and capture the Guardian. After freeing a number of New Republic prisoners, Cavv and Sconn were able to reprogram the vessel's nearly-repaired hyperdrive to leap into the middle of a New Republic fleet when Drommel tested it. Drommel refused to surrender, but his officer Colonel Niovi shot him and took command of the vessel, surrendering it to the New Republic.

The New Republic assigned the Guardian to the Third Fleet, under the command of Admiral Gial Ackbar. From the Guardian, Ackbar led the New Republic's fleets in a series of skirmishes against the Empire, including the Second Battle of Champala and the Battle of Anx Minor, which drove the Empire under Gilad Pellaeon back to a scant few sectors. In the Yuuzhan Vong War, the Guardian served as protection for Chief of State Cal Omas, before being deployed to Traest Kre'fey's Fleet Group One at Kashyyyk. After the formation of a new government, the Galactic Alliance, the Guardian was redeployed to Mon Calamari to protect the Alliance headquarters. It later fought against the Yuuzhan Vong in the Battle of Mon Calamari.

entities.name: Harbinger
entities.description:
The Harbinger was a Hammerhead-class cruiser that served the Galactic Republic shortly after the Jedi Civil War. Originally assigned to patrol Republic space and deal with local troubles, the Harbinger was sent in 3951 BBY to the Outer Rim Territories to pick up Meetra Surik and ferry her to Telos IV.

When the Harbinger diverted its course to investigate a battle between a Sith warship and a light freighter, it was captured by Sith under the command of the Sith Lord Darth Sion. Sion took control of the vessel and piloted it to Peragus II in search of Surik, who had been abducted off the ship during the earlier crisis. Surik and her companions were forced to travel through the vessel to reach their own ship, and when they attempted to flee, the Harbinger opened fire. In the ensuing fight, the volatile Peragus asteroid field was destroyed, with the Harbinger caught in the middle of the explosion.

The Harbinger was a Hammerhead-class cruiser. The hull of the Harbinger was mostly white, with red and yellow decoration on the bow and around the engines.

The vessel held at least three strike teams of Republic soldiers which could be used for boarding enemy vessels. Around three-hundred crewmen were aboard and killed when the Sith attacked the vessel, including the warship's captain. Other members of the crew at that time included a female medical officer and an HK-50 assassin droid that had been posing as a protocol droid. A number of guns were located amidships, with others flanking the bridge and on the ends of the "hammerhead" portion of the vessel. Behind the hammerhead, on the exterior of the ship, sat a small golden dish, its purpose unknown. The Harbinger was also equipped with an umbilical, to aid in boarding other ships.

entities.name: Harbinger
entities.description:
The Harbinger was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy famous for being one of the only Star Destroyers to be hijacked by the Rebel Alliance.

The Harbinger was 1,600 meters long, the standard length for an Imperial-class Star Destroyer. As such, it was initially armed with turbolaser batteries, ion cannons, and several tractor beam projectors. Before it was hijacked, the Harbinger was upgraded with the removal of its tractor beam targeting array with a communications tower.

For months after the battle of Yavin, the Star Destroyer was stationed on unknown planet as it carried the TIE fighters.

entities.name: Harramin
entities.description:
The Harramin was an Imperial capital ship.

It was seized by the Yevetha when they captured the Black-15 shipyard and other Black Sword Command military assets, during their successful revolt against Imperial rule, eight months after the Battle of Endor.

Twelve years later, she served as one of the control ships from which the slave circuit system devised by Major Sil Sorannan and his escape committee was initiated, recapturing the Black Fleet for the Empire.

The Harramin has sometimes been taken to be a misprint of the name of Harridan, mentioned in Before the Storm as a Victory-class Star Destroyer assigned to Black Sword Command. However, there seems to be no canon evidence for this, especially as Harridan had been pulled away from N'zoth three weeks before the Yevethan revolt.
entities.short_description: The Harramin was an Imperial capital ship.

entities.name: Harthusa's Pride
entities.description:
The Harthusa's Pride was a modified space yacht owned by the Devaronian slaver, Harthusa. Confiscated by agents of the Alliance to Restore the Republic in the Bissillirus system shortly after the liberation of Kentara, they kept the ship as they continued to investigate the Bissillirus Resupply Base

Harthusa's Pride was a Luxurious-class space yacht manufactured by Ghtroc Industries. Thirty-one meters long, the ship had cargo capacity to store seventy-five metric tons within thirty cubic meters of space, and one month's worth of consumables. The ship was extensively modified by the Devaronian slaver Harthusa to his specifications, and reflected his own personal creed, which was to run rather than fight. Harthusa's Pride was fast for a vessel of its class, capable of achieving speeds of 1,200 kilometers and hour. Its hull and deflector shields were relatively weak, and could only withstand a few hits. Likewise, its armament was a single laser cannon. However, the vessel was installed with a sensor stealth package that made the Harthusa's Pride difficult to detect.

The ship was equipped with a navigation computer and sensors, and a Class Two hyperdrive with a Class Twelve backup unit. A crew of one pilot and one gunner operated the vessel, and four passengers were able to be transported comfortably in the luxurious appointed staterooms with carpeted corridors and expensive statuary. Harthusa also maintained a private master suite stocked with liquors and spices. The cargo hold was fitted out to contain cells to contain up to thirty cells. After its modifications, the Harthusa's Pride cost 350,000 credits.

The Harthusa's Pride was Harthusa's base of operations as he plied his slave trade around the galaxy. the Harthusa's Pride was appropriated by Alliance to Restore the Republic operatives after they raided Harthusa's compound on Deysum III and freed the Wookiee Kentara, a fellow Rebel that Harthusa had sold into slavery.

entities.description:
The Heart of Artorias, originally Tsam P'ah, was a Yuuzhan Vong slaveship used to house captured sentients from Artorias and other planets. Nina and Kaye Galfridian, as well as Jenny and Arbeloa, were held on board.

Its commander was Sha'kel, until he was killed in a revolt of the slaves, who took over the ship and renamed it the Heart of Artorias. The Heart then became the rallying point of volunteers who wanted to aid in the evacuation of refugees from Shramar during the Battle of Shramar.

entities.name: High Hauler
entities.description:
High Hauler was an Imperial transport that was captured by the New Republic in 5 ABY and used to sneak a Rebel strike team onto the planet of Ruusan through Jerec's blockade.

High Hauler normally contained a crew of twenty-five, but a crew as small as twelve could operate the vessel. The ship had a docking bay that could accommodate two smaller transports at once, such as light freighters and shuttles.

The High Hauler was an Imperial transport that was part of the task force of an Imperial Star Destroyer. The force was involved in the battle in the Milagro system which resulted to the Star Destroyer's surrender and capture by the Rebel forces stationed around Milagro.

The battle coincided with the search for the Valley of the Jedi, where Rebel agent and fledgling Jedi Knight Kyle Katarn was after the Dark Jedi Jerec who invaded the lost planet Ruusan, a location of a powerful Force nexus. Mon Mothma initially didn't condone Katarn's quest, mentioning, among others, Jerec's blockade around the planet; his partner, Jan Ors, backed by Han Solo, suggested to use a captured transport, available after the recent battle. Solo volunteered to pilot it but he was dissuaded by Leia Organa, and Ors recruited prisoner Alfonso Luiz Obota for the task.

entities.name: I'nah's cruiser
entities.description:
The Nihil I'nah captained a cruiser after commandeering the vessel from the Galactic Republic, patrolling the Nihil's Stormwall hyperspace barrier with her crew. During a meeting in the cruiser's briefing room in 229 BBY, I'nah argued with the Nihil scientist Niv Drendow Apruk about traveling to the Outer Rim planet Valo to gather valuable experiment materials. The aspiring pirate Zyle Keem—who had eavesdropped on the meeting—stole an escape shuttle from the vessel and traveled to Valo to seek materials to loot.

The cruiser could fit a crew of around fifty individuals, featuring a large, metal-decked hangar with room for several ships. It was equipped with engines, a navigation system, several Nihil escape shuttles, and a Path engine hyperdrive unit. The interior of the cruiser had an armory, a storeroom, and a galley. Its briefing room featured an antechamber and a table and was connected to at least one vent. The ship's main hangar, which was protected by a locked door, was on the same level that held its escape pods. After being commandeered by Nihil marauders, the ship's interior took on a scuffed appearance. At least one of its corridors was splattered with blue paint, its bulkheads were dented, and a viscous liquid dripped from some exposed pipes.

At some point during the High Republic Era, the Togruta I'nah commandeered the cruiser from the Galactic Republic. As part of the Nihil, she served as captain of the vessel and led her crew of around fifty members. The cruiser patrolled the Stormwall, the Nihil's hyperspace barrier separating the Occlusion Zone from the rest of Republic space, for some time. At some point, she allowed the pirate Tanana Keem and her crew to use her cruiser as a staging ground for their raids.

In 229 BBY, Keem and her crew visited the cruiser on their ships—the Venomed Scabbard and the Grim Devourer II—to barter goods before their heist on the astronomical object Quence. She opted to leave her child, the aspiring pirate Zyle Keem, aboard their vessel after deeming the endeavor too risky to take them. Though Zyle protested, Tanana insisted that the former could sneak around the Nihil cruiser and gather information for her. Zyle wandered through the ship's messy corridors following their mother's departure from the hangar, acquiring some lochi fruit to snack on and locating the vessel's armory.

entities.name: Ibutho 1
entities.description:
Ibutho 1 was the first of a group of 6 Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports that were used by the Rneekii Pirates.

A group of 3 Imperial Modified corvettes Hashim and a Shuttle G'nabgib, carrying the chief scientist had fell into a trap by the Rneekii. When Tan Maarek Stele in a TIE Defender was launched to fight of the Pirate strike force consisting of the transports, R-41 Starchasers and a Strike-class medium cruiser Intombe. Ibutho 1 had docked with the G'nabgib captured the scientist and jumped into Hyperspace. Stele managed to destroy all the other transports from Ibutho and drove of the Pirate force.

Ibutho 1 was used to transfer the scientist to the Empire as part of their decision to Ransom the scientist to the highest bidder which was the Empire. However, the Pirates gravely underestimated the Imperials and were trapped by Interdictor Red Claw. The pirates were eliminated and Ibutho 1 was captured to recover the ransom.

entities.name: IG-88's starship
entities.description:
A starship was operated by the droid bounty hunter IG-88. The starship originally was operated by RB-919, a cyborg and droid engineer, and was crewed by a number of droids. When RB-919 was hired by the bounty hunter Deva Lompop to repair IG-88, they traveled in their starship to an astronomical object that hosted the junkyard where the droid's remains were located. RB-919 brought IG-88 aboard their vessel and repaired him; however, the droid bounty hunter, following the first of Lompop's directives to kill those who were no longer needed, shot the engineer and destroyed their droid crew, commandeering their starship.

After contacting Lompop and receiving his mission—to reclaim the carbonite-frozen smuggler Han Solo from the bounty hunter Boba Fett, IG-88 embarked to Tatooine on RB-919's starship, but not before entering into a brief skirmish with pirates. After landing on Tatooine, IG-88 boarded Fett's own vessel, but was confronted by the bounty hunter, who incapacitated the droid and left him on Tatooine. As the fight against Fett had damaged IG-88 and prevented him from being forced to follow Lompop's directives, the droid bounty hunter took RB-919's starship back to the junkyard where his remains had been collected from, intending to improve his programming. IG-88 then continued to use it in his operations as a bounty hunter.

entities.name: Imperator
entities.description:
The Imperator was an Immobilizer 418 cruiser in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War. It was assigned to Black Sword Command, located at one of the shipyards in the Koornacht Cluster. It was later overrun by the native Yevetha, who acquired all of the Command's assets, and was renamed Splendor of Yevetha by them. The vessel would later be used against the forces of the New Republic.

Captured from Imperial forces of the Black Sword Command after the Battle of Endor by the alien Yevetha, this ship subsequently entered the fleet of the Yevethan Duskhan League, and was used in 16 ABY to capture the New Republic fleet shuttle Tampion, and to kidnap General Han Solo.

Renamed Splendor of Yevetha, the Imperator was present at the New Republic's showdown with Nil Spaar's forces at N'zoth. With the rest of the Imperial-designed ships in Duskhan League service, she was recaptured by surviving Black Sword personnel under the leadership of Major Sil Sorannan during the Battle of N'zoth in 17 ABY, and redirected to Byss in the Deep Core.

The Imperator/Splendor of Yevetha was described as an Interdictor Dreadnaught in Shield of Lies. It was later clearly identified as an Immobilizer 418 in its entry in The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia.

entities.name: Imperial starship
entities.description:
An Imperial starship, a type of starfighter, was hijacked at Gordon on Aquilae by Luke Skywalker, Annikin Starkiller, Han Solo, Leia, Artwo and Threepio as they escaped from the trap set aboard the Baltarian freighter by Valorum.

It was docked in a secured area, but was accessed through subterfuge and jury rigging. Two bubble-domed turrets allowed crew to fire lazercannons at opposing craft. It was equipped with shields, which covered individual sections of the ship.

It was pursued by hunter destroyers, a type of Imperial ship. After enduring a barrage of torpedoes and laser shots, it became heavily damaged over the planet Yavin, where the crew bailed out into life pods.

"Imperial starship" was the name given to this craft in the rough draft script. It may be a Banta Four. If it had two manned turrets and room for 5-7 crew it was a rather large starfighter.

entities.name: Imperialis
entities.description:
The Imperialis was a luxury pleasure craft owned by Supreme Chancellor and eventually Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine during the Galactic Civil War. While the Imperialis was stolen by the gambler Lando Calrissian and wrecked on the moon Quantxi, the Emperor had several replicas of the vessel housed at his Observatories, which were scattered throughout the galaxy. In 5 ABY, the bounty hunter Mercurial Swift found information about Fleet Admiral Gallius Rax's origins aboard the Imperialis computers.

The Imperialis was a sleek, silvery pleasure yacht with two swept-back wings. It was a custom job by Raith Sienar, who owned Republic Sienar Systems. The Imperialis was fast, maneuverable and capable of outrunning Imperial Star Destroyers. The yacht was equipped with advanced defensive systems in its wings that were capable of blasting gravity mines. The ship's cockpit had red-tinted screens and could seat a pilot and co-pilot. On one occasion, the smuggler Lando Calrissian was able to use the Imperialis to drag the tractor beam of a Star Destroyer, causing it to collide with another Star Destroyer.

The Imperialis was filled with treasure from top to bottom including a Gungan fertility totem from the Naboo system. The ship had a securely-locked central chamber that could only be accessed by interface. These artifacts were believed to belong to the Sith sculptor Sith Lord Darth Momin.

The Imperialis also had a medical bay in the lower deck that contained a bacta tank. The ship also had a well-stocked armory that contained a wide array of blasters. The Imperialis also had an airlock and docking rig that could be remotely operated. The ship's escape pods could also be remotely deactivated by interface. The Imperialis also had a self-destruct mechanism. Lobot's AJ^6 cyborg construct could also connect to the ship's interface.

entities.name: The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced
entities.description:
The Inquisitor's TIE Advanced was the personal TIE/ad v1 prototype TIE fighter entrusted to the Grand Inquisitor in his mission to hunt down Jedi for the Galactic Empire.

This TIE/ad was equipped with a cockpit access hatch, targeting sensors and solar collectors. Its special folding wings allowed it greater speed than the 1,200 kph of a standard TIE fighter. It boasted an armament of two laser cannons and could carry up to 20 missile shells. Unlike the production version of the v1, the Inquisitor's personal ship also had life support in the cockpit, allowing it to be flown without a flight suit if desired. Unlike most other TIE models, the v1 was outfitted with a hyperdrive and basic shields.

On the Empire Day celebration on Lothal five years before the Battle of Yavin, the Inquisitor used it to pursue rogue Jedi Padawan Kanan Jarrus and the Spectres after a "terrorist attack" in Capital City. Later, following the Inquisitor's death aboard the Sovereign, Jarrus and Ezra Bridger stole it to escape the exploding Star Destroyer and rejoin with their own transport.

According to General Antoc Merrick, following the action at Mustafar, Capin Harinar and his crew had a merry time taking the ship apart.
