entities.name: Rebels TIE fighter
entities.description:
The rebels TIE fighter, nicknamed "Sabine's masterpiece," and also known as Sabine Wren's TIE Fighter was an Imperial TIE/ln space superiority starfighter, piloted by Baron of the Empire Valen Rudor, that was stolen by Ezra Bridger and Garazeb Orrelios, two members of a rebel cell on the Outer Rim planet Lothal. The two rebels used the fighter to attack an Imperial Troop Transport that was carrying Imperial prisoners, who the rebels were able to liberate. The two rebels lied to their leaders, Hera Syndulla and Kanan Jarrus, by saying that they purposefully crashed the fighter, but in reality they hid it elsewhere on Lothal. Sabine Wren, an artist on the crew, was told about it and painted the fighter, and she considered it some of her best work. The fighter was later used as part of a mission to rescue Jarrus from Imperial captivity.

While on a simple supply run, this TIE Fighter was under the care of TIE pilot Baron Valen Rudor, until it was hijacked by Zeb and Ezra when they were on the run from stormtroopers. Flying blind with fruit juice covering the ship's visor, they flew away from the town of Kothal and across the open fields of Lothal. When Ezra and Zeb told Kanan about the TIE, he told them to get rid of it as stealing a TIE could attract unwanted attention and the Empire could be tracking it.

After dismantling the locator beacon, Ezra and Zeb flew all the way to the Rebel rendezvous point when they spotted trouble at a farm owned by Morad Sumar, a friend of Ezra's parents. They used the TIE to rescue the farmers and help them escape from the Imperials. They later continued on their way to regroup with the Rebels. Zeb and Ezra claimed that they crashed the TIE Fighter they stole on purpose but in fact they hid it in a secret place where Sabine got hold of it and decorated it in graffiti artwork and Rebel colors.

The TIE Fighter was used in the Rebels' mission to rescue Kanan, who was being held prisoner aboard Tarkin's Star Destroyer, the Sovereign, in orbit over Mustafar. They remotely piloted the TIE Fighter aboard the ship and once inside, released an electromagnetic pulse that rendered the Sovereign powerless. As the ship began to blow up, Hera, Zeb, and Sabine used the starfighter to escape while Ezra and Kanan used the Inquisitor's TIE Advanced and regrouped with the transport ship they stole and escaped to hyperspace with a fleet of other rebels.

entities.name: Reciprocity
entities.description:
The Reciprocity was a Axehead frigate in the Republic Navy following the Great Sith War.

It was Saul Karath's first command, and the first bridge appointment of Dallan Morvis.

During the Mandalorian Wars, Morvis returned to captain the Reciprocity, landing Phaeda Militia troops and Jedi Knights onto Essien to battle Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders. Morvis and his soldiers were tricked into leaving the ship behind and cornered by the Jedi, who turned out to be Mandalorian Knights. They meant to take the vessel and use it against the Republic, forcefully drafting the captain and his crew.

Later Morvis, with the help of Zayne Carrick, not only took his ship back, but used it to save the Jedi younglings on Dantooine, foiling the plan of Dorjander Kace.

entities.name: Red Feathers
entities.description:
Red Feathers was a crippled Kuat Drive Yards Super Transport VI, which had crashed on Blood Nest, orbiting the gas giant M2398-3. This ship was used as the headquarters for a band of pirates under name Blood Nest until their defeat in 7 ABY by Wraith Squadron. It was then used by the New Republic in the Battle of Ession to deliver three starfighter squadrons and the Page's commandos. The commandos activated its self-destruct and left the ship in an escape pod, while Rogue, Blue, and Green Squadrons were released from the ship's hangar when the self-destruct charges broke apart its hull.

entities.name: Red Gauntlet
entities.description:
Red Gauntlet was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer under the command of Warlord Zsinj. It participated in the Battle of Vahaba, attacking Admiral Teren Rogriss's Stellar Web along with Zsinj's Victory-class Star Destroyer Serpent's Smile. The attack failed due to mass fire and superior tactics on behalf of the temporarily allied New Republic and Galactic Empire, and Serpent's Smile was destroyed. Red Gauntlet surrendered shortly after, under the guns of General Han Solo's Crynyd and Skyhook, as well as Stellar Web. General Solo captured Red Gauntlet by putting a crew aboard her and discussed using her against Zsinj until she was reassigned.

entities.name: Redoubtable
entities.description:
Redoubtable was an early-model Imperial I-class Star Destroyer. It was later renamed the Destiny of Yevetha.

After taking significant damage in the retreat from the Battle of Endor, she was sent to the Black-15 shipyard at N'zoth. The ship was seized by Nil Spaar of the Yevetha during their uprising, and renamed the Destiny of Yevetha. After the Yevetha completed her repairs, she served in the Yevethan fleet during the Black Fleet Crisis.

Redoubtable jumped to Byss in the Deep Core along with the other Imperial-design starships which left the Yevethan fleet under the command of Sil Sorannan.

entities.name: Renown
entities.description:
The Renown was a Venator-class Star Destroyer utilized by the Galactic Republic and its naval branch, as well as the Open Circle Fleet, during the Clone Wars. The Star Destroyer was eventually stolen from the Republic by the Confederacy of Independent Systems and placed in orbit of Abafar, where it was loaded with huge amounts of rhydonium from the planet.

Constructed for combat service by the Galactic Republic Navy, the Renown was a Venator-class Star Destroyer deployed by the Galactic Republic's Open Circle Fleet. As common with vessels of the Venator-class, the Star Destroyer was equipped with a hangar bay located along the dorsal surface of its hull, as well as an additional hangar on its ventral hull. Within the hangar bay, large enough to transport at least one Rho-class transport shuttle, possessed numerous compartments, which could store hundreds of canisters of the highly volatile Rhydonium starship fuel. Meanwhile, along the stern, the Renown was propelled by a series of eight ion drive thrusters, four located on the port side and four on the starboard side. Additionally, the Star Destroyer held the capability to travel through hyperspace, from points within the Outer Rim Territories to the Colonies.

At some point during the war, the Renown was stolen and appropriated by the Confederacy of Independent Systems, stationed above the planet Abafar in 20 BBY. In Abafar's atmosphere, the Star Destroyer was loaded with hundreds of canisters of Rhydonium, a highly volatile starship fuel, which was to be implemented in a plan to destroy the Republic's Valor Space station in the Carida system, the location of a strategy conference for Republic Military officials.

Towards the end of the loading mission on Abafar, the Republic special unit, designated D-Squad, boarded the Renown. Unaware of its capture by the Separatists and their plot, the squad eventually discovered its current crew of battle droids, commanded by an ST-series super tactical droid. However, shortly after the Venator arrived in the Carida system, the Republic droid squad managed to prevent its destruction of the space station, detonating the Renown at a distance.

entities.name: Renthal's Vigilance
entities.description:
Renthal's Vigilance was a Carrack-class light cruiser in Drea Renthal's pirate fleet. Originally it had been an Imperial ship named Vigilance under Captain Darv Eldon.

It was part of the Imperial squadron present at the Battle of Nar Shaddaa in 4 BBY. When the Vigilance entered the debris field surrounding the moon, it was ambushed by ships of the smugglers' First Strike Element. After a fierce engagement with the Hutt ship Dragon Pearl commanded by Mako Spince, Vigilance became damaged to the extent that the shields on the port side went down and the lasers started to score hits on the hull. The pirate ships Too Late Now and Minestra came in to finish it off, leaving the Vigilance a crippled wreck in space and Captain Eldon dead.

Before the Vigilance was defeated, it destroyed Take That! and Bnef Nlle, though the latter ship weakened the Vigilance port shields in a ramming attack. After the battle, it was salvaged by the pirate leader Renthal. She renamed her new acquisition the Renthal's Vigilance, turning it into her flagship and the largest ship in her fleet.

The ship's size and power came in handy in subsequent raids, especially when Drea assaulted the Queen of Empire by tugging a massive asteroid into place and knocking the luxury liner out of hyperspace.
entities.short_description: Renthal's Vigilance was a Carrack-class light cruiser in Drea Renthal's pirate fleet. Originally it had been an Imperial ship named Vigilance under Captain Darv Eldon.

entities.name: Retribution
entities.description:
The Retribution was a Discril-class attack cruiser.

The Retribution originally served with the Daupherm Systems Fleet. However, it was stolen by Gorvan Shrulldike and Evram Darkmere, who set themselves up as pirates and slavers. However, Darkmere began to consider slavery to be repugnant, so he defeated Shrulldike in personal combat and took control of the ship.

The crew of the Retribution was made up mainly of former members of the Daupherm Merchant Space Fleet. The First Mate was Dexter Thorgrim, who personally selected most of the candidates to become new crew members of the ship.

The Retribution appeared in the 1994 Star Wars Roleplaying Game (RPG) supplementary book Cracken's Rebel Operatives, published by West End Games. Mike Jackson, who illustrated the Retribution, noted that the design was one of his personal favourites.

entities.name: Reveille
entities.description:
Reveille was the personal Lambda-class T-4a shuttle of General Tycho Celchu during the Second Galactic Civil War. Selecting Syal Antilles as his personal pilot, he used it to travel to Endor in an attempt to negotiate with the New Jedi Order. While there, he was taken captive and his shuttle, piloted by Han Solo and Luke Skywalker, was used to infiltrate the Anakin Solo.

entities.description:
RLH-1 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle used for prisoner transport assigned to Despayre.

Sometime before the completion of the first Death Star, the shuttle was captured by prisoners who had escaped the prison planet. The shuttle was destroyed by Villian Dance of Alpha Squadron, assigned to the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Steel Talon.

entities.name: Sable III
entities.description:
The Sable III, originally known as the Anto's Star, was a modified Corellian CR90 corvette used by the flamboyant pirate Drek Drednar and his crew. The ship was stolen by a group of starship thieves working for Drednar who was planning a mutiny against Captain Karn Granzor.

The Anto's Star had was a standard corvette with a normal armament of 6 double turbolasers. After Drek Drednar and his crew took over the ship and defeated the gunship Sable II, the newly-commissioned Sable III received numerous upgrades: The mechanics upgraded the hull and shields and installed two salvaged gun turret mounts from the Sable II. These mounts were later equipped with an ion cannon and a tractor beam. Additionally, a salvaged tractor beam was installed for a front turbolaser.

The docking bay carried five non-hyperdrive snubfighter, usually three Z-95 Headhunters and two Zebra starfighters, leaving one slot for emergencies.

The ship was decorated with the "Blazing Claw" symbol, which had been an icon for piracy for thousands of years in the history of the galaxy.

entities.name: Saltbarrel
entities.description:
The Saltbarrel was a freighter originally owned by the Watith captain Fsir. During the plot to destroy the Chiss Ascendancy, the Saltbarrel sent out a distress call to Senior Captain Thrawn of the Chiss Expansionary Defense Fleet. The Saltbarrel claimed to be under attack from Vagaari pirates, but was in reality under false attack by gunboats remotely piloted from aboard itself. This skirmish was meant to delay the Chiss officer from discovering the plot against the Ascendancy. Thrawn did not fall for the ruse, and ended up arresting Fsir and commandeering the Watith gunboats and the Saltbarrel. Thrawn later employed the commandeered starships at the Hoxim incident.

entities.name: Scutz
entities.description:
Scutz was an Imperial Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was stolen by Rebel Officers.

The shuttle was originally used by the Empire before it was stolen by Rebel Officers. The shuttle would then participate in a joint attack on Outpost D-34 by the Alliance and Mugaari pirates, arriving within 5 minutes into the battle.

The shuttle was attempting to sneak past the Outpost carrying rebel officers. However, Maarek Stele, who was then an above average TIE pilot picked up the shuttle on his scanners while engaging X-wings. He managed to get close and inspected it to find Rebel Officers. Once that was done, he was contacted by the Priest informing him that Assault Gunboats are being dispatched. The Gunboats engaged the Scutz launching Concussion missiles which drained the shields and disabled it with their Ion cannons. Once the shuttle was disabled and immobile Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports Epsilon 1 proceeded to board and capture it. The Shuttle then departed from the area entering Hyperspace to an unknown location.

The Scutz features in the 1994 PC game Star Wars: TIE Fighter and its Prima Strategy Guides. The shuttle is to be inspected by the player to complete "Secondary" mission objectives. The capture of the shuttle is the missions "Bonus" objectives which can only be seen once they are completed.

entities.name: Sealion
entities.description:
The Sealion was a prototype Missile Boat delivered to the Rebel Alliance.

The Sealion was a Missile Boat prototype, that was stolen by forces under the command of Rogue Grand Admiral Zaarin. When Zaarin conferred to his officers about the second Death Star and that the Rebels were actually walking into a trap at Endor but didn't intend to warn them, one of his loyal commanders Namuura Din who lead the Victory-class Star Destroyer Zeplin decided to take the information and the Sealion and defect to the Alliance. While Zaarin was unable to stop him, Loyalist forces led by Darth Vader in the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Garrett managed to intercept and capture Din's flagship, but by the time they arrived the Sealion was already transferred to the Mon Calamari Cruiser Link and the cruiser jumped to lightspeed.

The commander of the Link attempted to get the news to Rebel Command, but the ships engines overloaded forcing the ship out of Hyperspace. The Link commander sent the Sealion to a Rebel stronghold, a XQ4 Platform Enin'sd to be fully analyzed. But the Rebels never got the chance to disassemble the vessel and learn its secrets before the Imperials arrived at the base with the intention of either destroying or otherwise illicitly recovering the Sealion, as the Prophets of the Dark Side discovered when recovering it illicitly before its container was destroyed, preventing any chance of the Rebels making their own Missile Boats. Nonetheless, the Rebel's capture of the Sealion, combined with the treacherous Grand Admiral Zaarin's breakaway faction's destruction of the Missile Boat's production facilities via planetary bombardment, led to the suspension of all Missile Boats from service until further notice at Emperor Palpatine's order, with all remaining Missile Boats being placed into a secure holding area.

The Sealion only appears in Star Wars: TIE Fighter Battle 13 Combat 4. The first mission regarding the prototype shows the ship on the Link and the third and final mission about the fighter hiding in one of the Class-B cargo container group Niicee.

entities.short_description: The Sealion was a prototype Missile Boat delivered to the Rebel Alliance.

entities.name: Shadow Chaser
entities.description:
Shadow Chaser was a unique shuttle produced by the Second Imperium, for use by the Shadow Academy. Though she was a unique prototype, the Shadow Chaser was of a recognizably Imperial design, probably standing in the same lineage as the Theta-class and Lambda-class shuttles. Before she was stolen by Luke Skywalker and his students, Brakiss considered the Shadow Chaser to be the Shadow Academy's finest small ship.

Shadow Chaser was a small, compact ship, capable of carrying perhaps a dozen people. She had a sleek hull sheathed in nearly indestructible quantum-crystalline armor, a technology pioneered in the Sun Crusher, which gave her a distinctive oiled-silver gleam.

In the bow was a narrow cockpit with seats for two pilots and other flight crew, and the stern of the ship enclosed a small engine room, but most of the hull was taken up by a single main cabin, which contained passenger seating, with a series of escape pods in the aft bulkhead. Each of these could carry one person, but for security reasons, their homing beacon signals were encoded in a way that only the Shadow Academy could decrypt.

Other onboard amenities included several sleeping bunks and a small galley area, which were either located in the rear part of the main cabin, or else along the corridor leading aft to the engine room. There may also have been a separate cargo hold, though it is possible that the main cabin served this function as well.

entities.name: Shuttle 2743
entities.description:
Shuttle 2743 was a Lambda-class T-4a shuttle that was tasked with transporting the Imperial clone engineer Penn Pershing in 9 ABY. After being disabled by Slave I ion cannons, the shuttle was taken over by Din Djarin and Marshal Cara Dune. The shuttle was subsequently used as part of the plan to rescue Grogu from Moff Gideon's forces. After pretending to be under attack by Slave I, the shuttle crash-landed into the launch tube of Gideon's light cruiser. Afterwards, Cara Dune, Bo-Katan Kryze, Koska Reeves, and Fennec Shand assaulted the hangar, with Din Djarin not far behind.

Shuttle 2743 first appeared in "Chapter 16: The Rescue" of Jon Favreau's 2019 Disney+ television series Star Wars: The Mandalorian, directed by Peyton Reed

During the Thrawn campaign, Mara Jade and Luke Skywalker stole the shuttle on Wistril and used it to gain entry to the Chimaera and rescue Talon Karrde.

entities.name: Shuttle 593
entities.description:
Shuttle 593 was a Star Commuter 2000. Senator Nadea Tural of the Imperial Senate boarded the shuttle on her way to the planet Arkanis. However, the hyperdrive malfunctioned, causing the Star Commuter to crash. The senator was then rescued by the members of the rebel Spectre cell. Later the same year, the Spectres used the salvaged Shuttle 593 to make their way to Lothal without catching the attention of the Galactic Empire.

Shuttle 593 first appeared in Star Wars Rebels: The Siege of Lothal.

entities.name: Shuttle 81572
entities.description:
Shuttle 81572 was a captured Sheathipede-class Type B shuttle that was used by the Galactic Republic in 20 BBY to infiltrate the Separatist-controlled Citadel prison on Lola Sayu. Piloted by a squad of reprogrammed battle droids under the command of the astromech droid R2-D2, the ship, carrying a Republic strike team frozen in carbonite to evade lifeform scanners, gained access onto the planet by claiming that it carried supplies and frozen rations. Landing in a hidden canyon, R2-D2 and his droid crew waited by the ship as the strike team was unfrozen and headed off for the prison to rescue Jedi Master Even Piell and his officers.

R2-D2 and his crew later took the shuttle to the Citadel's landing pad in an attempt at an evacuation. However, the shuttle was destroyed by a commando droid manning a turbolaser turret during a battle on the landing pad, apparently killing ARC trooper Echo, who had been attempting to reclaim the ship. As a result, the remaining Republic soldiers and Jedi were forced to request assistance, leading Jedi General Plo Koon to bring a large fleet to evacuate them from the planet. Unbeknownst to the Republic, Echo had not actually perished in the shuttle's explosion. Severely injured, he was salvaged by the Separatists and wound up in the hands of the Techno Union, who turned him into a cyborg in order to extract information from his brain. Kept in a stasis chamber, Echo constantly relived the shuttle explosion at the Citadel for some time until rescued by General Anakin Skywalker, Clone Captain Rex, and Clone Force 99.

Shuttle 81572 was a Sheathipede-class Type B shuttle. Like all shuttles of that model, it was manufactured by Haor Chall Engineering Corporation, was equipped with a hyperdrive, and was armed with three laser cannons. It was intended as a cargo shuttle.

Shuttle 81572 was originally owned and used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems. However, during the Clone Wars between the Confederacy and the Galactic Republic, the shuttle was captured by the Republic. In 20 BBY, the shuttle was brought to the Jedi Temple hangars on Coruscant, as it was to be used in an infiltration of the Separatist-controlled Citadel prison on Lola Sayu to rescue captured Jedi Master Even Piell, who had retrieved the coordinates of the secret Nexus Route hyperlane. The shuttle was placed under the command of astromech droid R2-D2, who had a squadron of reprogrammed battle droids which would fly the starship. In order to infiltrate the Citadel, Jedi General Anakin Skywalker had the team, himself included, undergo carbon-freezing to beat the prison's lifeform scanners. Once the team had been frozen, they were loaded onboard the shuttle, which its droid crew piloted away from Coruscant, with Jedi Master Plo Koon seeing the ship off.

entities.description:
Shuttle S257 was a Sentinel-class landing craft of the Galactic Empire's naval forces. the shuttle was stolen by the rebels of Phoenix Cell, where it was used by Kanan Jarrus and Rex in their mission to an experimental Interdictor-class heavy cruiser in order to rescue Jarrus' Padawan, Ezra Bridger, and Commander Jun Sato.

A Sentinel-class landing craft, Shuttle S257 was equipped with a hyperdrive generator and communications system which was compatible with the communications of an Interdictor-class heavy cruiser. The shuttle also came armed with its own weapon systems near its forward ramp and along its articulated wings.

entities.name: Shuttle two
entities.description:
Shuttle two was a Rho-class transport shuttle stationed at the Imperial doonium refinery on the planet Ryloth shortly after its occupation by the Galactic Empire. The attack shuttle was stolen by the Twi'lek Hera Syndulla and the clone Omega in order to disable the cannons at the refinery so that Omega's fellow members of the Bad Batch could attack the refinery; the attack was intended to distract Imperial forces away from the capital city of Lessu to allow Hera's parents, the freedom fighters Cham and Eleni, to be rescued. After firing upon the refinery and shutting down its power, Hera and Omega rescued the astromech droid C1-10P, who had made a previous unsuccessful attempt to deactivate the defenses. Hera piloted the shuttle away from the refinery, allowing the Bad Batch's Marauder to launch an attack on the facility. Once the clones Hunter and Echo had rescued Cham, Eleni, and their imprisoned supporters, Hera and Omega followed the Marauder in shuttle two, and they regrouped on Ord Mantell.

entities.name: Shuttle TY992
entities.description:
Shuttle TY922 was a stolen Sentinel-class landing craft piloted by Kanan Jarrus and Captain Rex during the attempt to rescue the Fulcrum Agent Kallus from Thrawn's Star Destroyer.

As a Sentinel-class landing craft, Shuttle TY992 had a tri-wing design. It was also capable of hyperspace travel and could carry several passengers.

Shuttle TY992 was acquired by the rebellion during the Age of the Empire. In 2 BBY, the rebels Kanan Jarrus and Rex used the shuttle as part of the secondary phase of a mission to rescue the rogue Imperial Security Bureau Agent Kallus. While their initial plan was to rescue Kallus from Lieutenant Yogar Lyste's Arquitens-class command cruiser, Kanan and Rex were forced to change their plans after Lyste brought Ezra Bridger aboard Grand Admiral Thrawn's Star Destroyer Chimaera.

After Chopper obtained the necessary clearance codes, Rex and Kanan were able to land in the Chimaera hangar bay. Following a brief fight involving Governor Arihnda Pryce and Lieutenant Lyste, Rex and Kanan managed to reunite with Ezra and the droids Chopper and AP-5. However, Kallus elected to stay behind to continue helping the rebels from behind Imperial lines.

entities.name: Sibwarra
entities.description:
Sibwarra, formerly the Shriwirr, was a heavily customized Ssi-ruuvi Shree-class battle cruiser, and was the flagship of the attack fleet on the remote Imperial world Bakura shortly after the Battle of Endor. After it was captured by the Rebel Alliance, it was renamed in honor of Dev Sibwarra.

The Ssi-ruuk were a saurian race from the very far reaches of the galaxy. The Shriwirr was a formidable ship, about 900 meters long and had the Ssi-ruuvi equivalent of 24 heavy turbolasers, 24 ion cannons, 12 concussion-missile launchers, 12 tractor beam projectors. She also carried 500 Swarm-class battle droids which were the Ssi-ruuvi equivalent of starfighters.

Since Ssi-ruuk place a very high priority on capturing enemy ships, they often used the Shriwirr tractor beam projectors and ion cannons to capture enemy ships which they dragged into huge landing bays. They then captured the crew of the ships and used a process called entechment to draw the life forces out of their captives and then transfer them into their droids, ships and computers. The Shriwirr had one large entechment lab onboard where many captives were turned into Ssi-ruu slaves. Thirty more of these labs were under construction prior to their defeat.

The Shriwirr had five meter tall ceilings since the Ssi-ruuk were very tall. There were also several tunnels and passage ways for the P'w'ecks, a species conquered by the Ssi-ruuk, to get around the ship and do their duties. The Ssi-ruuk used the P'w'ecks as slaves. Since the P'w'ecks could not be trusted, the Shriwirr had stun traps to ensure that the P'w'ecks followed their orders and keep out of the ship's sensitive areas. These stun traps could stun a P'w'eck and were lethal to Humans.

entities.name: Sidral II
entities.description:
Sidral II was an Imperial BFF-1 bulk freighter that carried the latest military equipment, timers and fusion cells, originating from a facility near Coruscant.

After the discovery of the Death Star I project, the Rebel Alliance attempted to discover the identities of the contractors involved in its construction. As part of this effort they decided to hijack the Sidral II and study its cargo, in the hopes that it would reveal more about who was building the Death Star.

The capture of the freighter was undertaken by the privateer, Tuz, and a rendezvous was planned to transfer the cargo to the Rebel CR90 corvette Frazier. The operation would be protected by two R-22 Spearheads from Red Squadron, led by Keyan Farlander.

The Rebels arrived to discover that the Imperial-class Star Destroyer Immortal had already arrived and begun launching TIE/LN starfighters and TIE/sa bombers, though the Star Destroyer itself was some distance away.

entities.name: Skyhook
entities.description:
Skyhook was an Imperial II-class Star Destroyer under the command of General Han Solo during the hunt for Warlord Zsinj as part of Group Two.

It participated in the Battle of Vahaba, defending Admiral Teren Rogriss's Stellar Web along with Solo's other Imperial II-class Star Destroyer, Crynyd, against Warlord Zsinj's Imperial I-class Star Destroyer, Red Gauntlet, and Serpent's Smile, Zsinj's Victory-class Star Destroyer. The attack failed due to mass fire and superior tactics on behalf of the temporarily allied New Republic and Galactic Empire, and Serpent's Smile was destroyed. Red Gauntlet surrendered shortly after, to the combined force of Solo's Star Destroyers, as well as Stellar Web. She carried six squadrons of TIE fighters even after her capture by the New Republic.

entities.name: Skywalker
entities.description:
Skywalker was the name given to an Acclamator-class assault ship after its capture by the Alliance to Restore the Republic.

The Acclamator-class assault ship later known as Skywalker served the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. It was used approximately eight months after the Battle of Yavin to transport Jabiimi Loyalist prisoners to Kalist VI, where they were used as slave labor. It remained docked there until it was seized by Luke Skywalker during a Rebel mission to free captured Rebel mathematician Jorin Sol which resulted in the liberation of the slaves. Skywalker and the slaves captured the ship and took off covered by Wedge Antilles and the members of Red Squadron. The ship was immediately dubbed Skywalker, after its captor, in comm transmissions. Skywalker returned Skywalker to the Alliance Fleet with the slaves, Sol, and several members of the infiltration team aboard.

entities.name: Slave II
entities.description:
The Slave II was a starship owned by Boba Fett, which he used circa 10 ABY. It cost him 225,000 credits.

Slave II was a MandalMotors Pursuer-class enforcement ship, a patrol craft, which was popular with the Mandalorian police units since it was tough and good at dealing with pirates, as well as having the cargo space for the usual police needs. Once Fett bought the ship, he immediately went about modifying it so it would hold all the "nasty surprises" that victims of his other ship experienced.

Two Tion Mil/Sci Industries Mil-StarIV engines propelled the heavy patrol craft, and three Corellian Engineering Corporation x41 maneuvering thrusters were mounted on the port-side stabilizer. Powerful Torplex military-grade shield generators provided protection, whereas the ship was armed with twin forward-firing blaster cannons and an ion cannon turret. There was also a "surprise weapon," consisting of a rearward-firing proton torpedo launcher, which held a magazine of six torpedoes. The ship had a sophisticated sensor array system, such as in Slave I. Although it lacked Slave I stealth systems, some might have eventually been installed.

There were rumors of five force-field-enclosed prisoner cages on board. Since his prime target's companion was a Wookiee, it is not unlikely that the cells had molecularly reinforced walls and gravity restraints.

entities.name: Han Solo's pirate ship
entities.description:
Han's pirate ship was an unnamed TDF104 formerly owned by Captain Oxus, a pirate and spice smuggler. After running up a huge debt with Oxus following a botched spice run, Han stole the ship to give Luke Skywalker, Artoo and Threepio a ride to Ogana Major. His friends, Montross Holdaack and Chewbacca, helped him fake a reactor overload, causing the crew loyal to Oxus to evacuate when it was docked at Docking Port 23 in Mos Eisley.

The ship was modified with secret compartments. The extent of other changes from the base model was unknown, though it was a custom construction.

When a Sith Knight examined the ship, captured at Alderaan, he referred to it as "drift junk". Holdaack also expressed a belief that going into hyper-skip might cause it to fall apart.

When Han had a change of heart and entered the Battle of Yavin, the pirate ship was critically damaged after Darth Vader's starfighter executed a kamikaze run on it. The crew evacuated in a life pod and the ship was destroyed with the Death Star.

entities.name: Star Herald
entities.description:
The Star Herald was a top-of-the-line prototype scout ship that was developed by the Galactic Empire around 18 BBY. It had a long, arrow-like hull supporting a tractor beam projector, and it housed at least one probe that could go underwater.

The Star Herald was stolen by Visler Aqorian Korda III, a former Imperial officer who had been stripped of his rank and put to forced work in the spice mines of Kessel. With the help of RX-48, a manumitted pilot droid, Korda used the stolen ship to journey to the Xala system, where he intended to exact revenge on those responsible for his disgrace, Milo and Lina Graf. The Imperial High Command was most displeased with the theft of the prototype. The ship was shot down on the planet Agaris, but was repaired by the Graf family after Lina and Milo and their droid CR-8R rescued their parents, Auric and Rhyssa, from imprisonment in the Imperial compound on the planet. Wilhuff Tarkin ordered it shot down on its departure from Agaris, but it managed to get away by activating its hyperdrive and traveling to the Lothal system before it could be destroyed.

In the hands of Milo and Lina Graf, the Star Herald saw much action in the days of the Galactic Civil War and afterward. Lina Graf used it to work with Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and the explorer Lor San Tekka. She promised the vessel as a favor to Skywalker if he ever needed it.

In 21 ABY, Skywalker called in the favor at the Adelphi New Republic staging outpost as he and Lando Calrissian attempted to help a family escape from the returning Sith, who sent Ochi of Bestoon. They took it to Polaar to meet with Komat, a former member of the Acolytes of the Beyond.

entities.name: Star Roamer
entities.description:
The Star Roamer was a medium freighter manufactured by Damorian Manufacturing Corporation. It was owned by CorDuro Shipping and in 26 ABY was used to deliver a shipment of bacta to the Yuuzhan Vong. They were intrigued by its healing properties, and would later try and sabotage its production using a virus carried by fallen Jedi Bey Gandan.

However, the Yuuzhan Vong never received this bacta shipment as the ship was captured by Han Solo and the Wild Knights to acquire bacta tanks to heal the wounded Jedi Master Eelysa. CorDuro was suspected of collaborating with the Yuuzhan Vong so Solo felt no guilt in raiding it.

The Wild Knights boarded the ship and the crew subsequently surrendered and the ship was captured.

entities.name: Star-Wake
entities.description:
Star-Wake was an Envoy-class shuttle that was used during rescue operations after the Seventh Battle of Ruusan by the Army of Light.

The Star-Wake, an Envoy-class shuttle, was a product of Tallaani Shipyards. When Jedi Lord Valenthyne Farfalla pleaded for resources for the New Sith Wars, a benefactor from Coruscant donated the shuttle to the Army of Light in the final weeks of the Ruusan campaign.

Irtanna piloted the Star-Wake upon her descent to Ruusan on one of the Army of Light's rescue missions following the detonation of the thought bomb in the catastrophic Seventh Battle of Ruusan, and her crew included Bordon and his sons, Tallo and Wend. The crew later attempted to rescue Zannah, who they believed to be a war orphan, however, the young Sith apprentice had been ordered to find a way to Onderon, and was determined to steal their shuttle. She murdered the Star-Wake entire crew and flew the ship to Onderon to meet her Master Darth Bane there.

When the Star-Wake crashed onto Onderon, Zannah was met and challenged by the Skelda clan, a group of Beast Riders. She was saved by Darth Bane upon his return from Dxun. Later, the Star-Wake was found floating aimlessly in the Japrael sector.
entities.short_description: Star-Wake was an Envoy-class shuttle that was used during rescue operations after the Seventh Battle of Ruusan by the Army of Light.

entities.name: Staraker
entities.description:
The Staraker was an experimental, cutting-edge starship designed by the Galactic Empire and created on the planet Foundry. It was stolen by Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa and Mici Shabandar of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It crashed after being shot down over Alashan by a Death Star-like beam of destructive energy.

After teaming up with a stranded Imperial team and dispatching the creature responsible for them both being there, Luke and the rest got the ship up and running again and left the planet, taking the ship back to the Rebel Alliance as originally intended.

entities.name: Steadfast
entities.description:
The Steadfast was an Ardent-class fast frigate in the service of Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire during the Second Imperial Civil War, seven years after the Dark Lord overthrew Galactic Emperor Roan Fel at the end of the Fel Empire's war with the Galactic Alliance. In 137 ABY, under the command of Captain Vaclen Tor, the Steadfast was assigned to the Coruscant Third Fleet, which had been tasked with protecting the strategically important planet of Ralltiir. That year, the fleet of the Galactic Alliance Remnant launched a surprise attack on Ralltiir, intending to capture as many of the Third Fleet's ships as possible. Under the command of Admiral Peto Kelsan, the Third Fleet engaged the Alliance forces until the Bastion Second Fleet, aligned with Emperor-in-exile Fel, arrived to bolster the Alliance fleet.

Facing overwhelming numbers, Kelsan surrendered the Third Fleet to Admiral Edouard Fenel, the commander of the Bastion Second Fleet. However, Tor declared from the command center of the Steadfast that he must decline to follow Kelsan's orders to surrender, as it was their duty to ensure the enemy did not capture their ships. In response, Fenel ordered the crew of the Steadfast to rise up and replace Tor, and when that failed, Fenel ordered his entire fleet to open fire on the Steadfast.

Refusing to help fire on the now heavily damaged frigate, Kelsan instructed the crews of the Third Fleet to disregard his previous order and to initiate the self-destruct mechanisms on their ships, before using lifepods to evacuate to Ralltiir. When Fenel ordered his ships to fire on the lifepods of the Third Fleet, the commander of the Alliance fleet—Duros Admiral Gar Stazi—intervened, protecting the lifepods and escorting the Steadfast, as the frigate's lifepod and self-destruct systems had been damaged. After the battle, under orders from Stazi, Tor and the Steadfast crew were deposited on the surface of Ralltiir, and the Steadfast was given to Fel as a gift.

The Steadfast was an Ardent-class fast frigate, The Steadfast was propelled through space by three engine units and carried lifepods. The frigate was also outfitted with turbolasers and a self-destruct mechanism. Internally, the Steadfast featured a command center that was equipped with a holoprojector for communicating with other ships.

entities.name: Stinger
entities.description:
The Stinger was a Surronian assault ship given to Prince Xizor of the Black Sun crime syndicate in exchange for his assistance to the hive craft guild that created it. Although basically a Conqueror-class assault ship, the vessel was uniquely customized by its creators. By the Clone Wars, the ship had come into the hands of Galactic Republic Admiral Tarnese Bleyd, but Xizor reacquired it after his death. Xizor eventually presented it to his bodyguard, the Human replica droid Guri, who had it redesigned to meet her needs, radically overhauling the ship's systems. Among the systems upgraded by Guri were the hyperdrive and weapons, making the ship both fast and deadly. It continued to serve as her personal transport even after the death of Xizor in 3 ABY.

The ship that became known as the Stinger, like all Surronian vessels, was an individual creation. Though it fit into the general category of Conqueror-class assault ships, it was designed according to the tastes of the hive craft guild that created it, and featured a number of unusual extras that set it aside from similar ships. Even so, when the vessel came into the possession of the Human replica droid Guri, she was not satisfied with its performance and began to overhaul its systems, heavily modifying it to meet her exacting standards. The resulting vessel was fast, tough and truly unique. Although not available for sale, the ship was worth 150,000 credits used.

The ship was roughly twenty-eight meters long, with a curved hull that had an almost sculpted appearance. It comprised fore and aft sections linked by a slender "neck." The fore section housed the cockpit while the main cargo hold, reactor core and engines were located in the larger aft section to the rear of the neck. Retractable landing skids were located on the underside of the ship, under both the fore and aft sections. A retractable entry ramp under the neck allowed access to the ship, while a separate hatch provided access to the cargo hold. A further hatch, located on top of the vessel, allowed access to the main reactor core, while the core's exhaust valves were located at the rear of the vessel.

The Stinger was powered by eight Surronian ion engines mounted around the rear section—two dorsal and two ventral A2-grade ion engines, along with two port and two starboard A2.50-grade ion engines. Together, these engines combined to produce a sublight speed greater than that of the T-65 X-wing starfighter and only slightly below that of the TIE Interceptor, then the fastest starfighter in the Imperial arsenal. Under atmospheric conditions, the Stinger was capable of reaching speeds of up to 1,150 kilometers per hour.

The Sun Crusher was one of the most powerful superweapons ever devised. It was developed at the secret Maw Installation.

The Sun Crusher was a nearly indestructible craft that was no larger than a starfighter,

The Sun Crusher's primary weapon was a payload of 11 energy resonance torpedoes. Each torpedo resembled an oval-shaped plasma discharge and was activated when it passed through the Sun Crusher's resonance torpedo launcher. The resonance torpedo then traveled to the system's sun at near-lightspeed velocity.

entities.name: Sungrass
entities.description:
The Sungrass was a Xiytiar-class heavy transport used by Wraith Squadron during their time posing as the Hawk-bat Independent Space Force in the Halmad system.

Previously belonging to an Imperial shipping corporation, it was stationed at a facility which was attacked by New Republic Intelligence and listed by the Empire as destroyed. In reality it was repaired and given a new name and history.

As part of the Hawk-bat ruse, the Sungrass primary role was to act as a transport for the unit's TIEs, which were otherwise incapable of hyperspace travel. It was commanded by Captain Valton.

entities.name: SW-0608
entities.description:
SW-0608 was a Zeta-class Heavy Cargo Shuttle stolen from the Galactic Empire by the Alliance to Restore the Republic and used by the squad Rogue One during the Battle of Scarif.

Initially assigned to the Eadu Flight Station, it was stolen by Bodhi Rook. The reprogrammed KX-series security droid K-2SO assisted Rook to pilot SW-0608 during the rescue of Jyn Erso, Baze Malbus, Chirrut Îmwe, and Cassian Andor from the Research station and return them to the Rebel base on Yavin 4. Following Jyn's failed attempt to persuade the Rebel Alliance to attack Scarif and retrieve the Death Star plans, it was stolen again by Rook and K-2S0 to transport Erso & Andor's infiltration team to the surface of Scarif.

The shuttle was destroyed during the Battle of Scarif by a shoretrooper who threw a grenade into the ship's hangar, killing Bodhi Rook.

The significance of the designation SW-0608 was confirmed by Rogue One: A Star Wars Story screenwriter Chris Weitz when asked the question on Twitter. "SW" are the initials of Weitz's son Sebastian Weitz, whose birthday is the 8th June.

entities.name: Orn Free Taa's shuttle
entities.description:
Orn Free Taa's shuttle was the personal shuttle of Senator Orn Free Taa of Ryloth. Kept in a private hangar in the Capitol building in Lessu, Taa believed the shuttle's existence was a secret, so he could make a hasty retreat to Coruscant if need be. However, Eleni Syndulla knew of the shuttle's existence, and when she and her husband Cham and other members of the Free Ryloth Movement were rescued by members of Clone Force 99 early in the Imperial Era, they used the shuttle as an escape vehicle. Cham kept the starship afterwards, as he and his followers departed Ord Mantell after regrouping there with their rescuers.

entities.description:
The Talisman was a luxury space yacht owned by Teroenza, the t'landa Til High Priest of Ylesia. In 10 BBY, the Talisman was stolen by Han Solo and Bria Tharen in their escape from Ylesia, and sold to "Truthful" Toryl, a Duros who maintained a used starship lot and dealt mainly in stolen ships. Toryl was only willing to offer 5,000 credits for the yacht, as it was too high-profile to sell safely. Instead, the Duros reluctantly scrapped the luxurious and valuable vessel.

entities.name: Tampion
entities.description:
The Tampion was a fleet shuttle in the Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic.

In 16 ABY, it was sent to ferry Commodore Han Solo from Coruscant to the Endurance-class fleet carrier Intrepid, which was stationed at the periphery of the Koornacht Cluster, so that Solo could take command of the New Republic Fifth Battle Group and defend the New Republic from the danger of the Yevetha.

However, in the capture of the Tampion, the Tampion and her escort of the eight Recon-Xs of the Fifth Battle Group's Bravo Flight were interdicted 91 light-years from the Koornacht Cluster by the Interdictor Star Dreadnaught Imperator. The Tampion and her escorts were hit by a thick barrage of ion cannon fire, and the Yevetha used an Aramadia-class thrustship to tractor in the disabled Tampion, and boarded it.

The pilot of the Tampion, Captain Sreas, was killed by a blaster bolt. Commodore Solo and the engineer of the fleet shuttle, Lieutenant Barth, surrendered without a fight, knowing the odds were hopeless. They were captured and sent to N'zoth.

The Tarken attempted rescue the Rebel MC80 Star Cruiser Knights which was captured during a meeting with Bothans in a Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser called Doomer. The Tarken was disabled and captured as well, by Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transports with the assistance of Tan Maarek Stele.

entities.name: Task Force 99's Sentinel-class landing craft
entities.description:
A Sentinel-class landing craft was utilized by Task Force 99, also known as SCAR Squadron, an elite stormtrooper squad of the Galactic Empire. SCAR Squadron, led by Sergeant Kreel, used the Sentinel-class landing craft to travel to the moon Hubin, where prominent Rebel Alliance members Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker, and Han Solo, were in hiding; the squad had learned of their location after capturing and interrogating rebel associate and smuggler Sana Starros aboard the shuttle. During a skirmish on the moon, the shuttle was stolen by the rebels, who used it to escape Hubin along with the resident Clan Markona, led by Thane Markona's daughter, Tula. The rebels traveled in the Sentinel-class landing craft to the Imperial Impound Yard on Novka, where Starros' starship, Volt Cobra, had been taken. After crashing the shuttle through a control tower, the rebels escaped aboard the Volt Cobra while Markona and her clan commandeered another vessel.

A shuttle, the Sentinel-class landing craft was equipped with engines and a hyperdrive. The starship also possessed a transponder that could be damped to obscure its identity. Able to be flown by one pilot and a navigator, the shuttle could accommodate a number of passengers. The shuttle had a red stripe on the front of its cockpit exterior, while its viewport appeared red from the outside.

During the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Rebel Alliance, the Sentinel-class landing craft was utilized by Task Force 99, an elite Imperial stormtrooper squad also known as SCAR Squadron, led by Sergeant Kreel. SCAR Squadron caught her attempting to evade an Imperial Star Destroyer. The squad interrogated Starros using a torture droid aboard the shuttle, learning the rebels' location.

SCAR Squadron landed the vessel on Hubin, within the village inhabited by the resident Clan Markona. Upon landing, they were greeted by Thane Markona, who led them back to his estate while trooper Aero secured the ship. The squad intended to capture the rebels and take them to their shuttle, but Markona, citing the tradition of Hubin and the fact that the rest of the clan would retaliate and prevent the stormtroopers from returning to their ship if they harmed him or the settlement, instead arranged a duel between Kreel and Skywalker.

entities.name: Tecora
entities.description:
The Tecora was a reddish-colored YV-865 Aurore-class freighter that belonged to Darts D'Nar during the Clone Wars. D'Nar used the ship for transporting slaves and treasures to Zygerria, until its capture by Republic forces during the battle on Kiros. Under Republic custody, it served as Jedi Generals Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, and their team's means to infiltrate to Zygerria to find enslaved Togruta colonists from the planet Kiros.

As an YV-865 Aurore-class freighter, the Tecora was highly durable with primitive yet powerful thruster engines located on its articulated boom arms that extended from the ship's primary hull. A blocky transport which had its spacious storage bay outfitted for live cargo, the Tecora sported a large cargo hold in which creatures the size of a blixus could be transported, and could be competently operated by a single pilot—namely, its owner, Darts D'Nar.

During the Clone Wars, the Tecora was owned by Zygerrian slaver Darts D'Nar. A servant of Queen Miraj Scintel, D'Nar used the Tecora to transport slaves to be sold at the Royal Slave Auction so that the Zygerrian Slave Empire saw its resurgence. Through its alliance with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, D'Nar was sent to the neutral planet of Kiros to round up all 50,000 of its Togruta citizens. On the Tecora, he landed alongside a contigent of the Separatist Droid Army and abducted the inhabitants of the artisan colony and had them transported to Zygerria, while he and his ship remained to await for Republic forces to arrive.

After ten rotations, Jedi General Obi-Wan Kenobi of Grand Army of the Republic tried to negotiate a surrender from D'Nar, but with no success. During the battle on Kiros, D'Nar attempted to flee on the Tecora. He boarded the ship and blasted off the governor's tower landing platforn, but was stopped when Anakin Skywalker disabled one of the ship's thrusters with his lightsaber. As Skywalker fended off a blixus on the cargo hold, Ahsoka Tano engaged in a brief duel with D'nar, who was quickly defeated. As D'Nar was arrested, the Tecora was taken into Republic custody.

entities.name: Thrawn's patrol boat
entities.description:
Thrawn's patrol boat was a Vak patrol boat that was commandeered by Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Ascendancy in order to escape the Vak homeworld of Primea with the caregiver Mitth'ali'astov. Thrawn used modulated laserfire to contact Admiral Ar'alani's Vigilant, which had arrived to collect him. When four Lioaoin cruisers attacked the Vigilant on the orders of the Nikardun Destiny, Thrawn fired upon one of the cruisers in the Vak patrol boat, managing to cause significant damage during the initial confusion. After his starfighter was shot and damaged, Thrawn landed it aboard the Vigilant, which escaped from Primea.

In a final move against the Nikardun leader, General Yiv, Thrawn had Thalias and the sky-walker Che'ri return the Vak fighter to Primea along with a message regarding Yiv. As Thrawn expected, the two Chiss were captured by Vaks who supported Yiv and his message was not delivered; the capture of a sky-walker led the Ascendancy to permit a retaliatory strike. When the Vak Combine searched the fighter, they discovered an additional message from Thrawn, which warned them about the possibility of Vaks conspiring with Yiv and contained information about previous Nikardun activities.

Thrawn's patrol boat first appeared in the 2020 novel Thrawn Ascendancy: Chaos Rising by Timothy Zahn, the first installment in Star Wars: The Ascendancy Trilogy.

entities.name: Tinmolok
entities.description:
The Tinmolok was a Marl-class heavy freighter manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards. Captained by Swori Mdimu and his Etti crew, it was part of the Peace Brigade fleet during the Yuuzhan Vong War. The ship was used to carry supplies and munitions for the Yuuzhan Vong, and carried two Yuuzhan Vong warriors onboard.

The ship was hijacked by Han Solo and Leia Organa Solo one jump from the Cha Raaba system, not far from Tynna. They were working on creating the Great River, a string of safehouses to transport Jedi across the galaxy. Among the cargo confiscated were three E-wing escort starfighters, 200 kilos of lommite, and a large supply of rations. All this would be delivered to Shelter base in the Maw, as the start of a privateering effort by Solo. The hold also contained amphistaffs grown on Wayland.

The Tinmolok itself was also taken to the Maw and used forthwith by the New Jedi Order.

One of its laser cannon turrets was replaced with an ion cannon, allowing it to disable ships for capture. It was instrumental in helping to destroy the Carrack-class light cruiser Vigilance. Too Late Now was destroyed by Imperial forces shortly thereafter.

The Torton Runner was a heavy freighter owned by the Hidden Daggers pirates during the Galactic Civil War. the Hidden Daggers obtained sensitive information about Imperial operations on Corellia and planned to deliver the data to the Rebel Alliance. However, the Torton Runner carrying the sensitive information was attacked in the Corellian system by Imperial starfighters led by Prisk Kith'Vys. The Imperial Navy special unit Black Epsilon disabled the Torton Runner engines and captured the ship, thereby securing the data.

entities.name: Trickster
entities.description:
The Trickster, originally the Ksstarr, was a Yuuzhan Vong frigate analog renamed in the latter half of the Yuuzhan Vong War. It held three scourges of warriors. She was Executor Nom Anor's personal warship, but was stolen by Jacen Solo and Vergere to aid the rest of the Jedi strike team in their getaway after the Mission to Myrkr. Jaina Solo, who became the owner, first piloted the ship to Coruscant, hoping the New Republic could gain much-needed intel from a still-living Yuuzhan Vong ship. Upon their arrival, However, they found themselves in the midst of a large-scale battle. Realizing that it would be impossible to make contact with their allies, the Jedi opted instead to jump to the Hapes Cluster. Once the crew had arrived safely in the Hapes Consortium, the warship was closely examined by Jaina and Lowbacca, who used it to better understand how Yuuzhan Vong biotechnology worked. Renamed Trickster in honor of Yun-Harla, the so-called Trickster Goddess of the Yuuzhan Vong pantheon, it was outfitted with a comm system and controls fit for normal usage, as opposed to the cognition hoods normally used by the ship's former masters. During Jaina and Lowie's efforts, much was learned about how the Yuuzhan Vong fought their battles, with the result that work on several versions of countermeasures and other 'tricks' was begun. Trickster would serve as a testbed for many of these developments, which included the yammosk jammer.

The ship was used as part of Jaina's efforts to become the embodiment of Yun-Harla, in an effort to destabilize and demoralize the enemy, particularly during the Battle of Hapes. Realizing that the ship's dovin basals bore unique gravitic signatures that differentiated the Ksstarr from other warships, she made copies of it and put them on ships piloted by Hapan pilots, making them appear to be the same ship, thus confusing the yammosks that coordinated Yuuzhan Vong fleet movements and attacks. Throughout the course of several battles, the Trickster served Jaina and her crew of Jedi well, sowing confusion and providing the New Republic (and later the Galactic Alliance) with several key victories.

entities.name: Triumph
entities.description:
The Triumph was an Imperial Star Destroyer serving under Director of Imperial Intelligence Ysanne Isard. It was one of two ships left to defend Imperial Center against the impending New Republic invasion. It was captured by the Mon Remonda after having received heavy damage.

The Triumph's class was never specified, but well before the battle, Admiral Gial Ackbar stated that approximately seven Victory-class Star Destroyers were on station defending Imperial Center. It was also stated that both sides' Star Destroyers traded missiles during the battle, something Imperial-class Star Destroyers do not have, lending more credibility to the ship being a Victory-class Star Destroyer.

Although tasked with the defense of Imperial Center, the Triumph was not known for its illustrious reputation or crew. As a result, Isard chose it to defend the planet during the Seizure of Coruscant along with the Star Destroyer Monarch, which had a similarly unimpressive reputation.

Isard wanted Coruscant to fall to the Rebel hands so that the New Republic would find its bacta resources devastated by an outbreak of the krytos virus. Therefore, it is likely Isard knew the Triumph and Monarch would be either captured or destroyed during the battle. She essentially left them for dead, choosing to instead relocate the superior Star Destroyers Emperor's Will and Imperator.

entities.name: True Justice
entities.description:
The True Justice was an Imperial prison ship, which was used to hold trials for political prisoners in space, rather than on a planet which might potentially support the prisoners.

In 18 BBY, the True Justice captured and held Roan Lands and Dona Telamark for trial. However, Solace, Trever Flume, and Oryon managed to rescue them by impersonating the courtroom officers and proving the two as innocent. Then, they took over the cockpit and stole the ship for their uses.

entities.name: Twi'lek Dancer
entities.description:
The Twi'lek Dancer was a CEC Barloz-class freighter that had a number of owners through the years.

Originally known as the Harvest it was owned by an agricultural combine. The ship was later re-named the Venom Sting, customized and used by the Tiss'shar bounty hunter Xufal D'uat until his death. The ship was then salvaged by a mining station and sold to a cell of Thalassian slavers, who renamed it Twi'lek Dancer, re-customized it and used it in their raids. The ship was then requised by pirates and sold to a legitimate trader of used ships.

This Barloz-class freighter built by the Corellian Engineering Corporation was originally bought by an agricultural combine in the Tion Hegemony. The owners called the ship Harvest and used it for a time, until they earned enough money to buy an YT-1300 light freighter. They decided to sell the Harvest at this point.

The Harvest was bought by Xufal D'uat, a bounty hunter of Tiss'shar species. D'uat re-named the ship Venom Sting and performed several modifications first on a limited scope and later covering the whole ship, allowing him to fight any intrusion in his headquarters.

entities.name: Twilight
entities.description:
The Twilight was a Corellian G9 Rigger-class light freighter owned and operated by the Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars. Skywalker and his Padawan, Ahsoka Tano, used the ship to escape from a battle on Teth. When Obi-Wan Kenobi traveled to the planet Mandalore during the Mandalorian civil war, the ship was destroyed by the former Sith Lord Maul and his Shadow Collective.

The Twilight had a roomy cockpit with chairs for the pilots

The Twilight was originally owned by the Hutt crime lord Ziro Desilijic Tiure, who used it as a spice freighter. early in the Clone Wars, Ziro allied himself with the Confederacy of Independent Systems in a plot to take over his nephew Jabba Desilijic Tiure's criminal empire, as well as sabotaging relations between the Galactic Republic and the Hutt Clan. As a result, the Twilight was present on the Wild Space planet Teth, at a landing platform near a B'omarr Order Monastery where the Separatists were holding Jabba's abducted son, Rotta. During the subsequent battle at the monastery as Republic forces attempted to locate the child, the spy droid 4-A7 and several battle droids were loading cargo aboard the ship when they were discovered by Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker, his Padawan Ahsoka Tano, and Skywalker's astromech R2-D2, who had rescued Rotta and were escaping Separatist commander Asajj Ventress. Realizing that 4-A7 was not the "caretaker droid" he had claimed to be, Tano destroyed him and the battle droids before she and her master claimed the Twilight.

At first, the Twilight refused to start up, but Skywalker and R2 were able to fire up the engines and attempted to land on the nearest Jedi Cruiser. Unfortunately, the Vulture droids prevented them from landing in one of the cruiser's hangars. Thus, Skywalker and his crew were forced to take the Twilight to Tatooine. Aboard the ship, Tano activated the medical droid hologram, TB-2 to save Rotta from near death. Upon the Twilight arrival at Tatooine, the ship came under attack by a pair of IG-100 MagnaGuards using Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighters. Skywalker, Tano, and R2 were able to destroy the starfighters, but were forced to crash land in the Dune Sea.

entities.name: Tyaonon Ranger
entities.description:
The Tyaonon Ranger was one of only nine experimental Stathas-class freighters ever produced. At one time it was owned by Bib Fortuna who used it to smuggle spice for Jabba the Hutt until their smuggling ring was taken down by a Phraetiss system patrol cruiser which seized the ship and took the crew into custody. Somehow the vessel mysteriously disappeared from the impound yard mere days after being logged in. The only lead as to who did this was a Human near the yards just after the Ranger first arrived. He was described as being solidly built and smelled of armudu spice. Apparently this man had sold and then stolen the ship from no less than four people. Sometime before Tealo came into possession of the ship, it was upgraded to have additional hull plating.

When Tealo came into possession of the ship, it only had 10,000 light-years on it. He had received it from a quiet Sullustan who had used it to travel the Outer Rim trade routes, and was looking to sell it straight away. Though he did not know the true value of the craft, he had put a price of 25,000 credits on it, without knowing that there was 40,000 credits worth of spice inside the ship in hidden compartments. He eventually managed to sell it to a group of Rebels who discovered that the ships records had been falsified. The previous "owners" of the ship all tried to gain the ship back from the group, especially Jabba who wanted his spice back.

entities.name: Unidentified Consular-class cruiser
entities.description:
A Consular-class cruiser was owned by Noggox the Hutt during the Clone Wars. It was captured by the pirate Dool Pundar in 22 BBY.

A Consular-class cruiser was used as a freighter by Noggox the Hutt during the Clone Wars. It was painted silver, featured deflector shields. It had at least one escape pod. A Hologram emitter was on the bridge. Like other ships of its class, it was 115 meters and had three sub light Dyne 577 radial atomizer engine units.

In 22 BBY, the freighter was carrying droid brains to the Fondor Shipyards. The captain was a Klatooinian man, and other crew included a Snivvian lieutenant, a Rodian, another alien, and a Human. The freighter was intercepted near Shipwrights' Trace by Dool Pundar's pirate ship, which disabled the two of the freighter's thrusters and the primary shield generator. Pundar ordered the crew to surrender and sent B1-series battle droids to take control of the vessel. Pundar then allowed the crew to leave in an escape pod. After Pundar absconded with their vessel, the crew transmitted a distress signal to the planet Coruscant, home of the Galactic Republic. At the time of its capture, the ship was insured.

The freighter appears in 2011's The Clone Wars: Strange Allies, a comic tie-in to the Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions young readers series.

entities.name: Unidentified dreadnought
entities.description:
A dreadnought served in the Imperial Navy as one of the Galactic Empire's thirteen Super Star Destroyers prior to the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY. However, by 5 ABY, it had been captured over Kuat by the New Republic for use in its fleet.

The dreadnought was one of the Galactic Empire's thirteen Super Star Destroyers of Imperial capital ships—during the Galactic Civil War. As such, it was equipped with a propulsion system and extensive weapons systems.

Prior to the Battle of Endor the dreadnought was one of the thirteen Super Star Destroyers originally in Imperial service. The Empire's defeat at Endor, which saw the death of the Emperor and the destruction of the second Death Star, left the Imperial forces fractured, while the victorious Rebel Alliance transitioned into the New Republic.

After the battle, the dreadnought transmitted tracking data to the Hall of Imperial Register on the Imperial planet Coruscant, allowing for a black box recording of information so the Empire could discern what had happened to the ship in the event it was destroyed, captured, or had surrendered. Indeed, by 5 ABY, the dreadnought was undergoing repairs at the Imperial planet Kuat, when it was captured by the New Republic for use in its fleet.

entities.name: Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer
entities.description:
This Imperial-class Star Destroyer was a warship that served in the Imperial Navy during the Galactic Civil War.

This Star Destroyer was 1,600 meters long, the standard length for an Imperial-class Star Destroyer. However, it featured a bridge with a different interior design than the standard Imperial-class Star Destroyer. The ship also housed several laboratories.

The Star Destroyer was particularly resilient, as was shown when it was adrift during several years. Despite being near a dying star and hit by meteors, most of the ship still had operational gravity and life support systems.

The Star Destroyer carried a complement of TIE/LN starfighters and at least one TIE/sa bomber.

Sometime during the Great Galactic War and the Cold War between the Galactic Republic and the reconstituted Sith Empire, the notorious pirate Harridax Kirill captured a vessel belonging to the Jedi Order that was carrying Force-sensitive children. Kirill, better known as the Voidwolf, personally led the boarding party that killed the Jedi defenders aboard the starship, and he took the children to the Sith planet of Korriban as a "gift" to the Empire. The Empire rewarded the Voidwolf by promoting him from privateer to commander in the Imperial Navy.

The Spice Runners of Kijimi undertook a mission to locate Ledesmar, which became a skirmish against the New Republic after New Republic Security Bureau officer Sela Trune located Poe Dameron aboard the cruiser. entities.name: Unidentified Munificent-class star frigate
entities.description:
A Munificent-class star frigate was created at the Gwori shipyards during the Clone Wars. In 22 BBY, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, and Ahsoka Tano stole the frigate to help them transport the slave workers in the shipyards off-world during a battle on Gwori.

The frigate was not fitted with armaments, so the Jedi were unable to fight through the blockade around the planet. They were forced to play safe; when traffic control ordered them to pass through the scanning station, they obeyed. Unfortunately Overseer Juhm, in charge of the operations on Gwori, ordered the station to activate its radiation beam, which would kill everyone on board the frigate. However, Jedi Masters Saesee Tiin and Plo Koon opened fire on the station from their interceptors, destroying it and allowing the frigate to pass safely through. Since their hyperdrive rings had been destroyed, Koon and Tiin boarded the frigate, which then flew safely to Coruscant.

entities.name: Unidentified Nihil starship
entities.description:
A starship was utilized by a Cloud of the Nihil marauders on the planet Temerancé. The Nihil used the starship to kidnap a number of Force-sensitive children from the planet, including the Altiri Lene Kostana. The monster hunter Ty Yorrick boarded the vessel to rescue Kostana and the other children, defeating the Nihil crew. Yorrick crash-landed the ship outside the settlement where Kostana lived, returning the children home. However, after her apprentice, Drewen Qweebjillan took Yorrick's own ship on a mission, she returned to the settlement and requested the Nihil vessel. Assisted by her astromech droid R0-VR and Kostana, Yorrick repaired the Nihil ship and intended to leave Temerancé. Yorrick shortly returned to rescue Kostana from the Nihil's Children of the Storm, departing the planet to find Qweebjillan.

entities.description:
A starship was used by Vice Admiral Amilyn Holdo of the Resistance when stealing the head of Admiral Mathieson's protocol droid from the New Republic space station Brooksdion. The starship, piloted by Nien Nunb, was pursued by Rapier Squadron, its hyperdrive having been damaged by Commander Poe Dameron. Dameron chased the starship through the Lost Souls asteroid field, but the Resistance members disabled his T-85 X-wing to prevent him from chasing them any further. With the hyperdrive repaired, Holdo anonymously informed Dameron of the Resistance's nature before escaping into hyperspace.

Left at Durd's base while he and his forces left to test his Defoliator weapon on a village of Lurmen colonists, the shuttle was subsequently stolen by a small group of Galactic Republic soldiers stranded on the planet who were aware of Durd's presence and intended to stop him. After the ensuing battle concluded with a successful defense of the Lurmen village, the shuttle was used by the Republic to transport a captured Lok Durd and his weapons technician Pune Zignat into custody.

entities.name: Unidentified Theelin family's ship
entities.description:
A ship was owned by a Theelin family during the High Republic Era. the family was present on planet Genetia when the Evereni Ro family was attacked by townspeople. During the attack, two members of the Ro family, the mothers of the cousins Marda and Yana, killed the Theelin family and took their ship. After they escaped, the ship's life-support systems began to fail and the Ros experienced days of hunger and cold.

Eventually, the family was towed by a Hutt trawler to Nar Shaddaa where the Hutts attempted to enslave the Ros. In 382 BBY, as the cousins spoke about Yana's plans to leave the Path of the Open Hand cult they had since joined, Yana mentally recalled their mothers taking the Theelin family's ship and the subsequent events involving it.

The Theelin family's ship was mentioned in the 2022 young-adult novel The High Republic: Path of Deceit, written by Justina Ireland and Tessa Gratton as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's Within the novel, the ship was mentioned in a chapter written by Ireland.

The clan briefly rendezvoused with the Rebel Alliance leaders Leia Organa, Luke Skywalker and Han Solo on Brentaal IV, before parting ways to find General Hera Syndulla aboard the Geist, whilst the rebels went in search of the Home One in the Kaliida Nebula.

entities.name: Valorous
entities.description:
The Valorous was a Victory-class Star Destroyer of the Imperial Navy assigned to Black Sword Command. It was later captured by the Yevetha following an uprising led by them, and the ship was renamed the Devotion of Yevetha or simply the Devotion.

The Valorous had large numbers of weapons ports and paired starfighter bays on either side of the hull. The fighter complemment included a number of TIE/rc starfighters for long-range reconnaissance, and the ship's weaponry was capable of subjugating settlements of considerable size, such as that on Polneye.

In 4 ABY, the Valorous was assigned to Black Sword Command and based in the Koornacht Cluster. Along with the Super Star Destroyer Intimidator, she was one of two Imperial warships seized substantially intact at N'zoth by the native Yevetha in their coup eight months after the Battle of Endor. Subsequently, together with a number of Type II Orbital Repair Yards such as Black Fifteen, plus a number of ships under construction and undergoing repair, they became the nucleus of the Black Fleet.

The surviving Imperial crewers from Valorous, along with their counterparts from Intimidator, were sent to Camp Pa'aal and forced to assist their captors with the reverse-engineering and copying of Imperial technology, and the two Star Destroyers were renamed and incorporated into the fleet of the Duskhan League. However, unbeknownst to the Yevetha, the Imperial survivors they had retained for their technical skill, led by Major Sil Sorannan, secretly equipped every Imperial-designed ship in the Black Fleet with extensive slave circuitry which would eventually enable them to regain control.

entities.name: Vigil
entities.description:
The Vigil was a Vakbeor-class cargo frigate manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards. It was captured by Resistance commandos from pirates during a battle off the Chasidron Shoals. It became part of the Resistance fleet under the command of Vice Admiral Jotis during their war with the First Order. It was one of four vessels that Resistance forces used on the planet D'Qar evacuated on after they were attacked by the First Order following the destruction of Starkiller Base. It was used also to house supplies and munitions and many other types of equipment during the evacuation. After the Resistance successfully destroyed the Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought Fulminatrix above D'Qar, the Vigil jumped to lightspeed along with the Raddus, the Anodyne and the Ninka. The First Order was able to track the Resistance fleet through lightspeed and followed them and attacking once they arrived at their destination, quickly destroying the Vigil as it attempted to flee.

Star Wars: The Last Jedi: Incredible Cross-Sections

entities.name: Vorknkx
entities.description:
The Vorknkx was a CR90 corvette in the service of the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War.

The Vorknkx was the prototype vessel used in an Imperial scientific project of the same name, which had the goal of developing a cloaking device for a small-sized craft. It would become the mechanism by which Imperial traitor Grand Admiral Demetrius Zaarin was finally defeated by his archenemy and Imperial successor, Grand Admiral Thrawn. Though Zaarin and Thrawn had skirmished for months and Zaarin's forces had slowly been whittled down by the larger loyalist force under Thrawn's command, the former Admiral was irritatingly good at keeping his flagship, Imperial-class Star Destroyer Glory, and therefore himself, out of harm's way. Thrawn used his assignment to defend the Vorknkx project from Zaarin as a chance to change this pattern and end Zaarin's rebellion against the Emperor once and for all.

Thrawn knew that Zaarin's core weakness was his desire to possess new military technology for himself. He also had received an exclusive report from the scientists in charge of the project which suggested that the experimental cloaking device aboard the Vorknkx could produce a catastrophic power overload if used in conjunction with the craft's hyperdrive. Both of these weaknesses became a critical part of Thrawn's plan to ensnare his enemy.

Zaarin's forces had attacked the station where the Vorknkx Project was being conducted, but had been repulsed by Thrawn's fighter patrols, led by Maarek Stele. When the project was moved to a hollowed-out asteroid some time later, Thrawn allowed the Vorknkxs new location to be discovered by Zaarin. When Zaarin inevitably threw all of his remaining transports at seizing the project, Stele easily destroyed them. A double agent planted by Zaarin attempted to steal a shuttle and flee in the chaos of the battle, but was also shot down by Stele. With his transports gone and unaware that his spy had been eliminated, Zaarin joined the battle himself aboard Glory. Using the remote device which the spy had planted on the Vorknkx, Zaarin was able to guide the ship into his own hangar bay. He then quickly fled the scene, thinking he had triumphed.

entities.name: VX-391
entities.description:
VX-391 was a freighter that carried the bodies of Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka Tano and other clone troopers encased in carbonite.

R2-D2 piloted the ship by enslaving a B1-series battle droid as all biological lifeforms that were scanned on the ship would be irradiated and vaporized. After the freighter passed inspection, Juhm questioned the operators of the irradiator why there was one extra ship in the convoy. As the freighter entered the atmosphere of Gwori, the convoy was ordered to change course, and Artoo could not adjust, thus pointing out the impostor. Artoo ejected the carbonite blocks and itself into the sands below just before the ship was destroyed by droid fighters.

entities.name: Waterspire
entities.description:
The Waterspire was a Mon Calamari Simiyiar-class light freighter.

Initially used by a crew of Rebel Alliance operatives whose primary area of operations was located in the Wilpiet area, the ship was stolen by the bounty hunter Milacass at least two months after he joined the Granse Confederacy. In the process, he also damaged Rebel property and became a being wanted by Alliance Intelligence.

Milacass's made the Waterspire available to the Granse Confederacy. However, the loose organization of bounty hunters preferred to use their other two starships, the Mist Laden and Nightcast, because they were less striking—and thus, less noticeable. Due to this, Milacass did not bother to change the ship's markings or transponder codes during the following two months, as he saw no need to do so.

entities.name: Weet
entities.description:
Weet was a Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport employed by the Rebel Alliance during the Galactic Civil War.

Weet was a transport containing Rebel spies hiding inside a Rebel Class-D cargo container Pi, surrounded by Type A mines. The minefield was cleared by a single Assault Gunboat, Mu 1, and was inspected to see what was hiding inside. The transport was then launched from the container and attempted to escape, only to be disabled by the Gunboat. System Patrol Craft Scythis then boarded the transport and captured it.

The event was recorded and used to train future pilots on how to use a Gunboat. One of those pilots was Maarek Stele.
