entities.name: Mist-bond
entities.description:
The mist-bond was an ability used by the scientifically-augmented Child of the Storm, Brother Rrkak. The mist-bond was produced by Rrkak's fingers as supposedly unbreakable cords which could be used to bind an adversary. It shares a name with the Mist, a term used by Rrkak to describe the Force.

In 228 BBY, when former Trandoshan Jedi Master Sskeer, Sephi guru Tey Sirrek and former Nihil Tempest Runner Lourna Dee infiltrated Shingcu Station, secret laboratory facility of the Nihil's Ithorian Minister of Advancement and dark scientist Baron Boolan, the Ithorian ordered Rrkak and Sister H'Tar to subdue the intruders. Following an explosion in the space station, Rrkak used the mist-bond to subdue Sskeer and Sirrek.

Though Rrkak thought the mist-bond to be unbreakable, Sskeer's Trandoshan strength in the face of his pure rage was sufficient to overcome the tensile strength of the power.

entities.description: Natural navigation was a Force power. It could be bestowed upon an individual after several months of attunement to a turquoise tasar crystal. Natural navigation prevented an individual from getting lost as long as they had a map or a sense of the approximate direction they were heading in. If the individual had no bearings, they could still discern the direction of magnetic north.

entities.name: Phase
entities.description:
Phase was a Force power that enabled the user to pass through solid matter, such as walls and doors. It could also be used to reach into someone’s body to deadly effect.

An'ya Kuro was a known user of this ability. Bazel Warv could also use this ability when he was afflicted by his Force psychosis. After Bazel used it, Raynar Thul said that Killiks developed the technique while they created the Maw. However, Leia Organa Solo suggested that it was the Celestials that developed the ability since the Killiks absorbed the memories of any being who became Joined to one of their nests.

entities.name: Precognition
entities.description:
Precognition, known to the Chiss as "Third Sight," was an ability of the Force that allowed its use to see future events before they occurred.

Anakin Skywalker utilized precognition during his time as a Jedi Knight and Sith Lord Darth Vader to peer into the future to know where and when an attack was coming from.

Chiss individuals, nearly always females, who were born to be Force-sensitive, were born with the ability of precognition. Because of this, they were used by the Chiss to navigate and pilot their ships through the Unknown Regions, as well as finding and mapping temporary hyperlanes. Such Chiss navigators were known as ozyly-esehembo. Only Chiss children had precognitive power to safely guide their ships at the speed the Aristocras demanded, and as the Chiss grew older the ability faded, regardless of the amount of training or practice the individual undertook. The Force-sensitive child Eila could use this ability.

Precognition was first mentioned in Star Wars canon in the 2015 novel Aftermath, written by Chuck Wendig. It made its first appearance in 2017 during Zero Hour, the Star Wars Rebels Season Three finale.

entities.name: Psychometry
entities.description:
Psychometry, also known as Sense Echo, Force Echo, or retrocognition, was the Force ability of acquiring information about people or events associated with an object or a place solely by touching or entering it.

Psychometry albeit with slightly distorted input, of the sight, sound, and emotions associated with the object. As such, the skill was useful for tracking escaped targets.

Psychometry was not a power that could be achieved through training, as only those that were born with the power could use it, such as Karr Nuq Sin. The power did not always manifest directly at birth, as in the case of Nuq Sin, who began experiencing visions caused by objects at age thirteen. Though an innate skill, it nonetheless still required some study and practice to properly control it. To an unpracticed individual touching an object that induced a vision could also cause severe headaches and seizures, consequently making these episodes appear more like symptoms of a serious illness rather than a rare and powerful Force ability. Nuq Sin discovered that wearing gloves prevents the ability activating when he did not want it to. Jedi Knight Vildar Mac found that his power of psychometry often yielded no results, with the Force visions taking a toll on him whenever it did.

During the High Republic Era, Jedi Knight Vildar Mac often used psychometry but found his Force visions to be often unreliable.

entities.description: Restful-sleep-in-danger was a Jedi technique that allowed the Jedi Knights to get much needed sleep while remaining aware of their surroundings. This meant the Jedi could rest while dealing with a potentially dangerous situation.

entities.name: Sever Force
entities.description:
A Force phenomenon existed that suppressed Force-sensitive individuals' connection to the Force. Whether by choice or circumstance, the severing of the Force from an individual prevented them from using Force powers to varying degrees and even render an individual imperceptible in the Force by Force users.

Several members of the Jedi Order distanced themselves from the Force following traumatic experiences, such as Cere Junda, Ahsoka Tano, Kanan Jarrus, and Luke Skywalker. The inhibition facilitated periods of self-imposed exile and contemplation. Regardless of the cause, the severance was not necessarily permanent, and many Jedi often reversed the effects on themselves.

The Force was a field of energy created by the energy of all life—the Living Force—in symbiosis with the Cosmic Force, which had a will that communicated to all individuals via the midi-chlorians, which were in symbiosis with their host to allow them to perceive and channel Force energy through training. Particularly Force-sensitive individuals could tap into the Force and use it in either a harmonious or corruptive manner, with the Jedi Order instilling discipline into its pupils to adhere to the principles of the light side and listen to the will of the Force. However, traumatic experiences could inhibit a Jedi's connection to the Force. Distancing one's connection with the Force could also be done by choice, and could even render an individual imperceptible in the Force by Force users. An affected person nevertheless could have their connection with the Force restored.

According to the quasi-historical Qel-Droma Epics, a millennium after the Great Hyperspace War, Ulic Qel-Droma turned away from the dark side following his attempt to infiltrate the Krath from within and was redeemed by being cut off from the Force. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Elzar Mann suppressed his connection to the Force for a time after using the dark side of the Force during the Nihil attack on Valo. Following another Nihil attack on Valo in which the Nameless murdered one of his Jedi Masters, the Jedi youngling Gavi lost his ability to use the Force.

Shatterpoint was a Force ability that could be used to sense the significance of an event It also referred to key moments where actions could change events. Jedi Master Mace Windu had the ability to detect shatterpoints. While speaking with Anakin Skywalker, Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine claimed that Windu had a lack of empathy and suggested that may be his shatterpoint. When the shuttle Tydirium landed on the Sanctuary Moon, Darth Sidious sensed someone on board that was a shatterpoint and would have a great role in the course of fate.

Novices would find it difficult to maintain while an adept practitioner could keep up the technique as if it were second nature. Darth Plagueis briefly used this power to defend himself from melee attacks from the crew of the Woebegone after he had decided to kill them all and take the ship as his means of transport.

entities.name: Taming beasts
entities.description:
Taming beasts, also known as animal kinship or beast control, was an ability of the Force that allowed its user to connect mentally with animals.

Taming beasts, also known as animal kinship or beast control, Leia Organa was able to use the ability without even trying to, simply asking for help in a moment where she found the Force inside of herself. Organa's prior attempts to use the Force had failed because she had seen it as something outside of herself to be controlled.

During the Sith Empire's occupation of Serenno, the Sith used the Force to control the Tirra'Taka and use it in combat. During the High Republic Era, Jedi Master Porter Engle used this ability to calm a group of steelees so they could be used as mounts during a Jedi rescue attempt of the Blythe family, who had been kidnapped by the Nihil.

Obi-Wan Kenobi demonstrated a natural talent at the technique early in his training. He easily connected with his varactyl mount on Pijal, impressing his master Qui-Gon Jinn. In contrast Kenobi's apprentice Anakin Skywalker struggled to learn the skill, unable to calm a Mott during a training session and likewise failed to calm the corpse-leeches on Carnelion IV causing Skywalker to kill them instead.

entities.name: Tapas
entities.description:
Tapas was a Force technique that allowed its user to draw on the power of the Force to remain warm in a cold environment. The Jedi Knight Jacen Solo once used this Force technique, employing it in conjunction with a Force shield during the Battle of Ebaq in 28 ABY to survive in a mine that had lost its atmosphere.

The art of keeping warm in a cold environment, Tapas required the user to concentrate on the Force to retain their body heat.

Utilizing Tapas to retain one's body heat was used by Jedi in hostile environments, such as vacuum. If a Force-sensitive knowledgeable in Tapas found themselves in a cold environment, they could draw on the Force to keep themselves warm.

Tapas was an ability once displayed by Jedi Knight Jacen Solo, who used the technique during the Battle of Ebaq of the Yuuzhan Vong War When his mentor, Vergere, crashed an RZ-1 A-wing interceptor into the Ebaq 9 moon, perishing on impact and causing the mines in which Solo was fighting to lose atmosphere, he was forced to use Tapas in conjunction with a Force shield to survive in the depressurized area. He found it difficult to concentrate on Tapas and on maintaining the Force shield that retained his air, and so he began to shiver. He managed to hold on with the help of Vergere's spirit before help arrived.

entities.name: Telekinesis
entities.description:
Telekinesis, also known as Force telekinesis, was the ability to move and otherwise manipulate physical matter in a variety of ways, all while using the power of the Force. The ability was virtually ubiquitous among Force-sensitive individuals and organizations, though the techniques could differ greatly. It had a tremendous number of applications, both combative and utilitarian.

Telekinesis was one of the most basic Force powers. A commonly used ability for those with power in the Force, the purpose of telekinesis was to manipulate matter, allowing the user to touch, hold, move, and otherwise interact with a target through the Force. For a sufficiently skilled and powerful practitioner, the size, weight, distance, and mass of a targeted object would seldomly hinder their ability to influence it. One could lift something as small as a piece of fruit to an X-wing starfighter, while they could also use it to manipulate liquids or to dispel gaseous substances.

Despite the ability allowing the user the ability to manipulate targets without physical contact and from a variable distance, the precision, accuracy, range, and strength of the ability were tied to the user's concentration, willpower, emotions, senses, and spatial awareness. Therefore, a user's power of telekinesis could be weakened, nullified, or destabilized, causing said user to be unable to properly control it. The power was generally used at close range, but in rare instances, a user was able to affect a target only by having to know the targets location relative to themselves, whether it be around a corner or in another room.

During meditation, which drew forth a stronger and more direct connection with the Force, the enhanced state of consciousness could sometimes inadvertently affect one's surroundings, usually by causing surrounding objects, or even the practitioner themselves to levitate. In fact, some practitioners were so skilled and powerful that they could consciously resist gravity, inertia, friction and other physical forces to enhance their mobility, notably allowing them to slow their falls.

entities.name: Telepathy
entities.description:
Telepathy, known to the Chiss as Second Sight, was the ability to mentally communicate and interact with other individuals, as well as to transmit and receive information to and from the minds of others.

Telepathy was the ability to mentally communicate and interact with other individuals through the Force, as well as to transmit and receive information to and from the minds of others.

Some Force-users were able to communicate with each other through the Force. Sometimes even those not born to the Force could be contacted with this art. Telepathy could be difficult for a Jedi to use.

Telepathy among the Chiss was known as Second Sight. The power typically manifested in young Chiss Force-sensitives around the age of ten and faded as they grew older, along with other Force powers. When used to touch the mind of another Chiss with the same power, Second Sight carried the risk that both would become lost in each other's minds.

entities.name: Thoughtful looking
entities.description:
Thoughtful looking was a Force-technique used by Jedi to get a greater look of a thing or things. The technique helped Jedi find things that even electrobinoculars didn't pick up. The technique involved shifting ones concentration back and forth from the big picture to a microscopic scale.

Ferus Olin used the technique to discover that EmPal SuRecon had the tiniest flaw, a ripple in the armoring on the highest levels of the tower, a flaw likely given by glancing blow of stray debris, enough to tell Ferus that it was armoring, not the metallic skin of the tower. Further inspection of the tower revealed to Ferus the slightest bumps that were regularly spaced, indicating power feed lines. Enough power feed lines to power a turbolaser.

entities.description: Time-drifting was an extension of the Aing-Tii ability of flow-walking, where an individual moved along the threads of the Force to travel backward or forward in time. Jacen Solo learnt this technique and revisited the final days of Anakin Skywalker to find out information about his fall to the Dark side. This ability still had its risks; if time-drifters were seen by those they visited, it could create shifts in the flow of time by altering the visited individual's actions.

entities.name: Time-stream
entities.description:
The "time-stream" is a term used to describe the concept that time is a constant forward flow, and that flow can be perceived. Several beings in the galaxy, such as the Seers of the H'drachi, reported the ability to view the time-stream using the Force. They claim they were therefore able to avoid or change the future they had seen, creating divergences in the time-stream.

entities.description:
A Force power that helped an individual regulate their body temperature was known to Mirialan Jedi Master Vernestra Rwoh. She taught the ability to Jedi Knight Indara.

The body temperature regulation power appeared in The Acolyte: Wayseeker, a 2025 novel written by Justina Ireland.

entities.description:
In 228 BBY, a Force technique was being studied by Jedi Master Elzar Mann, who considered the technique to be esoteric and near-forgotten. At the end of the day, Mann spent the night in bed with his lover and fellow Jedi Master Avar Kriss in Kriss' quarters on the Core Worlds planet Coruscant. After waking up the following morning and reaching for his datapad, Mann mentally recalled his research into the Force technique.

entities.name: Force vision
entities.description:
Force visions, also known as Force premonitions, were an ability of the Force to see into the past, the future, and other places. It was once possessed by all Jedi but grew rare in the final years of the Galactic Republic. Some Sith also experienced Force visions.

Force visions, also known as Force premonitions, were an aspect of the Force, an ability to see into the past, the future and other places. of the past of an object and those who had interacted with it.

Sith, as Force users, were also capable of experiencing Force visions. Some Jedi attributed this to the future constantly being in motion, with the visions merely warning of what could happen. with their visions of the past being useful in hunting down fugitives or gathering evidence.

During the High Republic Era, the Path of the Open Hand, a radical anti-Force wielder cult, was led by the Force-sensitive Elecia Zeveron, who was known to her followers as "the Mother" and hid her own use of the Force. She claimed to receive visions from the Force but, in fact, was little more than a con artist who tried to guide the Path to her own ends.

entities.name: Vitali
entities.description:
Vitali was a Force power. the Sephi Tey Sirrek investigated the murder of the Sarravi V'Kara in the Shrine of Sarrav. Jedi Knight Vildar Mac, who had chased Tey after he witnessed him stealing from a Bpfasshi Truthsayer, spotted the Sephi standing next to the dead V'Kara and assumed Tey murdered her. The Kiffar Jedi attacked Tey with his lightsaber, but Tey managed to dodge the strikes. When Vildar angrily asked Tey how he was doing this, the Sephi claimed to have mastered many Force powers, including Vitali, the Cry of the Broken King and Morichro. Vildar dismissed that claim as nonsence, saying that Morichro is just a myth. Tey then used biological pheromones, his ancestors developed against predators, to temporarily knock out the Jedi, whilest claiming he was using the ancient rite of Morichro on Vildar.

Vitali was was mentioned in the first issue of the The High Republic (2022) comic run published by Marvel Comics as part of Phase II of Star Wars: The High Republic.

entities.name: Wayfinding
entities.description: Wayfinding was a rare Jedi ability in the High Republic Era. It allowed a Jedi to sense whether planets or moons harbored life. According to Vernestra Rwoh, wayfinding was mostly done by experienced Jedi Masters who had practiced it for their entire lives. Imri Cantaros used wayfinding to locate the jungle moon Wevo after the attack on the Steady Wing.

Despite being alone against the pirates' corvettes and heavy frigates, the Aurora wiped out all twenty-eight enemy vessels and eradicated the Hook Talons.

entities.name: Battle of Chyron Belt
entities.description:
The Battle of Chyron Belt was a confrontation that took place at some point by the time of the First Order-Resistance War in the vicinity before eventually becoming a Vice Admiral of the Resistance.

By 34 ABY, if the unconventional Vice Admiral who had spoken was indeed the same person who had participated in the Battle of Chyron Belt. In response, Threnalli shrugged in the Abednedish language.

The Battle of Chyron Belt was first mentioned in the 2017 sequel trilogy film Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi.—Poe Dameron instead delivers an alternate version of the line mentioning the battle to Amilyn Holdo, with the battle's name misspelled as the "Battle of Chryon Belt." non-canon adaptation William Shakespeare's Jedi the Last: Star Wars Part the Eighth by Ian Doescher—in which yet another version of the line is instead delivered as an aside—introduced the alternate name "Clash of Chyron Belt" for that engagement.

entities.name: Attack on a Colicoid nest
entities.description:
By 252 BBY, hueches attacked a Colicoid nest which included its queen, Jinnix, and his drone-mate. During the attack, the drone-mate failed to protect the queen and afterward listed to Jinnix the reasons for why they had failed. Seeing the reasons as excuses for their failure, Jinnix ripped off the drone-mate's head and ate their ganglia. Sometime later, when Jinnix was a Storm in the Nihil marauder organization, he informed his Strike Towl of the attack on his nest by hueches and his response to his drone-mates attempts to explain their failure to protect the queen when Towl made an excuse for not following an order.

The attack on a Colicoid nest was mentioned in flashbacks in The High Republic: Tempest Runner, a 2021 audio drama written by Cavan Scott and published as a part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's Phase I.

entities.name: Unidentified skirmish
entities.description:
A skirmish took place on a sometime after the Ronin's rupture with the Jedi clans. Amidst rain and blasterfire, a Sith known as the Ronin dueled a Jedi who would later call himself the Grand Master, near some crates and a moisture vaporator. The Ronin knocked him down onto the ground and cut off his legs and lower jaw.

The Sith blasted him for his obsession with judgment, claiming it was a denial of the balance needed between light and dark sides of the Force. The Ronin saw the young man as closer to darkness than the Sith themselves. Badly wounded, the Jedi survived and took on cybernetics, vowing revenge on his opponent. Later, the two would again meet on the planet Olcatz, where the Ronin killed the man in a duel in Tkoku Island.

entities.name: Battle of Wasted Years
entities.description:
The Battle of Wasted Years in 241 BBY by fellow Padawan Tylera Yorrick after though he was later theorized by many Jedi to have been expelled from the Jedi Order.

In 88 BBY, Jedi Initiate Sifo-Dyas told fellow Initiate Dooku about Teradine's holojournal and its information on Darth Krall's deeds, including the Battle of Wasted Years. Dooku later told his sister Jenza about their conversation in a holo-letter. Dooku gave data disks containing his messages to Jenza to his recently recruited Sith assassin, Asajj Ventress, for her investigation into his sister's location, and she listened to the message that mentioned the battle.

The Battle of Wasted Years was first mentioned in the audio drama Dooku: Jedi Lost, written by Cavan Scott The capitalization of its name was later confirmed with the release of the script on October 1 of the same year.

entities.name: 12-4C-41's droid revolt
entities.description:
12-4C-41's droid revolt was an event that happened in 0 ABY. In it, 12-4C-41's Droid Army rose up against its oppressors in the hope of gaining galactic domination.

The Victory I-class Star Destroyer Decimator entered the Kleeva system, awaiting the delivery of a new shipment of droids from Boonda the Hutt. Boonda, however, woke up to find his droids attempting to kill him. The corpulent Hutt, panicked, escaped his would-be murderers using secret escape routes. The droids, led by 12-4C-41 (also known as Wuntoo), prepared to lead an assault on the Decimator, which they planned to capture and take to Vactooine, where they hoped to take over droid production.

In the Decimator loading bay, the droids were inspected by Captain Pelvin and Trooper 1219, but upon unloading, Wuntoo attacked the Imperials, and his droid lackeys started a fire on the deck. Admiral Groot believed this to be a machination of Boonda, and ordered an attack on the Hutt's facility. He, along with Pelvin and Gammat Squad, were able to escape the Decimator, which was quickly overrun by the renegade droids. They are then attacked by droid-piloted TIEs while approaching Boonda's Moon, and the Admiral is injured. Upon landing, the group was attacked by Boonda, but one of the troopers convinced him that they meant no harm. When Boonda discovered that the Imperials are not the ones who have caused the droids to revolt, he realizes that he needs to prove his innocence, and helps the troopers to destroy his own factory.

Before leaving, the Decimator picked up what was left of the factory. Though Boonda believed that there was nothing of worth within, Wuntoo had a cadre of specially designed battle droids that he had been keeping in reserve. Storing them aboard the Decimator, Wuntoo set course for Tatooine.

entities.description:
The 40th Emergence, or the fortieth Emergence, was the fortieth of the Emergences, fallout of the Great Hyperspace Disaster in which fragments of the freighter Legacy Run shot out of hyperspace seemingly at random. The fortieth Emergence was a portion of the Legacy Run bridge that contained its flight recorder. As a result, a skirmish ensued as members of the Jedi Order and Galactic Republic personnel, who were hoping to retrieve the device, fought members of the Nihil pirates who were attempting to destroy it.

entities.description:
During the Galactic War between the Galactic Republic and the Sith Empire, the Republic Special Forces unit Havoc Squad was dispatched to the Imperial prisoner-of-war facility A-77 in order to rescue Sergeant Ava Jaxo and the other prisoners there. However, the operation was actually a trap set by Havoc Squad's enemy General Arkos Rakton, and the squad barely escaped with the prisoners before the station's destruction.

entities.name: Occupation of Aaloth
entities.description:
During the occupation of the Twi'lek colony on the planet of Aaloth, the Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Quellus, who served as an emissary of the Sith Empire, was dispatched to conquer the world and incorporate it to the Sith dominion within the galaxy. Utilizing the power of the dark side of the Force and his gauntlet, Darth Quellus extinguished all bonfires in the settlements that were previously employed to repel Aaloth's predatory creatures. Additionally he compelled the Twi'lek population to construct a stronghold, thereby solidifying his control and asserting his authority over the planet.

In response to the Sith Lord's oppressive rule, a resistance group emerged and engaged in numerous battles against him. Despite thier efforts, the attack on the stronghold ultimately proved unsuccessful. Compelled to yield to Darth Quellus' authority, the Twi'leks reluctantly returned to their villages. However, hope was reignited when the elder Silana devised pouches containing flammable materials and distribured them to the rebellious Twi'leks. Unfortunately, her actions were discovered, and she was captured with the intention of being executed by Darth Quellus. Learing of this imminent threat, the Twi'leks rallied once more, launching a daring assault on again the stronghold. Their concentrated efforts resulted in a massive fire that forced Darth Quellus to retreat Aaloth, abandoning his hold over the planet.

entities.name: Attack on Aargonar
entities.description:
Around 22 BBY during the Clone Wars, the Galactic Republic attacked the Confederacy of Independent Systems-controlled planet Aargonar. A contingent of clone troopers attacked a newly established Separatist base and killed Mina Bonteri's husband, who had served as an officer in the Confederacy military.

During the the galaxy-wide Clone Wars between the Galactic Republic and Confederacy of Independent Systems, the planet Aargonar was under the control of the Confederacy. The officer also happened to be the husband of Separatist Senator Mina Bonteri, who shared his devotion to the Confederacy. Together, the two had a son named Lux some years before the war.

Around 22 BBY, the first year of the war, the Republic targeted and attacked Aargonar. A contingent of clone troopers attacked the yet to be completed base. Bonteri's husband defended himself and fought with merit, but he was ultimately killed by the clones.

The death of Bonteri's husband left her a widow and Lux without his father. Almost a full year since his passing, only missing the anniversary by one week, the Bonteris were visited by Republic Senator Padmé Amidala, who hoped to reach a diplomatic solution to the war and arrived with Ahsoka Tano, a Jedi Padawan and commander in the Republic Military.

entities.name: Battle of Ab Dalis
entities.description:
The Battle of Ab Dalis was a battle that occurred on Ab Dalis between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire during the Alliance's Operation Starlight. The ISD Ultima II under the command of Admiral Kalaxo trapped the Alliance Eleventh Division on the surface of Ab Dalis. The Rebel Ground Defense Command under Colonel Chouch organized the surface defense against Imperial walkers and tanks. Following Ground Defense Command's destruction, Starlight Squadron arrived and destroyed Ultima II by causing an eruption of the volcano directly below it.

entities.description:
The Ab'Bshingh civil war was a centuries-long war between the Waroot and Farang species of Ab'Bshingh.

When the planet was discovered by the Galactic Empire, the many battles were studied by the Imperial strategist Crat Dakerno, who was sent to subjugate the two races sometime between 19 BBY and 0 BBY. Dakerno used their complex maneuvers to create the board game known as B'shingh.

entities.name: Skirmish at the abandoned Jakku moisture farm
entities.description: A skirmish took place on the desert planet Jakku in and around an abandoned moisture farm between Constable Zuvio of the Niima Outpost and the droid posse of Rikard Lovas. After Lovas used the CZ-series secretary/business communications droid CZ-1G5 to fake the robbery of his own banking starship, CZ-1G5 escaped into the Jakku desert and rendezvoused with other droids. Zuvio was led away from Niima as he tracked the droid in a bid to learn the truth about the robbery. Zuvio ended up destroying several of the droids, including CZ-1G5, and then returned to Niima to arrest Lovas before the banker could murder two other Niima deputies.

entities.name: Destruction of Abek's Station
entities.description:
During the Galactic Civil War, the shadowport known as Abek's Station was destroyed by the Strike-class medium cruiser Ion Storm, under the command of Commander Surlev of the Galactic Empire. Surlev was searching for the mercenary Limna Yith, who had been leaving a trail of blood and destruction throughout the Sisar Run. When he tracked her to the space station, he received approval from Governor Skreeg to destroy it. He did so, but Yith escaped.

entities.name: Battle of Abonshee
entities.description:
A battle took place on the planet Abonshee in 0 ABY during the Galactic Civil War. While the Reekeene's Roughnecks of the Rebel Alliance were discussing an alliance with the leader of the Anointed People of Abonshee, Godking Trisstan, a damaged Imperial shuttle transporting the Governor-General of the Fakir sector landed near the Godking's castle for repairs. The Godking wished to discuss with the Imperials but the stormtroopers escorting the Governor-General got afraid by the mob gathering near the shuttle and opened fire on civilians. Trisstan de facto joined the Rebellion and sent his warriors fight the Imperial troops along with Alliance operatives. The Rebels eventually boarded the shuttle and captured the Governor-General.

entities.name: Raid in the Abrion sector
entities.description:
The Nihil pirate organization led a raid in the Abrion sector during the High Republic Era. The Tycoon Trader, a cargo cruiser, had been shipping glitterstim from Aaloth to the Hutt Cartel. An informer within the Hutt Cartel informed Dowutin Tempest Runner Pan Eyta of a stim shipment in the sector, so he sent his Tempest to raid the ship.

The Nihil pulled the Trader out of hyperspace with a gravity mine, punctured the hull with gas torpedoes, and boarded the ship with a boarding tube. The Nihil's masks protected the marauders from the war cloud they had released. The Trader was protected by the mercenary Lourna Dee, who set up automated defenses aboard the ship to combat the Nihil, and sacrificed the pilot droid RL-18 as part of her counter-ambush.

The Storm Jinnix dispatched a boarding party of his crew including the Nikto Towl and an individual named Blackwing, both of whom Dee killed. The droid H7-09 was damaged in the skirmish. Jinnix went to confront Dee, but she defeated him by ripping out one of his fangs and stabbing him with it.

Lourna thought she had won, but Pan Eyta came and took her prisoner. She cut a deal with him to join the Nihil and help conduct a raid on Aaloth. As payment, Lourna joined the Nihil and took possession of Jinnix's former ship, the Toothspike, renaming it the Lourna Dee.

entities.name: Havoc at the Accretion Disco
entities.description:
The Havoc at the Accretion Disco, was a skirmish between 3 ABY and 4 ABY. that broke out on the space station Accretion Disco when assassins of the Nar Kanji group Kanjiklub sought revenge on the Pyke Syndicate gangster Omel Sampak after he ordered a bombing of a Nar Kanji fight school that killed a number of students as they slept. After the bombing, Sampak hired out the Accretion Disco to celebrate his victory, and one of his underlings hired the bounty hunter T'onga and her crew to keep Sampak and his entourage alive as they celebrated.

Once the crew arrived at the station, they were brought before Sampak in a club, who was unimpressed with the crew, particularly Tasu Leech, who the gangster speculated could be a Nar Kanji assassin. After T'onga defended Leech, she pointed out a number of real assassins that had crashed the party. The assassins then opened fire on the Pykes, and T'onga's crew responded by protecting Sampak and his underling, with Bossk putting a table in front of them for cover. T'onga sent 4-LOM and Zuckuss to take out the assassins on the club's upper level, which they successfully did. With the path clear, T'onga had Leech take Sampak and his underling to a safe room. When they arrived at the room, however, they were confronted by a number of assassins. The lead assassin recognized Leech due to his fighting style, that they were both from Nar Kanji, and tried to remind Leech of where his loyalties should lie: with them and not the Pykes. Leech responded that he did not fight for the Pykes, but for his crew and friends, to which the assassin said they were not his real friends and warned Leech that they would eventually turn on him. The assassin then revealed the reason for why the Kanji had tried to kill Sampak: that he had ordered the bombing of a fight school, which killed students as they slept, and asked Leech if he felt that was honor. The assassin then questioned Leech as to what kind of friends would make him side with an individual like Sampak just for money, before finishing that they would be waiting for Leech when he realized that he was wrong, before the assassins left.

With the assassins gone, Sampak praised Leech for stepping up, but Leech instead stabbed and killed Sampak for the bombings. Not long after, T'onga and the rest of the crew made their way to the safe room to collect their payment from Sampak as the last of the assassins were being dealt with by the Pykes, though when they arrived, they discovered what Leech had done. In response, to Leech's killing of Sampak, the Pykes then attempted to kill the crew.

entities.name: Attack on Adelphi
entities.description:
During the High Republic Era, the Nihil marauders attacked Adelphi. The Nihil struck without warning and the Jedi Order was unable to arrive in time to stop them. Three hours after the attack Jedi Master Torban Buck asked a group of Jedi Initiates to watch over a group of children who had been separated from their caregivers. The Initiates decided to take the children to a theater where they watched the holofilm Socorro Jayme and the Starcave of Sharu.

The attack on Adelphi was first mentioned in "Three Younglings & the Snackfrog of Doom," a story included in the comic The High Republic Adventures Phase III Annual, which was published by Dark Horse Comics as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's Phase III. The story was written by Charles Soule and Rosemary Soule.

entities.name: Adumari Civil War
entities.description:
The Adumari Civil War occurred in 13 ABY, and was fought between the dominant nation of Cartann, and a coalition of smaller nations, such as Yedagon. The Civil War had a greater galactic significance because of outside involvement: the Imperial Remnant was supporting Cartann with a detachment from the 181st Imperial Fighter Wing, led by General Turr Phennir. The New Republic was supporting anti-Cartann Adumari coalition, after General Wedge Antilles disobeyed orders and allied Red Flight with Yedagon Confederacy, which persuaded other states to accept the leadership of General Antilles.

The Yedagon Confederacy and its allies was ultimately successful in the Civil War, with the corrupt Perator of Cartann Pekaelic ke Teldan ousted in favor of his son, who was more favorable towards the New Republic.

entities.name: Mutiny on the Advent
entities.description:
The mutiny on the Advent was an incident that occurred in 48 BBY aboard the Advent, a cargo freighter tasked with delivering food to a famine stricken star system. During the mutiny, the head Jedi in charge of protecting the ship, Rael Averross, decided to confront the mutineers alongside his Padawan Nim Pianna in the cargo bay of the Advent as opposed to following normal procedure and retaking control of the bridge of the ship. The skirmish in the cargo bay between the mutineers and the two Jedi resulted in Pianna's death when she was hit by a slicer dart which caused her to briefly turn on her Master, forcing him to kill her with his lightsaber.

By the end of the mutiny, all mutineers were either defeated or arrested. Upon return to the Jedi Temple on Coruscant, Averross was put on trial by the Jedi High Council who ruled that his actions were necessary to save the lives of the passengers of the Advent. After the trial, Averross was sent on an eight year assignment to mentor the planet's Princess Fanry, an assignment which he put all his energy in to to atone for his apprentice's death.

The mutiny on the Advent first appeared in a hologram in Master & Apprentice, a 2019 novel written by Claudia Gray.

entities.name: Battle of Aguarl 3
entities.description:
The Battle of Aguarl 3 was a brief engagement of the Galactic Civil War approximately six months after the Battle of Yavin, in which a wing of TIE bombers struck at a sub-aquatic Rebel base on Aguarl 3.

Following intelligence provided by a Quarren spy, the Imperial Star Destroyer Ravagor swiftly deployed a wing of TIE/sa Bombers to destroy the Rebel base hidden under the seas of Aguarl 3. Assigned to the task were the pilots, Willks, Rawst, Parrot and Ranulf Trommer.

The Rebel Base under command of Leia Organa quickly detected the fighter squadron, activating the Rebel anti-air emplacements. The mines swiftly destroyed all but one target, the bomber piloted by Ranulf Trommer. Although his craft had sustained damage, Trommer successfully launched three concussion missiles, striking the base's launch bay and flooding the facility, forcing the Rebels to evacuate.

Returning to the Ravagor, Trommer and his smoking ship were recovered by the Star Destroyer's tractor beam and brought to the flight deck. Imperial Firefighting droids hosed down the craft and recovered the critically injured Trommer, rushing him to surgery and saving his life at the cost of his leg. Disgusted by his cybernetic replacement, Trommer endeavored to hide it in his return to service, seeing it as dishonorable.

entities.description:
An attack was carried out on the Mid Rim world of Ahn Krantarium by Imperial forces led by Governor Ahr and Darth Vader, which happened during the early days of the Galactic Empire. The aim was to destroy deadly droids that had overrun the world long before the Imperial Era. The droids had rebuilt themselves to be more dangerous than regular security droids. Ahr sent out a stormtrooper patrol, but all of them perished, so instead of sending out more to die for nothing, the Governor sent out Darth Vader. The Sith Lord destroyed all of the droids in the vicinity, surprising Ahr.

entities.description:
The Battle of Akoshissss took place during the Clone Wars on the Trandoshan moon of Akoshissss. The main point of the battle was to destroy Bitt Panith's secret base that was located on the moon. There were three divisions in the battle plan: one to lead the battle and destroy the deflector shield generator, one to infiltrate the base once the shield was down, set charges inside, and destroy it, and one person who would go to Trandosha and persuade the locals not to get mixed up in the conflict. In the end, the Galactic Republic won the battle and the base was destroyed.

entities.name: Skirmish aboard the Albedo Brave
entities.description:
A skirmish broke out on Jedi General Jaro Tapal's Venator-class Star Destroyer during the final days of the Clone Wars, when the clone troopers in his unit, the 13th Battalion, received Order 66 from Supreme Chancellor Sheev Palpatine. The soldiers that had served under Tapal's command during the successful campaign on the planet Bracca suddenly turned against their Jedi officers, attempting to kill the Jedi Master and his young apprentice, Cal Kestis.

Tapal, in the middle of briefing his Padawan about the upcoming move to Mygeeto, sensed the mass murder of Jedi through the Force just as the Clone Commander of the unit received the order and attempted to carry it out, only for Tapal to quickly kill him with his double-bladed lightsaber. Though Kestis was unable to comprehend what was happening, Tapal quicky devised a plan for them to escape the cruiser via the escape pods; the smaller Kestis would take the maintenance tunnels to the escape pod bay whilst Tapal sealed the internal blast doors and distracted the clone troopers before meeting him there, though Kestis was to depart without his master if he had not made it there by then. The two Jedi then split up, Tapal heading to the Star Destroyer's reactor and overloading them in order to ensure its destruction and mask their escape. Both Jedi were confronted and engaged by clones at several points but whilst Tapal was able to kill multiple squads with relative ease, Kestis was overwhelmed and lost his lightsaber in the ship's turbolift shaft when it was shot out of his hand and fell to the bottom of the shaft. Kestis was nonetheless still able to help his master by opening several doors in his path, but a large number of clones caught up to them just as they were attempting to access an escape pod. Tapal did his best to protect his defenceless Padawan from the clones but was overwhelmed and struck multiple times by blasterfire, with one bolt striking the hilt of his lightsaber and sundering it in half. Kestis put himself between the clones and his wounded master and was wounded himself, but managed to use the Force to slow the clones enough for both Jedi to board the escape pod and launch from the cruiser, bound for Bracca.

Onboard the escape pod, Tapal's wounds were revealed to be fatal; with his last breath he informed Kestis of his sabotage, warned him of the war to come and implored him to await the Jedi Council's signal and trust only in the Force. Tapal then entrusted his broken lightsaber to Kestis before breathing his last just as the Albedo Brave exploded as a result of Tapal's sabotage to its reactor, taking the remainder of the 13th Battalion with it.

entities.name: Battle of Allst Prime
entities.description:
At some point between 2 BBY and 1 BBY but before the battle on Vir Aphshire, a battle took place between the Rebel Alliance's 61st Mobile Infantry led by Captain Micha Evon and the Galactic Empire's forces on Allst Prime led by Governor Magé. In the midst of the battle, the Forward Air Control Officer Cait was killed when directing the 61st's X-Wings and Evon had to take her place. At the same time 61st Soldier Brand rescued Lylee Anaraku from an AT-ST. Brand was distracted by Evon, standing over Cait's body and shouting orders into her comm, when Anaraku was taken down by an Imperial. Brand killed the Imperial and went to Anaraku's aid. Later in the battle Brand and Evon stormed into the governor's office and Brand stunned Magé. Brand then pointed her gun at Evon as she a had taken a bounty on him. Evon revealed what he knew about her past and convinced her to stay with the 61st and abandon her old life as a bounty hunter.

In 14,450 BBY, the famed Alsakan Mosaics found in the city of Rucapar on Alsakan were destroyed during the Cleansing of Rucapar.

Another faction, the Machinists of Nikato, defeated the rival Duros Red Credit Brigade and then established an independent pocket state known as the Nikato's Bootheel on Raxus Prime in 14,300 BBY.

entities.name: Battle of Amaltanna
entities.description:
The Battle of Amaltanna was a battle between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars on the planet Amaltanna. In the end, the Republic triumphed over the Separatists, but the extent of the damage was so severe that its inhabitants were relocated as refugees to worlds such as Naboo and Alderaan.

The Battle of Amaltanna appeared in "Galactic Tales: The Failing of the Light," a short story by Adam Lance Garcia that was published in issue 233 of Star Wars Insider magazine The battle originated in the Star Wars Legends continuity and appeared in the comic story "Impregnable," which was released on January 31, 2007, as part of Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 7. In the story, the battle was a bloody affair that occurred six months into the Clone Wars and saw conflict between the clone troopers of Jedi General Bultar Swan and the battle droids of who commanded the battle from a seemingly impregnable fortress.

Garcia intended for the canon battle to have started early in the Clone War, yet he decided against outright confirming as such in "The Failing of the Light" to give other Lucasfilm creatives a chance to determine its exact timeframe. On August 2, Garcia teased that the story would feature "several events from both Legends and Canon" from a specific perspective, all without spoiling what those events were. After release, Garcia expressed joy to see story elements from "The Failing of the Light" receive their own pages in the Wookieepedia fan encyclopedia, including the canonized Battle of Amaltanna.

entities.name: Assassination attempt on the ambassadors
entities.description:
In 382 BBY, an assassination attempt was conducted on Eirami Ambassador Lian Cerox and E'roni Ambassador Tintak while a peace summit was being held on the moon Jedha between their warring planets, Eiram and E'ronoh. Bombs were planted by the Brotherhood of the Ninth Door at the direction of Tilson Graf near Cerox's quarters at the Second Spire and Tintak's shuttle. Cerox was protected by Jedi Master Creighton Sun and Tintak was protected by Jedi Knight Aida Forte, but Tintak lost his left hand and his pilot was killed, and Cerox was still severely injured and taken to a temporary medical station by Sun.

The native Aqualish began to destroy droids to appease the invaders. In Imthitill, droids were exterminated all over the city using a massive fire but Jedi Knight Dorsk 82 intended to leave the planet with thirty-eight droids. He was then killed when his starship was shot down upon takeoff by security officers. Nevertheless this was ignored by Warmaster Tsavong Lah and an invasion and occupation of their planet ensued.

entities.name: Ambush in the Anoat sector
entities.description:
In the hours following the Battle of Endor, the TIE fighters and TIE strikers from the forces of Moff Ubrik Adelhard ambushed a Rebel Alliance squadron that had entered the Anoat sector.

In 4 ABY, Galactic Emperor Sheev Palpatine, the ruler of the of the Galactic Empire, lured the Alliance to Restore the Republic into a trap over the forest moon of Endor to destroy the rebellion once and for all using the firepower of the DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station as well as the Imperial Navy's Moddell sector fleet and Death Squadron. However, despite the odds being stacked against them, the Rebel Alliance emerged victorious from the decisive battle of Endor, with the DS-2 Mobile Battle Station being destroyed, and with it, Emperor Palpatine and his right hand man Darth Vader, as the Rebel Alliance began the process to reform themselves as the New Republic.

hours after their victory over Endor, a squadron including Rebel pilots Rynn Zenat, Preeti Delmin, and Eiro were assigned to attack Imperial forces in the Anoat sector. After the Rebel squadron engaged TIE/ln space superiority starfighters, over Darlyn Boda, the Imperial forces appeared to go on the run , making the pilots believe the tide was turning in their favor. However, a swarm Imperial TIE strikers soon arrived and began opening fire, catching the rebel squadron off guard. As a result, the rebel squadron split, with Rynn piloting her B-wing heavy assault starfighter in one direction to draw the TIE strikers away, while the other rebels went in another direction.

However, systems in Rynn's B-wing began failing from blaster damage, causing Rynn to request backup from the rest of the squadron and report to Preeti that her ship loosing power, she was trying to gain altitude, and that the TIE strikers were closing in. However, Preeti informed Rynn that the Imperial forces had formed a perimeter around the sector and were closing in on the rest of the squadron. Left with no other options as TIE strikers closed in, Rynn turned her B-wing towards the TIE strikers, damaging one of the fighters and knocking the wing off another, before ejecting the ship's cockpit from the rest of the ship and escaping to Endor. Meanwhile, the rest of the squadron was shot down over Darlyn Boda.

entities.name: Battle of Antamont
entities.description:
The Battle of Antamont occurred on the planet of Antamont during the Clone Wars, and was fought between the Grand Army of the Republic and the Separatist Droid Army.

Antamont, an nonindustrial, green planet covered in mountains, was the site of a Galactic Republic stronghold during the Clone Wars. Separatist forces targeted the base, and sent hordes of B1-series battle droids, grapple droids, dwarf spider droids, and Hailfire droids through the mountains toward the base. The path was littered with Republic landmines, which caused much damage to the onrushing droid forces.

The CIS and Republic eventually clashed in a valley. As their infantry approached each other, each side began firing missiles at each other. Though the majority of the battle was conducting with infantry and land vehicles, atmospheric combat between each force also occurred.

The battle left many destroyed battle droids strewn all over Antamont, which were often found by local farmers. One such droid, who had deserted the battle, was found in working condition and brought back to a ranch by two farmers.

entities.name: Antar 4 schism
entities.description:
During the Separatist Crisis, the moon of Antar 4 was embroiled in a schism between the pro-Galactic Republic loyalists and those who wished to align with the Confederacy of Independent Systems, including the Gotal Assembly for Separation and its radical splinter group, the Roshu Sune. Despite a protracted terrorist bombing campaign mounted by the Roshu Sune, the loyalists were able to retain power until the First Battle of Geonosis, the first conflict of the Clone Wars, after which the moon fell to the Separatists. It remained in Separatist control until the end of the Clone Wars, after which the Galactic Empire—which the Republic had been transformed into at the end of the war—carried out mass arrests and executions on Antar 4. This event was known as the Antar Atrocity.

Star Wars Propaganda: A History of Persuasive Art in the Galaxy

entities.description:
The battle on Aq Vetina was a conflict during the time of the Clone Wars that saw the Confederacy of Independent Systems a planet of humans. The civilians of the settlement were slaughtered by the droid forces of the Separatists, including B2-series super battle droids and HMP droid gunships. During the attack, a number of Mandalorian warriors of Death Watch intervened, fighting back against the battle droids. The young Din Djarin, whose parents were killed in the attack, was rescued by a Mandalorian warrior and taken in as a foundling. Djarin often thought back on the battle during his adult life.

entities.name: Skirmish on Argai Minor
entities.description:
The Skirmish on Argai Minor was a conflict between the New Republic and remnants of the Galactic Empire sometime after the Battle of Endor. Imperials operated from the Treinhaus Citadel, which the New Republic attacked with ground forces as well as air support from General Hera Syndulla's battle group's Vanguard Squadron and eventually Meteor Squadron and Hail Squadron. After days of brutal fighting, including orbital bombardment and precision strikes from Syndulla's fleet, the Treinhaus Citadel was heavily damaged, missing most of the eastern wall. Alphabet Squadron was sent in to patrol the battlefields surrounding the now ruined Treinhaus Citadel to prevent Imperials from retaking the citadel while New Republic salvage teams attempted to recover data. Alphabet Squadron defended the citadel for sixteen hours, flying over the wreckage of speeders, troop carriers, walkers, and other vehicles to fend off infantry units, TIE fighters, and TIE/sa bombers. After hours of patrols, the data was recovered and the New Republic forces returned to their ships.

entities.name: Battle of Argul
entities.description:
The Battle of Argul was a battle fought during the early years of the Clone Wars.

The Confederacy of Independent Systems blockaded the planet of Argul and forced its people to surrender to them. The Galactic Republic responded by sending clone troopers to recapture the world. However, they soon began to lose ground and the planet's cities became the sites for much bloody fighting. The Republic began an evacuation of the cities, while at the same time being forced to fall back. Jedi Master Yoda had been participating in the battle and he left to try and find reinforcements. While he was gone, the Separatist Commander Drogen Hosh, who was commanding their forces there, moved his troops in position for a final assault, and he sent an offer to a group of Jedi Padawans to let them surrender to him. However, soon after, Yoda arrived with reinforcements, turning the tide of the battle in the Republic's favor.

entities.description:
In 0 ABY, Imperial stormtroopers made an attack on a small Chubbit encampment being used by a Rebel gunrunner to sell arms to the Chubbit resistance. The Human gunrunner and his Chubbit allies attempted to flee, but their escape was only made possible when a man attacked the Imperial forces with a lightsaber. The Chubbit resistance fighters and their guest escaped, and the man introduced himself as Obi-Wan Kenobi. Nevertheless, he was actually an imposter working for Darth Vader.

entities.name: Slaughter of the Ascendant
entities.description:
Centuries before 4 ABY Bar'leth that housed the Spark Eternal, a sentient piece of technology created by the Ascendant that granted the user enormous power for the price of their life. The Sith sought the Spark Eternal, but an Ascendant cultist named Miril used the Spark to telekinetically stab many of the Sith with their own lightsabers. However Miril was still overcome by them, and gave her life to seal the Spark Eternal away and prevent the Sith from retrieving it. and were all killed by the Sith.

Sometime between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, archaeologist Doctor Chelli Lona Aphra discovered the Spark Eternal and was possessed by it, which allowed her to reach into the Spark's memories to see and learn about the slaughter and defeat of the Ascendant.

entities.name: Battle of Ashas Ree
entities.description:
The Battle of Ashas Ree was a conflict of the Great Galactic War, waged around 3660 BBY. After failed attacks on the Sith planets of Korriban and Ziost, the forces of the Galactic Republic, under the command of Jedi Master Ven Zallow, launched an attack on the Ashas Ree—a world in the heart of Sith Empire territory. The planet was defended by the Imperial Navy and Army under the command of Darth Angral and Darth Malgus. Despite the tenacity of Master Zallow and his Republic Military forces, the Jedi and his comrades lost the battle and were forced to fall back to Serenno.

Daniel Wallace, author of Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side, originally planned for the attack on Ashas Ree to be an assault on the Imperial capital of Dromund Kaas, but his first draft was vetoed by LucasArts.

Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side

entities.name: Battle of Asteroid 426
entities.description:
The Battle of Asteroid 426 took place during the Clone Wars.

In order for Count Dooku's plan of invading the volcanic planet of Sarapin, the CIS needed to destroy the primary planetary defense grid in the asteroid maze.

Arriving with the Separatist forces, General Sev'rance Tann was instructed by Dooku to fight through the asteroid field and Republic grid defenses to Asteroid 426, located outside of Sarapin in the planet's ring. It wasn't easy as the field was filled with Heavy Anti-Air turrets, which would destroy the fighters and the rest of the force very quickly. Fortunately with Confederacy cruisers, which were brought to assist Tann, she was able to slowly make way to the asteroid with facing a little resistance from the Republic fighters. Eventually making it to the asteroid, she destroyed the supply depots, so she could get enough resources to set up a base on it. Meanwhile the Republic troops stationed on the asteroid led periodic attacks to the enemy base, though it didn't faze them at all. Then, after gathering enough troops, she devastated the rest of the Republic forces and destroyed the power relay to Sarapin's shield.

Following the collapse of the planetary shield at the hands of the Confederacy, Sarapin was then left for the taking.

entities.name: Capture of the Ataraxia
entities.description:
In 228 BBY, the Star Cruiser Ataraxia was captured from Lourna Dee by Jedi Master Keeve Trennis with support from Republic Defense Coalition and Hutt Clan forces. Following a battle on Ballum, in which Skarabda the Hutt learned that Dee killed her sister Myarga, Skarabda ordered Dee eliminated and entered an alliance with the Republic and Jedi. In the space above Ballum, Dee attempted to flee with the Ataraxia, which she named the Lourna Dee, as the combined forces pursued. Trennis managed to breach the Ataraxia hull, where she had to fight various droids sent by Dee. Meanwhile, RDC Commander Velko Jahen used the Longbeam cruiser Gios tractor beam to hold the Ataraxia in place. Dee countered this by straining the ship's engines and dumping crates filled with civilians into the path of the tractor beam, forcing Jahen to turn it off. Jedi Ai-Dan Yelooc used the Force to direct the loose crates of people into the Gios for medical care. Following a confrontation in the Ataraxia bridge, Trennis stunned Dee, captured her, and secured control of the Ataraxia. She was soon joined by Kotabi bond-twins Terec and Ceret on the ship to lead an unsanctioned rescue mission into the Nihil Occlusion Zone.

As a result of the Azzameen family's actions against the Galactic Empire and the Imperial-aligned trading company Viraxo Industries, a competitor to the Azzameens' Twin Suns Transport Services trading company, the Galactic Empire issued warrants for the arrest of the members of the Azzameen family as well as the seizure of all Azzameen property. In 228 BBY, a battle on Banchii occurred when the Nihil, led by Minister of Advancement Baron Boolan attacked the planet Banchii. Boolan initially traveled there in hopes of recruiting the various Jedi there, including Jedi Knights Lily Tora-Asi and Reath Silas, fallen Jedi Azlin Rell, and Jedi Masters Savina Besatrix Malagán and Arkoff for his experiments, with the promise that he would not harm the people of Banchii if they complied. When the Jedi in charge, Tora-Asi, refused, Boolan sent his horde of Nihil pirates to attack the planet and the Jedi. As Tora-Asi fought the Nihil, the plants of the planet began to attack them too, as members of the Drengir species had triggered the plant life to protect Tora-Asi in their stead after the Jedi helped them flee Banchii.

As the Baron started to flee, not believing he could win the battle, he released Nameless creatures, which preyed on Force-sensitives such as the Jedi and inhibited them with only their presence. However, the Jedi were assisted by a large group of non-Force-sensitive Banchii natives as well as a group of Banchiians led by Shosho, a Nihil defector named Maktan Plynt, and Malagán's friend Dexter Jettster, who defeated the Nameless. Meanwhile, Boolan made one final plea to Rell to join him and study the Nameless, but Rell refused and chose to protect Jedi Initiates Viv'Nia Nia'Viv and Nima Allets instead. With the Nameless defeated, the Jedi drove the Nihil away, winning the battle and successfully protecting the planet.

entities.name: Skirmish on Banchii
entities.description:
Between 230 BBY and 229 BBY, a skirmish occurred on the planet Banchii after the Nihil pirates, assisted by the Harch bounty hunter Vol Garat, excavated Banchii's Jedi temple. They found the modified ZZ-model droid ZZ-10, who was protecting the journal of former Jedi Azlin Rell. ZZ-10 fought back against the Nihil and defeated them, but was unable to defeat Garat. However, ZZ-10 was able to secretly send a message to Jedi Master Arkoff. ZZ-10 prepared to self-destruct to stop Garat from capturing the journal, but Arkoff arrived in time to rescue the droid, and was fought Garat, killing him. Shortly after, Jedi Master Savina Besatrix Malagán arrived to help, but the fighting had already ended.

During the Yuuzhan Vong War, Barab I was captured by the Yuuzhan Vong. A significant number of the native inhabitants, the Barabels, were captured and placed into a slaving ship. At this point, Jedi Knight Saba Sebatyne arrived in-system. Believing her people have been murdered, as revenge she saw bloated balloon like ship she never saw before escorted by coralskippers. She first took care of coralskippers then fired her three remaining proton torpedoes into the big Yuuzhan Vong starship, rupturing it. Barabel bodies spewed out into the vacuum of space.

entities.name: Fight on a barren moon
entities.description:
The fight on a barren moon was a lightsaber duel fought between Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi and Dark Lord of the Sith Darth Vader on a barren moon, during the Great Jedi Purge.

The Jedi Master had lured the Sith Lord to the moon in a bid to give the Hidden Path time to escape. Kenobi confronted Vader not far from the Dark Lord's landing site. His former apprentice asked if he was ready to finish their battle to which Kenobi ignited his lightsaber and reaffirmed his resolve, assuming a classic defensive stance. The Sith Lord replied with murderous intent before igniting his own saber and striking the first blow.

Both Jedi and Sith initially fought evenly against each other with Vader's strikes, slashes, lunges, and ripostes met by Kenobi's blocks, parries, dodges, and counterstrikes. Kenobi soon sought to end the duel by landing two strong, sudden blows on Vader's blade to knock the Dark Lord off-balance and telekinetically dislodge a nearby pillar on top of him but Vader caught it with his own abilities. The Sith Lord acknowledged that his former master had lost none of his power but quickly boasted he was still no match for him. Vader swiftly proceeded to gain the upper hand, pummeling Kenobi with lightsaber strikes, force-guided boulders, and his own armored fist before using his power to collapse the ground beneath him and bury him alive by collapsing the stone columns around them. Declaring his victory, the Sith Lord turned and left for his shuttle.

Kenobi had survived but was slowly being crushed by the combined weight of the rubble and his own guilt. However, thoughts of his young charges allowed him to put his feelings aside and find the strength he needed to blast himself free before setting off to re-engage the Dark Lord. He caught Vader before he reached his shuttle, attempting to cut him down from behind only to meet the Sith Lord's blade instead.

entities.name: Assault on Base Prime
entities.description:
The Assault on Base Prime was an attack by the New Jedi Order against the Columi brothers, Craitheus and Marvid Qreph to rescue Han Solo and prevent the brothers from gaining access to a monolith on which Base Prime had been built.

In 45 ABY, the Columi brothers, Craitheus and Marvid Qreph had discovered an unidentified monolith at the heart of the Chiloon Rift. They built a fortress, Base Prime on the monolith above a Space–time-warping gate which granted access to the monolith. Upon study of the monolith, they discovered that it had the ability to grant those that entered the powers of the Force. To keep anyone else from interfering in their plans for the monolith, they organized a hostile takeover of the Chiloon Rift through dirty business dealings. These dealings brought them into conflict with the New Jedi Order, and as the conflict escalated, the Qrephs captured Han Solo, a friend of the Jedi. Solo was brought to Base Prime and tortured as the Qrephs prepared to enter the monolith. However, before they could enter, the Jedi discovered the monolith and prepared an assault to rescue Solo and stop the Qrephs.

The Qrephs were protecting their base with the biotically created species, the Nargons. To lead their forces, they had hired Mandalorian warriors led by Mirta Gev. However, when the Jedi arrived to attack the base, the Qrephs' Force-sensitive agent, Vestara Khai, under the alias of Savannah Raine, coerced the brothers into letting her lead the defense. However, Vestara had not predicted the speed of the Jedi attack or their use of YVH-Series battle droids. The Jedi easily breached the base, and Raine was forced to call a retreat. She evacuated the Qrephs through their residence to escape the advancing Jedi, but the maneuver resulted in the severe wounding of Craitheus. Marvid, fed up with Vestara's meddling in their affairs, betrayed his agent, shooting her in the legs and made his way to the gate to access the monolith.

Mirta Gev, realizing the battle was lost, agreed to help Vestara escape Base Prime in her ship, the Sith Meditation Sphere, Ship, leaving the Qreph brothers to fend off the Jedi on their own. She ordered her Mandalorians to abandon the Nargons and escape. As the Jedi took over the base, Vestara and Gev used Ship to escape. Ben Skywalker, who was leading the Jedi force, searched the base for Vestara and Gev, but was unable to find them. The battle won, Base Prime was destroyed by the Jedi and the monolith cordoned off from further interactions.

entities.name: Begali Uprising
entities.description:
The Begali Uprising, also known as the Bengali Uprising, was an uprising led by the world Begali against the Echani Command, the female council that governed a confederation of six Echani-dominated planets known as the Six Sisters that began in the year 1154 BBY. Begali was joined in revolt by the Thyrsians, an Echani subspecies from the planet Thyrsus, another of the Six Sisters.

Though the uprising nominally ended with the return of Begali to the Six Sisters less than a century later, hostility between the Thyrsians and Echani Command continued until the Pact of Almera in 899 BBY recognized Thyrsian independence.

The Begali Uprising was most well-known as being the event that introduced the use of force pikes to galactic warfare.

entities.name: Battle of Belazura
entities.description:
This battle on the planet Belazura occurred as a result of the machinations of the Galactic Empire Commander Rezi Soresh. His previous attempts to kill the Rebel Alliance pilot who destroyed the Death Star failed, so Soresh recalled his personal assassin, X-7. The Rebels tracked him to Belazura. Using the mercenary Div, the Rebels tried to turn X-7. X-7 was torn between his master and his new friends. In the battle to destroy the Imperial garrison on Belazura, Soresh ambushed the Rebels. The former Jedi Ferus Olin was forced to kill X-7, but the garrison was destroyed. Imperial leader Darth Vader demanded Soresh's arrest for his failure, but Soresh escaped into exile.

Ambitious Imperial Commander Rezi Soresh, an important figure in the bureaucracy, used his personal assassin X-7 to hunt down the Rebel Alliance pilot who destroyed the Imperial superweapon, the Death Star. Previous attempts to kill the Rebel pilot failed, so Soresh recalled X-7 to Belazura for reconditioning.

During the attempt, X-7 had hired mercenaries to assist him; one of them, Div, was captured by Skywalker. Div was subsequently sprung from the his prison by unknown forces. Skywalker and his companions tracked down Div to Belazura with the help of a former Jedi Padawan and Div's former mentor, Ferus Olin.

The Rebels recaptured Div and used him in a plot to turn X-7 to their side; Div acted that X-7 was in reality Div s "brother," Trever Flume. The Rebels also planned to destroy the Imperial Garrison on Belazura to liberate the planet. Soresh calculated the Rebel's plan and tried to ambush them.

entities.name: Attack on Belsavis
entities.description:
The attack on Belsavis was a small assault on the Plawal Rift region of the planet Belsavis in 18 BBY. The Plawal Rift was the location of a small enclave of Jedi refugees, mainly children, looked after by the Ho'Din Jedi Master Plett in the wake of Order 66. After Emperor Palpatine learned of the enclave, he commissioned the battlemoon Eye of Palpatine to destroy it. However, the battlemoon was disabled in the Moonflower Nebula by Jedi Knights Callista Masana and Geith Eris. A wing of Imperial starfighters subsequently assaulted the enclave, but the refugees managed to escape as they were forewarned of the coming danger.

The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons

A shootout occurred at BG-RT's Tavern and Spirits sometime during the Imperial Era, where several bounty hunters attempted to eliminate cyborg human Beilert Valance. Prior to the shootout, bounty hunter Xonr entered the cantina and tracked down Valance with the intent to kill him for breaking the Bounty Hunter Code and stealing bounties from him, alongside several other bounty hunters. In reality, Valance had lured all of them to the cantina. He began the shootout by killing Xonr first, then proceeded to kill every bounty hunter in the vicinity. After the shootout, Valance and the cantina's patrons raised a glass.

entities.name: Raid on the Black Sun's clinic
entities.description:
In around 3643 BBY, Coruscant Security Force officer Stansun tasked an agent of the Galactic Republic with raiding a clinic being operated by the criminal Black Sun on the planet Coruscant. The clinic was being used to surgical alter the faces of wanted criminals to help them escape arrest, and Stansun wanted for it to be shut down and for a list of its previous patients so they could be tracked down.

The agent successfully located a passkey for the clinic and then entered the structure, killing at least eight of the Human and droid medical personnel working inside and shutting the facility down. The agent then recovered the patient list from the structure's computers and returned it to Stansun.

Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide

entities.name: Firefight on Bogden's moons
entities.description:
The Firefight on Bogden's moons was a skirmish between Boba Fett and a fake security trooper.

The skirmish began when the Honest Gjon and Aia provoked the young Boba Fett into helping steal counterfeit money. The money itself was being transported between Bogg 2 and Bogg 9, the plan was to catch the balloon carrying the money, with Boba as the pilot of the thieves' craft.

The plan was a success at first, with two balloons captured; however, the third balloon was guarded by a security trooper (who was as fake as the money) who attempted to stop the thieves. The trooper went inside the thieves' ship and attempted to control the crew; however, Boba dazed the trooper by igniting the ship's engines, and the trooper was then shoved out of the ship by the crew.

As it turned out, the trooper had really been a hijacker.

entities.name: Search for Boolan and Sskeer
entities.description:
In 228 BBY, Jedi Masters Keeve Trennis and Avar Kriss, alongside bounty hunter and former Nihil pirate Lourna Dee, spearheaded a search for ailing Jedi Master Sskeer and Nihil Minister of Advancement Baron Boolan after the two were captured by Muglan Tarantyne's crew and brought into the custody of Eye of the Nihil Marchion Ro on the planet Heiklet. However, Sskeer and Boolan eventually escaped Heiklet on their own and traveled to Boolan's former home on the planet Dalna. There, they were recovered by the Jedi and brought to the planet Protobranch for medical attention, and so that Boolan could help the Galactic Republic researchers there find a solution for the mysterious blight spreading across the galaxy. However, Ro and the Nihil pursued Sskeer and Boolan to Protobranch, where Dee dueled and bested Ro, who warned that Boolan had created a virus that would kill all life and was pretending it was a cure for the blight. With Dee's warning, the Jedi and the Republic were able to contain the virus, provide an antidote to those already infected, and arrest Boolan.

entities.name: Bounty Hunter Wars
entities.description:
The Bounty Hunter Wars was a series of inner conflicts between the members of the Bounty Hunters' Guild. It began by Prince Xizor urging Palpatine to destroy the guild in order to benefit his struggle for power. After accepting Xizor's idea, Palpatine sent Boba Fett to join the Bounty Hunters' Guild, at the time under the leadership of Cradossk.

After several missions in which Boba Fett prevailed, the members started turning against each other. Soon, the Bounty Hunters' Guild was split into the True Guild and the Guild Reform Committee. Not satisfied with the results, Xizor, once again, persuaded Palpatine to follow his plan. This time, Xizor had Palpatine place a huge bounty on Trhin Voss'on't's head. Supposedly, Trhin had killed everyone aboard his Star Destroyer, evacuated himself with a huge sum of money, and gone into hiding. All of the bounty hunters took up the job, and greed killed most of them off; or, at least, destroyed the remaining factions of the Bounty Hunters' Guild.

entities.name: War of the Bounty Hunters
entities.description:
The War of the Bounty Hunters was a major conflict across the galaxy's underworld kicked off when crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure, believing bounty hunter Boba Fett had betrayed him by selling the carbon-frozen Han Solo to another faction, placed a hit out on the In reality, the Crimson Dawn criminal syndicate, under Solo's former lover Qi'ra, had stolen the smuggler from Fett on the crime moon Nar Shaddaa. Because Solo had become important to numerous galactic factions, they hoped to use him to lure the major powers together as a reveal of the return of Crimson Dawn. On Nar Shaddaa, Fett was attacked by bounty hunters 4-LOM and Zuckuss, but he dispatched both and used 4-LOM's head to learn about the bounty. Qi'ra invited various powers to the Jekara system aboard the Vermillion for an auction for Han Solo. The Galactic Empire, Alliance to Restore the Republic, and numerous criminal syndicates gathered.

Fett also followed and defeated fellow hunter Bossk'wassak'Cradossk outside the Vermillion. At the auction, Jabba won with a bid of one million credits before the Sith Lord Darth Vader entered and demanded Solo for himself to draw out his son, Commander Luke Skywalker of the Rebel Alliance. When Qi'ra refused, she had a brief duel with Vader before he ordered Solo take back to his flagship, the Executor. Jabba accepted the loss and returned to his palace on Tatooine. However, secretly following the orders of Qi'ra, the Hutt leader Bokku rallied the remaining members of the Grand Hutt Council to attack the Executor to reclaim their prize. In the chaos, rebel agents under Solo's love Leia Organa attempted to reclaim Solo, as did Fett. Helped by fellow bounty hunter Beilert Valance, Fett was successful and delivered Solo to Jabba on Tatooine. Meanwhile, Vader boarded the war barge of the Hutt Council and slaughtered the council to end the attack.

Left for dead by Fett, and 4-LOM joined T'onga's crew.

Star Wars: The Secrets of the Bounty Hunters

entities.description:
In 9 ABY, an attack was launched on the planet Bpfassh, along with two other nearby star systems in the Sluis sector, by Grand Admiral Thrawn to lure the New Republic Defense Fleet to Bpfassh. Thrawn hoped that, by luring the fleet to one central area, he could steal the unguarded derelict capital ships located at Sluis Van with mole miners stolen from Lando Calrissian's mining operation on Nkllon.

Thrawn's maneuvers did lure the New Republic towards a dead end, and the Empire attacked the Sluis Van shipyards, after stealing the mole miners. However, this attack was thwarted.

entities.name: Attempted kidnapping of Bragh
entities.description:
Several months into the blockade of the Anoat sector by the Galactic Empire, the Uprising plotted to kidnap Commander Bragh, leader of the Purge Troopers and right-hand-man of the Imperial Governor Ubrik Adelhard.

Having leaked that Riley and her sibling the Smuggler, two young scoundrels with an Imperial death mark on their heads, were hiding on the planet Anoat, the Uprising wanted to attract Bragh in the middle of Anoat's ruined city. As soon as the commander would have set a foot on Anoat, the Smuggler and the Kouhun assassins led by Deathstick would ambush him, while several throneships of the Noble Court would keep his Imperial-class Star Destroyer at bay in orbit.

However, the kidnapping attempt was doomed from the outset, as Riley warned the Empire of the upcoming trap. Thinking that capturing Bragh would never convince Governor Adhelard to lift her and her sibling's death mark, she sabotaged the operation in hopes that the Empire would turn a blind eye on them if they turned over the Nobles and the Kouhun. Ultimately, Bragh never showed up on the surface of Anoat in person, and his Star Destroyer managed to overpower the Throneships. Her Majesty, leader of the Nobles, was captured by the Imperials, and so was the assassin Loathe. The captured members of the Uprising were taken to an Imperial penitentiary known as the Crypt.

Category:Battles of Anoat Category:Battles of the Iron Blockade

entities.name: Conflict on Bri'n
entities.description:
By 37 BBY, the conflict on Bri'n had arisen between the Metal Clan and the people of Mistress Th'er, the priestess of wood. The Jedi Order sent Qui-Gon Jinn and his Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi to the planet in 37 BBY. The leader of the Metal Clan attempted to capture Th'er so that either her word or her blood could be used to destroy her trees. Surrounded by forces of the Metal Clan, Jinn chose to escape with Mistress Th'er in an Eta-class shuttle and return to Coruscant. After seeking guidance from the Force, Jinn met with Th'er, suggesting that she recruit allies to her cause to help fight against the Metal Clan.
