entities.name: Skirmish in the Dathomiri rainforest
entities.description:
This skirmish took place in 43.5 ABY in the rainforest of the planet Dathomir. Luke and Ben Skywalker traveled to the planet in search of the Sith apprentice Vestara Khai, while Han and Leia Solo traveled there to find the Skywalkers. At the Dathomir Spaceport, the Solos enlisted a group of guides to help lead them through the rainforest, consisting of Tarth Vames, Carrack, Yliri Consta, the Force-sensitive Dyon Stadd, and the former Dathomiri Witch Tribeless Sha.

Meanwhile, the Raining Leaves Clan was preparing for a conclave with the Broken Columns Clan. On their search for Khai, the Skywalkers began to trespass on the land that was to be held for the gathering, and the Raining Leaves Clan leader, Kaminne Sihn, attacked them several times in an attempt to deter them. However, the Jedi continued on their trek, so Sihn and nine other Raining Leaves members set up a trap for them, preparing to trap them in a rockfall. The Jedi noticed the trap and avoided the falling rocks, but they were instantly surprised by the appearance of the several Witches and their rancors, as the Skywalkers had only expected to see the Witch they had previously encountered. Luke Skywalker attempted to speak with Sihn, but the Jedi were quickly attacked.

Meanwhile, the Solos and their guides arrived the scene, joining the fight against the Witches. The Jedi-allied force quickly overcame the Dathomiri Witches, incapacitating them and ending the fight. After the Witches had been tied up, Luke Skywalker introduced himself to Sihn. Remembering the assistance he had rendered the Dathomir Witches in previous years, she declared him and his friends as counselors, making them participants in the upcoming conclave.

entities.name: Invasion of Dearic
entities.description:
The Invasion of Dearic was an invasion by the Alliance to Restore the Republic to retake the Talusian city of Dearic in the year 1 ABY, in an attempt to free the Talusian people from an Imperial presence in the region. The primary target for the Alliance was an Imperial General, who was vital to the Empire's efforts. They figured that taking him out would cripple Imperial operations in the area. The only way that such a move would be successful was to take the city by an invasion, as the Imperials possessed a sizable defense - an entire battalion of stormtroopers were stationed in the city.

Once the Alliance had the signal to attack, they attacked from various sections of the city - primarily by the starport to the west, the hotel to the east, and the theater to the south. Unfortunately for the Rebels, Imperial spies had already stolen the plans for the assault and the Imperials erected several choke points where the Rebels were significantly halted in their advance. Heavy fighting erupted outside the starport and just beyond the hotel. Many on both sides were soon seen wounded, demoralized or both. Medics rushed in to aid the wounded, and certain troopers entertained and rallied the demoralized troopers. As the Imperial lines of defenses fell, the Imperial troopers were soon forced to fall back deeper with in the city, and soon the remaining squadron of Imperial troopers retreated to the General.

The Imperials made one brilliant last stand -- they fought with all they had and kept the lines of defense together as best they could, but now they were too concentrated and cornered. While the Rebels had suffered heavy casualties, they still had an edge in numbers. The remaining Imperials were placed under a barrage of trooper and tank fire, and the defensive structures soon gave way. The Imperials eliminated many Alliance troops, but eventually the Imperial General had fallen. With the battle over, the Imperials attempted to retreat, which itself was a challenge. Many Imperials fell in the aftermath of the battle and their attempt to retreat, though a few had managed to survive the battle.

entities.name: Ambush near the Degan Gas Clouds
entities.description:
In 1 ABY, the Khuiumin Survivors ambushed the Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Brazen near the Degan Gas Clouds.

The Imperial II-class Star Destroyer Brazen managed to escape the battle and went to Derilyn to receive temporary repairs on its engines at the facilities of the Derilyn Space Defense Platform. The plan was to perform limited repairs on the Star Destroyer so that it would be able to reach a fully-equipped Imperial Navy shipyard, most probably a deepdock facility located towards the Metharian Nebula. However, the Brazen was destroyed by Rebel agents who infiltrated the Derilyn Space Defense Platform.

entities.name: Attack on Demir
entities.description:
During the era of the New Republic, the First Order launched an attack on the iron planet Demir in the Unknown Regions.

On the iron planet Demir, First Order stormtroopers, an AT-ST and TIE/sf space superiority fighters engaged Demirian warriors and ships. Captain Phasma led the stormtroopers into battle, taking down some of the Demirians. Phasma then told the stormtroopers that the AT-ST would clear the path to the Demirian stronghold. She then ordered the stormtroopers to be ready and not hesitate. Phasma then delivered a speech to the troops, stating they were another gun that she held. She went on to tell them that if their aim was not true, if the falter, they were no longer worthy of being held in her hand and no longer worthy to serve the First Order.

A stormtrooper warned Phasma about an incoming Demirian ship, causing Phasma to order the stormtroopers to get down as the ship was charging up to fire. The ship released a massive blast that destroyed the AT-ST and sent the stormtroopers to the ground. KM-8713 woke up and removed their helmet. They notice DB-7197, a trooper they went through basic training with, on the ground and helped him get up. As many of the injured troopers began to get up, KM-8713 reassured DB-7197 that they started this together and they would not leave him behind. However, Phasma then told KM-8713 to leave DB-7197 behind, although KM-8713 insisted that he would not slow them down. Phasma told the trooper that she had ordered them to leave him behind, but before she could finish, KM-8713 warned her of an ambushing Demirian. KM-8713 eliminated the Demirian with their F-11D blaster rifle, but the falling Demirian dropped a thermal detonator. Phasma grabbed DB-7197 and threw im on the thermal detonator as KM-8713 exclaimed in horror. The trooper's body covered the thermal detonator as it exploded, allowing Phasma and KM-8713 to survive the explosion. Phasma then informed KM-8713 they were pulling out to regroup, adding that KM-8713 will report to her command shuttle to discuss what occurred in the battle.

entities.description:
In 9 ABY, a dogfight occurred between Morgan Elsbeth's forces and former Jedi Padawan and Fulcrum agent Ahsoka Tano in the Denab system, where Tano and her apprentice Sabine Wren discovered the Eye of Sion. At Morgan Elsbeth's command, the Force-sensitive mercenaries Shin Hati and Marrok led a starfighter squadron against Tano and Wren, and attempted to destroy the T-6 1974 shuttle carrying the Jedi and her student. During the dogfight, Tano's droid Huyang scanned the Eye of Sion which was a large hyperspace transport ring, but her T-6 shuttle was damaged in the process. Hati's squadron pursued the Jedi to the planet Seatos where both parties encountered and maneuvered around several purrgil. Ultimately the Jedi escaped from Hati and Marrok, whose squadmates were killed during the battle.

entities.name: Battle at the Denarii Nova
entities.description:
The battle at the Denarii Nova was fought in the Denarii system at the end of the Great Hyperspace War in 5000 BBY.

Following his defeat at Korriban, the Dark Lord of the Sith Naga Sadow set course for the Denarii system aboard his Derriphan-class battleship, the Corsair. Pursued by Galactic Republic forces, Sadow maneuvered his damaged flagship between the binary stars of the Denarii Nova. The Sith sorcerer then used his powers to manipulate the solar flares of the Denarii Nova. The resulting explosion destroyed the Republic ships in his wake and allowed him to stage his own death.

This cataclysmic event also resulted in the destruction of the entire system, which created a nebula of highly ionized gases known as the Denarii Nebula.

In the aftermath of the battle, Sadow, his Sith followers, and his Massassi crew settled on the jungle moon Yavin 4.

entities.name: Battle of Denova
entities.description:
In 3639 BBY, during the Galactic War between the reconstituted Sith Empire and the Galactic Republic, the Empire invaded the planet Denova for its baradium reserves. As the Empire lacked the ships to hold the planet's airspace, they landed an entire battalion on the surface, and the Republic was forced to hire the Trandoshan mercenary army known as the Warstalkers to fight back against the Empire. The battle raged for almost three months, but the six Sith Lords known as the Dread Masters used their powers to enslave the Trandoshans' leader, Kephess, and the Imperial army. The Republic and the Empire both investigated the disappearance of Kephess and the Imperial forces, and the battle ended with Kephess's defeat and death—albeit a temporary one, as the Dread Masters resurrected him as Kephess the Undying.

entities.name: Ambush of a rebel convoy at Derra
entities.description:
The ambush of a rebel convoy at Derra was a clash between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and Galactic Empire that occurred at the Derra during the Empire's search for the rebel base after the Battle of Yavin. Although the ambush did not provide the Empire with the location of the base, it fit together with chatter about increased rebel operations in the region that had been tracked by Imperial Intelligence. Following the ambush, the Imperial search for the rebel base intensified. although it was true that she already had a connection to that vessel.

The ambush of a rebel convoy at Derra was mentioned within the canon source Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy. This Legends battle had previously been referenced in canon through Star Wars Helmet Collection 3 as an ambush on Red Squadron. However, no canon source has linked the ambush of a rebel convoy and the ambush on Red Squadron at this time.

More detail was provided about the battle in canon in the book Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire by Doctor Chris Kempshall, which is framed as an in-universe text by historian Beaumont Kin. According the book, the battle saw Rae Sloane promoted from the rank of Vice Admiral to a full admiral. and "Lord Vader Will See You Now" establish she was still a commodore in the aftermath of the Battle of Hoth, which occurs after the ambush. Further, the book alleges that Sloane was in command of the Vigilance during the battle, which she only received command of in the short story "Lord Vader Will See You Now." However, she did already have a history with the ship according to the video game Star Wars: Squadrons.

Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy

entities.description:
"Backstabber" was a human TIE fighter pilot in the Galactic Empire's Black Squadron who served as the wingman of Darth Vader during the Battle of Yavin. He was shot down by Han Solo when Vader was following Luke Skywalker and his X-wing starfighter who was trying to destroy the Death Star.

At the battle, during which the Rebel pilots attacked the Death Star, Vader ordered Backstabber and Mithel to be his wingman. Vader pursued Red Squadron as they targeted the thermal exhaust port, a flaw in the Death Star put in place by Imperial scientist Galen Erso, which would allow a precision shot to destroy the main reactor, destroying the station.

Vader, along with several other Imperial pilots, destroyed or disabled the attacking Rebel ships, with the exception of Luke Skywalker. As Vader and his wingmen targeted Skywalker, the Millennium Falcon, piloted by Han Solo, engaged the Imperials, shooting down Backstabber. His death caught Vader by surprise, and led Mithel to attempt to evade the attacker, clipping Vader's TIE Advanced x1 in the process before crashing into the Death Star. With Vader's ship damaged and incapacitated, he fled the battle, while Skywalker fired a proton torpedo into the thermal exhaust port, destroying the Death Star.

"Backstabber" was the nickname of a human Corellia stationed on board the Death Star superweapon when it traveled to the Yavin system to destroy the rebel headquarters on the moon Yavin 4.

entities.name: "Midnight"
entities.description:
"Midnight" was the nickname of a human male fighter pilot of the First Order who flew under the callsign Omega Leader and commanded Omega Squadron, At one point, "Midnight" flew above a terrestrial body and was fired upon. Midnight was equipped with a First Order pilot uniform, had fair skin and dark blonde hair.

entities.description:
"One Eye" was an aged bounty hunter who owned the Meltdown Café on Nar Shaddaa before turning the reins over to Uralak for hunting one final bounty.

entities.name: "Pure Sabacc"
entities.description:
"Pure Sabacc" was an Imperial TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter pilot during the Galactic Civil War. He had parted short hair and a beard. At one point, he was dispatched on a mission to a mountainous planet during a blizzard.

entities.name: "Duchess"
entities.description:
"Duchess" was an Imperial TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter pilot during the Galactic Civil War. She had light skin and shoulder-length brown hair. Duchess had been stationed on Scarif, and during the resulting battle between Imperial and Rebel forces, she provided aerial support, flying over an All Terrain Armored Cargo Transport.
